englishTitle: ALL HAIL THE POWER OF JESUS' NAME

sections.text:
Crown Him, ye martyrs of
our God
Who from His altar call;
Who from His altar call;
Extol Him in whose path
ye trod
And crown Him Lord of all.

Ye seed of Israel's chosen race
Ye ransomed from the fall,
Ye ransomed from the fall,
Hail Him who saves you
by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all.

Sinners! whose love can
ne'er forget
The worm wood and the gall;
The worm wood and the gall;
Go spread your trophies at
His feet
And crown Him Lord of all.

Let every kindred, every tribe
On this terrestrial ball,
On this terrestrial ball,
To Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him Lord of all.

O that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall,
We at His feet may fall,
Join in the everlasting song,
And crown Him Lord of all!
Amen

Gbogbo ayé gbé Jésù ga,
Angel', ẹ wólẹ fún Un:
Ẹ mú adé Ọba Rẹ wá,
S'É l'ọba àwọn Ọba.

Ẹ s'É l'ọba ẹyin Martyr,
Ti ń pè ní pẹpẹ Rẹ:
Gbe gbongbo igi Jésè ga,
S'É l'ọba àwọn Ọba.

Ẹyin irú ọmọ Israel',
Tí a ti ràpadà;
Ẹ kí Ẹni t'ó gbà yin là,
S'É l'ọba àwọn Ọba.

Gbogbo ènìyàn ẹlẹṣẹ
Rántí 'bànújẹ yín;
Ẹ tẹ 'kógun yín s'ẹsẹ Rẹ
S'É l'ọba àwọn Ọba.

Kí gbogbo orílẹ èdè,
Ní gbogbo àgbáyé;
Kí wọn kí, “Kábíyèsílẹ”
S'É l'ọba àwọn Ọba.

À bá lè pẹl' àwọn t'ọrun,
Láti máa júbà Rẹ;
K'á bá lè júmọ kọrin,
S'É l'ọba àwọn Ọba.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: PRAISE HIM, PRAISE HIM
yorubaTitle: FI ÌYÌN FÚN JÉSÙ, OLÙRÀPADÀ WA

sections.text:
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Jesus our blessed Redeemer,
Sing, O earth, His
wonderful; love proclaim.
Hail Him! Hail Him!
Highest archangels in glory,
Strength and honour give to
His holy name,
Like a shepherd, Jesus will
guard His children,
In His arms He carries them
all day long
O ye saints that dwell on the
mountain of Zion
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Ever in joyful song!

Praise Him! Praise Him,
Jesus our blessed Redeemer,
For our sins He suffered
and bled and died;
He, our rock, our hope of eternal
salvation,
Hail Him! Hail Him! Jesus,
the Crucified.
Loving Saviour,
meekly enduring sorrow
Crowned with thorns that
cruelly pierced His brow;
Once for us rejected,
despised and forsaken,
Prince of Glory ever
triumphant now.

Praise Him, Praise Him,
Jesus our blessed Redeemer,
Heavenly portals loud with
hosannas ring;
Jesus, Saviour, reigneth
for ever and ever,
Crown Him, crown Him,
Prophet and Priest and King!
Death is vanquished! Tell it
with joy, ye faithful
Where is now thy victory,
boasting grave?
Jesus lives! No longer thy
portals are cheerless,
Jesus lives, the mighty and
strong to save. Amen.

Fi ìyìn fún Jésù,
Olùràpadà wa,
Kí ayé k'ókikí ìfẹ Rẹ ńlá;
Fi ìyìn fún Un! Ẹyin Ańgẹli ologo,
F'ọlá àt' ògo fún orúkọ Rẹ,
B'Olús'àgùntàn,
Jésù y'ó tọ ọmọ Rẹ,
L'àpa Rẹ l' Ó ń gbé wọn
lé l'ojọojo;
Ẹyin èniyàn mímọ ti ń
gb'òkè Síon',
Fi ìyìn fún Un pẹlú orin ayọ.

Fi ìyìn fún, Jésù
Olùràpadà wa,
Fún wa, Ó t'ẹjẹ Rẹ silẹ, Ó kú,
Òun ni àpàta, àti 'rètí
'gbàlà wa,
Yin Jésù tí a kàn
m' ágbélébùú;
Olùgbàlà t'Ó fara da ìrora ńlá,
Tí a fi adé ẹgun dé lórí,
Ẹni tí a pa nítórí àwa ẹdá,
Ọba ògo ń jọba títí láéláé.

Fi ìyìn fún, Jesu
Olurapada wa
Ki ariwo iyin gba orun kan,
Jesu Oluwa ń jọba lae ati
laelae,
Se l' Oba gbogb'eyin alagbara;
A sẹgun iku: fi ayo royin
naá ka,
Isẹgun rẹ ha da, isa oku?
Jesu ye ko tun si wahala
fun wa mo
‘Tori O l'agbara lati gbala. Ààmín.

englishTitle: PRAISE THE KING OF GLORY

sections.text:
Praise the King of Glory,
He is God alone:
Praise Him for the wonders,
He to us hath shown;
For His promised presence,
all the pilgrim way;
For the flaming pillar,
and the cloud by day.

Praise... Him, shining angels
Strike ... your harps of gold.
All... His hosts adore Him,
Who... His face behold
Through ... His great dominion,
While... the ages roll.
All His works shall praise Him (3ce)
Bless the Lord, my soul

Praise Him for redemption,
free to every soul;
Praise Him for the Fountain
that can make us whole:
For His gifts of kindness and
His loving care,
For the blest assurance that
He answers prayer.

Praise Him for the trials sent
as cords of love,
Binding us more closely to
the things above;
For the faith that conquers,
hope that naught can dim,
For the land where loved ones
gather unto Him. Amen.

Ẹ yin Ọba Ogo,
Òun ni Ọlorun,
Yìn Ín fún 'ṣẹ 'yanu ti
Ó ti fi han,
Ó wà pẹl'awon ero
mimọ l'ọna,
Ó sì jẹ imọlẹ wọn
l'ọsan l'oru

Ẹyin angẹli dídán,
lu duru wura,
Kí gbogbo yin juba
T'ẹ ń wo oju Rẹ,
Ni gbogbo 'jọba Rẹ,
B'aye ti ń yi lo.
Isẹ Rẹ y'o máa yin,
Isẹ Rẹ y'o máa yin,
Fi ibukun fun Oluwa
ọkan mi.

Ẹ yin fún 'rapada,
ti gbogbo ọkan,
Ẹ yin fún orísun ìmúláradá,
Fún inú rere àti ìtọju Rẹ,
Fún 'dánilójú pé
Ó ń gbọ àdúrà.

Ẹ yin fún ìdánwò,
bí okùn ìfẹ,
T'ó ń so wa pọ mọ
àwọn ohun t'ọrun,
Fún 'gbàgbọ tí ń sẹgun ‘rètí
tí kíí sá.
Fún ilé ògo t' Ó ti pèsè
fún wa. Ààmín.

englishTitle: OH FOR A THOUSAND TONGUES

sections.text:
Oh for a thousand tongues to sing
My dear Redeemer's praise
The glories of my God and King;
The triumphs of His grace!

He breaks the pow'r of cancell'd sin,
And sets the prisoner free;
His blood can make the foulest clean
His blood avail'd for me,

He speaks and, listening to His voice
New life the dead receive;
The mournful broken hearts rejoice,
The humble poor believe.

Hear Him, ye deaf, His praise ye dumb,
Your loosen'd tongues employ;
Ye blind behold your Saviour come.
And leap, ye lame, for joy!

My gracious Master and my God,
Assist me to proclaim
And spread through all the earth abroad,
The honours of Thy name.
Amen.

Èmi 'bá n'ẹgbẹrun ahọn,
Fún 'yin Olùgbàlà,
Ògo Ọlọrun Ọba mi
Ìṣẹgun oore Rẹ.

Jèsù t'ó ṣẹru wa d'ayọ
T'ó mú bànújẹ tán
Orin ni l'eti ẹlẹṣẹ
Iye at'ilera.

Ó ṣẹgun agbara ẹṣẹ
Ó da onde silẹ;
Ẹjẹ Rẹ le w'elèèérí mọ,
Ẹjẹ Rẹ seun fún mi.

Ó sọrọ okú gb'ohùn Rẹ
O gba ẹmi titun;
Onirobinújẹ y'ayọ,
Òtosi si gbagbọ.

Baba mi at'Ọlọrun mi,
Fun mi ni 'ranwọ Rẹ;
Ki n le rò ká gbogbo ayé,
Ọla orukọ Rẹ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: PRAISE, MY SOUL THE KING OF HEAVEN

sections.text:
Praise, my soul the King of heaven;
To His feet thy tribute bring
Ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven,
Who like thee His praise should sing?
Praise Him, Praise Him
Praise the everlasting King.

Angels, in the heights, adore Him;
Ye behold Him face to face:
Sun and moon, bow down before Him;
Dwellers all in time and space
Praise Him, Praise Him
Praise with us the God of grace.
Amen

Ọkan mi yin Ọba ọrun,
Mú ọrẹ wá s'ọdọ Rẹ
'Wọ t'á wòsàn, t'á dáríjì
Tá l'à bá ha yin bí Rẹ?
Yin Olúwa, Yin Olúwa,
Yin Ọba àìnípẹkun.

Yìn Ín fún àánú t'o ti fí han
F'áwọn Baba ń'nu pọnju;
Yin Ín Ọkan náà ní titi
Ó lọra láti bínú,
Yin Olúwa, Yin Olúwa,
Ológo ń'nú òtítọ.

Bí baba ni Ó ń tọju wa,
Ó sì mọ àìlera wa;
Jẹjẹ l' Ó ń gbé wa l'ápa Rẹ
Ó gbà wá lọwọ ọtá,
Yin Olúwa, Yin Olúwa,
Àánú Rẹ, yí ayé ká.

Áńgẹl, ẹ jùmọ bá wa bọ,
Ẹyin ń rí l lójúkojú
Ọ̀run, Òsùpá, ẹ wólẹ
Àti gbogbo àgbáyé,
Ẹ bá wa yin Ín, Ẹ bá wa yin Ín,
Ọlọrun Olótìítọ.
Ààmín

englishTitle: LET US WITH A GLADSOME MIND

sections.text:
Let us with a gladsome mind,
Praise the Lord, for He is kind;
For His mercies still endure
Ever faithful, ever sure.

He, with all-commanding might,
Filled the new-made world
with light;
For His mercies still endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

All things living He doth feed,
His full hand supplies their need:
For His mercies still endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

He His chosen race did bless
In the wasteful wilderness:
For His mercies still endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

Let us then with gladsome mind
Praise the Lord, for He is kind:
For His mercies still endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure. Amen.

Ẹ jẹ k'á f'inú dídùn,
Yin Olúwa Olóore,
Àánú Rẹ, ó wà títí,
L'ódodo dájúdájú.

Òun nípa agbára Rẹ,
F'ìmọlẹ s'áyé titun,
Àánu Rẹ, ó wà títí,
L'ódodo dájúdájú.

O ń bọ gbogb'ẹda 'laaye,
O ń pese fun aini, won
Àánu Rẹ, ó wà títí,
L'ódodo dájúdájú.

O bukun ayanfe Rẹ,
Li aginju iparun,
Àánu Rẹ, ó wà títí,
L'ódodo dájúdájú.

Ẹ jẹ k'á f'inú dídùn
Yin Oluwa Oloore,
Àánu Rẹ, ó wà títí,
L'ódodo dájúdájú. Ààmín.

englishTitle: PRAISE TO THE LORD, THE ALMIGHTY

sections.text:
Praise to the Lord, the Almighty,
the King of creation;
O my soul, praise Him for
He is thy health and salvation;
All ye who hear,
Brothers and sisters draw near,
Praise Him in glad adoration.

Praise to the Lord, who o'er all
Things so wondrously reigneth,
Shelters thee under His wings,
yea, so gently sustaineth.
Hast thou not seen?
All that is needful hath been;
Granted in what he ordaineth.

Praise to the Lord,
who doth prosper
Thy work and defend thee;
Surely His goodness and mercy
here daily attend thee;
Ponder anew
What the Almighty can do,
If with His love He
befriends thee.

Praise to the Lord! O let all that
is in me adore Him
All that hath life and breath,
come now with praises
Before Him!
Let the Amen
Sound from His people again:
Gladly for aye we adore Him.
Amen.

Yin Oluwa Olodumare,
Ọba Elẹda
Yin In ọkan mi to
r'Oun ni 'lera ati 'gbala rẹ
Arakunrin,
Arabinrin sun mọ 'hin
F'ayo at orin juba Rẹ.

Yin Oluwa, Ẹni t'o joba
lor'ohun gbogbo
To daabo bo, to si gbe ọ ro
Labe iye Rẹ
O ha ri pe
Gbogb'ohun to tọ lo se?
B'o ti la'na n'ipilese.

Yin Oluwa to ń bukun
'Sẹ rẹ to si ń gbèjà rẹ;
L'otitọ ire ati àánu
Re ń tọ ọ lẹyin
'Gbà náà ronu
Ohun t'Oluwa le se
Eni tó fẹ ọ, t'O yan ọ.

Yin Oluwa! Ki gbogb' ẹya
ara mi juba Rẹ
Ki gbogbo ohun t'o l'ẹmi
Wa pẹlu iyin Rẹ.
Jẹ ki iro
Ààmín dun jakejado,
Layo lao juba Re titi.
Ààmín

englishTitle: O MAGNIFY THE LORD WITH ME

sections.text:
O Magnify the Lord with me,
Ye people of His choice!
Let all to whom He lendeth
breath;
Now in His name rejoice;
For love's blest revelation,
For rest from condemnation,
For uttermost salvation,
To Him give thanks.

Let all... the people praise Thee,
Let all... the people praise Thee!
Let all.... the people praise
Thy name
Forever and for evermore
Forever more O Lord!
Let all... the people praise Thee
Let all... the people praise Thee
Let all... the people praise
Thy name
Forever and for evermore.

O praise Him for His holiness,
His wisdom and His grace;
Sing praises for the precious blood
Which ransom'd all our race;
In tenderness He sought us,
From depths of sin He brought us,
The way of life then taught us,
To Him give thanks.

Had I a thousand tongues to sing,
The half could ne'er be told
Of love so rich, so full and free,
Of blessings manifold;
Of grace that faileth never,
Peace flowing as a river
From God the glorious Giver,
To Him give thanks. Amen.

Gbe Oluwa ga pẹlu mi
Ẹyin eniyan Rẹ
Ki gbogbo ẹda alààye
Máa yọ l'orukọ Rẹ
Fun ifẹ ti O ń fihan
Fun isinmi l'ọkan wa
Fun igbala kikun Rẹ,
Tirẹ l'ọpẹ.

Ki gbogbo wa f'ọpẹ fun Un,
Ki gbogbo wa f'ọpẹ fun Un,
Ki gbogbo wa yin orukọ
Oluwa wa
Títí láéláé, àni, titi láéláé.
Ki gbogbo wa f'ọpẹ fun Un
Ki gbogbo wa f'ọpẹ fun Un
Ki gbogbo wa yin
orukọ Oluwa wa
Titi láéláé.

Ẹ yìn Ín fun iwa-mimọ Rẹ,
Fun oore-ọfẹ Rẹ,
Kọrin ìyin fun ẹjẹ Rẹ
T'o fi ra wa pada
Ifẹ lo fi wá wa rí
Ninu irà ẹṣẹ wa,
O ọna iye han wa
Ẹ f'ọpẹ fun Un.

Emi 'ba l'ẹgbẹrun ahọn
N kò lè royin ná tan;
Ifẹ Rẹ si mi pọ jọjọ,
Aago 'bukun mi ń kun,
Oore-ọfẹ ti kíí yẹ,
Aláàfià bí odo
Lat'ọdọ Olubukun;
E f'ọpẹ fun Un. Ààmín

englishTitle: WHEN ALL THY MERCIES, O MY GOD

sections.text:
When all Thy mercies, O my God,
My rising soul surveys,
Transported with the view, I’m lost
In wonder, love and praise.

Unnumbered comforts on my soul
Thy tender care bestowed
Before my infant heart conceived
From whom these comforts flowed.

When in the slippery paths of youth
With heedless steps I ran,
Thine arm, unseen, conveyed me safe,
And led me up to man.

Through hidden dangers,
toils, and deaths,
It gently cleared my way;
And through the pleasing
snares of vice,
More to be feared than they.

When worn with sickness oft
hast Thou
With health renewed my face;
And when in sins and sorrows
sunk,
Revived my soul with grace.

Ten thousand thousand
precious gifts,
My daily thanks employ;
Nor is the least a cheerful heart
That tastes those gifts with joy.

Through every period of
my life,
Thy goodness I'll pursue,
And after death, in distant
worlds,
The glorious theme renew.

Through all eternity to Thee
A joyful song I'll raise;
But oh, eternity's too short
To utter all Thy praise. Amen.

Ọlọrun, 'gba t'ọkàn mi wo,
Gbogbo àánú Rẹ ńla,
Iran náà mu ki emi kun
Fun 'yanu 'fẹ iyin.

Ìtọju Rẹ fi àìmoye,
Ìtunu f'ọkan mi,
K'ọkan ọmọde mi to mọ
'Bi ti 'rẹ náà ti ń san.

L'ọna yiyo ọdọmọde
Mo sare láìwoye;
Ọwọ àánu Rẹ l'o tọ mi
Titi mo fi dàgbà.

Láàrin ewu, ati iku,
O ń tọ isise mi;
Ati ń'nu ikekun ẹṣẹ,
T'o li ẹru julọ.

Nigba t'aisan ję mi l'ara,
'Wọ tun fun mi l'okun
'Wọ f'oor'ọfẹ mu mi sọji
'Gbat' ẹṣẹ bori mi.

Fun ẹgbẹẹgbẹrun ẹbun Rẹ,
Mo ń sọpẹ l'ojọojọ;
Ati f'okan t'o m'oore Rẹ,
Ti ń gba wọn pẹl'ayọ.

Ni gbogbo igba aye mi,
N ó lepa oore Rẹ;
Lẹhin iku, l'aye ti ń bọ
N ó tun oore Rẹ sọ.

N ó máa kọrin ọpẹ si Ọ,
Titi ayeraye;
Sùgbọn ayérayé kò tó
Sọ gbogbo ìyin Rẹ! Ààmín

englishTitle: ALL PEOPLE THAT ON EARTH
yorubaTitle: GBOGBO ẸYIN TI Ń GBÉ AYÉ

sections.text:
All people that on earth do
dwell,
Sing to the Lord with cheerful
voice;
Him serve with mirth, His
praise forth tell;
Come ye before Him and
rejoice.

Know that the Lord is God indeed:
Without our aid He did us make;
We are His flock,
He doth us feed,
And for His sheep He doth us take.

Oh enter then His gates with Praise,
Approach with joy His courts unto;
Praise, laud, and bless His name always,
For it is seemly so to do.

Gbogbo ẹyin ti ń gbe ayé
Ẹ f'ayo korin s'Oluwa
F'ìbẹru sin In, ẹ yin In l'ogo
Ẹ f'ayo wa si ọdọ Rẹ.

Oluwa, Oun ni Olorun
Laisi ’ranwo wa, O da wa
Agbo Rẹ ni wa, O ń bọ wa
O si fi wa s'agutan Rẹ.

Nje, f'iyin wọ ile Rẹ wa
F'ayọ sun mọ agbala Rẹ
F'ibukun fun oruko Rẹ
'Tori o yẹ lati se bẹẹ.

Ẹni rere l'Olorun wa
Àánú Rẹ, ó wà títí láé
Otítọ Rẹ kò sì le yẹ
O dúró lát'iran-dé-ran. Àámín

englishTitle: GREAT IS THY FAITHFULNESS!

sections.text:
Great is Thy faithfulness!
O God, my Father!
There is no shadow of turning with Thee;
Thou changeth not, Thy compassions, they fail not,
As Thou hast been Thou forever wilt be.
Great is Thy faithfulness!
Great is Thy faithfulness!
Morning by morning new mercies I see,
All I have needed Thy hand hath provided
Great is Thy faithfulness,
Lord, unto me!

Summer and winter, and spring time and harvest,
Sun, moon and stars in their courses above,
Join with all nature in manifold witness,
To Thy great faithfulness, mercy and love.

Pardon for sin and a peace that endureth
Thine own dear presence to cheer and to guide!
Strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow.
Blessings all mine, with ten thousands beside! Amen

Otítọ Rẹ tóbì,
Ọlọrun Baba!
Kò sì àyídà kan ní ọdọ Rẹ;
'Wọ kíí yí padà, ìfẹ Rẹ
kíí síí sá
B'íwo ti wà, Ìwọ yóó sì wà
Otítọ Rẹ tóbì!
Otítọ Rẹ tóbì!
Ni ojọojúmọ àánú
Rẹ ń pọ síi;
Gbogbo àìní mi l'ọwọ
Rẹ ń bá pàdé
Otítọ Rẹ tóbì nín'ayé mi!

Ẹ̀rùn àt'òjò, àt'ìgbà ìkórè,
Oòrun, òsùpá àti ìràwọ,
Dara pọ pẹlú ẹdá wọn sì ń jẹri
P'óòótọ, àánú àt'ìfẹ Rẹ tóbi.

Dáríjì ẹṣẹ àt'àlàáfíà pípé,
Ìfarahàn Rẹ dídùn ló ń tọ wa,
Agbára àti ìrètí fún ọla
'Bùkún fún ni pẹlú ẹgbẹẹgbẹrun! Ààmín.

englishTitle: HEAD OF THE CHURCH TRIUMPHANT

sections.text:
Head of the church triumphant,
We joyfully adore Thee;
Till Thou appear,
Thy members here
Shall sing like those in glory;
We lift our hearts and voices,
With bless'd anticipation,
And cry aloud, and give to God
The praise of our salvation.

While in affliction's furnace,
And passing through the fire,
Thy love we praise in grateful lays,
Which ever brings us higher:
We clap our hands, exulting
In Thine almighty favour:
The love divine, that made us Thine,
Shall keep us Thine for ever.

Thou dost conduct Thy people
Through torrents of temptation:
Nor will we fear, while
Thou art near,
The fire of tribulation;
The world, with sin and Satan,
In vain our march opposes,
By Thee we shall break
through them all,
And sing the song of Moses.

By faith we see the glory
To which Thou shalt restore us,
The world despise, for that
high prize
Which thou hast set before us,
And, if Thou count us worthy
We each, with dying Stephen
Shall see Thee stand at God's
right hand,
To call us up to heaven. Amen.

'Gbà t'á wà ninu pọnju
T'a ń koja ninu iná
Orin ife l'awa o kọ
Ti o ń mu wa sun mọ Ọ;
Awa sápẹ, a si yọ
Ninu ojurere Rẹ
Ifẹ t'o sọ wa di Tirẹ
Yóó se wa ni Tirẹ laé

Iwọ mu awọn eniyàn Rẹ
Koja isan idanwo:
A ki o beru wahala
'Tori O wa nitosi,
Aye, ẹṣẹ, at'esu,
Kọ 'ju'ja si wa lasan,
L'agbara Rẹ, a o ṣẹgun
A o si kọ orin Mose.

Awa f'igbagbo r'ogo
Ti o tun ń fẹ fi wa si,
Awa kẹgan aye 'tori
Èrè ńlá iwaju wa:
Bi o ba si ka wa yẹ,
Awa pelu Stefen t'o sun
Yóó ri Ọ bi O ti duro;
Lati pe wa lọ s'ọrun. Ààmín.

englishTitle: TO GOD BE THE GLORY

sections.text:
To God be the glory, great
things He hath done,
So loved He the world that He
gave us His Son,
Who yielded His life an
atonement for sin,
And opened the Life Gate that
all may go in.

Praise the Lord!
Praise the Lord!
Let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord!
Praise the Lord!
Let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father,
through Jesus the Son;
And give Him the glory!
Great things, He hath done!

O perfect redemption, the purchase of blood
To every believer the promise of God;
The vilest offender who truly believes,
That moment from Jesus a pardon receives.

Great things He hath taught us, Great things He hath done,
And great our rejoicing through Jesus the Son;
But purer, and higher, and greater will be
Our wonder, our transport when Jesus we see. Amen.

Ògo ni f'Olúwa tó se
ọhun ńlá,
Ìfẹ l'Ó mú k' Ó fún wa ní
Ọmọ Rẹ,
Ẹni t' Ó fẹmi Rẹ lé'lẹ f'ẹṣẹ wa;
T' Ó sì sílẹkùn ìyè sílẹ fún wa.

Yin Olúwa, Yin Olúwa,
F'iyìn fún Olúwa,
Yin Olúwa, Yin Olúwa,
Ẹ yo ní'wájú Rẹ,
K'á tọ Baba wa lọ
l'órúkọ Jésù,
Jẹ k'á jọ f'ògo fún
Onísẹ 'yanu

Ìràpadà kíkún ti ẹjẹ Rẹ rà,
F'ẹnikẹni t'ó gba ìlérí Rẹ gbọ,
Ẹni t'ó buru jù b'ó bá lè gbàgbọ,
Lójú kan nàà yóó rí ìdáríjì gbà.

Ó s' ohun ílá fún wa,
Ó dá wa l'ọlá,
Ayo wa di kíkún nínú Ọmọ Rẹ,
Ogo àti ẹwa ìràpadà yìí;
Yóó yà wá lẹnú 'gbà t'á bá rí Jésù. Ààmín.

englishTitle: BE GLAD IN THE LORD, AND REJOICE
yorubaTitle: Ẹ YO Ń'NU OLUWA, Ẹ YO

sections.text:
Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice.
All ye that are upright in heart,
And ye that have made Him your choice,
Bid sadness and sorrow depart.

Rejoice! Rejoice!
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice,
Rejoice! Rejoice!!
Be glad in the Lord and rejoice.

What though in the conflict for right,
Your enemies almost prevail!
God's armies, just hid from your sight,
Are more than the foes which assail.

Though darkness surrounds you by day,
Your sky by the night be o'er cast
Let nothing your spirit dismay,
But trust till the danger is past.

Be glad in the Lord and rejoice,
His praises proclaiming in song;
With harp, and with organ, And voice
The loud hallelujahs prolong!
Amen

Ẹ yo ń'nú Oluwa, ẹ yo:
Ẹyin t'ọkan rẹ se déédé
Ẹyin to ti yan Oluwa.
Le'banuje at'aro lọ.

Ẹ yo! Ẹ yo!
Ẹ yo ń'nu Oluwa, Ẹ yo!
Ẹ yo! Ẹ yo! Ẹ yo ń'nu Oluwa, e yo!

Ẹ yo 'tori Oun l'Oluwa
L'aye ati l'ọrun pẹlu;
Ọrọ Rẹ bor'ohun gbogbo
O l'agbara lati gbala.

'Gbat' e ba ń ja ija rere,
Ti ọta fẹrẹ bori yin;
Ogun Ọlọrun t'ẹ ko ri
Pọ ju awọn ọta yin lọ.

B'okunkun tile yi o ka,
Pẹlu isudẹdẹ gbogbo,
Ma se jẹ k'okan re dààmu,
Sa gbekẹl'Oluwa d'opin.

Ẹ yọ n'nu Oluwa, ẹ yo:
Ẹ kọrin iyin Rẹ kikan;
Fi duru ati ohun kọ ọ
Aleluya l'ohun gooro.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: NOW THANK WE ALL OUR GOD

sections.text:
Now thank we all our God,
With hearts and hands and voices,
Who wondrous things hath done,
In whom His world rejoices;
Who from our mothers' arms
Hath bless'd us on our way
With countless gifts of love
And still is ours today.

Oh may this bounteous God
Through all our lives be near us,
With ever joyful hearts
And blessed peace to cheer us;
And keep us in His grace,
And guide us when perplex'd
And free us from all ills
In this world and the next.

All praise and thanks to God
The Father now be given,
The Son, and Holy Ghost
Supreme in highest heaven,
The One eternal God,
Whom earth and heav'n adore,
For thus it was, is now,
And shall be evermore. Amen.

A f'ọpẹ f'Ọlọrun
L'ọkan ati l'ohun wa.
Ẹni s'ohun 'yanu,
N'nu ẹni t'araye ń yọ;
'Gbat' a wa l'ọm'ọwọ
Oun náà l'o ń tọju wa
O si ń f'ẹbun ifẹ
Se 'tọju wa sibẹ.

Oba Onib'orẹ
Ma fi wa sile laelae,
Ayo ti ko l'opin
On 'bukun' y'o jẹ ti wa
Pa wa mo nin' oore
To wa, gb'a ba dààmu;
Yọ wa ninu ibi
L'aye ati l'ọrun.

K'a f'iyin oun ọpẹ,
F'Ọlọrun, Baba, Ọmọ,
Ati Ẹmi Mimo;
Ti O ga julo lorun,
Olorun kan laelae,
T'aye at'Ọrun ń bọ,
Bẹẹ l'o wa d'isinyi,
Bẹẹ ni yóó wa laelae.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: COME, YE THANKFUL PEOPLE, COME

sections.text:
We ourselves are God's
own field,
Fruit unto His praise to yield;
Wheat and tares together sown
Unto joy or sorrow grown;
First the blade, and then the ear,
Then the full corn shall appear,
Grant, O harvest Lord, that we
Wholesome grain and pure
may be.

Wa, ẹyin ọlọpẹ, wa,
Gbe orin ikore ga,
Ire gbogbo ti wọle
K'otutu oyẹ to de;
Ọlọrun eleda wa,
L'o ti pese f'aini wa;
Wa k'a rele Ọlọrun
Gbe orin ikore ga.

Oko Ọlọrun l'a jẹ
Lati s'eso iyin Rẹ
Alikama at'epo,
N dagba f'aro tab'ayo
Ehu su, ipẹ tele
Siiri ọka si kẹyin;
Oluwa 'kore mu wa
Jẹ eso rere fun Ọ.

N'tori Ọlọrun wa ń bọ
Yóó si kore Re sile
Oun o gbọn gbogbo panti
Kuro l'oko Re ńjọ náà;
Yóó f'asẹ f'awọn angel'
Lati gba ẹpo s'ina;
Lati ko àlikama
Si aba Rẹ titi lae.

Bẹẹ ni máa wa, Oluwa
Si ikore ikẹyin
Ko awọn èèyan Rẹ jọ
Kuro l'ẹṣẹ at'aro;
Sọ wọn di mimo laelae
Ki wọn le máa ba Ọ gbe
Wa t'Iwọ t'angel' Rẹ
Gbe orin ikore ga. Ààmín.

englishTitle: COME, YE THAT LOVE THE LORD

sections.text:
Come, ye that love the Lord,
And let your joys be known
Join in a song with sweet accord,
Join in a song with sweet accord,
And thus surround the throne,
And thus surround the throne.

We're mar... ching to Zion,
Beautiful, beautiful Zion;
We're marching upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

Let those refuse to sing,
Who never knew our God;
But children of the heavenly King.
But children of the heavenly King,
Must speak their joys abroad,
Must speak their joys abroad.

The hill of Zion yields,
A thousand sacred sweets,
Before we reach the heav'nly fields.
Before we reach the heav'nly fields.
Or walk the golden streets.
Or walk the golden streets.

Then let our songs abound,
And every tear be dry,
We're marching through
Immanuel's ground,
We're marching through
Immanuel's ground,
To fairer world on high,
To fairer world on high. Amen.

Ẹyin t'ẹ fẹ Oluwa,
Ẹ fi ayọ yin han,
Ẹ jumọ kọ orin didun
Ẹ jumọ kọ orin didun
K'ẹ si y'itẹ náà ká,
K'ẹ si y'itẹ náà ká.

A ń yan lo si Sion',
Sion' to l'ewa julo,
A ń yan goke lo si Sion',
Ilu Ọlọrun t'o l'ewa.

Je k'awọn ni má kọrin
Ti ko m'Ọlọrun wa
Sugbon awọn ọmọ Ọba,
Sugbon awọn ọmọ Ọba,
Y'o royin ayọ wọn,
Y'o royin ayọ wọn.

Oke Sion' l'o ń mu
Egberun adun wa
Ki a to de gbangba ọrun
Ki a to de gbangba ọrun,
Pelu 'ta wura re,
Pelu 'ta wura re.

Nje ka máa kọrin lo,
K'omije gbogbo gbe,
A ń yan n'ile Imanuel'
A ń yan n'ile Imanuel'
S'aye dida loke,
S'aye dida loke. Ààmin.

englishTitle: O LORD MY GOD!

sections.text:
O Lord my God!
When I in awesome wonder,
Consider all the works Thy
hands hath made,
I see the stars, I hear the
rolling thunder,
Thy pow'r thro' out the
universe displayed.

Then sings my soul,
My Saviour God to Thee;
How great Thou art,
How great Thou art!
Then sings my soul,
My Saviour God to Thee
How great Thou art,
How great Thou art!

When through the woods
And forest glades I wander,
And hear the birds sing
Sweetly in the trees;
When I look down from
Lofty mountain grandeur,
And hear the brook and feel
The gentle breeze.

And when I think that God,
His Son not sparing,
Sent him to die, I scarce can
Take it in;
That on the cross, my burden
Gladly bearing;
He bled and died to take
Away my sin.

When Christ shall come with
Shout of acclamation,
And take me home,
What joy shall fill my heart!
Then I shall bow in humble
Adoration,
And there proclaim, my God,
How great Thou art!
Amen.

Ọlọrun mi, 'gba ti mo f'ẹru
'yanu
Kiyesi ise ti owo Re se!
Mo ri 'rawo, mo gb'ohun
ààrá ti ń sán,
Agbara Rẹ tàn ká gbogbo
aye.

Ọkan mi kọ'rin si Oluwa rẹ,
Alagbara l'Ọlọrun mi!
Ọkan mi kọ'rin si Oluwa rẹ,
Alagbara l'Ọlọrun mi.

'Gbà tí mo rin káàkiri
Ninu igbo,
Mo gbo t'awọn ẹyẹ ń
kọrin didun,
'Gbà mo wo'lẹ lat' ori
Oke giga,
T'odo ń san, t'afẹfẹ si fẹ si mi.

'Gbà tí mo rò ó pe ko da
Mo Rẹ si,
Lati wa ku, mo roju
Gba a gbo pe
O r'ẹru ẹṣẹ mi lo lori igi,
O t'ẹjẹ Rẹ silẹ, O ku fun mi.

'Gbà Kristi yóó de pelu
Orin 'segun,
Wa mu mi lọ, ayo yoo
Gb'ọkan mi!
'Gbà náà n o juba,
N o f'irele wolẹ,
N o kede “Títobi l'Ọlọrun
Mi”.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE GOD OF ABRA'AM PRAISE

sections.text:
The God of Abra'am praise,
Who reigns enthroned on high,
Ancient of everlasting days
And God of love,
Jehovah, Great I Am,
By earth and heaven confess'd,
I bow and blessed the sacred
Name,
Forever bless'd.

The God of Abra'am praise,
At whose supreme command,
From earth I rise, and seek
The joys
At His right hand:
I all on earth forsake,
Its wisdom, fame and power,
And Him my only portion make,
My shield and tower.

He by Himself hath sworn,
I on His oath depend;
I shall, on eagle's wing up-borne,
To heaven ascend,
I shall behold His face
I shall His power adore,
And sing the wonders of His
Grace,
Forever more.

Though nature's strength decay,
And earth and hell withstand,
To Canaan's bounds
I urge my way,
At His command,
The watery deep I pass,
With Jesus in my view;
And through the howling
wilderness
My way pursue.

The God who reigns on high,
The great archangels sing;
And, “Holy, Holy, Holy,” cry;
Almighty King:
Who was and is the same,
And evermore shall be,
Jehovah, Father, Great I Am,
We worship Thee.

The whole triumphant host,
Give thanks to God on high
Hail, Father, Son and Holy Ghost,
They ever cry;
Hail Abra'am's God and mine,
I join the heavenly lays:
All might and majesty are Thine,
And endless praise.
Amen.

Yin Ọlọrun Abra'am,
Tí ó ń 'jọba lókè
Ẹni t'ó ti wà títí láé,
Ọlọrun'fẹ,
Jehófà ńlá l'Èmi,
Gbogbo ẹdá j'ẹwọ,
Mo fi'bukun f'orukọ Rẹ,
Títí láéláé.

Yin Ọlọrun Abra'am,
Nípa'ṣẹ Ẹni tí
Mo dìde mo sì wá 'túnú
Lọwọ 'tún Rẹ
Mo kọ ayé sílẹ,
Ọgbọn àt'ọlá rẹ
Ọun nikan ni ìpín mi
Àt'asà mi.

Òun náà ti se'lérí,
Mo gbẹkẹlé èyí,
N ó fí ìyẹ idì gòkè
Lọ sí ọrun;
N ó máa wo ojú Rẹ,
N ó sì yin ipá Rẹ,
N ó kọrin ìyanu t'oore-ọfẹ,
Títí láéláé.

B'ágbaára ẹdá pin,
T'ayé at'esu ńde,
N ó dojú kọ ọna Kénánì,
Nípa'ṣẹ Rẹ;
N ó ré odò kojá,
Bí Jésù wà lọọkàn,
N ó kojá ń'nú igbó dídí
Lọ s'ọna mi.

Ọba òkè ọrun,
Ọlor'Angeli ń ké,
Wí pé: “Mímọ, Mímọ, Mímọ,”
Ọba títí
Ẹni yóó sì wà láéláé,
Jehofà, Baba, “Èmi ni”,
Àwá yìn Ọ.

Gbogb' ẹgbẹ aşẹgun,
N yin Ọlorun lókè,
Baba ọmọ àt'Ẹmí ni,
Wọn ń ké títí,
Yin Ọlorun Abra'am,
N ó bá wọn kọrin náà,
Tirẹ l'agbára àt'ọlá,
Pẹlú ìyin.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WE ARE NEVER, NEVER WEARY
yorubaTitle: KÒ SU WA LÁTI MÁA KỌ ORIN

sections.text:
O the children of the Lord,
Have a right to shout and sing,
For the way is growing Bright,
And our souls are on the wing,
We are going by and by
To the palace of the King;
Glory to God, Hallelujah!

We are lost amidst the
rapture
Of redeeming love,
Glory to God, Hallelujah!
We are rising on its pinions
To the hills above,
Glory to God, Hallelujah.

We are going to a palace
That is built of gold,
Glory to God, Hallelujah!
Where the King in all
His splendor,
We shall soon behold,
Glory to God, Hallelujah!

There we'll shout redeeming
Mercy
In a glad new song,
Glory to God, Hallelujah!
There we'll sing the praise
Of Jesus
With the blood wash'd
Throng,
Glory to god, Hallelujah!
Amen.

Kò su wa láti máa kọ
Orin ti ìgbàanì,
Ògo f'Ọlorun, Àleluya!
A lè fi ìgbàgbọ kọrin náà
S'ókè kíkan,
Ògo f'Ọlorun, Àleluya!

Ọmọ Ọlorun ní ẹtọ lati
Máa bú s'ayọ,
Pé ọnà yìí ń yé wa síi
Ọkàn wa ń s'àfẹẹrí Rẹ,
Nígbòòse a ó dé ààfin
Ọba wa ológo,
Ògo f'Ọlorun, Àleluya!

Àwa ń bẹ ń'nú ibú ìfẹ t'ó
rà wá padà,
Ògo f'Ọlọrun, Àleluya!
Àwa yóó fi iyẹ gòkè lọ
s'ókè ọrun,
Ògo f'Ọlọrun, Àleluya!

Àwa ń lọ sí ààfin kan
tí a fi wúra kọ,
Ògo f'Ọlọrun, Àleluya!
Ní'bi tí a ó rí Qba ògo
ń'nú ẹwà Rẹ,
Ògo f'Ọlọrun, Àleluya!

Ní'bẹ a ó kọrin titun t'àánú
t'ó dá wa ńdè,
Ògo f'Ọlọrun, Àleluya!
Ní'bẹ àwọn àyanfẹ yóó
kọrin 'yin ti Kríst;
Ògo f'Ọlọrun, Àleluya!
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I WILL PRAISE THE LORD FOR HIS LOVE
yorubaTitle: ÈM' Ọ YIN OLUWA FUN ÌFẸ RẸ

sections.text:
I will praise the Lord for
His love to me,
I am washed in the blood of
My Redeemer,
In the fount that flows at the
Cross so free,
I am washed in the blood of
My Redeemer.

Glory, glory, glory to the Lamb
I am saved from sin and He
makes me what I am,
Oh! glory, glory,
glory to the Lamb,
I am washed in the blood
Of my Redeemer.

I am saved by grace and to
Him brought near,
I am washed in the blood of
My Redeemer.
I would sing so loud that the
world might hear,
I am washed in the blood of
My Redeemer.

What a constant peace in my
Heart I feel,
I am washed in the blood of
My Redeemer.
There's a holy joy I can
Ne'er reveal,
I am washed in the blood of
My Redeemer.

I will lift my voice while
On earth I stay,
I am washed in the blood of
My Redeemer.
Then my soul shall sing in the
Realms of day,
I am washed in the blood of
My Redeemer.
Amen

Èm 'ó yin Olúwa fún ìfẹ Rẹ,
A wẹ mi nín'ẹjẹ Olùràpadà;
Eje náà t'ó ń sàn ní
'B'àgbélébùú,
A wẹ mi nín'ẹjẹ Olùràpadà.

Ògo, ògo fún Ọd'àgùntàn
O gbà mi lọwọ ẹṣẹ, mo sì
di mímọ,
Ògo, ògo, ògo,
f'Ọd'àgùntàn
A wẹ mi nín'ẹjẹ Olùràpadà.

Oore-ọfẹ mú mi sún
m'ọdọ Rẹ,
A wẹ mi nín'ẹjẹ Olùràpadà;
Èm'ó kọrin s'ókè,
ayé yóó gbọ,
A wẹ mi nín'ẹjẹ Olùràpadà.

Àlàáfíà wo ló tó yíi l'ọkàn mi,
A wẹ mi nín'ẹjẹ Olùràpadà
Ayọ mímọ náà kò
se é fẹnu sọ,
A wẹ mi nín'ẹjẹ Olùràpadà.

Èmi ó máa gbóhùn
ìyìn s'ókè,
A wẹ mi nín'ẹjẹ Olùràpadà
Ọkàn mi yóó máa kọrin
lọjọọjọ;
A wẹ mi nín'ẹjẹ Olùràpadà.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: MY SOUL IS SO HAPPY IN JESUS
yorubaTitle: ỌKÀN MI Ń YỌ NÍNÚ OLÚWA

sections.text:
My soul is so happy in Jesus,
For He is so precious to me,
His voice, it is music to hear it,
His face, it is heaven to see.

I am happy in Him,
I am happy in Him,
My soul with delight He fills
day and night;
For I am happy in Him.

He sought me so long ere
I knew Him,
When wandering a-far from
The fold;
Safe home, in His hands
He has bro't me;
To where there are pleasures
Un-told.

They say I shall someday
Be like Him;
My cross and my burden
Lay down;
Till then I will ever be faithful
In gather-ing gems for His
Crown. Amen.

Ọkàn mi ń yọ nínú Olúwa,
Torí Ó jẹ ìyè fún mi,
Ohùn Rẹ dùn púpọ láti gbọ,
Adùn ni láti r'ójú Rẹ.

Èmi ń yọ ninu Rẹ,
Èmi ń yọ ninu Rẹ,
'Gbà gbogbo l'ó ń f'ayọ
kún ọkàn mi,
Torí èmi ń yọ ninu Rẹ.

Ó ti pẹ t'Ó ti ń wá mi kiri,
'Gbà tí mo rìn jinnà s'agbo,
Ó gbé mi wá s'ilé l'apá Rẹ,
Ní 'bi tí pápá tútù wà.

Ire àtàánú Rẹ yí mi kà
Oor'ọfẹ Rẹ ń sàn bí odò,
Ẹmi Rẹ ń tọ, ó sì ń se 'tùnú,
Ó ń bà mi lọ sí 'bikíbi.

Èmi yóó dàbí I Rẹ ní'jọ kan,
N ó s'ẹrú wúwo mi kalẹ,
Títí di 'gbà náà, ń ó s'olóòótọ,
Ní sise ọṣọ f'adé Rẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: SINCE CHRIST MY SOUL FROM SIN SET FREE
yorubaTitle: BI KRIST' TI DA ỌKÀN MI NDÈ

sections.text:
Since Christ my soul from sin
Set free,
This world has been
A Heav'n to me,
And mid earth's sorrows
And its woe,
'Tis heaven my Jesus here to
Know.

O Hal-le-lu-jah, yes,
'tis Heav'n,
'Tis Heav'n to know my sins
forgiv'n
On land or sea, what matters
where?
Where Jesus is,
'Tis Heaven there.

Once heaven seemed
A far off place,
Till Jesus showed His
Smiling face;
Now it's begun with-in
My soul,
'T will last while endless
Ages roll.

What matters where on earth
We dwell?
On mountain top, or in
The dell?
In cottage or in mansion fair,
Where Jesus is, 'tis Heaven
There. Amen.

Bí Kríst' ti dá ọkàn mi índè,
Ayé mi ti dàbí ọrun,
L'áàárin 'bànújẹ àt' arò'
Ayo ni làti mọ Jésù.

Alelúyà! Ayo ló jẹ
Pé, mo ti rí 'dàríjì gbà;
Ibikíbi tí mo bá wà,
Kò s'ewu, Jésù wà ní'bẹ.

Mo ti rò pé Ọrun jinnà,
Sùgbọn nígbà tí Jésù dé
L'ọrun ti dé'nú ọkàn mi,
Ní'bẹ ni yóó sì wà títí.

Níbo la kò lè gbé láyé,
L'ór'òkè tàbí pẹtẹlẹ;
L'ahéré tàbí àgbàlá,
Kò s'ewu, Jésù wà ní'bẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: FOR MERCIES, COUNTLESS AS THE SANDS
yorubaTitle: FÚN ÀÁNÚ T'O PỌ BÍI YANRÌN

sections.text:
For mercies countless
As the sands,
Which daily I receive,
From Jesus, my Redeemer's
Hands;
My soul, what canst thou give?

Alas! From such a heart as
Mine,
What can I bring Him forth?
My best is stain'd and dyed
With sin'
My all is nothing worth.

Yet His acknowledgment
I'll make,
For all He has bestow'd,
Salvation's sacred cup I'll take;
I'll call upon my God.

The best return for one like me,
So wretched and so poor,
Is from His gifts to draw a plea;
And ask Him still for more.

I cannot serve Him as I ought,
No works have I to boast;
Yet would I glory in the thought,
That I shall owe Him most.
Amen.

Kí ni ń ó fi fún Olúwa
Lati 'nú ọkàn mi?
Ẹsẹ ti ba gbogbo rẹ ję;
Kò tilẹ jámọ nnkan.

englishTitle: TO THEE, O COMFORTER DIVINE

sections.text:
To Thee, o Comforter divine,
For all Thy grace and pow'r
benign,
Sing we Hallelujah.

To Thee, whose faithful love
Had place,
In God's great covenant
Of grace
Sing we Hallelujah.

To Thee, whose faithful
Power doth heal,
Enlighten, sanctify and seal;
Sing we Hallelujah.

To Thee, our Teacher
And our Friend,
Our faithful Leader to the end
Sing we Hallelujah.

To Thee, by Jesus Christ
Sent down,
Of all His gifts the sum
And crown;
Sing we Hallelujah.
Amen.

Sí Ọ, Olùtùnú ọrun,
Fún oore àt'agbára Rẹ,
A ń kọ Alelúyà.

Sí Ọ, ìfẹ ẹni t'ó wá'
Nínú májẹmú Ọlọrun,
A ń kọ Alelúyà.

Sí Ọ, agbára Ẹni tí
Ó ń wẹni mọ t'ó ń wo ni sàn,
A ń kọ Alelúyà.

Sí Ọ, olùkọ àt'Ọrẹ,
Amọna wa tóótọ títí d'opin,
A ń kọ Alelúyà.

Sí Ọ, Ẹni tí Krístì ràn,
Adé ohun gbogbo ẹbùn Rẹ,
A ń kọ Alelúyà.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: OH LORD OF HEAVEN AND EARTH AND SEA

sections.text:
Oh Lord of heaven and
Earth and sea,
To Thee all praise
And glory be,
How shall we show
Our love to Thee,
Who givest all!

The golden sunshine,
Vernal air,
Sweet flowers and fruit,
Thy love declare,
Where harvest ripen,
Thou art there;
Who givest all!

For peaceful homes and Healthful days,
For all the blessings Earth displays,
We owe Thee thankfulness And praise;
Who givest all!

Thou didst not spare Thine only Son,
But gav'st Him for a world Undone,
And freely with that Blessed One;
Thou givest all!

Thou giv'st the Holy Spirit's Dow'r,
Spirit of life and love And pow'r,
And dost His sevenfold Graces show'r;
Upon us all!

For souls redeemed, For sins forgiven,
For means of grace and hopes Of heaven,
What can to Thee, oh Lord, Be given;
Who givest all!

We love what on ourselves We spend,
We have as treasure Without end,
Whatever, Lord, to Thee We lend;
Who givest all!

Whatever, Lord, we lend To Thee,
Repaid a thousand-fold will be,
Then gladly will we give To Thee;
Giver of all!

To Thee from whom we all Derive,
Our life, our gifts, and Power to give,
Oh may we ever with Thee Live;
Giver of all! Amen.

Olúwa ọrun òn ayé,
'Wọ ní'yìn àt'ọpẹ yẹ fún,
Báwo là bá ti fẹ Ọ tó?
Oníbú ọrẹ!

Oòrùn tí ń tàn àt'afẹfẹ,
Gbogbo ewéko ń sọ'fẹ Rẹ,
'Wọ ló ń mú irúgbìn dára'
Oníbú ọrẹ!

Fún ara líle wa gbogbo,
Fún gbogbo ìbùkún ayé,
Àwa yìn Ọ, a sì dúpẹ;
Oníbú ọrẹ!

O kò dù wá lí ọmọ Rẹ,
Ó fí fún ayé ẹṣẹ wa,
Ó sì fẹbùn gbogbo pẹlú;
Oníbú ọrẹ!

Ó ń fún wa l'Ẹmi Mímọ Rẹ,
Ẹmí ìyè àt'agbára,
Ó rọ̀ọ̀ ẹkún 'bùkún Rẹ;
Lé wa lori!

Fún ìdáríjì ẹṣẹ wa,
Àti fún ìrètí ọrun,
Kí l'ohun t'á bàá fí fún Ọ?
Oníbú ọrẹ!

Owó tí a ń ná, òfo ni,
Sùgbọn èyí t'á fí fún Ọ,
Ó jẹ ìsura tít' ayé;
Oníbú ọrẹ!

Ní ọdọ Rẹ la ti sàn wá,
Ọlọrun Olódùmarè,
Jẹ ká lè bá Ọ gbé títí;
Oníbú ọrẹ! Ààmín.

englishTitle: OH WORSHIP THE KING

sections.text:
Oh worship the King,
All glorious above;
Oh gratefully sing his power
And His love;
Our shield and Defender, the
Ancient of days,
Pavilion'd in splendor and
Girded with praise.

The earth with its store of
Wonders untold,
Almighty Thy power hath
Founded of old,
Hath stablish'd it fast by a
Changeless decree;
And round it hath cast, like a
Mantle, the sea.

Thy bountiful care, what
Tongue can recite?
It breathes in the air, it shines
In the light;
It streams from the hills, it
Descends to the plain;
And sweetly distills in the
Dew and the rain.

Frail children of dust and
Feeble as frail;
In Thee do we trust, nor find
Thee to fail;
Thy mercies how tender, how
firm to the end?
Our Maker, Defender,
Redeemer and Friend!

Ayé yìí pẹlú ẹkún 'yanu rẹ,
Ọlọrun agbàra Rẹ ló dá wọn;
O fi ìdí rẹ múlẹ kò sì lè yí,
O sí f'òkun se asọ ìgúnwà Rẹ.

Àwa erùpẹ, àwa aláilera,
'Wọ l'a gbẹkẹlé,
'Wọ kì y'ó da ni;
Àánú Rẹ rọrùn, ó sì
Lè dé òpin;
Ẹlẹdàá, Aláàbò,
Olùgbàlà wa.

'Wọ Alágbára, onífẹ jùlọ,
B'àwọn Angẹlì tí ń yìn
Ọ l'ókè;
Bẹẹ l'àwa ẹdá Rẹ níwọn
T'a lè se;
A ó máa juba Rẹ,
A ó máa yin Ọ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: KING OF GLORY, KING OF PEACE

sections.text:
Gbogbo ọjọ ayé mi ni,
N ó fi yin Ọ;
Mo lé gbé Ọ ga ninu,
Ọkàn mi yíi,
Ààyè wà ń'nú ọkàn mi;
Tí 'Wọ yó máà gbé!
Ayérayé kúrú jù,
Láti yin Ọ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: CROWN HIM WITH MANY CROWNS

sections.text:
Crown Him with many crowns,
The Lamb upon His throne;
Hark! How the heav'nly
Anthem drowns
All music but its own:
Awake, my soul, and sing
Of Him who died for thee,
And hail Him as thy matchless
King,
Through all eternity.

Crown Him the Virgin's Son,
The God incarnate born;
Whose arm those crimson
Trophies won;
Which now His brow adorns,
Fruit of the mystic Rose,
As of that Rose the Stem:
The Root where mercy
ever flows,
The babe of Bethlehem.

Crown Him, the Lord of life,
Who triumphed o'er the grave,
And rose victorious in the strife;
For those He came to save:
His glories now we sing;
Who died, and rose on high,
Who died, eternal life to bring,
And lives, that death may die.

Crown Him the Lord of peace,
Whose pow'r, a sceptre sways,
From pole to pole, that wars
May cease;
And all by pray'r and praise:
His reign shall know no end,
And round His pierced feet,
Fair flow'rs of paradise extend
Their fragrance ever sweet.

Crown Him the Lord of love:
Behold His hands and side,
Those wounds,
yet visible above,
In beauty glorified:
No angel in the sky
Can fully bear that sight;
But downward bends his
burning eye
At mysteries so bright.

Crown Him the Lord of years,
The Potentate of time,
Creator of the rolling spheres:
Ineffably sublime:
All hail! Redeemer, hail!
For Thou hast died for me;
Thy praise shall never;
Never fail
Throughout eternity. Amen.

S'Ọmọ Wúndía l'Ọba!
Ọm'Ọlọrun t'a bí;
Tí adé Rẹ ń mì lẹgbẹ fún
Àmi ìṣẹgun Rẹ:
Sílò t'á sọ tẹlẹ,
Ẹka igi Jésè.
Olùs'àgùntàn agbo Rẹ;
Ọmọ ti Bẹt-lẹhẹm'.

S'Olúwa ayé l'Ọba,
T'ó sẹgun ibojì;
T'ó sì jí dìde ní'sẹgun,
F'awọn t'Ó wá gbà là,
Orin ògo l'a ń kọ yíi,
T'Eni t'ó kú, t'ó jí,
Ó kú kó bà lè mú ’yè wá;
Ó yè kí 'kú baà lè kú.

englishTitle: CHRIST WHOSE GLORY FILLS THE SKIES

sections.text:
Christ, whose glory
Fills the skies,
Christ, the True, the only Light,
Sun of Righteousness arise,
Triumph o'er the shades
Of night,
Day-spring from on high
Be near,
Day-star in my heart appear.

Dark and cheerless is the morn,
Unaccompanied by Thee;
Joyless is the day's return,
Till Thy mercy's beams I see;
Till Thou inward light impart,
Glad my eyes and warm
My heart.

Visit then this soul of mine,
Pierce the gloom of sin
And grief;
Fill me Radiancy divine,
Scatter all my unbelief;
More and more Thyself display,
Shining to the perfect day.
Amen.

Kríst' t'ògo Rẹ ká ayé,
Kríst' ìmọlẹ òtítọ;
Oorùn òdodo dìde,
K'ó sì borí òkùnkùn.
'Mọlẹ òórọ, sún mọ mi,
'Ràwọ òórọ, yọ ń'nú mi.

Òórọ t'ó dé láìsí Rẹ'
Òòkùn òun 'bánújẹ ni;
Ilẹ t'ó mọ kò l'áyo,
Bí n kò r'óye àánú Rẹ,
B'Ìwọ kò f'ìmọlẹ Rẹ
Kún ojú òun ọkàn mi.

englishTitle: ALLELUIA, SING TO JESUS

sections.text:
Alleluia! Sing to Jesus!
His the scepter, His the throne
Alleluia! His the triumph
His the victory alone;
Hark! The songs of
Holy Zion
Thunder like a mighty flood:
Jesus out of ev'ry nation
Hath redeemed us by His blood.

Alleluia! Not as orphans
Are we left in sorrow now;
Alleluia, He is near us,
Faith believes,
Nor questions how:
Though the cloud from sight
Received Him;
When the forty days were o'er,
Shall our hearts forget
His promise,
'I am with you evermore.'

Alleluia! Bread of heaven,
Thou on earth our food,
Our stay;
Alleluia! Here the sinful,
Flee to Thee from day to day.
Intercessor, Friend of sinners;
Earth's Redeemer, plead for me,
Where the songs
Of all the sinless,
Sweep across the crystal sea.

Alleluia! King eternal,
Thee the Lord of lords we own:
Alleluia! Born of Mary.
Earth Thy footstool,
Heaven Thy throne
Thou within the veil
Hast entered,
Robed in flesh,
Our great high priest:
Thou on earth both
Priest and victim:
In the Eucharistic Feast. Amen.

Alelúyà! Jẹ k'á kọrin
Jésù sẹgun, Ó ń jọba
Alelúyà! Ó ti gòkè
Lọ s'ọwọ 'tún Baba Rẹ
Gbọ orin ayọ ní Sion
Tí ń dun bi ohùn ààrá
Gbogb'orílẹ àti èdè
Ni Jésù f'ẹjẹ Rẹ rà.

Alelúyà! kò s'ẹkún mọ
F'áwọn t'á ti sọ d'ọmọ
Alelúyà! O sún mọ wa
Éyí ni ìgbàgbọ wa
Ohunkohun tó wù k'ó dé,
A rọ mọ ìlérí Rẹ
“Ẹ má bẹru, ẹ tújúká”
“Mo wà pẹlu yín d'ópin.”

Alelúya! Oúnjẹ ọrun
Máa jẹ oúnjẹ wa l'ayé
Alelúya! Gbogb' ẹlẹṣẹ
Kò lè sàisá tọ Ọ wá,
'Wọ Alágbàwí ẹlẹṣẹ
T'ó ń bẹbẹ fún mi l'ókè;
Jẹ k'órin iyin mi lónìí
Dàpọ mọ t'àwọn mímọ.

englishTitle: GRACE! 'TIS A CHARMING SOUND

sections.text:
Grace! 'Tis a charming sound,
Harmonious to the ear,
Heav'n with the echo shall
Resound,
And all the earth shall hear.
Saved by grace alone!
This is all my plea;
Jesus died for all mankind,
And Jesus died for me.

'Twas grace that wrote
My name,
In life's eternal book;
'Twas grace that gave me to
The Lamb,
Who all my sorrows took.

Grace taught my wand'ring feet
To tread the heavenly road,
And new supplies each
hour I meet;
While pressing up to God.

Oh, let Thy grace inspire,
My soul with strength divine!
May all my powers to
Thee aspire,
And all my days be Thine.
Amen.

Oore-ọfẹ! Ohùn
Adùn ni l'étí wa,
Gbohùn-gbohùn Rẹ
Y'ó gba ọrun kan
Ayé yó gbọ pẹlú.
Oore-ọfẹ sá!
N'ígbẹkẹlé mi,
Jésù kú fún aráyé;
Ó kú fún mi pẹlú.

Oore-ọfẹ ló kọ
Orúkọ mi l'ọrun
L'ó fi mí fún Ọd'àgùntàn
T'ó gba ìyà mi jẹ.

Oore-ọfẹ ń kọ mi,
L'ọnà t'ó lọ s'ọrun,
Ó ń tọjú mi lojoojumọ;
Ní ìrìn àjò mi.

Jẹ kí oore-ọfẹ yìí,
F'agbára f'ọkàn mi;
Kí n lè fi gbogbo ipá mi,
Àt'ọjọ mi fún Q. Ààmín.

englishTitle: BEFORE JEHOVAH'S AWESOME THRONE

sections.text:
Before Jehovah's awesome
Throne,
Ye nations, bow with
Sacred joy;
Know that the Lord is
God alone;
He can create, and He destroys.

His sov'reign pow'r,
Without our aid,
Made us of clay,
And form'd us men;
And when like wand'ring
Sheep we strayed,
He brought us to His fold again.

We 'll crowd Thy gates with
Thankful songs;
High as the heavens
Our voices raise;
And earth, with her ten
Thousand tongues,
Shall fill Thy courts with
Sounding praise.

Wide as the world is
Thy command;
Vast as eternity Thy love;
Firm as a rock Thy truth
Shall stand,
When rolling years shall cease
To move. Amen.

Níwájú ìtẹ Jèhófà,
Ẹ f'ayọ sìn, oríl'èdè,
Mọ p'Ólúwa, Òun nikan ni;
Ó lè dá, Ó sì lè parun.

Ipá Rẹ, láìsí rànwọ wa,
F'amọ dá wa ní eniyan,
Nígbà t'á sáko b'ágùntàn;
Ó tún wa mú sí agbo Rẹ.

A ó f'orin sún mọ 'lé Rẹ,
L'óhùn gíga l'a ó kọrin:
Ilẹ, 'lẹgbàrún ahọn rẹ;
Yóó f'iyìn kún àgbàlá Rẹ.

Àṣẹ Rẹ gbòòrò k'ágbàáyé,
Ìfẹ Rẹ pọ b'ayérayé:
Òótọ Rẹ yóó dúró láéláé;
Gbà t'ọdún ó dẹkun yípo.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: AWAKE, MY SOUL, TO JOYFUL LAYS

sections.text:
Awake, my soul, to joyful lays
And sing thy great Redeemer's Praise,
He justly claims a song
From me,
His loving kindness,
Oh, how free!

He saw me ruined by the fall
Yet lov'd me notwithstanding All;
He sav'd me from my lost Estate,
His loving kindness,
Oh, how great!

Tho' num'rous hosts
Of mighty foes;
Tho' earth and hell
My way oppose,
He safely leads my soul along
His loving kindness,
Oh, how strong!

When trouble,
Like a gloomy cloud,
Has gathered thick and
Thunder'd loud,
He near my soul has
Always stood,
His loving kindness,
Oh, how good!

Often I feel my sinful heart,
Prone from my Jesus to depart,
And though I oft have
Him forgot,
His loving kindness
Changes not. Amen.

Ogun ọtá dìde sí mi,
Ayé àt'Èsù ń dènà mi,
Òun mú mi la gbogbo rẹ já;
'Seun 'fẹ Rẹ ti ní 'pa to!

'Gbà 'yọnu dé, b'áwọsánmọ,
T'ó sú dudu, t'ó ń sán ààrá,
Ó dúró tì mí láàrin rẹ;
'Seun 'fẹ Rẹ ti dára tó!

'Gbà gbogbo lọkàn ẹṣẹ mi,
Ń fẹ yà lẹyìn Olúwa mi,
Sùgbọn bí mo ti ń gbàgbé Rẹ;
Ìseun ìfẹ Rẹ kíí yẹ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: WE GIVE IMMORTAL PRAISE

sections.text:
We give immortal praise,
To God the Father's love,
For all our comforts here,
And better hopes above.
He sent His own eternal Son,
He sent His own eternal Son,
To die for sins that man
Has done.

To God the Son belongs,
Immortal glory too,
Who bought us with His
Blood,
From everlasting woe;
And now He lives
And now He reigns,
And now He lives
And now He reigns,
And sees the fruit of all
His pains.

To God the Spirit's name,
Immortal worship give,
Whose new creating pow'r,
Makes the dead sinner live;
His work completes
The great design,
His work completes
The great design,
And fills the soul
With joy divine.

Almighty God, to Thee,
Be endless honours done,
The undivided Three;
And the mysterious One,
Where reason fails with
All her pow'r,
Where reason fails with
All her pow'r,
There faith prevails and love
Adores. Amen.

A f'ìyìn àilópin
Fún Ọlọrun Baba,
Fún oore ayé wa,
Àt'ìrètí t'ọrun.
Ó rán Ọmọ Rẹ àyànfẹ,
Ó rán Ọmọ Rẹ àyànfẹ,
Láti kú fún ẹṣẹ ayé.

A f'ìyìn àilópin,
Fún Ọlọrun Ọmọ,
T'ó f'ẹjẹ Rẹ rà wá,
Kúró nínú ègbé,
Nísinyìí, Ó wà, Ó ń jọba
Nísinyìí, Ó wà, Ó ń jọba
Ó ń rí èso ìrora Rẹ.

A f'ìyìn àilópin,
Fún Ọlọrun Ẹmí,
Ẹni f'agbára Rẹ
Sọ ẹlẹṣẹ d'ààyè;
Ó parí iṣẹ ìgbàlà
Nísinyìí, Ó wà, Ó ń jọba
Ó sì f'ayọ ọrun k'ọkàn.

A f'ọlá àìlópin
Fún Olódùmarè,
'Wọ Ológo mẹta
Sùgbọn ọkan soso.
B'Ó ti ju ìmọ wa lọ nì,
B'Ó ti ju ìmọ wa lọ nì,
A ó máa f'ìgbàgbọ yin Ọ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HOW SWEET THE NAME OF JESUS

sections.text:
How sweet the name
Of Jesus sounds
Blessed be the name
Of the Lord;
It soothes my sorrows heals
My wounds,
Blessed be the name
Of the Lord!

Blessed be the name,
Blessed be the name,
Blessed be the name
Of the Lord;
Blessed be the name,
Blessed be the name
Blessed be the name
Of the Lord!

It makes the wounded
Spirit whole,
Blessed be the name
Of the Lord!
'Tis man-na to the hungry soul
Blessed be the name of the Lord!

It soothes the troubled
Sin-ner's breast,
Blessed be the name of the Lord!
It gives the weary sweetest rest,
Blessed be the name of the Lord!

Then will I tell the sinners round,
Blessed be the name of the Lord!
What a dear Sa-viour I
Have found;
Blessed be the name of the LORD!
Amen

B'órúkọ Jésù ti dùn tó,
Ògo ni fún Orúkọ Rẹ!
Ó tán bánúje àt'ogbẹ
Ògo ni fún orúkọ Rẹ

Ògo f'óókọ Rẹ,
Ògo f'óókọ Rẹ,
Qgo f'oruko Oluwa
Ògo f'óókọ Rẹ,
Ògo f'óókọ Rẹ,
Ògo f'órúkọ Olúwa.

Ó wo ọkàn t'ó gb'ogbẹ sàn,
Ògo ni fún Orúkọ Rẹ!
Ọnje ni f'ọkan t'ebi ń pa,
Ògo ni fún Orúkọ Rẹ!

Ó tán àníyàn ẹlẹsẹ,
Ògo ni fún Orúkọ Rẹ!
Ọ fún aláàárẹ ní 'sinmi,
Ògo ni fún Orúkọ Rẹ!

Njẹ n ó ròyìn náà ẹlẹṣẹ,
Ògo ni fún Orúkọ Rẹ!
Pé mo ti rí Olùgbàlà,
Ògo ni fún Orúkọ Rẹ!
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS MY SAVIOUR TO BETHLEHEM CAME

sections.text:
Jesus my Saviour to
Bethlehem came,
Born in a manger to
Sorrow and shame;
Oh, it was wonderful -
Blest be His name!
Seeking for me, for me.

Seeking for me ...! For me ...!
Oh, it was wonderful blest be
His name!
Seeking for me, for me!

Jesus my Saviour,
On Calvary's tree,
Paid the great debt and my
Soul He set free;
Oh, it was wonderful -
How could it be?
Dying for me, for me!

Dying for me...! For me...!
Oh, it was wonderful - how
Could it be?
Dying for me, for me!

Jesus my Saviour,
The same as of old,
While 1 was wandering afar
From the fold,
Gentle and long did He plead
With my soul,
Calling for me, for me!

Calling for me...! For me...!
Gently and long did He plead
With my soul!
Calling for me, for me!

Jesus my Saviour shall come
From on high
Sweet is the promise as weary
Years fly
Oh, I shall see Him
Descending the sky
Coming for me, for me!

Coming for me...! For me...!
Oh, I shall see Him
descending the sky!
Coming for me, for me!
Amen.

Jésú Olúwa mi ní Bẹtlẹhẹm',
Níbùjẹ ẹran li a gbé bí I si,
Háà! ìyanu ni, yin Orúkọ Rẹ;
Ẹni t'Ó wá mi rí.

Ó wá mi rí, àn'émi,
Háà! ìyanu ni,
yin Orúkọ Rẹ;
Ẹni t'Ó wá mi rí.

Jésú Olúwa mi ní Kálfàrì,
San 'gbèsè ẹṣẹ, mo d'òmìnira,
Háà! ìyanu ni pé Ó kú fún mi;
Ẹlẹṣẹ bí èmi.

Ó kú fún mi...! fún mi,
Háà! ìyanu ni pé
Ó kú fún mi;
Ẹlẹṣẹ bi emi.

Jésú Olúwa mi, bákan náà ni,
Ẹni t'Ó wá mi 'gbà mo ń
sáko lọ,
Jẹjẹ l'Ó bá mi sọrọ t' Ó pè mí,
Ó pè mí sọdọ Rẹ.

Ó ń ké pè mí, àn'émi,
Jẹjẹ l'ó ń bá mi sọrọ
T'ó pè mí,
Ó pè mí sọdọ Rẹ.

Jèsù Olúwa mi tún ń padà bọ,
Ìlérí dídùn l'èyí ję fún mi,
Ojú mi y'ó rí i b' Ó ti ń sọkalẹ
Bọ láti wá mú mi.

Ó ń padà bọ fún mi,
Ojú mi y'ó rí I
b' Ó ti ń sọkalẹ,
Ó ń padà bọ fún mi.
Ààmín

englishTitle: I HEARD THE VOICE OF JESUS
yorubaTitle: MO GB'ÓHÙN JÉSÙ T'Ó WÍ PÉ

sections.text:
I heard the voice of Jesus say,
“Come unto Me and rest:
Lay down, thou weary one,
Lay down
Thy head upon my breast.”
I came to Jesus as I was
Weary, and worn, and sad;
I found in Him a resting place
And He has made me glad.

I heard the voice of Jesus say
Behold, I freely give
The living water; thirsty one
Stoop down and drink, and live.
I came to Jesus and I drank
Of that life-giving stream
My thirst was quenched, my
Soul revived,
And now I live in Him.

I heard the voice of Jesus say,
“I am this dark world's Light;
Look unto me, thy morn
Shall rise
And all thy day be bright.”
I looked to Jesus and I found
In Him my Star, my Sun;
And in that light of life I'll walk,
Till traveling days are done.
Amen

Mo gb'óhùn Jèsù t'ó wí pé,
“Wá sinmi lọdọ Mi.”
Gbé orí rę, 'wọ aláàárẹ
Lé oókan àyà Mi.”
Nín'àárẹ òun ìbànújẹ
Ni mo tọ Jèsù wá;
Ó ję ibi 'sinmi fún mi,
Ó sì mú 'nú mi dùn.

Mo gb'óhùn Jèsù t'ó wí pé,
“Ìwo ti òngbẹ ń gbẹ
Ń ó f'omi'yè fún ọ lọfẹ.
Bẹrẹ, mu, k'ó sì yè!”
Mo tọ Jèsù wá, mo sì mu,
Nínú omi'yè náà,
Ọkàn mi tún sọjí,
Mo d'alààyè ńnú Rẹ.

Mo gb'óhùn Jèsù t'ó wí pé,
“Mọlẹ ayé l'Èmi!
Wò mi, Èmi ni oòrun rę
Ọjọ rę yóó dára!”
Mo wo Jèsù, èmi sì rí I
B'Oòrun òdodo mi.
Nínú 'mọlẹ yìí l'è m'ó rìn,
Tít'àjò mi yóó pin. Ààmín.

englishTitle: TAKE THE NAME OF JESUS WITH YOU

sections.text:
Take the name of Jesus With you,
Child of sorrow and of woe;
It will joy and comfort give You,
Take it then wher'er you go.

Precious name ..!
Oh, how sweet!
Hope of earth
And joy of heaven;
Precious name ..!
Oh, how sweet...!
Hope of earth
And joy of heaven.

Take the name of Jesus ever,
As a shield from every snare;
If temptations round you Gather,
Breathe that holy name in Prayer.

Oh, the precious name of Jesus!
How it thrills our souls with Joy;
When His loving arms Receive us,
And His songs our tongues Employ!

At the name of Jesus bowing;
Falling prostrate at His feet:
King of kings in heaven we'll Crown Him,
When our journey is complete.
Amen

Sá di Orúkọ Jésù mú,
Nígbà ìbànújẹ́ rẹ,
Y'ó sì fi ìtùnú fún ọ,
Rọ mọ ní ibi gbogbo.

Orúkọ ...... iyebíye!
Ìrètí wa l'áyé yìí
Orúkọ ...... iyebíye!
Ayo fún àwọn t'ọrun.

Máa fi orúkọ Jésù se
Asà nígbà ìdánwò,
Bí 'dààmú kan bá dé bá ọ;
F'orúkọ náà gbàdúrà.

Iyebíye l'oókọ Jésù!
Ò ń mú kí ọkàn wa yọ,
'Gbà t'ápá 'fẹ Rẹ bá gbà wá;
A ó kọrin ìyin Rẹ.

A ó júbà orúkọ Jésù,
A ó wólẹ̀ l'ẹsẹ Rẹ,
A ó dé Ọba wa l'ádé;
'Gbà t'ájò wa bà parí.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: COME, THOU ALMIGHTY KING

sections.text:
Come, Thou Almighty King,
Help us Thy name to sing,
Help us to praise,
Father, all-glorious,
O'er all victorious,
Come, and reign over us,
Ancient of Days!

Come, Thou incarnate Word.
Gird on Thy mighty sword:
Our prayers attend;
Come, and Thy people bless,
And give Thy Word success:
Spirit of holiness,
On us descend.

Come, Holy Comforter,
Thy sacred witness bear,
In this glad hour;
Thou, who almighty art,
Now rule in every heart,
And ne'er from us depart.
Spirit of power!

To the great One in Three,
The highest praises be,
Hence evermore!
His sovereign majesty
May we in glory see,
And to eternity,
Love and adore. Amen.

Wá, Alágbára, wá,
Kọ wa b'á ti ń júbà
B'á ti ń yin Ọ
Baba wa Ológo
Ìwọ ni Aṣẹgun
Wá jọba nínú wa
Ẹni 'gbàani.

Ìwọ Ọrọ ìyè
Wá dì wá l'àmùrè
Gb'àdúrà wa
Wá bùkún gbogbo wa
Mú ọrọ Rẹ s'èso
Ìwọ Ẹmí Mímọ
Wá bà lé wa.

Wá, Ẹmí Mímọ, wá
Máa jẹríí nínú wa
Lójúojúmo
Ìwọ Alágbára
Máa jọba nínú wa
Má fi wá sílẹ mọ
Ẹmí Ọrun.

Mẹtalọkan Mímọ
Gba orin ìyin wa
Títí láéláé
Se wa yẹ k'a lè rí
Ẹwà Rẹ ológo
Gbà wá s'ínú Ògo
Títí láéláé. Ààmín.

englishTitle: IMMORTAL, INVISIBLE, GOD ONLY WISE

sections.text:
Immortal, Invisible,
God only wise,
In light inaccessible
Hid from our eyes,
Most blessed, most glorious
The Ancient of Days
Almighty, victorious,
Thy great name we praise.

Unresting, unhasting,
and silent as light,
Nor wanting, nor wasting,
thou rulest in might!
Thy justice like mountains
high soaring above,
Thy clouds, which are
fountains of goodness and love.

To all life Thou givest to both
Great and small
In all life Thou livest, the true
Life of all;
We blossom and flourish as
Leaves on the tree,
And wither and perish
But naught changeth Thee.

Ọba àìkú, àìrí,
Orisun ogbọn,
Tó wà ń'nú ìmọlẹ
T'ojú kò lè wò;
Olùbùkún jùlọ, Ologo julo
Alágbára, Olùṣẹgun,
'Wọ la yìn.

Láisìnmi, láidúró
Nídàákeje,
O ń jọba lọ,
O kò sì se aláiní;
Gíga ni ìdájọ Rẹ bí òkè ńla,
Ìkùukùu Rẹ, bí isun ire àt'ìfẹ.

O ń tẹ gbogbo
Ẹdá alààyè lọrun,
Ńipa ìmísí rẹ,
Wọn ń gbé ìgbé wọn;
A ń dàgbà,
A ń gbilẹ bí ewé igi;
A sì ń rọ, sùgbọn
Bákan náà l'Ọlọrun.

Baba ńlá, Ológo
Ìmọlẹ pipe,
Awọn Ángeli Rẹ
Wolẹ l'ẹsẹ Rẹ!
Ìyin wa la mú wá,
Jọọ ràn wa lọwọ;
K'á lè r'ògo ìmọlẹ
T'ó yí Ọ ká.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HOLY, HOLY, HOLY

sections.text:
Holy, Holy, Holy!
Lord God Almighty;
Early in the morning
Our song shall rise to Thee;
Holy, Holy, Holy!
Merciful and mighty,
God in Three Persons,
Blessed Trinity!

Holy, Holy, Holy!
All the saints adore Thee;
Casting down their golden
Crowns around the glassy sea;
Cherubim and Seraphim
Falling down before Thee,
Which wert and art and
Evermore shalt be.

Holy, Holy, Holy!
Though the darkness hide Thee;
Though the eye of sinful man
Thy glory may not see;
Only thou art holy,
There is none beside Thee,
Perfect in pow'r, in love
And purity.

Holy, Holy, Holy!
Lord God Almighty;
All Thy works shall praise
Thy name in earth
And sky and sea;
Holy, Holy, Holy!
Merciful and mighty,
God in Three Persons,
Blessed Trinity! Amen.

Mímọ, Mímọ,
Mímọ! Olódùmarè,
Ní kùtùkùtù n'Ìwọ
Ó gbọ orin wa,
Mímọ, Mímọ,
Mímọ! Oníyọnú jùlọ,
Ológo mẹta, láé Olùbùkún.

Mímọ, Mímọ, Mímọ!
Àwọn t'ọrun ń yìn,
Wọn fí adé wúrà
Wọn lélẹ y'ìtẹ ká:
Kérúbu, Séráfu ń wólẹ
Ní'wájú Rẹ;
'Wọ t'ó ti wà, T'ó sì wà títí láé.

Mímọ, Mímọ, Mímọ!
Olódùmarè!
Gbogbo iṣẹ Rẹ, ní'lẹ,
l'ókè ló ń yin Ọ:
Mímọ, Mímọ, Mímọ!
Oníyọnú jùlọ,
Ológo mẹta, láé Olùbùkún.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WE PRAISE THEE O GOD
yorubaTitle: A YIN ỌLỌRUN NITOR' ỌMỌ RẸ

sections.text:
Hallelujah! Thine the glory,
Hallelujah! Amen,
Hallelujah! Thine the glory,
Revive us again.

We praise Thee o God,
For Thy Spirit of light,
Who has shown us our
Saviour and scattered our night.

All glory and praise to the
Lamb that was slain;
Who has borne all our sins,
And has cleansed every stain.

Revive us again,
Fill each heart with Thy love,
May each soul be re-kindled,
With fire from above.
Amen.

A yin Ọlọrun nitor'ọmọ Rẹ,
Fún Jésù tí ó kú T'ó sì lọ s'ókè.

Alelúyà, Tìrẹ l'ògo,
Alelúyà, Ààmín
Alelúyà, Tìrẹ l'ògo,
Tún mú wa sojí.

A yin Ọlọrun f'Ẹmí Ìmọlẹ Rẹ,
T'Ó f'Olùgbàlà hàn,
T'Ó mú'mọlẹ wá.

Ògo àt'ìyìn f'Ọdọ-àgùntàn
T'a pa;
T'ó ru gbogbo ẹṣẹ wa; t'Ó
W'èérí wa nù.

Sà mú wa sojí, fi'fẹ Rẹ
K'ọkàn wa;
K'ọkàn gbogbo gbiná,
Fún iná ọrun. Ààmín.

englishTitle: O COME, AND LET US TO THE LORD

sections.text:
O come, and let us to the Lord
In songs our voices raise,
With joyful noise let us
Praise the Rock
Of our salvation.

Let us before His presence come,
With praise and thankful voice;
Let us sing psalms to Him
with grace,
And make a joyful noise.

The Lord's a great God and
Great King,
Above all gods He is,
Depths of the earth are in
His hand,
The strength of hills is His.

To Him the spacious sea belongs,
For He the same did make;
The dry land also from His
Hands
Its form at first did take.

O come and let us worship Him,
Let us bow down withal,
And on our knees before
The Lord
Our Maker let us fall.
Amen.

Ẹ wá k'á kọrin s'Ólúwa,
Ólúkùlùkù wa;
Kí a ho ìhọ ayọ sí,
Àpata 'gbàlà wa.

Ẹ jẹ k'á wá síwájú Rẹ
Pẹlu 'yìn àt'ọpẹ;
K'á kọrin pẹl'oore-ọfẹ,
K'á sì yọ ayọ ńlá.

Tìrẹ li àwọn òkun ńlá,
Òun ni Ó sì dá wọn;
Àti 'yàngbẹ ilẹ pẹlu,
Ọwọ Rẹ ló sì da.

Ẹ wá, ẹ jẹ kí á wólẹ,
Kí á tẹrí ba fún Un,
Kí á sì kúnlẹ níwájú
Olúwa Ẹlẹdàá.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: COME, LET US JOIN OUR CHEERFUL SONGS
yorubaTitle: WÁ, JẸ K'Á JÙMỌ F'OHÙN KAN

sections.text:
Come, let us join
Our cheerful songs
With angels round the throne;
This is the day that Jesus found
And ordained as His own.

This day the God of
Heaven bless'd
Out of the seven days;
A type of rest unto the bless'd
A type of heav'nly days.

So, let us sing unto His name
And hope on for the day;
When Jesus shall come
In His fame
And end all earth's vain way.

Ever more till grace He brings
We shall to Jesus sing
Let's keep rejoicing in the Lord,
For ever in His word.
Amen.

Wá, jẹ k'á jùmọ f'ohùn kan,
Kọrin yí Ìtẹ ká:
Òní lọjọ t'Ólúwa dá;
T'Ó sì pè ní Tirẹ.

Ojo yìí l'Ọlọrun bù kún,
Láàrin ọjọ méje;
Àpeẹrẹ 'sinmi àìlópin
T'áwọn t'ọrun ń gbádùn.

Nje k'á máa kọrin oókọ Rẹ,
K'á máa retí ọjọ,
T'Ólùdándè yóó sọkalẹ
T'ásán ayé yóó pin.

englishTitle: O LORD OUR GOD, HEAR THOU OUR PRAY'R

sections.text:
O Lord our God hear
Thou our pray'r,
In this Thy house
On this Thy day,
And own as grateful sacrifice;
Let out song be acceptable.

Sweet is Thy rest,
O Lord my God,
But there's a greater rest above,
Still, with expectation of joy;
Thus our thirsty soul now desire.

No more fatigue, no more labour,
Nor sin, nor death shall reach
The place,
The voice of pain shall not
Sound there;
Which warble from immortal
Tongue.

No rude alarms of raging foes,
The rest without anxiety,
The daylight will not be
Dark there;
But sacred day, eternal noon.

O long expected day begin,
Dawn on this realms of world
Of pain,
With joy we shall walk
Path of joy
And sleep in death to rest
With the Lord. Amen.

Olúwa gbọ àdúrà wa,
Ńnú 'lé Rẹ l'ọjọ mímọ yìí:
Bí ẹbọ ọpẹ ní 'lé yìí,
K'órin wa ję ìtẹwọgbà.

Olúwa, ìsinmi Rẹ dùn:
Sùgbọn t'òkè ju t'ayé lọ;
Síbẹ pẹlu 'rétí ayọ,
Lí ọkàn òngbẹ wa ń sàárẹ.

Kò sí àárẹ, kò sí isẹ,
Ẹsẹ, ikú kì yóó dé 'bẹ,
Ohun ìrora kì yóó dún;
Ní'bi tí ahọn àìkú wà.

Kò sí ìdágìrì ọtá,
Ìsinmi láìsí àníyàn,
Ojú ọjọ kìí sú níbẹ,
Ọsán gangan ayérayé.

Bẹrẹ, ọjọ t'á ti ń retí,
Mọ sí ayé irira yìí,
A ó f'ayọ̀ rìn lọna t'ayọ
A ó sì sùn nínú Olúwa.
Àmín.

englishTitle: O DAY OF REST AND GLADNESS

sections.text:
O day of rest and gladness,
O day of joy and light,
O balm of care and sadness,
Most beautiful, most bright;
On thee, the high and lowly,
Through ages join'd in tune,
Sing Holy, Holy, Holy,
To God the great Triune.

On Thee, at the Creation,
The light first had its birth;
On Thee, for our salvation,
Christ rose from depths of earth,
On Thee our Lord victorious
The Spirit sent from heav'n;
And thus on Thee most glorious
A triple light was giv'n.

Today on weary nations,
The heav'nly manna falls;
The holy convocations
The silver trumpet calls
Where Gospel-light is glowing
With pure and radiant beams,
And living water flowing
With soul refreshing streams.

May we, new graces gaining
From this our day of rest,
Attain the rest remaining
To spirits of the blest;
And there, our voice upraising
To Father, and to Son,
And Holy Ghost, be praising
The blessed Three in One.
Amen.

Ọjọ 'sinmi àt'ayọ̀,
Ọjọ inú dídùn,
Ìtúnú fún 'bànújẹ
Ọjọ dídáa jùlọ,
Tí àwọn ẹni giga,
Níwájú ìtẹ Rẹ;
N kọ mímọ, mímọ, mímọ,
S'Ẹni Mẹtalọkan.

L'ọjọ yìí n'ìmọlẹ là,
Nígbà dídá ayé,
Àti fún ìgbàlà wa,
Kríst' jínde ń'nú òkú,
L'ọjọ yìí li Olúwa,
Rán Ẹmi t'ọrun wá,
Ọjọ ológo jùlọ,
T'á tan 'mọlẹ pípé.

Lónìí sí 'lùú t'áàrẹ mú,
Ni manna t'ọrun ń bọ,
Sí ìpéjọpọ mímọ,
N'ìpè fàdákà ń dún,
Ní 'bi tí ìyìnre,
N tàn ìmọlẹ mímọ,
Omi ìyè ń sàn jẹjẹ;
Tí ń tu ọkàn lara.

K'á r'oore-ọfẹ títún,
L'ọjọ 'sinmi wa yìí,
K'á sì dé 'sinmi t'ó kù
F'áwọn alábùkún,
Ní'bẹ k'á gbó'hùn s'ókè,
Sí Baba àt'ọmọ;
Ní 'yin Mẹtalọkan. Ààmín.

englishTitle: LORD OF THE SABBATH, HEAR OUR VOWS

sections.text:
Lord of the Sabbath,
Hear our vows,
On this Thy day,
In this Thy house;
And own, as grateful sacrifice
The songs which from Thy
Servants rise.

Thine earthly Sabbaths,
Lord, we love
But there's nobler rest above;
To that our lab'ring souls aspire
With ardent hope
And strong desire.

No more fatigue,
No more distress,
Nor sin nor hell, shall reach the
Place;
No sighs shall mingle
With the songs
Which warble from immortal
Tongues.

No rude alarms of raging foes,
No cares to break
The long repose,
No midnight shade,
No clouded sun;
But sacred, high, eternal noon.

O long-expected day, begin!
Dawn on these realms
Of woe and sin;
Fain would we leave this
Weary road,
And sleep in death, to rest with
God. Amen.

Olúwa ọjọ ìsinmi,
Gbọ ẹjẹ wa níhin-ín, lónìí,
Gba orin ìyìn tí a ń kọ,
Bí ẹbọ ọpẹ wa sí Q.

Kò s'áàrẹ mọ tàbí 'pọnjú,
Ẹsẹ tàb'ègbé kì ó dé 'bẹ:
Òsé kì yóó dàpọ m'ẹrin;
Tí àwọn ẹni àìkú ń kọ.

Bẹrẹ, ọjọ t'á ti ń retí,
Àfẹmọjú rẹ l'a fẹ rí,
A fẹ yọ! Lọnà isẹ yìí,
K'á sì dé ibi 'sinmi náà.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS WE LOVE TO MEET

sections.text:
Jesus we love to meet,
On this Thy holy day.
We gather round Thy throne
On this Thy holy day.
Thou art our heav'nly
Friend;
Our pray'rs ascend to Thee;
Look on our spirits, Lord,
On this Thy holy day.

Let us shake off dull sloth,
On this Thy holy day.
We kneel in reverence, Lord
On this Thy holy day.
Our sins may Thou forgive,
And may Thou teach us,
Lord;
To worship as we ought,
On this Thy holy day.

We listen to Thy word,
On this Thy holy day.
Bless all the words we hear,
On this Thy holy day.
As we part, be with us,
Thy salvation impart,
To every heart, dear Lord;
On this Thy holy day.
Amen.

Jésù, a fẹ pàdé,
L'ọjọ Rẹ mímọ yìí.
A sì yí 'tẹ Rẹ ká,
L'ọjọ Rẹ mímọ yìí.
'Wọ ọrẹ wa ọrun,
Àdúrà wa ń bọ wá,
Bojú wo ẹmi wa,
L'ọjọ Rẹ mímọ yìí.

A kò gbọdọ lọra,
L'ọjọ Rẹ mímọ yìí.
Lí ẹrù a kúnlẹ,
L'ọjọ Rẹ mímọ yìí.
Máa tọ gbogb'èrò wa,
Kí 'Wọ k'ó sì kọ wa,
K'á sin Ọ b'ó ti yẹ;
L'ọjọ Rẹ mímọ yìí.

A tẹtí s'ọrọ Rẹ
L'ọjọ Rẹ mímọ yìí.
Bù kún ọrọ t'á gbọ,
L'ọjọ Rẹ mímọ yìí.
Bá wa lọ 'gbà t'á lọ,
F'oore ìgbàlà Rẹ
Sí àyà wa gbogbo,
L'ọjọ Rẹ mímọ yìí.
Àmín.

englishTitle: SIX DAYS OF WORK AND TOIL ARE PAST

sections.text:
Six days of work
And toil are past,
This one begun,
Is meant for rest,
Come thou my heart,
And take thine rest;
Rejoice thou in the day
God bless'd.

O Lord, we rejoice
At Thy work,
In various hues, both new
And old,
We praise Thee, Lord,
For mercy giv'n;
In earnest hope of that
To come.

Let all our thoughts
And praise rise,
Like sweet incense
Unto Thy throne,
That it may bring down
Joy untold;
Known only to those
Made holy.

This heav'nly peace
Of heart is giv'n,
As witness of glorious rest,
To the ones who have
Been made pure;
The end of afflictions and
Cares.
Amen.

Ọjọ mẹfà t'isẹ kọjá,
Ọkan tí'sinmi sì bẹrẹ,
Wá, ọkàn mi sí 'sinmi rẹ,
Yọ s'ọjọ t'Ọlọrun bù sí.

Ọlọrun, a yọ sí 'sẹ Rẹ,
L'ónírúurú t'ó gbọ t'ọrun;
A f'ìyìn ro àánú t'ó lọ,
A ní 'rètí s'éyìí tí ń bọ.

Kí 'rònú àt'ọpẹ wa nde,
B'ẹbọ tùràrí s'ọrun;
K'ó lè fa inú dídùn wá,
T'ó ję tęni t'ó mọ nìkan.

Ìbàlẹ àyà ọrun yìí,
L'ẹrí ìsinmi t'ó l'ógo;
T'ó wà fún ènìyàn mímọ,
Òpin àníyàn àt'àisàn.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THIS IS THE DAY THE LORD HATH MADE

sections.text:
This is the day the Lord
Hath made,
He calls the hours His own,
Let Heav'n rejoice,
Let earth be glad,
And praise surrounds
His throne.

Today, He rose and left the
Dead,
And Satan's empire fell;
Today, the saints His
Triumphs spread,
And all His wonders tell.

Hosanna to the anointed King,
To David's Holy Son!
Help us, O Lord descend
And bring;
Salvation from Thy throne.

Bless'd be the Lord,
Who comes to men,
With messages of grace;
Who comes, in God His
Father's Name:
To save our sinful race.

Hosanna in the highest strains,
The church on earth can raise;
The highest heav'ns, in which
He reigns,
Shall give Him nobler praise.
Amen.

Èyí l'ọjọ t'Ólúwa dá,
Ó pe 'gbà náà ń'Tirẹ,
K'ọrun k'ó yọ, k'áyé k'ó yọ;
Kí 'yìn yí 'tẹ náà ká.

Lónìí, Ó jínde ń'nú òkú,
Ìjọba Sátán 'tú,
'Wọn mímọ tàn'sẹgun Rẹ ká;
Wọn ń s'ọrọ 'yanu Rẹ.

Hòsánà sí Ọba t'a yàn,
S'ọmọ mímọ Dáfíd',
Olúwa, jọ'ọ sọkalẹ wá;
T'Ìwọ t'ìgbàlà Rẹ.

Abùkún l'Olúwa t'ó wá,
N'iṣẹ oore-ọfẹ,
T'ó wá l'órúkọ Baba Rẹ;
Láti gbà 'ran wa là.

Hòsánà lí ohùn gooro,
L'orin Ìjọ t'ayé,
Orin t'òkè ọrun l'ọhùn-ún,
Yóó dùn jù bẹẹ lọ.
Ààmín

englishTitle: SWEET IS THE WORK, MY GOD MY KING

sections.text:
Sweet is the work,
My God my King,
To praise Thy name, give
Thanks and sing;
To show Thy love by
Morning light,
And talk of all Thy truth
At night.

Sweet is the day of sacred rest,
No mortal cares disturb
My breast,
O may my heart in tune
Be found;
Like David's harp of solemn
Sound!

My heart shall triumph
In the Lord,
And bless His works
And bless His word:
Thy works of grace, how
Bright they shine!
How deep Thy counsels,
How divine!

And I shall share
A glorious part,
When grace has well
Refined my heart,
And fresh supplies of joy
Are shed,
Like Holy oil, to cheer my head.

Then shall I see, and hear, know,
All I desired or wish'd below;
And every pow'r find
Sweet employ
In that eternal world of joy.
Amen.

Dídùn ni 'ṣẹ náà, Ọba mi,
Láti máa yin orúkọ Rẹ,
Láti se 'fẹ Rẹ l'ówúrọ,
Láti sọ òótọ Rẹ l'álẹ.

Dídùn l'ọjọ 'sinmi mímọ,
Láàláà kò sí fún mi l'ónìí,
Ọkàn mi 'bá lè máa kọ orin
Bí ohùn dùùrù Dáfídì!

Ọkàn mi ó yọ ń'Olúwa,
Y'ó yin iṣẹ àt'ọrọ Rẹ
Iṣẹ oore Rẹ ti pọ tó!
Ìjìnlẹ sì ni ìmọ Rẹ.

Èmi ó yan ipò ọlá,
'Gb'oore-ọfẹ bá wẹ mí nù,
Tí ayọ púpọ sì bá mi;
Ayọ mímọ lát'òkè wá.

englishTitle: ERE ANOTHER SABBATH CLOSE

sections.text:
Ere another Sabbath close,
Ere again we seek repose,
Lord, our song ascends to Thee,
At Thy feet we bow the knee.

For the mercies of the day
For this rest upon our way,
Thanks to Thee alone be giv'n;
Lord and King of earth and
Heav'n.

Cold our services have been;
Pray'rs and praises stain'd
with sin
But Thou canst and wilt
Forgive,
By Thy grace alone we live.

Whilst this thorny
path we tread,
May Thy love our
Footsteps lead;
When our journey here is past,
May we rest with Thee at last.

May our earthly
Sabbaths prove,
Foretastes of our joy above;
While our pilgrim steps
We bend;
To the rest, which knows no
End. Amen.

K'ọjọ 'sinmi yíí tó tán,
K'á tó lọ f'ara lé'lẹ,
Àwa wólẹ l'ẹsẹ Rẹ,
A ń kọrin ìyìn sí Ọ.

Fún àánú ọjọ ònì,
Fún ìsinmi l'ọnà wa,
'Wọ nikan l'a f'ọpẹ fún,
Olúwa àt'Ọba wa.

Ìsin wa kò níláárí,
Àdúrà wa lù m'ẹsẹ,
Sùgbọn 'Wọ l'ó ń fẹsẹ jì;
Oor'ọfẹ Rẹ tó fún wa.

Jẹ kí 'fẹ Rẹ máa tọ wa,
B'á ti ń rin'nú ayé yíí,
Nígbà t'ájò wa bá pin,
K'á lè sinmi l'ọdọ Rẹ

K'ọjọ 'sinmi wọn yí jẹ,
Ìbẹrẹ ayọ ọrun,
B'á ti ń rin àjò wa lọ;
Sí 'sinmi tí kò l'ópin.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THIS IS THE DAY OF LIGHT

sections.text:
This is the day of rest:
Our failing strength renew;
On weary brain and troubled
Breast,
Shed Thou Thy freshening dew.

This is the day of pray'r,
Let earth to heav'n draw near,
Lift up our hearts to seek
Thee there.
Come down to meet us here.

This is the first of days:
Send forth Thy quick'ning
Breath,
And wake dead souls to love
And praise,
O vanquisher of death!
Amen.

Ọjọ 'mọlẹ l'èyí,
Kí 'mọlẹ wà lónií,
'Wọ oòrùn ràn s'ókùnkùn wa,
K'ó sì lé òru lọ.

Ọjọ 'sinmi l'èyí,
S'agbára wa d'ọtun,
S'óri àibalẹ àyà wa,
Sẹ 'rì ìtura Rẹ.

Ọjọ àlàáfíà
F' àlàáfíà fún wa;
Dá ìyapa gbogbo dúró,
Sì mú ìjà kúrò.

englishTitle: HOLY SPIRIT COME DOWN ON THIS

sections.text:
Holy Spirit come down on this
Thy day of rest.
Without Thee our worship
Is vain,
Vanity is our pray'r.

Vanity is our song,
Our preaching will be vain.
Unprofitable our gathering,
Except if Thou be there.

Great Messenger from Heav'n,
Who knows Thy beginning?
Talk Thou to us by Thy ownself;
Through this Thy servant here.

Teach us how to seek Thee,
For all of our requests,
With groaning that can't
Be uttered;
Take to Jesus our pray'rs.

Through Thy gracious leading,
We hope for Thy mercy,
Our service will be bless'd
Indeed;
If Thou be with us here.
Amen.

Ẹmí wá bá wa pé,
L'ọjọ ìsinmi yìí;
Láìsí Rẹ àwa kò lè sì, 
A kò lè gb'àdúrà.

Asán li orin wa,
Ìwàásù wa asán.
Ìpéjọpọ wa kò l'èrè;
A fi b'Ọ pẹlú wa.

Òjíṣẹ́ ọrun ńlá
Tani mọ bẹ̀rẹ̀ Rẹ̀?
Tikálarẹ wàásù fún wa;
Nípa íránṣẹ Rẹ̀.

Wá kọ wa láti bẹ,
L'ohun t'á bá tọrọ
Sì mú 'bèèrè wa tọ Jésù;
T'á bẹ l'órúkọ Rẹ̀.

Nípa 'rànlọwọ Rẹ̀,
L'a n'írètí áánú,
Ìsin wa kò lè sài l'érè;
Bí 'Wọ bá pẹlú wa.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE LORD OF SABBATH LET US PRAISE

sections.text:
The Lord of Sabbath
Let us praise,
In concert with the blest,
Who, joyful, in harmonious
Lays,
Employ an endless rest.

Thus, Lord, while we
Remember Thee,
We blest and pious grow;
By hymns of praise
We learn to be,
Triumphant here below.

On this glad day a brighter
Scene,
Of glory was displayed,
By God, th' eternal Word,
Than when;
This universe was made.

He rises, who mankind has
Bought,
With grief and pain extreme:
'Twas great to speak a world
From naught,
'Twas greater to redeem!
Amen.

Jẹ k'á yin Olúwa ‘sinmi,
Pẹlu àwọn mímọ,
Tí ń f' ayọ àt'orin dídùn
Lọ 'sinmi àìlópin.

Olúwa, b'á ti ń rántí Rẹ̀,
N 'ìbùkún wa ń pọ síi;
Nípa orin ìyin l'a ń kọ,
B' á tíí y'ayọ 'sẹgun.

L'ọjọ ayọ yìí l'Ọlọrun,
Ọrọ ayérayé,
F'isẹ ńlá hàn, t'ó l'ógo jù,
Ti ìṣẹdá ayé.

Ó jínde, Ẹni f'irora,
Ra gbogbo ẹdá padà;
Isẹ ńlá ni dídá ayé,
Ìdándè jù 'yí lọ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: HOW SWEET IT IS THIS HOLY DAY
yorubaTitle: B'Ó TI DÚN TÓ L'ỌJ' ỌWỌ YÍ

sections.text:
How sweet it is this holy day,
A day most beautiful,
To set aside all earthly care;
And lift our thoughts to
Heav'n.

How sweet it is to have the
Joy,
That comes through pard'ning
Grace!
To say with boldness, as a
Son;
“Father, who art in heav'n.”

To hear the words that brings
Sweet peace,
Sent through Thy servants's
Mouth,
A broken heart that weeps
For sin,
And sees the gates of heav'n.

And if thou come to
Jesus Christ,
To wash thy sins away,
The One who knows and sees
The heart;
Will send abundant grace.

Welcome, thou holy day,
Welcome,
A day most beautiful,
Assembled here are we to pay;
Our vows and gratitude.
Amen.

B' ò ti dùn tó l'ọj' ọwọ yìí,
Ọjọ t'ó dára jù,
Kí a pa 'rònú ayé tì,
K' á ronú nnkan t'ọrun!

B'ó ti dùn tó láti l'áyo,
Bẹbẹ fún 'dàríjì!
K'á fí 'gboyà ọmọ wí pé,
“Baba tí ń bẹ l'ọrun.”

Láti gb'ọr' àlàáfíà dídùn,
Lát' ẹnu 'rànsẹ Rẹ;
Láti mú k'á sọkún ẹsẹ,
K'á rí ọna ọrun.

B'ó bá sì jẹ pé ó ti wá,
Láti lé ẹsẹ lọ,
Ẹni t'Ó ń wo inú ọkàn,
Yóó rán oor'ọfẹ wá.

Njẹ máa wolẹ ọjọ ọwọ,
Ọjọ t'ó dára jù,
T'ọkàn pé láti san ẹjẹ
Ìm'oore fún ọrun.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: OUR GOD WHO ART IN HEAV'N

sections.text:
Our God who art in heav'n,
Who in only six days,
Created everything on earth;
Rested on seventh day.

It is Thy strict command,
To hallow seventh day,
But for those who will not obey;
Thine anger will wax hot.

Each ancestor of ours,
In darkness of sin died,
They were die-hard idolaters;
Without knowing the law.

Here we come Jesus Lord,
Following Thy command,
After our six days of labour;
Gather'd to do Thy will.

Day of rest is holy,
We ought to rest in it
Assembled are we in Thy house,
To hear Thy Holy word.

There is still one great rest,
For Thy people oh Lord,
O Jesus Lord,
Thou blessed Son,
Lead us unto Thy rest.
Amen.

Ọlọrun wa ọrun,
T'ó fi ọjọ mẹfà
Dá nnkan gbogbo
Tí ń bẹ láyé,
Sinmi ní 'jọ keje!

Àwọn baba ńlá wa,
Ti kú nín' òkùnkùn;
Wọn jẹ ògbó abọrìsà,
Wọn kò mọ òfin Rẹ.

Àwa dé Olúwa,
Gẹgẹ bí àṣẹ Rẹ:
Lẹyin iṣẹ ìjọ mẹfà,
Láti se ìfẹ Rẹ.

Mímọ l'ọjọ ònì,
Ó yẹ kí á sinmi,
K'á pé jọ nínú ilé Rẹ,
K'á gbọ 'rọ mímọ Rẹ.

Ìsinmi ńlá kan kù,
F'áwọn èniyàn Rẹ,
Ọm'Ọlọrun,
Álábùkún,
Mú wa dé 'sinmi Rẹ!
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE HEAV'NLY HOST ARE ALL ASTIR
yorubaTitle: GBOGB' OGUN ỌRUN Ń RỌ KẸKẸ

sections.text:
The Heav'nly host are all astir,
The angels take up their harps,
The saints all set with
Their voices;
To join the glorious worship.
Our God's day of rest
Has now come,
It is a most glorious day;
Heav'n fill'd with joyful
Noises,
How delightful their worship!

Let us join with the
Heav'nly throng,
To praise God, He is our King.
Let us cleanse and prepare
Our hearts,
And sing with holy voices.
Ours can only be a foretaste,
Of their rest in heav'n above,
Until we see the Lord our God;
Whom we worship face to face.

And until then, let us go on,
Worshiping on the Lord's Day.
Let's set aside our anxious
Cares,
Invoke His presence 'midst us.
He has commanded so to do,
His Blessings He will bestow.
Let us serve Him without
Fainting;
He will surely reward us.
Amen.

Gbogb'ogun ọrun ń rọ kẹkẹ
Áńgẹlì mú hápù wọn,
Àwọn mímọ ń t'ohun
Wọn se,
Láti jọsin t'ó l'ógo;
Ọjọ t'ó l'ógo jùlọ,
Ọrun kún fún ìhó ayọ,
Háà! Bí 'sin wọn ti dùn tó.

Jẹ k'á pẹlú àwọn t'ọrun,
Yin Ọlọrun Ọba wa;
Jẹ k'á pa'lẹ ọkàn wa mọ,
K'á f'ohùn mímọ kọrin,
Àpẹẹrẹ ni tiwa lè jẹ
T'ìsinmi ti wọn l'ókè,
Títí a ó fi rí Ọlúwa;
Tí a ń sìn l'ójúkojú.

K'ó tó d'ìgbà náà, ẹ jẹ kí
A máa sìn Ìn l'ọjọ keje,
K'á f'àníyàn wa s'ápákan;
K'á pé sí'nú ilé Rẹ;
Ó ti pà'ṣẹ k'á máa se bẹẹ,
Yóó bùkún ìpèjọ wa,
Ẹ jẹ k'á sìn Ìn lí àìsàárẹ,
Èrè rẹ yóó jẹ tiwa.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HOW SWEET THE WORD OF GOD TO HEAR.
yorubaTitle: BÍ MO TI YỌ LÁTI GB' ỌRỌ

sections.text:
How sweet the word
Of God to hear,
From the mouth of our friends,
That we should gather in Zion,
To keep the holy day.

Its env'rons and the gates I keep,
The decorated house,
The house that we built
For our God;
Where His mercy, to show.

The courtyard of the
House of joy,
Where holy tribes went forth,
On the throne, the Son of David;
Is judging matter there.

He hears our praises
And our cries,
Like His tremendous voice,
That separate sinners
To his doom;
In tremble we rejoice.

Let Thy blessing be in
The place,
And joy of often time,
Let us give friends,
And His goodness;
To all that serve Him there.

My soul's now pleading
For Zion,
While I am still alive,
There all the relatives
And friends;
Our Saviour too is there.
Amen.

Bí mo ti yọ láti gb'ọrọ,
L'ẹnu àwọn ọrẹ;
Pé, “Ní Síon ni k'á pé sí
K'á p'ọjọ mímọ mọ.”

S'ágbàlá ilé ayọ náà,
L'ẹyà mímọ sí lọ,
Ọmọ Dáfíd' wà l'órí 'tẹ;
Ó ń dá ẹjọ ní'bẹ.

Ó gbọ ìyìn àt'igbe wa;
Bí ohùn ẹrù Rẹ,
Tí ń ya ẹlẹṣẹ sí 'b'ègbé,
A ń yọ ní wárìrì.

Kí 'bùkún pẹlú ibẹ náà,
Ayọ nígbàkugbà;
K'á fi ọrẹ àti oore,
F'áwọn tí ń sìn ní'bẹ.

Ọkàn mi bẹbẹ fún Síon',
Nígbà tí ẹmí wà;
Ní'bẹ n' ìbátan àt'ọrẹ
Àt'Olùgbàlà wà.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HOW DELIGHTFUL IS THE LORD'S DAY

sections.text:
How delightful is the
Lord's Day,
The bell that rings, the word
We hear,
When I feel sad and sorrowful,
They always made my heart
So glad.

How delightful also the hour,
That I observe within
Thy courts,
To know the sweet pleasure
In pray'r;
Partake the manna of Thy word.

There is delight in the “Amen”,
From many lips that fills
The house,
Intermittently rise and fall,
And passes to the Father's
Throne.

The world may wish to tie
Me down,
To its six-day labour burden,
Break up the chain; remove
The snare,
Release my soul and set me
Free. Amen.

Ayọ l'ọjọ 'sinmi fún mi,
Àt'agogo àt'ìwàásù;
Gbà t'á bá ń'nú 'bànújẹ
Àwọn l'ó ń mú inú mi dùn.

Ayọ ni ìdáhùn “Ààmín”,
T'ó gba gbogbo ilé náà kan,
Lẹẹkọọkan l'ó ń dún t'ó ń
rọlẹ;
Ó ń kọjá lọ s'ọdọ Baba.

B'áyé fẹ f'agbára dè mí,
Mọ isẹ ijọ mẹfà rẹ;
Olúwa, jọ'ọ tú ìdè náà,
K'ó sọ ọkàn mi d'òm'nira.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HALLOWED DAY AND HOLY

sections.text:
Hallowed day and Holy,
Thou holy day of rest,
We ought to give one full day,
To God, the good and kind.
Other days bring the tear drops,
Thou wipes the tears away,
Thou art a day of gladness;
I love thy happy morn.

Hallowed day and Holy,
There is no work today,
We will suspend our labour,
Until tomorrow's day.
How beautiful and how bright,
Thou blessed day of rest,
Other days speak of troubles;
But thou give hope of rest.

Hallowed day and Holy,
Hear how the Church bell says,
Give one day to thy Maker,
Who gave to you six days.
We shall take leave of labour,
To go and worship there,
Both we and all dear friends;
On to the house of pray'r.

Hallowed day and Holy,
Thy hour delights me so,
A taste of heav'n you give us,
Like that eternal rest.
Lord, let me be partaker,
Of rest beyond the grave,
To sing and serve Thee ever;
With all Thy saints above. Amen.

Osẹ, Osẹ rere,
À kì yóó s'isẹ lónìí;
A ó f'isẹ wa gbogbo,
Fún àisinmi ọla,
Dídán l'ojú rẹ máa dán,
'Wọ arẹwà ọjọ;
Ọjọ mí-ìn ń sọ ti lààlàá,
Ìwọ ń sọ t 'isinmi.

Osẹ, Osẹ rere,
Àago tilẹ ń wí pé,
F'Ẹlẹdàá rẹ l'ọjọ kan,
T'O fún ọ ní 'jọ mẹfà
A ó fi 'sẹ wa sílẹ,
Láti lọ sìn ní'bẹ,
Àwa àti ọrẹ wa,
A ó lọ sílé àdúà.

Osẹ, Osẹ rere,
Wákàtí rẹ wù mí;
Ọjọ ọrun ni 'wọ se,
'Wọ àpẹẹrẹ ọrun,
Olúwa, jẹ kí n jogún,
'Sinmi lẹyin ikú;
Kí n lè máa sìn Ọ títí,
Pẹlú èniyàn Rẹ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE LORD'S OWN HALLOW'D DAY OF REST

sections.text:
The Lord's own hallow'd
Day of rest
O day most beautiful and right;
A day given to us by God
For us, a day to rest therein.

Six days He provided for us
To do all that we have to do;
The seventh day He set aside,
It is God's hallow'd day of rest.

Let us forsake our vain pursuits,
Our daily duties for six days,
Our work today, let hallow'd be,
Because the day belongs to God.

Strength from above energizes
Us well,
For service in the house of God;
Let us sing a joyful anthem,
On the Lord's day, this early
Morn.

Very early in the morning,
On the Lord's hallowed
Day of rest,
Let us raise a joyful chorus;
And let us lift our hearts to pray.
Amen.

Ọjọ ìsinmi Ọlọrun,
Ọjọ tí ó dára jùlọ;
Tí Ọlọrun ti fi fún wa,
K'áwa k'ó sinmi nínú rę.

Ìjọ mẹfà l'Ó fi fún wa,
K'á fi se iṣẹ wa gbogbo;
Sùgbọn ọjọ keje yàtọ,
Ọjọ 'sinmi Ọlọrun ni.

K'á fi'ṣẹ asán wa sílẹ,
Tí àwa ń se ní 'jọ mẹfà;
Mímọ ni iṣẹ ti òni,
Tí Ọlọrun Olúwa wa.

Agbára dé nísinsinyí,
Ńnú ilé Ọlọrun wa,
Jẹ k'á kọrin dídùn sí I,
Lí òwúrọ ọjọ óní.

Ní kùtùkùtù 'jọ keje,
Ní ọjọ ìsinmi mímọ,
Jẹ k'á jùmọ kọrin dídùn,
Jẹ k'á sì jùmọ gbàdúrà.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HOW OUR HEARTS LONG FOR THEE
yorubaTitle: A BẸ, A FẸ RÍ Ọ

sections.text:
How our hearts long for Thee,
Thou hallowed day of rest,
All the week long,
We long for Thee;
Thou hallowed day of rest.

Thou hast taught us to know,
Christ rose up from the dead,
All the week long,
We long for thee;
Thou hallowed day of rest.

Telling us we shall rise,
As Jesus also rose,
All the week long,
We long for thee;
Thou hallowed day of rest.
Amen.

A bẹ, a fẹ rí Ọ,
Ọjọ 'sinmi rere
Gbogbo ọsẹ á máa wí pé,
Ìwọ ó ti pẹ tó?

Ó kọ wa pé Krístì,
Jínde nínú òkú;
Gbogbo ọṣẹ á máa wí pé,
Ìwọ ó ti pẹ tó?

Ó sọ t'àjínde wa,
Gege bí ti Jésù;
Gbogbo ọṣẹ á máa wí pé,
Ìwọ ó ti pẹ tó?
Ààmín.

englishTitle: NOW THE DAY IS OVER

sections.text:
Now the day is over,
Night is drawing nigh,
Shadows of the evening
Steal a-cross the sky.

Now the darkness gathers,
Stars their watches keep,
Birds and beasts and flowers,
Soon will be asleep.

Jesus, give the weary
Calm and sweet repose;
With Thy tend'rest blessing
May mine eye-lids close.

Grant to little children
Visions bright of Thee,
Guard the sailors tow-ing;
On the deep blue sea.

Comfort every sufferer
Watching late in pain;
Those who plan some evil
From their sin restrain.

Through the long night
Watches
May Thine angels spread
Their white wings above me,
Watching round my bed.

When the morning wakens,
Then may I arise
Pure and fresh and sin-less
In Thy holy eyes.

Glory to the Father
Glory to the Son
And to Thee, blest Spirit,
Whilst all ages run. Amen.

Ọjọ òní lọ tàn,
Ọru sún mọ'lé,
Òkùnkùn ti dé ná,
Ilẹ sì ti sú.

Òkùnkùn bo ilẹ,
Awọn 'ràwọ yọ:
Ẹranko àt'ẹyẹ;
Lọ sí 'bùsùn wọn.

Jésù f'oorun dídùn,
F'ẹni aláàrẹ;
Jẹ kí ìbùkún Rẹ,
Pa ojú mi dé.

Máa tojú aláìsàn,
Tí kò r'óorun sùn,
Awọn tí ń ro ibi;
Jọ'ọ, dá wọn l'ẹkun.

N'nú gbogb' ewu òru,
Jẹ k'angẹli Rẹ,
Máa se olùṣọ mi;
L'órí'bùsùn mi.

Gbà iḷẹ bá sì mọ,
Jẹ k'émi dìde,
B'ọmọ tí kò l'ẹṣẹ;
Ní iwájú Rẹ.

Ògo ni fún Baba,
Àti fún Ọmọ,
Àti f'Ẹmí Mímọ;
Láé àti láéláé. Ààmín.

englishTitle: FROM ALL DANGERS OF THE NIGHT

sections.text:
From all the dangers of the Night,
Jesus my Lord protects,
'Am privilege to see this Night;
I kneel to worship Thee.

Jesus my Lord keep me today,
Protect me in Thy hands;
It is only those Thou keepest,
That are safe from danger.

Let my speech and
My behavior,
Depict that I am Thine,
So much that Thy great
Light of truth;
May shine thro'out the earth.

O let me not depart from Thee,
