Thou oh my Saviour dear,
Until I see with mine own eyes;
Thy glorious face at last. Amen.

Nínú gbogbo ewu òru,
Olúwa l'ó ń ṣọ wa
Àwa sì tún rí 'mọlẹ yìí,
A tún tẹ eékún ba.

Olúwa, pa wá mọ l'ónìí,
Fi apá Rẹ ṣọ wa,
Kìkì àwọn t'Ìwọ pa mọ
L'ó ń yọ nínú ewu!

K'ọrọ wa, àti ìwà wa,
Wí pé, Tirẹ l'àwa,
Tó bẹẹ k'mọlẹ ótítọ
Lè tàn l'ójú ayé.

Má jẹ k'á padà lọdọ Rẹ,
Olùgbàlà ọwọn
Títí a ó f'ojú wa rí
Ojú Rẹ ní 'kẹyin. Ààmín.

englishTitle: FATHER, BREATHE AN EVENING BLESSING

sections.text:
Though destruction walk around us,
Though the arrow past us fly,
Angel-guards from Thee surround us;
We are safe, if Thou art nigh.

Never fail us nor forsake us,
May sweet sleep our strength renew,
And the fresh'ning morn awake us;
Thy loved service to pursue.

Father, to Thy holy keeping,
Humbly we ourselves resign;
Saviour, who hast slept our sleeping,
Make our slumbers Pure as Thine.

Blessed Spirit, brooding o'er us,
Chase the darkness of our night;
Till the perfect day before us,
Breaks in everlasting light.
Amen.

K'á tó sùn, Olùgbàlà wa,
Fún wa ní'bùkún alẹ,
A jẹwọ ẹṣẹ wa fún Ọ;
Ìwọ l'Ó lè gbà wá là.
Bí ilẹ tilẹ sú dudu,
Òòkùn kò le se wa mọ,
Ìwọ Ẹni tí kìí s'àárẹ;
N sọ àwọn eniyan Rẹ.

Bí'parun tilẹ yí wa ká,
Tí ọfà ń fò wá kojá,
Àwọn ángẹlì yí wa ká;
Àwa ó wà l'áiléwu.

Má kọ wá, má fi wá sílẹ,
K'ágbára wa di ọtun,
Kí ìmọlẹ òórọ jí wa;
K'á lè máa fẹ iṣẹ Rẹ.

Ní'rẹlẹ, àwá f'ara wa,
Sábẹ ààbò Rẹ, Bàbá,
Jésù, 'Wọ t'ó sùn bí àwa;
Se oòrùn wa bí Tìrẹ.

Ẹmí Mímọ, ràdọ bò wá,
Tàn 'mọlẹ s'ókùnkùn wa,
Tít'àwa ó fi rí ọjọ,
Ìmọlẹ ayéraye. Ààmín.

englishTitle: ABIDE WITH ME, FAST FALLS THE EVENTIDE
yorubaTitle: WÁ BÁ MI GBÉ AIẸ FẸRẸ LẸ TÁN

sections.text:
Abide with me, fast falls
The eventide;
The darkness deepens,
Lord, with me abide!
When other helpers' fail,
And comforts flee,
Help of the helpless,
O abide with me.

Swift to its close ebbs
Out life's little day,
Earth's joys grow dim;
Its glories pass away,
Change and decay in all
Around I see
O Thou who changest not,
Abide with me!

Come not in terrors,
As the King of kings,
But kind and good,
With healing in Thy wings;
Tears for all woes, a heart for
Every plea,
Come Friend of sinners,
Thus abide with me.

I need Thy presence every
Passing hour,
What but Thy grace can foil
The tempter's pow'r?
Who like Thyself my guide
And stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine,
O abide with me.

I fear no foe, with Thee
At hand to bless;
Ills have no weight,
And tears no bitterness;
Where is death's sting?
Where grave, thy victory?
I triumph still, if thou abide
With me.

Wá bá mi gbé alẹ fẹrẹ lẹ tan,
Òkùnkùn ń sú, Olúwa
Bá mi gbé,
Bí olùrànlọwọ mìíràn bá yẹ,
Ìrànwọ aláìní wá bá mi gbé.

Ọjọ ayé mi ń sàré lọ s'ópin,
Ayọ ayé ń kú, ògo rẹ ń wọ'mi,
Ayídà àt 'ìbánújẹ ni mo ń rí,
'Wọ tí kìí yí padà wá bá mi
Gbé.

Má wá l'ẹrù b'Ọba àwọn ọba,
B'onínú're, wá pẹlú'wòsàn Rẹ,
Kí O sì máa k'ááánú fún
Ègbé mi,
Wá, Ọrẹ ẹlẹṣẹ, wá bá mi gbé.

Mo ń fẹ Ọ rí ní wákàtí gbogbo,
Kí l'ó lè sẹgun Èsù b'óore Rẹ?
Ta l'ó lè se amọna mi bí Rẹ?
N'nú 'bánújẹ àt'ayọ bá mi gbé.

Pẹlú 'bùkún Rẹ ẹrù kò bà mí,
Ibi kò wúwo, ẹkún kò korò,
Oró ikú dà? 'Sẹgun isà dà?
N ó sẹgun síbẹ bí 'Wọ
Bá mi gbé.

Wá bá mi gbé ní wákàtí ikú,
Se'mọlẹ mi, sì tọka sí ọrun,
B'áyé ti ń kojá, k'ílẹ ọrun mọ,
Ní yíyè, ní kíkú wá bá
mi gbé. Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE DAY THOU GAVEST LORD IS ENDED

sections.text:
The day Thou gavest,
Lord is ended,
The darkness falls at Thy behest;
To Thee our morning hymns
ascended,
Thy praise shall hallow
now our rest.

We thank Thee that Thy
Church unsleeping,
While earth rolls onward
into light,
Though all the world her watch
is keeping,
And rest not now by day
or night.

As o'er each continent
and island
The dawn leads on another day,
The voice of prayer is
never silent,
Nor dies the strain of praise
away.

The sun, that bids us rest,
is waking
Our brethren 'neath
the western sky,
And hour by hour fresh
lips are making
Thy wondrous doing heard
on high.

So be it, Lord Thy throne shall never,
Like earth's proud empires, pass away
But stand and rule, and grow for ever,
Till all Thy creatures own Thy way. Amen.

Olúwa ọjọ yìí ti d'ópin
Òkùnkùn sì dé l'ásẹ Rẹ,
'Wọ la ń kọrin òwúrọ wa sí,
Ìyin Rẹ yóó m'álẹ wa dùn.

A dúpẹ ti Ìjọ Rẹ ko ń sùn
B'áye ti ń lọ sí 'mọlẹ
Ó sì ń sọna ní gbogbo ayé,
Kò sì sinmi t'ọsán t'òru.

Bí'lẹ sì ti ń mọ l'ójooújúmọ,
Ní orílẹ àt'eékùsù,
Ohùn àdúrà kò dákẹ rí,
Bẹẹ l'orin ìyin kò dẹkun.

Oorùn t'ó wọ fún wa sì ti là,
S'áwọn ẹdá ìwọ-oòrùn,
Nígbàkugbà li ẹnu sì ń sọ
Isẹ 'yanu Rẹ di mímọ.

Bẹẹ Olúwa láé n'ìjọba Rẹ,
Kò dàbí ìjọba ayé,
Ó dúró, ó sì ń ṣe àkóso
Tít'ẹdá Rẹ ó júbà Rẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: GLORY TO THEE, MY GOD, THIS NIGHT

sections.text:
Glory to Thee, my God, this night,
For all the blessings of the light:
Keep me, o keep me;
King of kings,
Beneath Thine own Almighty wings.

Forgive me, Lord, for Thy dear Son,
The ill that I this day have done;
That with the world, myself, and Thee,
I, ere I sleep, at peace may be.

O may my soul on Thee repose,
And may sweet sleep mine eyelids close;
Sleep that may more vigorous make,
To serve my God when I awake.

If in the night I sleepless lie,
My soul with heav'nly thoughts supply,
Let no ill dreams disturb my rest,
No pow'rs of darkness Me molest.

Praise God, from whom all blessing flow,
Praise Him, all creatures here below,
Praise Him above, ye heav'nly host;
Praise Father, Son and Holy Ghost. Amen.

Ògo f'Ọlọrun l'álẹ yìí
Fún gbogbo oore ìmọlẹ,
Sọ mi Ọba àwọn ọba
L'ábẹ òjìji ìyẹ Rẹ.

Olúwa f'ẹsẹ mi jì mí,
Nítorí Ọmọ Rẹ, lónìí
K'émi lè wà l'álàáfíà
Pẹlú Ìwọ àti ayé.

Jẹ k'ọkàn mi lè sùn lé Ọ,
K'óorun dídùn p'ojú mi dé,
Oorun tí yóó m'ára mi le;
Kí n lè sìn Ọ lí òwúrọ.

Bí mo bá dùbúlẹ láìsùn,
F'èrò ọrun kún ọkàn mi,
Má jẹ kí n lá 'láá búburú,
Má jẹ kí 'pá òòkùn bò mí.

Yin Ọlọrun, ibú ọrẹ;
Ẹ yín Ín, ẹyin ẹdá ayé,
Ẹ yín Ín, ẹyin ẹdá ọrun,
Yin Baba, Ọmọ òun Ẹmi. Ààmin.

englishTitle: SUN OF MY SOUL, THOU SAVIOUR DEAR

sections.text:
Sun of my soul, Thou Saviour dear,
It is not night if Thou be near;
O may no earth-born cloud arise,
To hide Thee from Thy servant's eyes!

When the soft dews of kindly sleep,
My wearied eyelids gently sleep,
Be my last thought, how sweet to rest;
For ever on my Saviour's breast!

Abide with me from morn till eve,
For without Thee I cannot live;
Abide with me when night is nigh,
For without Thee I dare not die.

If some poor wand'ring child of Thine
Have spurned to day the voice divine,
Now, Lord, Thy gracious work, begin;
Let him no more lie down in sin.

Watch by the sick; enrich the poor
With blessings from Thy boundless store;
Be every mourner's sleep To-night
Like infant's slumbers, pure and light.

Come near and bless us when we wake,
Ere through the world our way we take,
Till in the ocean of Thy love
We lose ourselves in heav'n above. Amen.

Ìwọ ìmọlẹ ọkàn mi,
Ní ọdọ Rẹ, òru kò sí,
Kí kùukùu ayé má bò Ọ,
Kúrò l'ójú ìránsẹ Rẹ.

Nígbà t'oorun alẹ dídùn
Bá n pa ìpénpé 'jú mi dé,
K'érò mi ję láti sinmi,
Láé l'áyà Olùgbàlà mi.

Bá mi gbé l'óòórọ tít'alẹ,
Láisí Rẹ, èmi kò lè wà,
Bá mi gbé 'gba'lẹ bá ń sú;
Láisí Rẹ, èmi kò lè kú.

Bí òtòsì ọmọ Rẹ kan,
Bá tàpá s'ọrọ Rẹ lónìí,
Olúwa, s'isẹ oore Rẹ;
Má ję k'ó sùn nínú ẹsẹ.

Bù kún fún àwọn aláìsàn,
Pèsè fún àwọn tálákà
K'órun oníròbínújẹ,
Dàbí oorun ọmọ títún.

Súre fún wa nígbà t'a jí,
K'á tó m'ohun ayé yìí se,
Títí àwa ó dé 'bi 'fẹ;
T'a ó sì dé ìjọba Rẹ.
Ààmin.

englishTitle: AT EVEN, ERE THE SUN WAS SET

sections.text:
At even, ere the sun was set,
The sick, o Lord, around Thee lay;
O in what divers pains they met!
O with what joy they went away!

Once more tis eventide, and we,
Oppress'd with various ills, draw near,
What if Thy form we cannot see?
We know and feel that Thou Art here.

O Saviour Christ, our woes dispel
For some are sick, and some are sad,
And some have never lov'd Thee well,
And some have lost the love they had;

And all, O Lord, crave perfect rest
And to be wholly free from sin;
And they who fain would serve Thee best
Are conscious most of wrong within.

Thy touch has still its ancient pow'r,
No word from Thee can fruitless fall;
Hear in this solemn evening hour,
And in Thy mercy heal us all.
Amen.

L'ójú alẹ 'gbà t'óòòrun wọ,
Wọn gbé abirùn w'ọdọ Rẹ
Onírúurú ni àìsàn wọn,
Sùgbọn wọn f'ayo lọ 'lé wọn.

Jésù, a dé l'oj'alẹ yìí,
A sún m'Ọ t'àwa t'àrun wa,
Bí a kò tilẹ lè rí Ọ,
Sùgbọn, a mọ p'Ó sún mọ wa.

Olùgbàlà, wo òsì wa,
Ọpọ ń sàìsàn, ọpọ ń k'ẹdùn,
Ọpọ kò ní 'fẹ sí Ọ tó,
Ọpọ n'ìfẹ wọn tutu.

Ọpọ ti rí p'ásán l'ayé,
Síbẹ wọn kò f'ayé sílẹ,
Ọpọ l'ọrẹ bà ń'nú jẹ,
Síbẹ wọn kò fi Ọ s'ọrẹ.

Kò s'ọkan nínú wa t'ó pé,
Gbogbo wa sì ni ẹlẹṣẹ,
Àwọn t'ó sì ín Ọ tòótọ
Mọ ara wọn ní alàìpé.

Sùgbọn Jésù, Olùgbàlà,
Ẹni bí àwa ni 'Wọ 'se'
'Wọ ti rí 'dánwò bí àwa;
'Wọ sì ti mọ àìlera wa.

Agbár'ọwọ Rẹ wà síbẹ
Oore Rẹ sì ní agbára,
Gbọ àdúrà alẹ wa yíì;
Ní àánú, wo gbogbo wa sàn.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: ANGELS FROM THE REALMS OF GLORY

sections.text:
Angels from the realms of glory;
Wing your flight o'er all the earth,
Ye, who sang creation's story;
Now proclaim Messiah's birth.
Come and worship!
Come and worship!
Worship Christ, the new-born King.

Shepherds in the filed abiding,
Watching o'er your flocks By night,
God with man is now residing,
Yonder shines the infant light.

Saints, before the altar bending,
Watching long with hope
And fear,
Suddenly the Lord, descending
In His temple shall appear.

All creation, join in praising,
God the Father, Spirit, Son!
Evermore your voices raising;
To th' Eternal Three in One.
Amen.

Ẹyin ańgẹl' l'ọrun ògo,
Tó yí gbogbo ayé ka;
Ẹ ti kọrin dídá ayé,
Ẹ sọ t'ibí Mèsáyà.
Ẹ wá josìn
Ẹ wá josìn
Fún Krísti Ọba titun.

Ẹyin Olù-sọ-àgùntàn,
Tí ń sọ ẹran yín l'óru,
Ìmánú-ẹlì wa ti dé,
Ìràwọ Ọmọ náà ń tà n.

Amòye, f'èrò yín sílẹ,
Wò 'ran dídán l'ókèèrè!
Wa 'rẹtí ńlá oríl' èdè,
Ẹ ti rí ìràwọ Rẹ.

Onígbàgbọ tí ń tẹríba,
Ní 'bẹrù, àt'írétí,
L'ójijí l'Olúwa ó dé
Tí yóó mú yín re'lé.

Gbo-gb'ẹdá, ẹ fi ìyìn fún
Bàbá, Ọmọ àt'Ẹmí,
Títí láé, ẹ máa kọrin 'yìn
Ọlọrun Mẹtalọkan.
Ààmin.

englishTitle: HARK! THE HERALD-ANGELS SING

sections.text:
Hark! the herald-angels sing
Glory to the new-born King,
Peace on earth, and mercy mild,
God and sinners reconciled
Joyful, all ye nations, rise,
Join the triumph of the skies;
With th'angelic host proclaim.
Christ is born in Bethlehem.

Hark! the herald-angels sing
Glory to the new-born King.

Christ, by highest heav'n ador'd,
Christ, the Everlasting Lord,
Late in time behold Him come.
Offspring of a virgin's womb!
Veiled in flesh the Godhead see;
Hail th' incarnate De-ity!
Pleas'd as Man with man
To dwell,
Jesus, our Immanuel.

Hail the heav'n-born Prince of Peace!
Hail the Sun of Righteousness!
Light and life to all He brings,
Risen with healing in His wings,
Mild He lays His glory by,
Born that man no more may die,
Born to raise the sons of earth,
Born to give them second birth.

Come, Desire of nations, come,
Fix in us Thy humble home;
Rise, the woman's conquering Seed,
Bruise in us the serpent's head.
Adam's likeness now efface,
Stamp Thine image in its place:
Second Adam from above,
Reinstate us in Thy love. Amen.

Gbo! Ẹdá ọrun ń kọrin;
“Ogo fún Ọba t'á bí”
Alááfía l'áyé yí”
Ọlọrun bá wa làjà,
Gbogbo ẹdá nde l'áyo,
Ẹ gberin, àt'òkè wá,
Kéde pẹl'ángẹli pé
'A bí Kríst' ni Bẹtlẹhẹm'.

Gbọ ẹdá ọrun ń kọrin
Ogo fún Ọba t'á bí.

Krístì t'á ń yìn l'ógo l'ọrun
Kríst' Olúwa títí láé,
Ní ìgbẹyìn, 'Wọ ó dé,
Ọmọ inú Wúndíá!
W'Ọlọrun di èniyàn,
Ọ wá l'áwòrán eniyan
Ó w'Ú láti bá wa gbé,
Jésù, Ìmánúẹl' wa.

Yin, Aládé Àlàáfia!
F'ìyin f'Oòrun Òdodo!
Ó mú 'mọlẹ iyè wá,
'Lèra ńbẹ ní apá Rẹ,
Ó b'ógo Rẹ s'ápá kan;
A bíi k'ẹniyàn má kùú;
A bíi k'Ó gb'éniyàn ró,
A bíi k' Ó lè tún wọn bí.

Wá, 'Rètí oríl'èdè,
F'ọkàn wa se 'bùgbé Rẹ,
Nde, irú Ọmọbinrin,
Sẹgun Èsù nínú wa,
Pa àwòrán Adám rẹ,
F' àwòrán Rẹ dípò rẹ,
Adám' kejì lát' òkè.
Gbà wá padà sí 'fẹ Rẹ.
Ààmin.

englishTitle: O COME, ALL YE FAITHFUL

sections.text:
O come, all ye faithful,
Joyful and triumphant,
O Come ye, O come ye to Bethlehem;
Come and behold Him
Born the King of angels:

O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord!

True God of true God,
Light of Light eternal,
Lo! He abhors not the Virgin's womb,
Son of the Father,
Begotten, not created.

Sing, choirs of angels,
Sing in exultation,
Sing, all ye citizen of heaven above,
Glory to God, In the highest.

Yea, Lord, we greet Thee,
Born this happy morning;
Jesus, to Thee be glory given,
Word of the Father,
Now in flesh appearing.
Amen.

Wá, ẹyin olóòótọ!
L'áyo àt'ìṣẹgun,
Wá, k'á lọ, wá k'á lọ sí Betlehẹm';
Wá, k'á lọ wò Ó
Ọba àwọn Áńgẹl':

Ẹ wá k'á lọ júbà Rẹ,
Ẹ wá k'á lọ júbà Rẹ,
Ẹ wá k'á lọ júbà Krístì Olúwa.

Olódùmarè ni,
Ìmọlẹ òdodo,
Kò sì kórira inú Wúndía,
Ọmọ Ọlọrun;
Tí a bí, t'á kò dá!

Áńgẹlì, ẹ kọrin
Kọrin itoye Rẹ!
Kí gbogbo ẹdá ọrun sì gberin,
Ògo f'Ọlọrun;
L'ókè ọrun lọhùn-ún!

Ní tòótọ a wọlé,
F'Ọba t'á bí lónìí,
Jésù Ìwọ li àwa ń fògo fún!
'Wọ Ọmọ Baba,
T'ó gbé ara wa wọ! Ààmin.

englishTitle: JOY TO THE WORLD!

sections.text:
Joy to the earth!
The Saviour reigns;
Let men their songs employ;
While fields and floods, rocks, hills and plains
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat, repeat the sounding joy.

No more let sins and sorrows grow,
Nor thorns infest the ground;
He comes to make His blessings flow
Far as the curse is found,
Far as the curse is found,
Far as, far as the curse is found.

He rules the world with truth and grace,
And makes the nations prove
The glories of His righteousness
And wonders of His love,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders, and wonders
Of His love. Amen.

Ayọ b'áyé! Olúwa dé,
K'áyé gba Ọba rẹ!
Kí gbogbo ọkàn múra dè É,
K'áyé kọrin s'òkè.

Ayọ b'áyé, Jésù jọba,
Ẹ ję k'á hó f'ayọ,
Gbogbo ìgbẹ, omi, òkè,
Wọn ń gberin ayọ náà.

K'ẹṣẹ òun 'yọnu pin l'áyé,
K'ẹgun yé hù ní 'lẹ,
Ó dé láti mú 'bùkún sàn,
Dé'bi t'ẹgún gbé wà.

Ó f'òótọ àt'ìfẹ jọba,
Ó ję k'óríl'èdè
Mọ, òdodo ìjọba Rẹ,
Àt'ìfẹ 'yànu Rẹ. Ààmin.

englishTitle: SONGS OF PRAISE THE ANGELS SANG

sections.text:
Songs of praise the angels sang,
Heav'n with hallelujahs rang,
When creation was begun,
When God spoke,
and it was done.

Songs of praise awoke the morn
When the Prince of Peace
was born;
Songs of praise arose when He
Captive led captivity.

Heav'n and earth must
pass away;
Songs of praise shall crown
that day;
God will make new heav'ns,
new earth,
Songs of praise shall hail
their birth.

And shall man alone be dumb,
Till that glorious Kingdom
come?
No! the Church delights to raise
Psalms, and hymns, and songs
of praise.

Saints below, with heart
and voice,
Still in songs of praise rejoice,
Learning here, by faith
and love,
Songs of praise to sing above.

Borne upon their latest breath,
Songs of praise shall conquer
death;
Then, amidst eternal joy,
Songs of Praise their pow'r
employ. Amen.

'Gbà Jèhófà dá ayé,
'Gbà tí Ó sọrọ t'ó sì sẹ,
Àwọn Áńgẹlì ń kọrin,
Alelúyà gb'ọrun kan.

Orin 'yin l'a kọ l'óòórọ
'Gbà t'á bí Olùgbàlà;
Orin 'yin ni a sì kọ,
Nígbà t'Ó dìgbèkùn lọ.

'Gbà t'áyé y'ó kọjá lọ
Ìyin ó gb'ọjọ náà kan;
'Gbà t'a ó d'áyé titun,
Orin ìyin l'a ó kọ.

Àwa ó ha dákẹ bí
Títí 'jọba náà ó dé?
Bẹẹ kọ! Ìjọ máa kọ
Orin mímọ àt'ìyin.

Ènìyàn mímọ l'áyé,
N f'ayọ kọrin ìyin náà;
Nípa 'gbàgbọ ni wọn ń ké,
Bí wọn ti ń kọ ọ l'ókè.

Nígbà ẹmí ó ba pin,
Orin ni ó sẹgun 'kú;
Nínú ayọ àìlópin,
Wọn ó máa kọrin títí. Ààmin.

englishTitle: JOY FILLS OUR INMOST HEART TODAY

sections.text:
Joy fills our inmost heart
To-day:
The royal Child is born:
And angel hosts in glad array
His Advent keep this morn.
Rejoice, rejoice! the
incarnate Word
Has come on earth to dwell;
No sweeter sound than this
is heard - Emmanuel.

Low at the cradle throne
we bend.
We wonder and adore;
And feel no bliss can ours
transcend,
No joy was sweet before.

For us the world must lose
its charms
Before the manger shrine,
When, folded in Thy mother's
arms
We see Thee, Babe divine.

Thou Light of uncreated Light,
Shine on us, Holy Christ
That we may keep Thy
birthday bright,
With service undefiled.
Amen

Ayọ kún ọkàn wa l'ónìí,
A bí ọmọ Ọba!
Ọpọ àwọn ogun ọrun,
N sọ ìbí Rẹ l'ónìí!
Ẹ yọ, Ọlọrun d'èniyàn,
O wá jókòó l'áyé!
Orúkọ wo l'ó dùn
tó 'yíi, Ìmánúẹl.'

A wólẹ ní 'bùjẹ ẹran,
Ní 'yanu l'a jọsin,
Ìbùkún kan kò ta 'yíi yọ,
Kó s'ayọ bí èyí.

Ayé kò l'ádùn fún wa mọ,
'Gbà tí a bá ń wò Ọ,
L'ọwọ Wúndía ìyá Rẹ,
'Wọ Ọmọ ìyanu.

Ìmọlẹ láti 'nú 'Mọlẹ,
Tan 'mọlẹ s'oòkùn wa!
K'a lè máa fì ìsìn mímọ,
Se 'rántí ọjọ Rẹ.
Ààmin.

A wólẹ ní 'bùjẹ ẹran,
Ní 'yanu l'a jọsin,
Ìbùkún kan kò ta 'yíi yọ,
Kó s'áyọ bí èyí.

Ìmọlẹ láti 'nú 'Mọlẹ,
Tan 'mọlẹ s'ọòkùn wa!
K'á lè máa fi ìsin mímọ,
Se 'rántí ọjọ Rẹ.
Ààmin.

englishTitle: AS WITH GLADNESS MEN OF OLD

sections.text:
As with gladness men of old
Did the guiding star behold,
As with joy they hailed its light,
Leading onward,
beaming bright;
So, most gracious Lord may we
Evermore be led to Thee.

As with joyful steps they sped,
Saviour, to Thy lowly bed.
There to bend the knee before
Thee, whom heav'n and earth
adore;
So may we with willing feet
Ever seek the mercy-seat.

As they offered gifts most rare
At Thy cradle crude and bare
So may we with holy joy
Pure, and free from sin's alloy
All our costliest treasures bring;
Christ, to Thee, our heav'nly
King.

Holy Jesus every day
Keep us in the narrow way:
And, when earthly things
are past.
Bring our ransomed souls at
last
Where they need no
star to guide,
Where no clouds
Thy glory hide.

In the heavenly country bright
Need they no created light:
Thou its light, its joy, its
crown,
Thou its sun which goes not
down:
There for ever may we sing
Hallelujah to our King.
Amen

B'awọn ará ìgbàaní
Ti f'ayọ rí 'ràwọ náà,
Bí wọn ti f'inú dídùn;
Tẹlé 'mọlẹ dídán Rẹ,
Bẹẹ, Olúwa Olóore,
Ni k'á mú wa d'ọdọ Rẹ.

Bí wọn ti fi ayọ lọ,
Sí ibùjẹ ẹran náà,
Tí wọn sì wọlé ní 'bẹ,
F'Ẹni t'ọrun àt'ayé ní bọ,
Gẹgẹ bẹẹ ni k'á máa yọ,
Láti wá sí 'tẹ áánú.

Bí wọn ti mú ọrẹ wá,
Sí ibùjẹ ẹran náà,
Bẹẹ ni k'á f'ayọ mú wá,
Ọrẹ t'ẹṣẹ kò bàjẹ
Mú isura gbogbo wá,
S'ọdọ Rẹ, Jésù Ọba.

Jésù mímọ, pa wá mọ,
L'ọnà tóóró l'ọjọọjọ
'Gbà t'óhun ayé bá pin,
M'ọkàn wa dé ilú tí,
'Ràwọ kò ń s'amọnà mọ,
'Bi tí wọn ń wo ògo Rẹ.

Ní 'lùú ọrun mímọ náà,
Wọn kò wá ìmọlẹ mọ,
'Wọ l'oòrùn rẹ tí kíí wọ,
'Wọ l'ayọ àt'adé rẹ,
Ní 'bẹ títí l'a ó máa kọ;
Alelúyà s'Ọba wa.
Ààmin.

englishTitle: WHILE SHEPHERDS WATCH'D

sections.text:
"Fear not", said he, for mighty dread
Had seized their troubled mind;
"Glad tidings of great joy
I bring,
To you and to all mankind."

"The heavenly babe,
you there shall find,
To human view displayed,
All meanly wrapped in
swathing bands,
And in a manger laid."

Thus spake the Seraph; and
forthwith,
Appeared a shining throng,
Of angels, praising God,
and thus,
Addressed their joyful song:

Ẹrù bà wọn púpọ, sùgbọn,
O ní, "Ẹ má bẹrù;
Ìyìn ayọ ni mo mú wá
Fún yín àt'aráyé."

"Fún yín ní'lú Dáfid', lónìí,
Ní'dìilé Dáfidi;
A bí Olùgbàlà tí se,
Krístì, Olúwa wa."

"Èyí ni yóó j'àmì, Ẹyin
Ó rí ọmọ'wọ náà,
A fi ọjá wé E, a sì tẹ Ẹ,
Sí ìbùjẹ ẹran."

Bí ángẹl' náà ti sọrọ tàn,
Ọpọ àwọn ángẹl' fò dé
Wọn sì ń yin Ọlọrun,
Wọn ń kọrin ayọ pé.

Ògo ni f'Ọlọrun l'ókè
Àlàáfìà l'áyé,
Kí'fẹ'nú rere s'éniyàn,
Bẹrẹ, láìní òpin.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: SILENT NIGHT, HOLY NIGHT

sections.text:
Si-lent night, Ho-ly night,
All is calm, all is bright;
Round you, Vir-gin Mother
and child,
Ho-ly in-fant so ten-der
and mild;
Sleep in heav-enly Peace,
Sleep in heav-en-ly peace.

Si-lent night, Ho-ly night,
Dark-ness flies, all is light,
Shepherds hear the an-gels sing;
“Al'le-lu-jah; hail the King,
Christ the Saviour is born,
Christ the Saviour is born.”

Si-lent night, Ho-ly night,
Guid-ing Star, lend thy light;
See the East-ern wise
men bring,
Gifts and hom-age to our King!
Christ the Saviour is born,
Christ the Saviour is born.”

Si-lent night, Ho-ly night,
Wondrous Star, lend thy light,
With the angels, let us sing;
Al-le-lu-jah to our King!
Christ the Saviour is born,
Christ the Saviour is born.”
Amen.

Ààjìn jìn, òru mímọ,
Òòkùn sú, 'mọlẹ dé,
Àwọn olùs'àgùntàn ń sọna;
Ọmọ t'ó wà lójú oorun,
Sinmi í'nú àlàáfìà,
Sinmi í'nú àlàáfìà.

Ààjìn jìn, ìru mimọ,
'Ràwọ ọrun tàn 'mọlẹ;
K'á pẹlú àwọn ángẹlì kọrin
Kábíyèsí, Alelúyà Ọba,
Jésù Olùgbàlà dé,
Jésù Olùgbàlà dé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: ONCE IN ROYAL DAVID CITY

sections.text:
He came down to earth from heaven,
Who is God and Lord of all,
And His shelter was a stable,
And His cradle was a stall;
With the poor, and mean,
And lowly;
Lived on earth our Saviour holy.

For He is our childhood pattern,
Day by day like us He grew;
He was little weak and helpless,
Tears and smiles like us He knew,
And He feeleth for our sadness,
And He shareth in our gladness.

Not in that poor lowly stable,
With the oxen standing by,
We shall see Him, but in heaven
Set at God's right hand on high,
When like stars His children crowned;
All in white shall wait around.
Amen.

O t'ọrun wá s'òde ayé,
Òun l'Ọlọrun Olúwa,
O fi'lé ẹran se ilé,
'Bùjẹ ẹran fún 'bùsùn;
L'ọdọ àwọn òtòsì,
Ni Jésù gbé ní ayé.

Ní gbogbo ìgbà èwe Rẹ,
O gbọ̀ràn, O sì ń b'ọlá,
O ń fẹràn O sì ń tẹríba
Fún ìyá t'ó ń tọjú Rẹ;
O yẹ kí gbogb'ọmọdé,
K'ó se olùgbọ̀ràn bẹẹ.

'Torí Òun ję àwòse wa,
A máa dàgbà bí àwa,
O kéré, kò lè dá nnkan se;
A máa sọkún bí àwa,
O sì lè bá wa dárò,
O lè bá wa yọ pẹlú.

Kíi se ní ibùjẹ ẹran,
Ní'bi tí málùù ù jęun;
L'àwa ó rí I, sùgbọn l'ọrun,
Lọwọ ọtún Ọlọrun;
'Gbà àwọn ọmọ Rẹ bí ìrawọ,
Bá wà ń'nú asọ àlà wọn.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: BRIGHTEST AND BEST OF THE SONS

sections.text:
Brightest and best of the sons of the morning,
Dawn on our darkness, and lend us thine aid;
Star of the East, the horizon adorning
Guide where our infant Redeemer is laid.

For He is our childhood pattern,
Day by day like us He grew;
He was little weak and helpless,
He knew,
And He feeleth for our sadness,
And He shareth in our gladness.

Not in that poor lowly stable,
With the oxen standing by,
We shall see Him, but in heaven
Set at God's right hand on high,
When like stars His children crowned;
All in white shall wait around.
Amen.

Say, shall we yield Him, in costly devotion,
Odors of Edom, and offering divine,
Gems of the mountain and pearls of the ocean,
Myrrh from the forest or gold from the mine?

Vainly we offer each ample oblation
Vainly with gifts would His favour secure;
Richer by far is the heart's adoration
Dearer to God are the prayers of the poor.

Brightest and best of the sons of the morning
Dawn on our darkness, and lend us thine aid;
Star of the East, the horizon adorning,
Guide where our infant Redeemer is laid.
Amen.

Ìwọ ni ìràwọ ológo dídán
Tàn sí òkùnkùn wa,
Ràn wá lọwọ
Ìràwọ tí ń samọ̀nà àwọn èrò
Sìn wá dé ibi t'Olugbàlà wà.

Ní gbogbo ìgbà èwe Rẹ,
O gbọ̀ràn, O sì ń b'ọlá,
O ń fẹràn O sì ń tẹríba
Fún iyá t'ó ń tojú Rẹ;
O yẹ kí gbogb'ọmọdé,
K'ó se olùgbọ̀ràn bẹẹ.

'Torí Òun ję àwòse wa,
A máa dàgbà bí àwa,
O kéré, kò lè dá nnkan se;
A máa sọkún bí àwa,
O sì lè bá wa dárò,
O lè bá wa yọ pẹlú.

Kíi se ní ibùjẹ ẹran,
Ní'bi tí màlùù ù jęun;
L'àwa ó rí I, sùgbọn l'ọrun,
Lọwọ ọtún Ọlọrun;
'Gbà àwọn ọmọ Rẹ bí ìrawọ,
Bá wà ń'nú asọ àlà wọn.
Ààmín.

Ó dùbúlẹ jẹjẹ ní ibùsùn Rẹ
A tẹ sílẹ láàrin àwọn ẹran
Àwọn Áńgẹlì ń júbà Rẹ
B'ó ti ń sùn
Ẹlẹ́dàá, Ọba, Olùgbàlà wa.

Kò ha yẹ k'á mú ọrẹ dídùn
wá fún Un?
Ọrẹ olóòórùn-dídùn t'ijọsìn
Kò ha yẹ k'á sìn-ín l'ẹmìí
àt'ótítọ?
Irú isinmi yìí ni Baba fẹràn

Inú Rẹ kò lè dùn sí ọrẹ mìíràn
Èyí kò le fún wa l'ójúrere
Fí f'ara wa rúbọ ti tẹ Ẹ lọrùn tó?
Àti àdúrà wa bi tùràrí.

Ìwọ ni ìràwọ ológo dídán
Tàn sí òkùnkùn wa, ràn wá lọwọ
Ìràwọ ti ń samọnà àwọn èrò
Sìn wá dé ibi t'Olùgbàlà wà.
Ààmín.

Kò ha yẹ k'á mú ọrẹ dídùn
wá fún Un?
Ọrẹ olóòórùn-dídùn t'ijọsìn
Kò ha yẹ k'á sìn-ín l'ẹmií
àt'ótítọ?
Irú isinmi yíi ni Baba fẹràn

Inú Rẹ kò lè dùn sí ọrẹ miíràn
Èyí kò le fún wa l'ójúrere
Fí f'ara wa rúbọ ti tẹ Ẹ lọrùn tó?
Àti àdúrà wa bi tùràrí.

englishTitle: O THOU HOLY WORD OF GOD

sections.text:
O Thou holy word of God
Thou wisdom from above,
The truth that never changeth
Our only light of life;
We praise Thee all for the light
From the holy Gospel,
A light to lighten our feet
That shines for evermore.

The Lord has given the gift
To His church on the earth,
The light is held high above
To light the world over:
It is a box of treasure
Full of all righteousness,
'Tis the resemblance of Christ
The true and living word.

It flieth high as a flag
That flies high in the sky,
Like an Evangelist light
Shines in the world's darkness:
It is a guide to all men
Amidst all ups and downs,
Amidst water of trouble
It came to Christ the Lord.

O Saviour transform
Thy church
Into a golden light,
To shed thy light all over
Just like the olden days;
Teach people who are misled
To make use of this light,
Till world's darkness disappear
And all have seen Thy face.
Amen.

Olúwa ló f'èbùn yìí
Fún Ìjọ Rẹ l'áyé;
A ń gbé 'mọlẹ náà sókè
Láti tàn y'áyé ká,
Apótí wúrà níi se
Ọkun fún òtítọ;
Àwòrán Krísti sì ni
Ọrọ ìyè tòótọ.

O ń fe lele b'ásìá,
T'á ta lójú ogun;
O ń tàn b'íná alóre,
Sí òkùnkùn ayé
Amọnà èniyàn ni,
Ní wàhálà gbogbo
N'nú àárin omi ayé
O ń tọ wa s'ọdọ Kríst.

Olùgbàlà, se 'jọ Rẹ,
Ní fítìlà wúrà;
Láti tan ìmọlẹ Rẹ
Bí ayé ìgbàànì
Kọ àwọn tí ó sáko,
Láti lò 'mọlẹ yìí.
Tít' òkùnkùn ayé y'ó pin
Tí wọn ó rójú Rẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: MASTER, SPEAK THY SERVANT HEARETH

sections.text:
Speak to me by name, O Master
Let me know it is to me;
Speak that I may follow faster,
With a step more firm and free
Where the shepherd leads the flock
In the shadow of the Rock.

Master speak; and make me ready,
When Thy voice is truly heard,
With obedience glad and steady,
Still to follow every word,
I am listening, Lord for Thee;
Master, speak O speak to me.
Amen.

Máa wí, 'torí 'rànsẹ Rẹ ń gbọ,
Mo dúró de ọrọ Rẹ
Mo fẹ gb'óhùn ìwòsàn Rẹ
Jẹ k'émi gbọ Olúwa,
Mo tẹtí sílẹ Olúwa,
S'ohun t'O fẹ wí fún mi.

Máa wí, pè mí, Olúwa mi,
Jẹ kí ń lè mọ ohùn Rẹ
Máa wí ki ń yára tẹlé Ọ
Ki ń sún-mọ girigiri
Níbi tí O ń tọ agbo Rẹ
L'ábẹ ibi ìtùra.

Máa wí, yálà l'óhùn jejẹ
Má jẹ k'émi lọ l'áìgbọ
Máa wí, Olúwa, Ìwọ mọ
Gbogbo èrò ọkàn mi
Ìwọ mọ ohun tí mo ń fẹ
Sọ mí di ẹni 'bùkún.

Máa wí, jẹ kí èmi múra
Bí mo bá ti gb'óhùn Rẹ
Pẹlú 'gbọràn àti ayọ
Ni kí ń fi tẹ l'ọrọ Rẹ;
Mo tẹtí sílẹ Olúwa,
Máa wí, Olúwa máa wí.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: LORD THY WORD ABIDETH

sections.text:
Lord, Thy word abideth,
And our footsteps guideth,
Who its truth believeth,
Light and joy recieveth.

When our foes are near us,
Then Thy word doth cheer us,
Word of consolation,
Message of salvation.

When the storms are o'er us
And dark clouds before us,
Then its light directeth,
And our way protecteth.

Who can tell the pleasure,
Who recount the treasure
By Thy word imparted
To the simple-hearted?

Word of mercy giving
Succour to the living;
Word of life, supplying
Comfort to the dying!

Oh that we discerning
Its most holy learning
Lord, may love and fear Thee,
Evermore be near Thee. Amen.

Jésù ọrọ Rẹ yè,
O sì ń tọ síṣẹ wa;
Ẹni tó bá gbàgbọ
Ý'ó láyọ oun 'mọlẹ.

Nígb'ọta súnmọ wa,
Ọrọ Rẹ l'odi wa;
Ọrọ ìtùnú ni,
Ìkọ ìgbàlà ni.

B'ígbì àt'òkùnkùn
Tilẹ bò wá mọlẹ;
'Mọlẹ Rẹ y'ó tọ wa,
Y'ó sì dáàbò bò wá.

Taani lè sọ ayọ,
T'ó lè ka ìsura
Tí ọrọ Rẹ ń fi fún
Ọkàn onírẹlẹ?

Ọrọ àánú, o ń fi
'Lera fún alààyè;
Ọrọ iyè, o ń fi
Ìtùnú f'ẹni ń kú.

Awa ìbá lè mọ
Ẹkọ tí o ń kọni
Kí á bà lè fẹ Ọ
K'á sì lè sún mọ Ọ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: THOU BIBLE EVER-LIVING BOOK!

sections.text:
Thou Bible ever-living book!
Thy start is never known?
Nobody knows thy origin?
No one will know thy end?

Thou art the Almighty's secret,
Thou come from Heavenly king;
Thou art the sword to kill
Death pains,
The true picture of God.

Thou art the chief amongst all those
Books of the ancient times;
Thou point the way to salvation
To all saints on the earth.

Thou treasure of the Trinity!
Of Great King on the throne!
Please make thyself known unto me
So that I doubt no more.

I want to read thee and then pray,
I want to learn from thee;
Thou great book of the ancient times!
Reveal me Jesus' love.
Amen

Bíbél' ìwé ayérayé!
Taani lè r' ídíì rẹ?
Taani lè sọ ìdide rẹ?
Taani lè m' òpin rẹ?

Ọkan ni Ọ láàárin ọpọ,
Iwé ayé 'gbàanì,
Iwọ ló s'ọnà ìgbàlà
Di mímọ f'áráyé.

Isura ti Métalọkan,
Ọba ńlá t'ó gúnwà;
Jọọ túmọ ara rẹ fún mi,
Kí n yé siyèmèji.

Kí n sí Ọ pẹlú àdúrà
Kí n kékòó nínú rẹ;
Iwọ ìwé ayérayé,
F'ìfé Jésù hàn mí. Ààmín.

englishTitle: WE LOVE THE PLACE O GOD

sections.text:
We love the place, O God,
Wherein Thine honour dwells
The joy of Thine abode
All earthly joy excels.

It is the house of prayer,
Wherein Thy servants meet;
And Thou, O Lord art there
Thy chosen flock to greet.

We love the sacred font,
For there the Holy Dove
Pours out, as He is wont.
The effluence from above.

We love our Fathers board,
Oh what on earth so dear
Where faithful hearts, O Lord,
Still find Thy presence near.

We love the word of life;
The word that tells of peace,
Of comfort in the strife,
And joys that never cease.

We love to sing below
For mercies freely given
But oh! we long to know
The triumph-song of heaven.

Lord Jesus, give us grace
On earth to love Thee more,
In heaven to see Thy face,
And with Thy saints adore.
Amen.

Ọlọrun, àwa fẹ.
Ilé t'ọlá Rẹ wà,
Ayọ ìbùgbé Rẹ,
Ju ayọ ayé lọ.

Ilé àdúrà ni
Fún àwa ọmọ Rẹ,
Jésù O wà níbẹ
Láti gbọ èbè wa.

Àwa fẹ ìsun Rẹ,
Níbẹ l'Ẹmí Mímọ
Tú oor'ọfẹ jáde
Gẹgẹ bíi t'ìgbàanì.

Àwa fẹ àsẹ Rẹ
Kí ló dùn tó o l'áyé,
Níb' àwọn olóòótó,
Ń rí Ọ nítòsí wọn.

Àwa fé òrò Rẹ,
Tí ń sọ t'àlàáfíà,
T' ìtúnú ń'nú ìjà,
Àt'àyọ tí kíí tán.

A fẹ́ kọrin ànú,
T'á ń rí gbà l'áyé yí,
Sùgbọ́n àwa fẹ́ mọ
Orin ayọ̀ t'ọrun

Jésù Olúwa wa,
Jọwọ́ ràn wá lọ́wọ
K'á rójú Rẹ lọrun
K'á bá'won mímọ́ sìn.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: SPEAK TO MY SOUL, LORD JESUS

sections.text:
Speak to my soul Lord Jesus,
Speak now in tend'rest tone;
Whisper in loving-kindness;
“Thou art not left alone”
Open my heart to hear Thee,
Quickly to hear Thy voice,
Fill Thou my soul with praises
Let me in Thee rejoice,

Speak Thou in softest whispers
Whispers of love to me
“Thou shall be always conq'ror
Thou shall always be free”
Speak Thou to me each day Lord
Always in tend'rest tone
Let me now hear Thy whisper
“Thou art not left alone.”

Speak to Thy children ever,
Lead in the holy way;
Fill them with joy and gladness,
Teach them to watch and pray,
May they in consecration
Yield their whole lives to Thee,
Hasten Thy coming kingdom,
Till our dear Lord we see.

Speak now as in the old time
Thou didst reveal Thy will;
Let me know all my duty
Let me Thy law fulfil,
Lead me to glorify Thee,
Help me to show Thy praise,
Gladly to do Thy bidding.
Honour Thee all my days.
Amen.

Bá mi sọrọ Olúwa,
Sọrọ l'òhùn jejẹ,
Kí n gbọ ohùn ìfẹ Rẹ;
“Émi wà pelú rẹ”
Lù mí ní ọ́okan àyà
Kí n yára gb'òhùn Rẹ,
F'orin 'yin kún ọkàn mi;
Kí n l'áyọ̀ nínú Rẹ.

Wí fún mi l'òhùn jejẹ
Pé, “wọ ó ju asẹgun lọ”
'Joojúmọ kí n lè máa gbọ
Ohùn Émí dídùn
Sọrọ náà fún mi lónìí;
“Émi wà pelú rẹ”.

Sọrọ bíi ti ìgbàaní,
Fí ìfẹ Rẹ hàn wá,
Kí n mọ gbogbo isẹ mi
Kí n mú asẹ Rẹ sẹ;
Tọ mi kí n gb'ọ́go Rẹ ga,
Kí n fí ìyìn Rẹ hàn,
Kí n máa f'ayọ̀ jísẹ Rẹ,
Kí n gbé Ọ ga títí.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE SPIRIT BREATHES UPON THE WORD
yorubaTitle: ẸMI Ń MÍ S'ORI ỌRỌ NÁÀ

sections.text:
The Spirit breathes upon
the word.
And brings the truth to sight;
Precepts and promises afford,
A sanctifying light.

Let everlasting thanks be Thine,
For such a bright display
As makes a world of
Darkness shine
With beams of heav'nly day.

My soul rejoices to pursue,
The steps of Him I love,
Till glory breaks upon my view,
In brighter worlds above.
Amen

Ẹmí ń mí s'órí ọrọ náà,
Ó ń f'òótọ rẹ hàn wá;
Ìlànà òun ìlérí Rẹ
Ń tan ìmọlẹ mímọ.

Ògo kan yí ìwé náà ká;
Ó mọlẹ bíi òòrùn,
Ìmọlẹ tí kò ní'pẹkun
L'Òun nìkan fi fún ni.

Ẹni t'ó f'ọrọ yìí fún wa,
Ó ń bẹ síbẹsíbẹ,
Ọrọ Rẹ yọ s'orí 'lẹ èdè;
Ó yọ, kì ó wọ mọ.

Jẹ k'á f'ọpẹ àití fún Ọ,
Fún irú 'mọlẹ yìí,
T'ó mú kí ìmọlẹ ọrun
Tàn s'ókùnkùn ayé.

Ọkàn mi ń yọ láti tọ 'pa
Ẹsẹ 'ni tí mo fẹ,
Títí n ó fi rí ògo Rẹ.
L'áyé dídán lókè.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JUST AS GOD WHO REIGNS ON HIGH

sections.text:
Just as God who reigns
on High
Spake to men in days gone by.
So the Lord is calling men
today.
And my brother this is true.
Whatso-e'er He says to you
There is but one thing to do
Just obey.

If you're in the Saviour's hand,
You must do as He commands.
For there is no other gospel
way;
Never put the message by,
Never stop to reason why,
When the Saviour speaks to
you, just obey.

If for mansions fair you sigh
In that land beyond the sky,
After time with you has
pass'd away;
Tho' the way you may not see,
Christ is calling, “Follow Me.”
Faith and duty both will cry,
just obey. Amen.

Sá gbọràn, sá gbọràn,
Èyí ni 'fẹ Rẹ.
'Gba t'Ó bá ránṣẹ sí ọ
Ohun kan ni kí o se
Sá gbọràn, sá gbọràn.

Bí ó bá jẹ t'Olúwa
O níláti gbọ Tirẹ.
Kò s'ọnà 'hìnrerẹ míìrán mọ
Má se sá àṣẹ Rẹ tì;
Má sì se lọ ọrọ Rẹ,
'Gba Olùgbàlà bá ń sọrọ,
sá gbọràn.

Bí o bá fẹ ni ìpín
Ní 'lúú dáradára ni
Lẹyìn ayé wa búburú yíì;
Bí o kò tilẹ m'ọnà,
Kríst' yó wí pé, “Tẹlé Mi”
Ìgbàgbọ, yó sì wí pé,
“Sá gbọràn”. Ààmín.

englishTitle: LORD, SPEAK TO ME
yorubaTitle: KO MI OLUWA, BI A TI

sections.text:
Lord, speak to me that
I may speak
In living echoes to Thy tone.
As Thou has sought,
So let me seek
Thy erring children lost
and lone

Oh, lead me, Lord,
that I may lead,
The wand'ring and the
wav'ring feet;
O, feed me, Lord,
that I may feed
Thy hung'ring ones with
manna sweet

Oh, strengthen me,
that while I stand
Firm on the Rock, and strong
in Thee,
I may stretch out a loving hand
To wrestlers with the
troubl'd sea.

Oh, teach me, Lord,
that I may teach
The precious things Thou dost
impart,
And wing my words that they
may reach
The hidden depths of
many hearts,

Oh, give Thine own sweet
rest to me.
That I may speak with
soothing pow'r
A word in season, as from Thee,
To weary ones in needful hour.

Oh, fill me with Thy fullness,
Lord,
Until my very heart o'erflow
In kindling thought and
glowing word,
Thy love to tell,
Thy praise to show.

Oh, use me, Lord, use even me.
Just as Thou wilt, and how,
and where;
Until Thy blessed face I see.
Thy rest, Thy joy, Thy glory
share. Amen.

Ko mi Oluwa, bi a ti
Je gbohùngbohùn ọrọ Rẹ
B'o ti wa mi, jẹ k'emi wá
Àwọn ọmọ Rẹ t'o ti nu.

Tọ mi, Olúwa, kí n lè tọ
Àwọn asáko sí ọnà;
Bọ mi Olúwa, kí n lè fi
Mana Rẹ b'àwọn t'ébi ń pa

Fún mi l'ágbára, f'ẹsẹ mi
Múlẹ lórí àpàta
Kí n lè na ọwọ ìgbàlà
S'awọn t'ó ń rì sínú ẹsẹ.

Kọ mi Olúwa, kí n lè fi
Ẹkọ rere Rẹ k'ẹlomìí
F'iyẹ f'ọrọ mi, k'ó lè fò
Dé ìkọkọ gbogbo ọkàn.

F'ìsinmi dídùnRẹ fún mi,
Kí n lè mọ, b'ó ti yẹ láti
Fi pẹlẹpẹlẹ s'ọrọ Rẹ
Fún àwọn tí àárẹ ti mú.

Fi ẹkún oore fún mi,
Titi ọkàn mi yó fi kún
Fún 'tara l'érò àt'ọrọ
Làti kéde 'fẹ òun 'yìn Rẹ.

Lò mí, Olúwa, àn'emi
Bí o ti fẹ, nígbàkúgbà,
Tít' em'ó fi r'ójú Rẹ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: STANDING ON THE PROMISES OF CHRIST

sections.text:
Standing on the promises of Christ my king,
Through eternal ages let His praises ring,
Glory in the highest, I will shout and sing,
Standing on the promises of God.

Stand...ing, stand...ing.
Standing on the promises of God my Saviour,
Stand...ing, stand...ing.
I'm standing on the promises of God.

Standing on the promises that cannot fail,
When the howling storms of doubt and fear assail,
By the living word of God I shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of God.

Standing on the promises I now can see,
Perfect, present cleansing in the blood for me,
Standing in the liberty where Christ makes free,
Standing on the promises of God.

Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord,
Bound to Him eternally by love's strong cord,
Overcoming daily with the Spirit's sword,
Standing on the promises of God. Amen.

Mo ń dúró lé 'lèérí Krist' Ọba
Ẹni tí a ó máa yìn títí láéláé
Ògo f'Ọlọrun, èmi yó
Máa kọn
Mo ń dúró lé 'lérí Ọlọrun

È-mi ń dúró ...
Mo ń dúró lé 'lèérí
Kristi Oluwa mi
È-mi ń dúró ...
È-mi ń dúró lórí 'lèérí
Ọlọrun.

Mo ń dúró lé ìlérí tí kó lè yẹ,
'Gbà tí 'jì 'yèméjì àt'ẹrù bá dé
Nípa ọrọ Rẹ ni èmi y'ó sẹgun
Mo ń dúró lórí ìlérí Rẹ.

Ìlérí Rẹ là mí lójú mo rí
Ìwẹnúmọ pípé nínú ẹjẹ Rẹ
Ìlérí Rẹ sọ'kàn mi d'òmìnira
Mo ń dúró lórí ìlérí Rẹ.

Mo ń dúró lé 'lèérí Krist' Ọba
Ìfẹ ló fi so mí pọ mọ ara Rẹ
Nípa ọrọ Rẹ mo ń sẹgun
lọjọojọ;
Mo ń dúró lórí ìlérí Rẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHOSOEVER HEARETH! SHOUT

sections.text:
“Whosoever heareth!” Shout, shout the sound!
Send me blessed tidings all the world around!
Spread me joyful news wherever man is found,
“Whosoever will, may come.”
“Whosoever will!”
“Whosoever will!”
Send the proclamation over vale and hill
'Tis a loving Father calls the wanderer home:
“Whosoever will may come.”

“Ẹnikẹni t'o gbàgbọ” ni Krist' wí
Sọ ìhìn dídùn yìí ní gbogbo ayé
Tan ìhìn náà kálẹ ní ibi gbogbo
“Ẹni t'ó bá fẹ lè wá”
“Ẹni t'ó bá fẹ”
“Ẹni t'ó bá fẹ”
Kéde rẹ jákèjádò ní gbogb' aye
Baba ló n ké pe
Asáko wá 'le
“Ẹni t'ó bá fẹ lè wá.”

“Ẹni t'ó fẹ wá” k'ó má se lọra
Wọlé nígbà tí ìlẹkùn sí sílẹ
Jésù nikan l'ọnà sí ibi ìyè
“Ẹni t'ó bá fẹ lè wá.”

“Ẹni t'ó fẹ”, ìlérí náà dájú
“Ẹni t'ó bá lè forí tìí dé òpin”
“Ẹni t'ó bá fẹ” ìyè ń bẹ títí láé
“ Ẹni t'ó bá fẹ lè wá.”Ààmín.

englishTitle: REDEMPTION! OH, WONDERFUL STORY

sections.text:
Redemption! Oh, wonderful story
Glad message for you and for me
That Jesus has purchased our pardon
And paid all the debt on the tree;

Believe it, O sinner,
believe it,
Receive the glad message -
it is true
Trust now in the crucified
Saviour
Salvation he offers to you.

No longer shall sin have dominion
Though present to tempt and annoy;
For Christ, in His blessed redemption,
The power of sin shall destroy.

Ìràpadà! Ìtàn ìyanu,
Ìyìn ayọ fún gbogbo wa,
Jésù ti ra 'dàríjì fún wa,
Ó san gbèsè náà lórí 'gi.

Hàà! ẹlẹṣẹ gba ìyìn
Náà gbọ
Jọ'ọ gba ìyìn òótọ náà gbọ,
Gbẹke rẹ lé Olùgbàlà rẹ
T'Ó mú ìgbàlà fún ọ wá.

Ó mú wa t'inú 'kú bọ sí 'yè,
Ó sì sọ wá d'ọm'Ọlọrun ;
Orísun kan sí fún ẹlẹṣẹ
Wẹ nín'ẹjẹ náà kóo sì mọ.

Ẹṣẹ kì y'ó lè jọba wa mọ,
B'ó ti wù kó dán wa wò tó;
Nítorí Krístì fi 'ràpadà
Pa 'gbára ẹṣẹ run fún wa.

Gba àánú t'Olorun fi lọ ọ,
Sá wá s'odo Jésù lónìí;
Torí yóó gb'ẹni t'ó bá tọ Ọ wá,
Kì yóó sì dá a padà láé.
Ààmin.

englishTitle: OH, SPREAD THE TIDINGS ROUND

sections.text:
Oh, spread the tidings round,
Wherever man is found,
Wherever human hearts
And human woes abound;
Let every Christian tongue
Proclaim the joyful sound
The Comforter has come!

Tan ìyìn náà kálẹ,
Jakejado aye
K'awon ti ẹru ń pa,
Mọ pé igbala de:
K'awon ti se ti Krist',
Sọ ìyìn ayọ náà,
Olutunu ti de.

Olutunu ti de.
Olutunu ti de.
Emi lat'oke wa,
Ileri Baba wa;
Tan ìyìn náà kale
Jakejado aye,
Olutunu ti de.

Ọba awọn ọba,
Wa f'iwosan fun wa,
O wá já ide wa,
O mu igbàlà wá,
K'olukuluku wa,
Korin isegun pe
Olutunu ti de.

Ife iyanu ńlá,
A! n bá le royìn náà,
Fun gbogbo eniyàn,
Ebun oor'ofe Rẹ;
Emi ọmọ egbe
Di ọmọ igbàlà,
Olutunu ti de.

Gbe orin 'yìn soke,
S'Oluràpadà wa,
K'awon mimo loke
Jumo bá wa gberin
Yin ife Re titi,
Ife ti ko le ku,
Olutunu ti de. Ààmín.

englishTitle: COME, YE SINNERS, POOR

sections.text:
Now, ye needy, come and welcome,
God's free bounty glory:
True belief, and true repentance,
Every grace that brings you nigh,
Without money,
Come to Jesus Christ and buy.

Come, ye weary, heavy-laden,
Bruised and ruin'd by the Fall,
If you tarry till you're better
You will never come at all:
Not the righteous,
Sinners Jesus came to call.

Lo! the incarnate God ascended
Pleads the merit of His blood
Venture on Him, venture wholly;
Let no other trust intrude:
None but Jesus
Can do helpless sinners good.

Saints and angels,
join'd in concert,
Sing the praises of the Lamb
While the blissful seats of heaven
Sweetly echo with his name:
Hallelujah,
Sinners here may sing the name. Amen.

Òtòsì ẹlẹṣẹ, ẹ wá
Wá ni wákàti àánu
Jesu setan lati gbà yin,
O kun f'àánu àt'ife
O si le se, O mura tan,
Má foya.

Eyin aláini, e wá gba
Ogo Olorun l'ofe
Gbàgbo tòótọ, ronu tòótọ
Oor'ofe ti o ń fà wá
Wa'dọ Jesu láini owo,
Sá wá rà.

Má je k'ọkàn yín dá yín ró.
Má se ro ti aye yín,
Gbogbo yíye t'O ń bèère ni
Kí ẹ sá mọ àini yín
Eyí t'Ó fún yín bí 'mọlẹ
L'ọkàn yín.

Eyin t'ẹrú ń pa, t'àárẹ mú'
T'ẹ ṣonù t'ẹ sì sègbé
Bí ẹ dúró títí ẹ ó sàn
Ẹ ki yóó wá rárá;
F'ẹlẹṣẹ ni, Òun kò wá
f'ólódodo.

Ọlọrun gòkè l'áwọ wa;
O ń fi ẹjẹ Rẹ bẹbẹ,
Gbé ara lé Ẹ pátápátá,
Má gbẹkẹlé ohun miì,
Jésù nikan l'Ó lè s'ẹlẹṣẹ lóore.

Ángẹlì àt'àwọn mímọ
Ń kọrin' yìn Ọd'àgùntàn;
Gbohùngbohùn orúkọ Rẹ,
Sì gba gbogbo ọrun kan,
Alelúyà! Ẹlẹṣẹ lè gberin náà.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: RETURN, O WANDERER, TO THY HOME

sections.text:
Return, O wanderer,
to thy home,
Thy Father calls for thee
No longer now an exile roam
In guilt and misery
Return, return.

Return O wonderer,
to thy home.
'Tis Jesus calls for thee:
The Spirit and the bride say,
“Come”,
Oh, now for refuge flee:
Return, return.

Return, O wanderer,
to thy home,
'Tis madness to delay:
There are no pardons
In the tomb,
And brief is mercy's day:
Return, return. Amen.

Padà, asáko sí'le rẹ,
Bàbá rẹ ló ń pe ọ,
Má se alárìnkiri mọ,
Ń'n' ẹṣẹ àt'òsì rẹ;
Padà, Padà.

englishTitle: ONCE AGAIN THE GOSPEL MESSAGE

sections.text:
Once again the Gospel message
From the Saviour you
have heard;
Will you heed the invitation?
Will you turn and seek
the Lord?
Come believing!...
Come believing!...
Come to Jesus!
Look and live!...
Come believing!...
Come believing!...
Come to Jesus!
Look and live!

Many summers you
have wasted,
Ripened harvest you have seen:
Winter snows by spring
have melted,
Yet you linger in your sin.

Jesus for your choice is waiting;
Tarry not: at once decide!
While the Spirit now
is striving,
Yield, and seek the
Saviour's side.

Let your will to God be given,
Trust in Christ's atoning blood;
Look to Jesus now in heaven,
Rest on His unchanging word.
Amen.

Lẹẹkan síi, a ránsẹ sí ọ,
Lat' ọdọ Olùgbàlà,
'Wọ k'y'ó ha f'eti si 'pe náà?
'Wọ k'y'ó ha tọ Jésù wá?
Wá! Sá gbàgbọ;
Wá! Sá gbàgbọ,
Wo Jésù kí o sì yè,
Wá! Sá gbàgbọ;
Wá! Sá gbàgbọ,
Wo Jésù kí o sì yè.

Ọpọ ọdún ti kojá,
Ìgbà òjò àt'ẹẹrùn
Gbogbo oore t'ó ń se fún ọ;
Ẹṣẹ l'o fi ń san-án padà.

Má se ronú ti ayé rẹ,
Má gbẹkẹlé ara rẹ,
Sá gbàgbọ nínú ọrọ Rẹ;
À'èdidí Ẹmí Rẹ.

Wá fi gbogbo ọkàn rẹ fún Un,
Gbàgbọ nínú ẹje Rẹ,
Wo Jésù t'ó jókòó l'ọrun
Sinmi lé ilérí Rẹ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS IS TENDERLY CALLING THEE
yorubaTitle: JÉSU Ń F'OHUN JẸJẸ PÉ Ọ WA 'LÉ

sections.text:
Jesus is tenderly calling
thee home -
Calling to-day, calling to-day!
Why from the sunshine of love
will thou roam
Farther and farther away?
Call...ing to-day! ...
call...ing to-day!...
Je... sus is call ... ing,
is tenderly calling to-day!

Jesus is calling the weary to rest
Calling to-day, Calling to-day
Bring Him thy burden,
and thou shalt be blest:
He will not turn thee away.

Jesus is waiting, oh,
come to Him now -
Waiting to-day, waiting
to-day?
Come with thy sins, at His
feet lowly bow:
Come and no longer delay!

Jesus is pleading: oh, list' to His voice -
Hear Him to-day, hear Him to-day!
They who believe on His name shall rejoice:
Quickly arise and away!
Amen.

Jesu ń f'ohun jẹjẹ pè ọ wá 'le
O ń pe lónìí, O ń pe lónìí!
Eése ti o kọ ifẹ Rẹ silẹ
T'o sáko jinna rere?
O ń pe lónìí! O ń pe loni!
Jesu ń pe o, O ńpe o,
ki y'o si le o pada.

Jesu ń pe aláàárẹ fun isinmi,
O ń pe loni, O ń pe lónìí!
Gb'eru re tọ Ọ wa,
y'o bukun fun ọ
Ki y'o si le ọ pada.

Jesu ń dúró, wa s'ọdọ
Rẹ lónìí;
Ń dúró de o, ń dúró de o,
F'irẹlẹ ko gbogbo ẹṣẹ rẹ wa
Wá, má se dúró pẹ mo.

Jesu ń sipẹ: feti si ohun Rẹ
Gbọ ìpè Rẹ, gba ìpè Rẹ
Awon t'o gba Oókọ
Rẹ gbọ yóó yọ
Yára wá sí ọdọ Rẹ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: I'VE A MESSAGE FROM THE LORD

sections.text:
I've a message from the Lord, Hallelujah!
The message unto you I'll give;
'Tis recorded in His Word, Hallelujah!
It is only that you "Look and live".
"Look and live." ...
My brother, live!...
Look to Jesus now and live;
'Tis recorded in His Word, Hallelujah!
It is only that you "look and live."

I've a message full of love, Hallelujah!
A message, O my friend, for you;
'Tis a message from above, Hallelujah!
Jesus said it - and I know 'tis true.

Life is offered unto thee, Hallelujah!
Eternal life thy soul shall have,
If you'll only look to Him, Hallelujah!
Look to Jesus who alone can save. Amen.

Oluwa ran mi n'ise, Aleluya!
Iwo ni n ó ję isę náà fun
A kọ s'inu Ọrọ Rẹ, Aleluya!
Gb'óju s'óke wo Jesu k' ó ye
Wo O k'o ye, arakunrin
Wo Jesu ki o si ye
A kọ ọ sinu Ọrọ Rẹ, Aleluya
Gb'óju s'óke wo Jesu k' o ye

A ran mi n'isę ife, Aleluya!
N o jise náà fun ọ, ọrę mi,
Ise lat'oke wa ni, Aleluya!
Jesu l'o wi bęę, otito ni.

Iye ti a fi ń lọ ọ, Aleluya!
Iye titi fun ọkàn rę
B'iwọ ba le wo Jesu,
Aleluya!
Jesu nikan lo le gba ni la.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I'M NOT ASHAMED TO OWN MY LORD

sections.text:
I'm not ashamed to own my Lord,
Or to defend His cause;
Maintain the honour of His word,
The glory of His cross.
At the cross, at the cross,
Where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my
Heart rolled away,
It was there by faith
I received my sight,
And now I am happy
All the day.

Jesus, my God! I know His name,
His name is all my trust,
Nor will He put my soul to shame,
Nor let my hope be lost.

Firm as His throne,
His promise stands,
And He can well secure
What I've committed
To His hands,
Till the decisive hour.

Then will He own my worthless name
Before His Father's face;
And in the new Jerusalem,
Appoint my soul a place.
Amen.

Ojú Olúwa kò tì mí,
N kò tijú iṣẹ Rẹ:
Láti gb'ọla ọrọ Rẹ ga
Àt'àgbélébùú Rẹ
Ní'bi àgbélébùú
Ni mo kọ r'imọlẹ,
Ní'bẹ, ẹrù ọkàn
mi sì fò lọ,
Ní'bẹ, nípa ìgbàgbọ
Mo ríran;
Nísìn, mo wà l'álàáfíà títí.

Mo m'orúkọ Olúwa mi,
Òun ni mo gbẹkẹlé,
Kò ní jẹ kí ojú tì mí;
Kí n sì sọ'rétí nù.

Ìlérí Rẹ dúró sinsin,
Y'ó pa ohun náà mọ,
Tí mo fi sí itọjú Rẹ;
Títí d'ọjọ 'kẹyìn.

'Gbà náà yóó gbà mí
s'ọdọ Rẹ,
Bí mo tilẹ s'àiyẹ
Ní 'lúú Jérúsálẹm' titun,
Y'ó fi mí sí 'pò mi.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: RING THE BELLS OF HEAVEN

sections.text:
Ring the bells of heaven!
There is joy to-day,
For a soul returning
from the wild,
See! The Father meets him
out upon the way,
Welcoming His weary,
wand'ring child.

Glory! Glory!
How the angel's sing!
Glory! Glory!
How the loud harps ring!
'Tis the ransomed army,
like a mighty sea,
Pealing forth the anthem
of the free!

Ring the bells of heaven!
there is joy to-day,
For the wanderer now is
reconciled;
Yes, a soul Is rescued from
his sinful way,
And is born a new a
ransomed child.

Ring the bells of heaven!
spread the feast to-day!
Angels swell the glad,
triumphant strain!
Tell the joyful tidings! bear
it far away!.
For a precious soul is born
again. Amen.

Agogo ayọ ń lu
Lí orun lónìí,
'Tori ẹlẹṣẹ kan
bọ wa'le:
Baba wa sare pade
rẹ li ọna;
O ń ki asako omo
“Káàbọ!”

Orin ogo li Angeli ń kọ
Won ń fì dùùrù wura
korin náà
Egbegberun awon ti a rapada
Gbogbo won ń jumo
korin ogo.

Agogo ayọ ń lu li orun lónìí,
T'ori asako pada wa 'le,
A yo ẹlẹṣẹ kan kuro
N'nu egbe;
O d' atunbi o d' omo'
Olorun.

Agogo ayọ ń lu li orun lónìí,
Angeli ń korin isegun náà:
So itan ayọ náà, kede re kiri;
A ti ra ẹlẹṣẹ kan pada.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I AM SO GLAD THAT OUR FATHER IN HEAVEN
yorubaTitle: MO YỌ PUPỌ PE BABA WA ỌRUN

sections.text:
I am so glad that our
Father in heaven
Tell of His love in the book
He has given:
Wonderful things in the
Bible I see
This is the dearest, that Jesus
loves me.

I am so glad that Jesus
loves me,
Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me,
I am so glad that Jesus
loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

Though I forget Him, and wander away,
Still He doth love me wherever I stray:
Back to His dear loving arms do I flee,
When I remember that Jesus loves me.

Oh, if there's only one song I can sing,
When in His beauty I see the great King,
This shall my song in eternity be,
“Oh what a wonder that Jesus loves me!”

If one should ask of me, how can I tell?
Glory to Jesus! I know very well!
God's Holy Spirit with mine doth agree,
Constantly witnessing - Jesus loves me.

In this assurance I find sweetest rest,
Trusting in Jesus, I know I am blest;
Satan, dismayed, from my soul now doth flee,
When I just tell him that Jesus loves me.
Amen.

Mo yọ pupọ pe
Baba wa ọrun
Sọ t'ifẹ Rẹ ninu 'we
t'O fun mi,
Mo r'ohun 'yanu
ninu Bibeli,
Eyi lo s'ọwọn ju ,
Jesu fe mi.

Mo yọ pupọ pe Jesu fe mi,
Jesu fe mi, Jesu fe mi,
Mo yọ pupọ pe Jesu fe mi,
Jesu fe an'emi.

'Gba mo gbagbe Re, ti emi sa lo,
O fe mi sibe, O ń wa mi kiri;
Mo yara pada s'apa àánú Re,
'Gba ti mo ranti Pe Jesu fe mi.

Bi o se orin kan l'emi le ko,
'Gba mo r'Ọba ńlá ninu ẹwa Re;
Eyi ni yóó máa J'orin mi titi,
A! iyanu ni pe, Jesu fẹ mi.

Jesu fẹ mi, Mo si mo pe mo f'Ẹ,
Ifẹ lo mu wa r'okan mi pada
Ifẹ lo mu k'O ku l'ori igi
O da mi loju pe, Jesu fẹ Ii.

Emi o ti se dahun b'a bi mi
Ohun ti ogo Oluwa mi ję?
Ẹmi Mimo ń jẹri nin'okan mi,
Ni igba gbogbo pe, Jesu fẹ Ii.

Ni 'gbẹkẹle yií ni mo r'isimi,
N'igbẹkẹle Krist' mo d'alabukun
Satan dààmu sa kuro l'okan mi,
Nigba mo so fun un pe, Jesu fẹ mi.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: O WHAT A WONDERFUL, WONDERFUL DAY

sections.text:
O what a wonderful,
wonderful day,
Day I will never forget;
After I'd wandered in
darkness away,
Jesus my Saviour I met
O what a tender,
Compassionate friend
He met the need of my heart;
Shadows dispelling, with joy
I am telling,
He made all the darkness depart!

Heaven came down and
Glory filled my soul,
When at the cross the
Saviour made me whole;
My sins were washed away,
And my night was turned
to day
Heaven came down and
Glory filled my soul!

Born of the Spirit
with life from above,
Into God's fam'ly divine,
Justified fully through
Calvary's love
O what a standing is mine!
And the transaction so quickly
was made
When as a sinner I came,
Took of the offer of grace
He did proffer
He saved me, O praise
His dear name.

How I've a hope that will surely endure
After the passing of time;
I have a future in heaven for sure,
There in those mansions sublime.
And it's because of that wonderful day
When at the cross I believed
Riches eternal and blessings Supernal
From His precious hand I received.
Amen.

Ògo orun si kun'nu
okan mi,
'Gba t'Olugbala
sọ mi di pipe;
A we ese mi nu,
Ale mi si d'owuro
Ogo orun si kun 'nu
okan mi.

A bi mi nipa Emi pelu 'ye
Sinu ebi Olorun,
A da mi lare nipa 'fe Kristi,
Mo n'igbekele t'o ga!
Ise náà di sise logan nigba
ti mo wa bi elese,
Mo gba ebun oor'ofe
eyi t'o wa lae
O gba mi, yin Oruko Re.

Nisin'yi mo n'ireti t'o wa lae
Lehin opin ajo mi;
O daju pe mo n'ireti l'orun,
N'ile ologo julo,
Ati nitori ojo 'yanu ni
Ti mo wole l'ese Re;
Oro ainipekun
Ibukun l'atorun,
Ti mo gba ni owo Re.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: STAND, SOLDIER OF THE CROSS

sections.text:
Stand, soldier of the cross,
Thy high allegiance claim
And vow to hold the world but loss
For Thy Redeemer's name.

Arise, and be baptized.
And wash thy sins away;
Thy league with God be Solemnized,
Thy faith avouch'd today.

No more thine own,
but Christ's
With all the saints of old
Apostles, seers, evangelist,
And martyr throngs enrolled.

In God's whole armour strong,
Front hell's embattled pow'rs,
The warfare may be sharp and long
The vict'ry must be ours.

Oh, bright the conqu'ror's crown,
The song of triumph sweet,
When faith casts every trophy down
At our great Captain's feet.
Amen.

Duro, om'oogun Krist',
F'enu re so f'aye
Si jeje pe, “ofo l'aye”
Nitori Jesu re.

Dide, ka baptis're,
Ko we ese re nu,
Wa b'Olorun da majemu
Jewo igbagbo re.

'Wo ki se t'ara re
Bi ko se ti Kristi;
A ko oruko re po mo
T'awon mimo 'gbàànì.

Ni'hamora Jesu
Koju 'ja si esu;
Bo ti wu k'ogun nàà le to
Awa ni yo segun.

Ade didara ni,
Orin naà, didun ni;
'Gba ta ba ko ikogun jo
S'ese Olugbala.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HEAR THE VOICE FROM HEAVEN

sections.text:
Hear the voice from Heaven saying
To Jesus, in River Jordan
A witness is to all the world
“This is my own beloved Son.”

Without sin is He and perfect
But to fulfill the righteousness
Of baptism in the water
He made Himself an example

Son of the Father's own bosom
Is Salvation for all mankind
The source of life for the sinner
Jordan, brought near to Calvary

Come, thou, follow now thy Saviour
Obey the command, be baptized
Example of death with Jesus
And the resurrection with Him.

Come, do not be curious to know
A secret which the Lord would keep
Put obedience first and at last
The result will then be revealed.
Amen.

Gbọ ohun t'o dun lat'oke
Si Jesu l'odo Jordani,
Ẹri fun gbogbo araye
“Eyi l'ayanfe Omo Mi.”

Alailese, Eni pipe
Sugbon nitori t'a pase
Iwenumo ninu odo,
O f'ara re se apere.

Ọmọ oókan aya Baba,
Igbala fun gbogbo eda,
Orisun iye elese
Jordani t'oke Kalfari.

Wa, tele Olugbala re,
Ninu ase ilo s'odo
Apere iba Jesu ku,
Ati ajinde Pelu Re.

Wa, ma tan idi asiri
T'o wu Oluwa lati bo,
F'igboran saju, nikehin
Ere re y'o fi ara han.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I WILL SING OF MY REDEEMER

sections.text:
I will sing of my Redeemer,
And His wondrous love to me;
On the cruel cross He suffered.
From the curse, to set me free.
Sing, oh sing ...
Of my Redeemer!...
With His blood ...
He purchased me!...
On the cross...
He sealed my par-don...
Paid the debt ... and made
me free...

I will tell the wondrous story,
How my lost estate to save,
In His boundless love
And mercy,
He the ransom freely gave.

I will praise my dear
Redeemer,
His triumphant power,
I'll tell;
How the victory He giveth,
Over sin, and death, and hell.

I will sing of my Redeemer,
And His heavenly love to me;
He from death to life hath
brought me,
Son of God, with Him to be.
Amen.

N ó máa kọrin ìràpadà
Ti ifẹ Jesu si mi
A fi Ọm'Ọlọrun gégùn-ún
Ki ń ba lè d'ẹni 'bùkún
N ó kọrin 'yìn s'Olùgbàlà
Ẹjẹ Rẹ lo fi ra mi
O san gbogbo igbese mi
O so mi d'ominira.

N ó máa ròyin 'tàn
'yanu náà
Bi O ti se wa mi ri
Ń'nu opolopo ifẹ Rẹ
O ra mi pada lọfẹẹ.

N ó yin Olurapada mi
N ó yin agbara íla Re
O segun ẹṣẹ at'iku
Won ki y'o le jọba mọ.

Em'o máa yin Oluwa mi
Yin ifẹ íla Re si mi
O so oku di alààye
O so mi d'om'Olorun.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THERE'S A STRANGER AT THE DOOR

sections.text:
There's a Stranger at the door:
Let ... Him in!...
He has been there oft before:
Let ... Him in!...
Let Him in, ere He is gone:
Let Him in, the Holy One,
Jesus Christ, the Father's Son;
Let ... Him in!...

Open now to Him your heart:
Let ... Him in!...
If you wait, He will depart:
Let ... Him in!...
Let ... Him in: He is your Friend;
He your soul will sure defend:
He will keep you to the end;
Let ... Him in!...

Hear you now His loving voice!
Let ... Him in!...
Now, oh, now make Him your choice:
Let ... Him in!...
He is standing at the door;
Joy to you He will restore;
And His name you will adore:
Let ... Him in!...

Now admit the heavenly Guest:
Let ... Him in!...
He will make for you a feast:
Let ... Him in!...
He will speak your sins forgiven:
And when earth-ties all are riven;
He will take you home to heaven:
Let ... Him in!...
Amen.

Àlejò kan mà ń kàn'kùn:
Pè Ẹ... Wọlé!...
O ti pẹ t'ó ti ń pààrà:
Pè Ẹ... Wọlé!...
Pè Ẹ wọlé kí ó tó lọ:
Pè Ẹ wọlé, Ẹmí Mímọ;
Jèsù Kríst Ọmọ Baba:
Pè Ẹ... Wọlé!...

Sí ọkàn rẹ páyá fún Un:
Pè E... Wọlé!...
B'ó bá pẹ, yóó padà lọ:
Pè E... Wọlé!...
Pè E wọlé, Ọrẹ rẹ ni:
Yóó dáàbò bo ọkàn rẹ:
Yóó pa ọ mọ dé òpin:
Pè E... Wọlé!...

O kò ha gbọ ohùn Rẹ:
Pè E... Wọlé!...
S' E l'áyànfẹ rẹ lóní:
Pè E... wọlé!...
O dúró l'ẹyìn 'lẹkùn:
Yóó fún ọ lí ayọ:
'Wọ ó yin orúkọ Rẹ:
Pè E... Wọlé!...

Pe àlejò náà wọlé:
Pè E... Wọlé!...
Yóó se àsè fún ọ:
Pè E... Wọlé!...
Yóó dárí ẹsẹ jin ọ:
'Gbà tí ìpinyà bá dé:
Yóó mú ọ dé'lé ọrun:
Pè E... Wọlé!...
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WOULD YOU BE FREE FROM YOUR BURDEN
yorubaTitle: WỌ HA Ń FẸ BỌ L'ỌW'ẸRU ẸSẸ RẸ

sections.text:
Would you be free from your burden of sin?
There's pow'r in the blood, Pow'r in the blood:
Would you o'er evil a victory win?
There's wonderful pow'r in the blood,

There's pow'r, pow'r
Wonder-working pow'r in
the blood of the Lamb.
There's pow'r, pow'r
Wonder-working pow'r in
the precious blood of the
Lamb.

Would you be free from your
passion and pride
There's pow'r in the blood,
Pow'r in the blood:
Come for a cleansing to
Calvary tide;
There's wonderful pow'r
in the blood.

Would you be whiter, much
whiter than snow?
There's pow'r in the blood,
Pow'r in the blood:
Sin stains are lost in its
life-giving flow
There's wonderful pow'r
in the blood.

Would you do service for
Jesus your King?
There's pow'r in the blood,
Pow'r in the blood:
Would you live daily His
praises to sing?
There's wonderful pow'r in
the blood. Amen.

'Wọ ha ń fẹ bọ l'ọw'ẹrù ẹsẹ?
Agbára ń bẹ nínú Ẹjẹ Rẹ:
'Wọ ha fẹ gbà 'sẹgun Lórí Èsù?
Agbára ń bẹ ń'nú Ẹjẹ Rẹ.

'Wọ ha ń fẹ bọ l'ọw
'agbára ẹṣẹ?
Agbára ń bẹ nínú Ẹjẹ Rẹ:
Wá fún ìwẹnúmọ ní Kálfárì
Agbára ń bẹ ń'nú Ẹjẹ Rẹ.

'Wọ ha ń fẹ k'ọkàn rẹ
funfun bí sno?
Agbára ń bẹ nínú Ẹjẹ Rẹ:
Ẹjẹ Rẹ l'ó ń wẹ àbàwọn ẹṣẹ,
Agbára ń bẹ ń'nú Ẹjẹ Rẹ.

'Wọ ha ń fẹ s'iṣẹ fún
Olúwa rẹ?
Agbára ń bẹ nínú Ẹjẹ Rẹ:
'Wọ ha ń fẹ fi gbogbo ayé
rẹ yìin ín?
Agbára ń bẹ ń'nú Ẹjẹ
Rẹ. Àmín.

englishTitle: SEND THE GOSPEL OF SALVATION

sections.text:
Send the gospel of salvation,
To a world of dying men;
Tell it out to ev'ry nation,
Till the Lord shall come again

Go and tell them,
Go and tell them,
Jesus died for sinful men,
Go and tell them,
Go and tell them,
He is coming, He is coming,
He is coming back again.

'Tis the church's commissions,
'Tis the Master's last command;
Christ has died for every creature,
Tell it out in every land.

Christ is gathering out a people,
To His name from every creature,
Ere shall end the day of grace

Give the! Gospel as a witness,
To a world of sinful men
Till the Bride shall be completed.
And the Lord shall come again.
Amen.

Kéde ìyìnrere ìgbàlà,
Fún ayé tí ń dákú lọ,
Kéde rẹ yí gbogb'
Ayé ká,
Títí Jésù yóó fi dé.

Lọ sọ fún wọn,
Lọ sọ fún wọn,
Jésù kú fún ẹlẹṣẹ,
Lọ sọ fún wọn, lọ sọ fún wọn,
Ó ń padà bọ, Ó ń padà bọ,
Jésù tún ń padà bọwá.

Asẹ ńla Olúwa wa ni,
Ọrọ ikẹyin Rẹ ni,
Krístì kú fún gbogb' èniyàn,
Kéde Rẹ yí ayé ká.

Ó ń sa áwọn ayànfe jọ,
Ní orílẹ at'ede,
Sáré láti fọn ìpè náà,
K'ilẹkùn àánú tó ti.

Ìyìn-rere náà, ẹri ni,
Yóó jẹ fun aye ẹṣẹ,
Tít'Iyàwó Rẹ yóó se tán,
Tí Ọkọ-Ìyàwó yóó dé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: COME TO THE SAVIOUR, MAKE NO DELAY
yorubaTitle: WÁ S'ỌDỌ JÉSÙ, MÁ SE LỌRA

sections.text:
Joyful, joyful will the Meeting be,
When from sin our hearts
Are pure and free,
And we shall gather,
Saviour, with Thee,
In our eternal home.

“Suffer the children” oh,
hear His voice!
Let every heart leap forth
and rejoice!
And let us freely make Him
our choice,
Do not delay, but come.

Think once again,
He's with us today;
Heed now His blest
command and obey;
Hear now His accents
tenderly say,
'Will you, my children,
come?”
Amen.

Wá s'ọdọ Jésù, má se lọra,
Ó ń fọnhà hàn wá ń'nú ọrọ Rẹ;
Ó ń dúró li ààrin wa lónií
O ń wí jẹjẹ pé, “Wá.”

Ipàdé wa yóó jẹ ayọ,
Gb'okan wa bá
Bo lọwọ ese,
A ó sì wà pẹlú Rẹ, Jésù;
Ní'lé wa 'yérayé.

englishTitle: FOR MY SAKE AND THE GOSPEL'S GO

sections.text:
“For my sake and
the gospel's go
And tell redemption's story;”
His heralds answer, “be it so,
And Thine, Lord, all the glory!”
They preach His birth, His life,
His cross,
The love of His atonement,
For whom they count the
world but loss,
His Easter, His enthronement.

Hark, hark, the trump of Jubilee
Proclaims to every nation,
From pole to pole, by land
and sea,
Glad tidings of salvation:
As nearer draws the day
of doom,
While still the battle rages,
The heavenly dayspring,
through the gloom
Breaks on the night of ages.

Still on and on the
anthems spread
Of Hallelujah voices,
In concert with the holy dead
The warrior church rejoices:
Their snow-white robes are
washed in blood,
Their golden harps are ringing;
Faith, and the paradise of God,
One triumph-song are singing.

He comes, whose advent
trumpet drowns,
The last of time's evangels-
Emmanuel
Crowned with many crowns,
The Lord of saints and angels:
O life, Light, Love,
The great I AM.
Triune, who changest never;
The throne of God and
of the Lamb
Is Thine, and Thine for
ever! Amen.

Torí mi àt'iyìnrere
Ẹ lọ sọ t'ìràpadà
Àwọn oń'ṣẹ Rẹ ń ké, “
Ààmín”.
Tirẹ ni gbogbo ògo
Wọn ń sọ t'ibí, t'ìyà, t'ikú;
Ìfẹ ètùtù ńlá Rẹ;
Wọn ka ohun ayé s'ófo,
T'àjínde òun'jọba Rẹ.

Gbọ, gbọ ipè t'ìdásílẹ,
Ó ń dun yí gbogb' ayé ká,
Ní'lẹ àti l'ójú òkun;
A ń tan ìyin ìgbàlà,
Bí ọjọ náà ti ń sún mọlé
T'ógun sì ń gbóná janjan
Ìmọlẹ ìlà-oòrùn náà
Yóó mọ láàrin òkùnkùn.

Síwájú àti síwájú,
L' a ó máa gbọ Alelúyà:
Ìjọ ajagun y'ó máa yọ;
Pẹl'àwọn ókú mímọ
A fọ asọ wọn ń'nú ẹjẹ
Dùùrù wúrà wọn sì ń dún
Ayé àt'ọrun d'ohùn pọ
Wọn ń kọ orin ìṣẹgun.

Ó dé, ẹni t'á ń wọnà Rẹ,
Ẹni ikẹyin náà dé,
Ìmmánúẹli tó d'ádé
Olúwa àwọn mímọ
Iye, imole at'ife.
Metalokan titi láé
Tirẹ ni itẹ Ọlọrun
Àti t'Ọdọ-àgùntàn. Àmín.

englishTitle: SINNERS JESUS WILL RECEIVE

sections.text:
Sinners Jesus will receive!
Sound this word of grace to all
Who the heav'nly
pathway leave,
All who linger, all who fall!

Sing it o'er...and o'er
again.....
Christ receiv... eth sinful
men ...
Make the mes ... sage
Clear and plain...
Christ receiveth sinful men.

Now my heart condemns me not,
Pure before the law I stand;
He who clean'd me from All spot
Satisfied its last demand.

Christ receiveth sinful men,
Even me with all my sin
Purg'd from ev'ry spot and Stain,
Heav'n with Him I enter in.
Amen.

Jésù ń fẹ gba ẹlẹṣẹ
Kéde rẹ fún gbogb' ẹdá
T'ó k'ọnà ọrun sílẹ
T'ó jáfara, t'o subú.

Kọ ọ l'órin, k'ó sì tún kọ,
Krístì ń gba gbogb' ẹlẹṣẹ,
Jẹ k'íyìn náà dájú pé,
Krístì ń gba gbogb' ẹlẹṣẹ.

Ọkàn mi kò lẹbi mọ,
Mo mọ níwájú òfin,
Ẹni t'ó ti wẹ mí mọ,
Ti san gbogbo gbèsè mi.

Krístì ń gba gbogb' ẹlẹṣẹ,
Àn'émi t'ó d'ẹṣẹ jù,
T'á wẹ mọ pátápátá;
Y'ó bá wọn jọba ọrun.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: BLOW YE THE TRUMPET BLOW!

sections.text:
Blow ye the trumpet blow!
The gladly solemn sound,
Let all the nations know,
To earth's remotest bound.
The year of jubilee is come!
Return, ye ransomed
Sinners, home.

Extol the Lamb of God,
The all-anointing Lamb;
Redemption by His blood,
Throughout the world
proclaim.

Ye, who have sold for naught,
Your heritage above,
Receive it back un-bought,
The gifts of Jesus' love.

Hearts that are weary come
Rest on the Savior's breast
Disconsolate heart, come
Be careful and rejoice.
Amen.

Ẹ fun 'pè náà kíkan,
Ìpè ìyinrere,
K'ódún jákèjádò;
L'étí gbogbo ẹda:
Ọdún ìdásílẹ ti dé,
Padà, ẹlẹṣẹ, padà!

Fun'pè t'Ọd'ágùntàn,
T'á ti pa s'ètùtù:
Jẹ kí àgbáyé mọ,
Agbára ẹjẹ Rẹ.

Ẹyin ẹrú ẹṣẹ,
Ẹ sọ'ra yín d'ọmọ,
Lọwọ Krístì Jésù;
Ẹ gba òmnira yin.

Ọkàn alàárẹ wá,
Sinmi láyà Jésù;
Oníròbíínúẹ:
Tújúká, sì máa yọ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WE HAVE HEARD A JOYFUL SOUND

sections.text:
We have heard a joyful sound,
Jesus saves; Jesus saves!
Spread the gladness all around
Jesus saves; Jesus saves!
Bear the news to ev'ry land,
Climb the steeps and cross
The waves; Onward, 'tis
Our Lord's Command,
Jesus saves; Jesus saves!

Waft it on the rolling tide,
Jesus saves; Jesus saves!
Tell to sinners far and wide,
Jesus saves; Jesus saves!
Sing, ye islands of the sea,
Echo back, ye ocean waves,
Earth shall keep her Jubilee!
Jesus saves; Jesus saves!

Sing above the battle's strife,
Jesus saves; Jesus saves!
By His death and endless life,
Jesus saves; Jesus saves!
Sing it softly thro' the gloom
When the heart for
Mercy craves
Sing in triumph o'er the tomb,
Jesus saves; Jesus saves!

Give the winds a mighty voice,
Jesus saves; Jesus saves!
Let the nations now rejoice,
Jesus saves; Jesus saves!
Shout salvation full and free,
Highest hills and
Deepest caves,
This our song of victory,
Jesus saves; Jesus saves! Amen.

Gbọ ìró ayọ dídùn,
Pé Jésù ń gba ni là,
Kéde rẹ jàkèjàdò:
Pé Jésù ń gba ni là ;
Tan ìyìn ayọ náà ká,
Lór'ókè òun petẹlẹ,
Kéde rẹ kíkankíkan,
Pé Jésù ń gba ni là.

Sọ fún àwọn tó jìnnà,
Pé Jésù ń gba ni là;
F'àwọn tó wà nítòsí;
Pé Jésù ń gba ni là.
Sọ fún gbogbo ẹlẹṣẹ
Ọrẹ àt'bátan rẹ,
Sọ ti ìdásílẹ yìí,
Pé Jésù ń gba ni là.

Kọrin ìràpadà náà,
Pé Jésù ń gba ni là,
Ó ti kú Ó sì jínde,
Pé Jésù ń gba ni là.
Kọrin náà lóhùn jejẹ,
Fún ọkàn tó ń wá àánú,
Kọ orin ìṣẹgun náà
Pé Jésù ń gba ni là.

Kí gbogbo wa kọrin náà,
Pé Jésù ń gba ni là
Kí gbogb'ayé bú s'áyọ,
Pé Jésù ń gba ni là
Ọfẹ ni ìgbàlà náà;
Ìgbàlà kíkún sì ni;
Orin ìṣẹgun l'èyí,
Pé Jésù ń gba ni là. Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS SHALL REIGN WHERE'ER THE SUN

sections.text:
Jesus shall reign where'er the sun
Doth his successive journeys run;
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore,
Till sun shall raise and Set no more.

For Him shall endless prayer be made,
And praises throng to crown His head;
His name like sweet Perfume shall rise
With every morning sacrifice.

People and realms of every tongue
Dwell on His love with sweetest song;
And infant voices shall proclaim
Their young hosannas to His name.

Let every creature rise, and bring
Its grateful honours to our King;
Angels descend with songs again,
And earth prolongs the joyful strain.
Amen.

Jésù yóó jọba ní gbogbo
Ibi t'á bá lè rí oòrùn,
'Jọba Rẹ yóó tàn káàkiri;
'Jọba Rẹ kì yóó ní'pẹkun.

Òun li a ó máa gbàdúrà sí,
Àwọn ọba yóó pè É l'Ọba,
Orúkọ Rẹ, b'óòrùn dìdùn,
Yóó bá ẹbọ òòrọ gòkè.

Gbogbo onírúurú èdè,
Yóó f'ìfẹ Rẹ kọrin dìdùn;
Àwọn ọmọdé yóó jęwọ,
Pé 'bùkún wọn t'ọdọ Rẹ wá.

englishTitle: JESUS ONLY IS OUR MESSAGE
yorubaTitle: JÉSÙ NIKAN LI A Ń WÀÀSÙ

sections.text:
JESUS only is our Message,
Jesus all our theme shall be,
We will lift up Jesus ever,
Jesus only will we see.
Jesus only, Jesus ever,
Jesus all in all we sing;
Saviour, Sanctifier, Healer,
Glorious Lord and coming
King.

Jesus only is our Saviour,
All our guilt He bore away,
All our righteousness
He gives us,
All our strength from day
to day.

Jesus is our Sanctifier,
Cleansing us from self and sin,
And with all His Spirit's
fulness,
Filling all our hearts within.

Jesus only, is our Healer,
All our sickness He bare,
And His risen life and fullness,
All His members still
may share.

Jesus only is our Power,
His the gift of Pentecost;
Jesus, breathe Thy power
upon us,
Fill us with the Holy Ghost.

And for Jesus we are waiting,
Listening for the trumpet's
sound,
But 'twill still be Jesus only,
Jesus ever, all in all. Amen.

Jésù nikan li a ń wàásù,
Jésù nikan l'a ń ròyin,
Àwa y'ó gbé Jésù s'ókè;
Òun nikan l'àwá ń fẹ rí.
Jésù nikan, Jésù nikan,
Jésù nikan l'orin wa,
Olùgbàlà, Olùwòsàn;
Ọba tí ń bọ lẹẹkeji.

Jésù ni Olùgbàlà wa
O ru gbogbo ebi wa
Ododo re lo gbe wo wa
O ń s'agbara wa d'otun.

Jesu l'o ń so wa di mimo
T'o ń wę abawon wa nu
O ń segun ese at'ara
Nipa iranwo Ẹmi.

Jesu ni Oluwosan wa
O ti ru àìlera wa
Nip'agbara ajinde Rẹ
A ni ilera pipe.

Jesu nikan l'agbara wa
Agbara Pentikosti
Jọ, da agbara yi lu wa
F'Ẹmi Mimọ Rẹ kun wa.

Jesu ni awa ń duro de
A ń reti ohun ipe
'Gbà t'o bá dé, Jesu nikan
Yóó ję orin wa títí. Ààmín.

englishTitle: SOFTLY AND TENDERLY JESUS IS CALLING
yorubaTitle: GBỌ BI OLÚWA TI Ń PÈ L'ÓHÙN JẸJẸ

sections.text:
Softly and tenderly Jesus
is calling
Calling for you and for me;
See, on the portals He's waiting
and watching
Watching for you and for me.

Come home...
come home...
Ye who are weary,
come home,
Earnestly, tenderly Jesus
is calling-
Calling "o sinner,
come ,home."

Why should we tarry when
Jesus is pleading-
Pleading for you and for me?
Why should we linger and
heed not His mercies-
Mercies for you and for me?

Time is now fleeting, the
moments are passing-
Passing from you and
from me?
Shadows are gathering death
beds are coming,
Coming for you and for me.

Oh for the wonderful love
He has promised,
Promised for you and for me;
Though we have sinned He
has mercy and pardon,
Pardon for you and for me.
Amen.

Gbọ bí Olúwa ti ń pè
l'óhùn jẹjẹ,
Ó ń ké sí ọ àt'èmi,
Wòó! Ó ń fi sùúrù dúró
Lẹnu-ọnà
N dúró de t'èmi tirẹ.

Wá 'le ...wa 'le
Ẹyin t'ààárẹ mú, wá le
Tifẹtịfẹ li Olùgbàlà ń kígbe
O ń pe, elese, wa 'le.

È é se t'á fi ń lọra 'gbà
Jésù ń sipẹ?
Ń sipẹ fún t'èmi tirẹ;
È é se t'á fi ń kegàn ọpọ
àánú Rẹ?
Àánú fún t'èmi tirẹ.

Wòó! B'ákòòkò ti ń sàré
t'ó ń kojá lọ,
N kojá fún t'èmi tirẹ,
Ọjọọ ogbó dé tán ikú ń
sún mọ 'lé
Ikú ńbọ fún ọ, f'èmi.

Háà! ifẹ 'yanu t'ó ti se ilérí,
'Lèrí fún t'èmi tirẹ,
Bí a tilẹ d'ẹṣẹ, idáríji ń bẹ;
Ó ń bẹ fún ọ àt'èmi.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: TELL ME THE OLD, OLD STORY
yorubaTitle: SỌ ÌTÀN KAN NÁÀ FÚN MI

sections.text:
Tell me the old, old story,
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love
Tell me the story simply,
As to a little child;
For I am weak and weary
And helpless and defiled.

Tell me the story slowly,
That I may take it in,
That wonderful redemption,
God's remedy for sin.
Tell me the story often,
For I forgot so soon!
The “early dew” of morning
Has passed away at noon.

Tell me the story softly,
With earnest tones, and grave;
Remember! I'm the sinner,
Whom Jesus came to save.
Tell me the story always,
If you would really be,
In any time of trouble
A comforter to me.

Tell me the same old story,
When you have cause to fear
That this world's empty glory
Is costing me too dear,
Yes, and when that world's glory
Is dawning on my soul,
Tell me the old, old story,
“Christ Jesus makes thee
whole”.
Amen.

Sọ ìtan kan náà fún mi,
T'ohun tí ńbẹ l'orun
Ti Jesu oun ògo Rẹ,
Àti ti ifẹ Rẹ;
Sọ ìtan kan náà fún mi,
Bí a ti ń sọ ọ féwe,
'Tor'álàilera l'èmi,
Èmi kò sì l'ókun.

Sọ'tàn náà fún mi pẹlẹ,
Kí ó ba lè yé mi,
T'ìràpadà ìyanu;
T'ètùtù fún ẹṣẹ.
Sọ fún mi nígbàgbogbo;
'Torí n kò pẹ gbàgbé
Òye orí mi ti lọ,
Bí ìrì òwúrọ.

Sọ'tàn náà fún mi jejẹ,
Lí ohùn òtítọ,
Rántí p'ẹlẹṣẹ l'èmi;
Tí Jésù wá gbàlà
Sọ fún mi nígbàkugbà
Bí ìwọ y'ó bá se
Olùtúnú mi ní 'gbà
Qjọ ibi bá dé.

Sọ ìtan kan náà fún mi,
Nígbà t'ó bá rí i pé
Ògo asán ayé yìí
Fẹ gbà mí lí ọkàn
'Gbà t'ógo òkè ọrun
Bá sì ń fara hàn mí
Sọ'tàn náà fún mi pe
“Krístì mú ọ l'áradá.”
Aàmín.

englishTitle: HEREIN DOTH PERFECT REST ABIDE

sections.text:
Herein doth perfect rest abide
By His side where blood flows
This alone is my only hope
That Jesus died for me.

Jesus my Saviour and my Lord
The fountain for my sins,
Sprinkle me with Thy precious blood
That I may be made pure.

Wash me, Lord, and make me Thine own
Wash me, and be Thou mine
Wash me, and not my feet alone
My hands and my heart too.

Work Thou in my heart, Lord Jesus
Till faith comes to an end
And until hope comes to an end
And my heart comes to rest.
Amen.

Nihin yii n'isinmi gbe wa,
N'iha Re t'eje n san;
Eyi nikan n'ireti mi,
Pe Jesu ku fun mi.

Olugbala, Olorun mi,
Orisun f'ese mi;
Maa f'eje Re won mi titi,
K'emi le di mimo.

We mi, si se mi ni Tire,
We mi, si je t'emi;
We mi, kii s'ese mi nikan,
Owo at'okan mi.

Maa s'ise l'okan mi, Jesu
Tit' igbagbo y'o pin;
Tit' ireti y'o fi dopin,
T'okan mi y'o sinmi.
Aamin.

englishTitle: WILL YOUR ANCHOR HOLD IN THE STORMS OF LIFE?

sections.text:
Will your anchor hold in the storms of life?
When the clouds unfold their wings of strife;
When the strong tides lift and the cables strain,
Will your anchor drift, or firm remain?

We have an anchor that keeps the soul
Stead fast and sure while the billows roll:
Fasten'd to the Rock which cannot move
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour's love!

It is safely moored, t'will the storm withstand
For 'tis well secured by the Saviour's hand
And the cables passed from His heart to mine
Can defy the blast, through strength divine.

Will your anchor hold in the straits of fear,
When the breakers roar and the reef is near,
While the surges rave and the wild winds blow,
Shall the angry waves then your bark o'erflow?

Will your anchor hold in the floods of death,
When the waters cold, chill your latest breath?
On the rising tide you can never fail,
While your anchor holds within the veil!

Will your eyes behold, through the morning light
The city of gold and the habour bright?
We you anchor safe by the heavenly shore,
When life storms are past for ever more? Amen.

Ìwọ ha ní 'dàkọró t'ó dajú?
Nínú ìrumi àt'ìjì ayé
Nígbà tí ìkún omi bá dìde,
Ìdàkọró rę ha lè dúró?

Idakoro ń bẹ fun okan wa
B'o ti wu ki iji náà le to?
Jesu !'Apata ti ko le ye
Lor'Apata ife Re l'a ń dúró.

A ti gúnlẹ s'ébúté ìsimi,
Kò s'ewu a ń lọwọ Oluwa
Okun ife t'o fi fa wa mora
Kò sí ìjì tí yóó lè fáá já.

A duro sinsin kò sí ẹru mọ,
Awon ota wa ni oju y'o ti
Kosi igbi t'o le ba wa leru
Awa n'idakoro ti o daju.

Bi a tilẹ ń rin l'ojiji iku
Riru omi ko le bò wá mọlẹ
Kríst' Apata wa yóó mú wa làá já.
Oun ni idakoro 'reti wa

'Gbat'a ba yọju sínu Ogo ńlá
Si ebute ti a fi wura ko
Ao duro lori idakoro wa
Gbogbo iji y'o re wa koja. Ààmín.

englishTitle: WONDERFUL STORY OF LOVE
yorubaTitle: ÌTAN ÌYANU T'ÌFẸ! SỌ FÚN MI LẸẸKAN SÍ

sections.text:
Wonderful story of love
Tell it to me again;
Wonderful story of love
Wake the immortal strain!
Angels with rapture
announce it
Shepherds with wonder
receive it;
Sinner, O won't you believe it?
Wonderful story of love.

Won...der ... ful!
won...der ... ful
Won...der ... Ful!
Wonderful story of love.

Wonderful story of love,
Tho' you are far away;
Wonderful story of love
Still He doth call to-day;
Calling from Calvary's
mountain,
Down from the crystal bright
fountain,
E'en from the dawn of creation,
Wonderful story of love.

Wonderful story of love
Jesus provides a rest.
Wonderful story of love,
For all the pure and blest,
Rest in those mansions
above us,
With those who've gone
On before us,
Singing the rapturous chorus,
Wonderful story of love.
Amen.

Ìtàn ìyanu t'ìfẹ!
Sọ fún mi lẹẹkan sí!
Ìtàn ìyanu t'ìfẹ!
Tí ń dún létí kíkan,
Àwọn Àńgẹlì ròyìn rẹ,
Àwọn olùṣọ sì gbàá gbọ;
Ẹlẹṣẹ, ìwọ kì y'ó gbọ?
Ìtàn ìyanu t'ìfẹ!

Ìyanu! Ìyanu!
Ìyanu! Ìtàn ìyanu t'ìfẹ!

Ìtàn ìyanu t'ìfẹ!
Bí'wọ tilẹ sáko,
Ìtàn ìyanu t'ìfẹ!
Síbẹ, Ó ń pè lónìí,
Lát'orí òkè Kálfàri,
Láti orísun dídán nì
Láti ìṣẹ-dálẹ ayé,
Ìtàn ìyanu t'ìfẹ!

Ìtàn ìyanu t'ìfẹ! Jésù ni ìsinmi,
Ìtàn ìyanu t'ìfẹ!
Fún àwọn olóòótọ;
T'ó sinmi ní 'lùú ńlá ọrun,
Pẹl' àwọn tó saájú wa lọ;
Wọn ń kọ orin ayọ ọrun,
Ìtàn ìyanu t'ìfẹ! Ààmín.

englishTitle: COME, OH COME, WHILE CHRIST IS CALLING
yorubaTitle: WÁ NÍGBÀ TÍ KRÍSTÌ Ń PÈ Ọ

sections.text:
Come, Oh come,
While Christ is calling,
Linger not in path of sin;
Sever ev'ry tie that binds you,
And the heav'nly race begin.

Calling now, calling now,
Hear the Saviour calling now,
Calling now calling now,
Hear the Saviour calling now.

Come, Oh come,
While Christ is pleading
Oh, what love His tones convey!
Will you slight His proffer'd mercy,
Will you longer from Him stray?

Come, Oh come delay no longer,
For th'accepted time is now,
Yield, Oh yield, yourself to Jesus,
And before His scepter bow.
Amen.

Wá nígbà tí Krístì ń pè ọ,
Wá má rin'nà ẹṣẹ mọ,
Wá tú gbogbo ohun t'ó dè ọ;
Wá bẹrẹ 'ré-'je t'ọrun.

Ó ń pè ọ, nísinyìí,
Gbọ b'Olùgbàlà ti ń pè,
Ó ń pè ọ, nísinyìí,
Gbọ b'Olùgbàlà ti ń pè.

Wá nígbà tí Krístì ń bẹbẹ,
Wá gbọ ohùn ìfẹ Rẹ,
'Wọ ó kọ ohùn ìfẹ Rẹ,
'Wọ ó sì máa sáko sá?

Wá má se f 'àkókò d'ọla
Wá ọjọ ìgbàlà nì'yí,
Wá fi ara rẹ fún Krístì;
Wá wólẹ níwájú Rẹ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: THERE IS LIFE FOR A LOOK

sections.text:
There is life for a look at the Crucified One,
There is life at this moment for thee,
Then look sinner, look unto Him and be saved;
Unto Him who was nailed To the tree.
Look! Look! Look, and live!
There is life for a look at the Crucified One,
There is life at this moment for thee.

Oh, why was He there as the bearer of sin,
If on Jesus thy sins were not laid?
Oh, why from His side flowed the sin cleansing blood
If His dying thy debt has Not paid?

It is not thy tears of repentance
nor prayers,
But the blood, that atones
for thy soul;
On Him, then, believe
and a pardon receives
For His blood can now make
thee quite whole.

Then, doubt not thy welcome,
since God has declared
There remaineth no more
to be done;
That once in the end of the
world He appeared
And completed the work
He began.

Then take with rejoicing from
Jesus at once
The life everlasting He gives;
And know with assurance thou
never canst die
Since Jesus thy righteousness
lives. Amen.

Ìyè wa ni wíwo Ẹni
t'á kàn mọ'gi
Ìyè wà nísinsinyí fún ọ
Njẹ wò Ó ẹlẹsẹ k'ó lè rí'gbàlà
Wo ẹni tí a kàn mọgi fún ọ
Wò Ó! Wò ó!
Wò Ó, k'ó yè!
Ìyè wà ní wíwo
Ẹni t'á kàn mọ 'gi
Ìyè wà nísinsinyí fún ọ.

Kín ni Òun se wà
bí ẹlẹrù ẹsẹ,
B'á kó bá gbẹbi rẹ ru Jésù?
Ẹjẹ wẹnúmọ ha se ti ìhà Rẹ sàn
Bí'kú Rẹ k'ó bá san Gbèsè rẹ?

Kíi s'ẹkún'pìwàdà àti
t'adúrà rẹ
Ẹjẹ náà l'ó s'ètùtù f'ọkàn
Gbé ẹrù ẹṣẹ rẹ lọ sí ọdọ Ẹni
Tí ó ti ta ẹjẹ náà sílẹ.

Má siyèmèji s'ohun tí
Ọlọrun wí
Kò s'óhun t'ó kù láti se mọ
Àti pé Òun yóó wá
níkeyìn ayé
Yóó sì s'àsepárí iṣẹ Rẹ.

Njẹ wá f'ayo gba
ìyè àìnípẹkun
Ní ọwọ Jésù tí fi fún ni
Sì mọ dájú pé ìwọ kò
Lè kú láéláé
'Gbà tí Jésù òdodo rẹ wà.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: TELL ME THE STORY OF JESUS
yorubaTitle: JỌ'Ọ, SỌ ÌTÀN JÉSÙ FÚN MI

sections.text:
TELL me the story of Jesus,
Write on my heart ev'ry word!
Tell me the story most precious,
Sweetest that ever was heard.
Tell how the angels in chorus
Sang, as they welcome His birth,
“Glory to God in the highest
Peace and good tidings to earth.

Tell me the story of Jesus,
Write on my heart ev'ry word,
Tell me the story most
precious,
Sweetest that ever was heard.

Fasting alone in the desert,
Tell of the days that He passed,
How He was tried
and was tempted,
Yet was triumphant at last,
Tell of the years of His labours
Tell of the sorrows He bore;
He was despised and afflicted,
Homeless, rejected, and poor.

Tell of the cross where
they nailed Him
Dying in anguish and pain;
Tell of the grave where they
laid Him
Tell how He liveth again
Love, in that story so tender.
Clearer than ever I see;
Stay, let me weep while
You whisper
Love paid the ransom for me.
Amen.

Jọ'ọ, sọ ìtàn Jésù fún mi
Kọ ọrọ náà s'ọkàn mi
Sọ ìtàn 'yanu náà fún mi
Ìtàn dídùn láti gbọ
B'awọn Áńgẹl'ti ń kọrin náà
Orin ti ibí Krísti
Ògo f'Ọlọrun l'ók'ọrun
Àlàáfìà l'áyé yí,

Jọ'ọ, sọ ìtàn Jésù fún mi
Kọ ọrọ náà s'ọkàn mi
Sọ ìtàn 'yanu náà fún mi
Ìtàn dídùn láti gbọ

A dárí Rẹ sí aginjù
Láti gbààwẹ òun nìkan
Ebi pa Á, òngbẹ sì gb'Ẹ
Ó bọ sí 'nú ìdánwò
Ó síṣẹ púpọ, Ó jìyà
Ẹni ìbànújẹ ni
A kọ Ọ sílẹ, a pọn Ọn lójú
Ó di alárinkiri.

A gbé E kọ sí orí igi
A kàn-án mọ àgbélébùú
Ó kú, a tẹ Ẹ sí ibojì
Ní 'jọ kẹta Ó jínde
Ìfẹ ìyanu l'ó fẹ mi
Òye náà túnbo ń yé mi
Ayo mi dàpọ mọ ẹkún
F'Ẹni t'ó rà mí padà.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THERE'S A CALL COMES RINGING O'ER THE RESTLESS WAVE
yorubaTitle: ÌPÈ Ń DÚN L'ỌTÙN-ÚN ÀTI L'ÓSÌ PÉ

sections.text:
There's a call comes ringing o'er
the restless wave;
Send the light! Send the light!
There are souls to rescue; there
are souls to save,
Send the light! Send the light!
Send the light...the blessed
gospel light,
Let it shine...from shore to
shore!...send
The light... and let its
radiant beams
Light the world ...
For evermore.

We have heard the Macedonian
call to-day
Send the light! Send the light!
And a golden offering at the
cross we lay,
Send the light! Send the light!

Let us pray that grace may everywhere abound,
Send the light! Send the light!
And a Christ-like spirit everywhere be found,
Send the light! Send the light!

Let us not grow weary in the work of love
Send the light! Send the light!
Let us gather jewels for A crown above,
Send the light! Send the light!
Amen.

Ìpè ń dún l'ọtùn-ún àti l'ósì pé,
Tàn 'mọlẹ! Tàn 'mọlẹ!
Ọpọ l'ó ń kú láìní ìrètí ọrun
Tàn 'mọlẹ! Tàn 'mọlẹ!
Tàn 'mọlẹ ìyìnrere náà
Jẹ k'ó tàn yí ayé ká
Tàn 'mọlẹ ìyìnrere náà
Jẹ k'ó tàn yí ayé ká.

Àwọn t'ó wà l'ókùnkùn
ń ké tantan pé
Tàn 'mọlẹ! Tàn 'mọlẹ!
Mú wọn wá jẹjẹ sí 'bi
àgbélébùú
Tàn 'mọlẹ! Tàn 'mọlẹ!

Jẹ k'á gbàdúrà k'óor' ọfẹ
Lè jọba
Tàn 'mọlẹ! Tàn 'mọlẹ!
Kí Ẹmí Kríst' jọba ní
Ibi gbogbo
Tàn 'mọlẹ! Tàn 'mọlẹ!

Jẹ k'á tẹra mọ iṣẹ t'ó l'éré yìí
Tàn 'mọlẹ! Tàn 'mọlẹ!
A ó gb'adé níkeyìn bí a forí tí
Tàn 'mọlẹ! Tàn 'mọlẹ!
Ààmín.

englishTitle: TODAY THE SAVIOUR CALLS

sections.text:
Today the Saviour calls:
Ye wand'rers, come!
Oh, ye be knighted souls,
Why longer roam?

Today the Saviour calls;
Oh, listen now!
Within these sacred walls,
To Jesus bow!

Today the Saviour calls;
For refuge fly:
The storm of justice falls
And death is nigh.

The Spirit calls today
Yield to His power!
Oh, grieve Him not away:
'Tis mercy's hour. Amen

Lónìí ni Jèsù pè!
Asáko wá
Háà! ọkàn òkùnkùn
Má kiri mọ.

Lónìí ni Jèsù pè!
Tẹtí lélẹ, Wólẹ fún Jèsù ni
'Lẹ ọwọ yìí.

Lónìí ni Jèsù pè!
Sá àsálà
Ìjì ìgbẹsan ń bọ
Ìparun ń bọ.

Lónìí ni Ẹmí ń pè
Jọwọ 'ra rẹ
Má mú k'ó bínú lọ,
Sáà àánú ni. Ààmín.

englishTitle: THY KINGDOM COME, O GOD

sections.text:
Where is Thy reign of peace
And purity and love?
When shall all hatred cease,
As in the realms above?

When comes the promised time,
That war shall be no more,
And lust, oppression, crime,
Shall flee thy face before?

We pray Thee, Lord arise,
And come in Thy great might;
Revive our longing eyes,
Which languish for Thy sight.

Men scorn Thy sacred Name,
