And wolves devour Thy fold,
By many deeds of shame;
We learn that love grows cold.

O'er heathen lands afar,
Thick darkness broodeth yet:
Arise, O Morning Star,
Arise, and never set. Amen.

Kríst' kí 'jọba Rẹ dé,
Kí àṣẹ Rẹ bẹrẹ
F'opá irin Rẹ fọ
Gbogbo ipá ẹṣẹ.

Ìjọba ìfẹ dà
Àti t'àláàfíà?
'Gbà wo ni ìríra
Yóó tán bi tí ọrun?

Àkókò náà ha dà
T'ọte yóó parí
Ìkà àti irẹjẹ
Pẹlú ìfẹkúfẹ

Olúwa jọ'ọ dide,
Wa ń'nú agbára Rẹ,
Fi ayọ fún àwa
Tí ó ń s'àfẹrí Rẹ.

Ẹdá ń gan Oókọ Rẹ,
'Kòokò ń jẹ agbo Rẹ,
Ìwà 'tijú púpọ
N fi hàn pé 'fẹ tutù.

Òòkùn bolẹ síbẹ,
Ní ilẹ Kèférí,
Dide 'ràwọ òórọ
Dide má se wọ mọ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: ONCE MORE, MY SOUL, THY SAVIOUR
yorubaTitle: LẸEKAN SÍI, A TÚN FI JÉSÙ LỌ Ọ

sections.text:
Once more, my soul,
Thy Saviour, thro' the word,
Is offer'd full and free;
And now, O Lord, I must,
I must decide:
Shall I accept of Thee?
I will, I will,
I will, God helping me,
I will, O Lord, be Thine!
Thy precious blood was
shed to purchase me,
I will be wholly Thine!

Thou knowest, Lord,
How very weak I am,
And how I fear to stray;
For strength to serve
I look to Thee alone
The strength Thou must supply!

And now, O Lord, give
all with us today,
The grace to join our song;
And from the heart to gladly
with us say:
“I will to Christ belong!”

To all who came, when Thou
wast here below,
And said, “O Lord, wilt Thou?”
To them, “I will”, was ever
Thy reply:
We rest upon it now. Amen

Lẹẹkan síi, a tún fí Jésù lọ ọ,
Ń'n 'ọrọ Rẹ, ọkan mi;
Nísinsìnyí, Olúwa, n ó pinnu,
P'émi y'ó gbọ Tìrẹ.
Mo fẹ, mo fẹ
B'Ọlorun se 'rànwọ
Mo fẹ kí n jẹ Tirẹ,
Ẹjẹ Rẹ 'yebíye l'ó fí rà mi,
Mo fẹ kí n jẹ Tirẹ.

Olúwa, O sá mọ àìlera mi,
Bí mo ti ń fẹ sáko,
Mo ń wò Ọ nikan fún
agbára ńlá,
Tí 'Wọ ó fí fún mi.

Fún wa n'ìfẹ láti jùmọ̀ kọrin
Lónií, Olùgbàlà
Kí gbogbo wa lè kọ
Tọkàntọkàn;
P'émi y'ó jẹ ti Kríst'.

Gbogbo àwọn tí
ó ti ń bá Ọ gbé
Tí ń bèèrè 'bùkún Rẹ
Gbogbo wọn l'ó ti rí
ìbùkún gbà,
Àwa náà ń fẹ 'bùkún. Ààmín.

englishTitle: O LISTEN TO OUR WONDROUS STORY

sections.text:
O listen to our wondrous story,
Once we dwelt among the lost:
Yet Jesus came from heaven's
glory,
Saving us at awful cost.
Who saved us from
eternal loss?
(Who but God's Son upon
the cross!)
What did He do?
(He died for you?)
Where is He now?
(Believe it thou),
In heaven interceding.

No angel could our place
have taken,
Highest of the high though He,
Nail'd to the cross, despis'd,
forsaken,
Was one of the Godhead Three.

Will you surrender to this Saviour?
Now before Him humbly bow?
You, too, shall come to know
His favour;
He will save, and save you now!
Amen.

Gbọ ìtàn 'yanu ti ìgbàlà,
Àwa t'á ti sọnù rí,
Jésù ló sọkalẹ lát'òkè,
T'ó f'ẹjẹ Rẹ gbà wá.
Ta l'ó yọ wá nínú ègbé?
(Jésù Ọmọ Ọlọrun ni),
Kí l'ohun t'Ó se?
( Ó kú fún wa),
Ní'bo l'Ó wà?
(L'ọdọ Baba),
Ó ń bẹbẹ fún wa l'ók'ọrun.

Ańgẹl' kan kò lè rà wá padà,
Àfi Kríst' t'ó ga jù lọ,
A kọ Ọ sílẹ, a sì kàn-án mọ'gi,
Ọkan ń'nú Mẹtalọkan.

Jọwọ ara rẹ f'Ólùgbàlà,
Yára wólẹ l'ẹsẹ Rẹ,
'Wọ ó tọ adùn ìfẹ Rẹ wò;
Òun yóó gbà ọ l'á-gbà-tán
Ààmín.

englishTitle: MY HEART IS OPEN TO THEE, DEAR LORD

sections.text:
My heart is open to Thee,
dear Lord,
Come in, come in
My faith is clinging to
Thy dear word,
Come in, come in:

Come not to tarry, but stay,
dear Lord,
All shall be Thine love can
afford,
Here in my heart ever make
Thine abode,
Come in, come in.

Yes, there is room in my heart,
dear Lord,
Come in, come in;
Thy presence makes Heaven
real to me,
Come in, come in.

I kept Thee standing outside
so long,
Come in, come in,
I pray Thee pardon this
shameful wrong,
Come in, come in.

I hear Thee knocking at my
heart's door
Come in, come,
I'll keep Thee waiting outside
no more,
Come in, come in. Amen.

Ọkàn mi sí payá,
Olúwa, Wọle, wọle,
Ìgbàgbọ mi rọ mọ ọrọ Rẹ
Wọle, wọle.

Máa bá mi gbé títí Olúwa
Ohun tí O fẹ ni n ó fẹ
Fi ọkàn mi se 'bùgbé
Rẹ láéláé, Wọle, wọle

Bẹẹ ni ààyè ń bẹ fun Olúwa
Wọle, wọle,
'Dídé Rẹ mú mi sún mọ ọ
sí i, Wọle, wọle.

Mo dá Ọ dúró s'òde pẹ jù
Wọle, wọle,
Dari eyí jì mí Olúwa
Wọle, wọle.

Mo gbọ, O ń kan 'lẹkun,
Wọle, wọle,
N kò ni dá Ọ dúró s'òde mọ
Wọle, wọle. Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHEN THE POW'R OF GOD DESCENDED

sections.text:
When the pow'r of God descended,
On the day of Pentecost,
All the days of waiting ended,
They received the Holy Ghost.
O Lord, send the pow'r
just now,
O Lord, send the pow'r
just now,
O Lord, send the pow'r
just now,
And baptize every one.

Tongues of flame came down upon them,
And they preached the word
In pow'r,
List'ning multitude awaken'd,
Turned to God that very hour.

We are waiting Holy Spirit,
We are all of one accord,
Lord fulfill just now the promise,
That is given in Thy Word.

Fill and thrill us with Thy presence,
Grant the blessing that we need,
Flood our souls with
wondrous glory,
While the pray'r of faith
We plead. Amen.

'Gbà t' agbára Ọlọrun dé,
Lí ọjọ Pẹntíkọsti,
Sáà if'ojú s'ọnà parí,
'Torí wọn rí Ẹmí gbà.
Rán agbára, Olúwa,
Rán agbára, Olúwa,
Rán agbára, Olúwa,
Kí O sì baptís' wa.

Ẹla 'họn iná bà lé wọn
Wọn sì wàásù ọrọ náà,
Ọpọlọpọ èèyàn gbàgbọ
Wọn yí padà s'Ọlọrun.

A ń w'ọnà fún Ẹmí Mímọ
Gbogbo wa f'ohun sọkan
Mu 'leri náà sẹ, Olúwa,
Tí a se ní n'ọrọ Rẹ.

Jo'ọ, fí agbára Rẹ kún wa,
Fún wa ní 'bùkún t'a ń fẹ;
Fi ogo Rẹ kún ọkàn wa.
B'a ti ń fí 'gbàgbọ bẹbẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: SPIRIT DIVINE, ATTEND OUR PRAYERS

sections.text:
Spirit divine, attend our prayers
And make this house Thy
home;
Descend with all
Thy gracious pow'r,
O come, great Spirit, come!

Come as the light: to us reveal,
Our emptiness and woe;
And lead us in those
paths of life,
Where all the righteous goes.

Come as the fire, and purge
our hearts
Like sacrificial flame;
Let our whole soul an
offering be
To our Redeemer's name.

Come as the dew,
and sweetly bless
This consecrated hour,
May barrenness rejoice to own
Thy fertilizing pow'r.

Come as the dove,
and spread Thy wings,
The wings of peaceful love;
And let Thy Church on
Earth become
Blest as the Church above.

Ẹmi ọrun gb'àdúrà wa,
Wá gbé 'nú ilé yìí;
Sọkalẹ pẹ'lagbára Rẹ,
Wá, Ẹmí Mímọ wá.

Wá bí 'mọlẹ sì fi hàn wá,
B'àìní wa ti pọ tó;
Wá tọ wa sí ọ̀nà ìyè,
Tí olódodo ń rìn.

Wá bí iná ẹbọ mímọ,
S'ọkàn wa di mímọ;
Jẹ kí ọkàn wa jẹ ọrẹ,
F'orúkọ Olúwa.

Wà bí ìri, sì wá bùkún
Àkókò mímọ yìí;
Kí ọkàn aláìléso wa
Lè yọ l'agbára Rẹ.

Wá, bí àdàbà, n'apá Rẹ,
Apá ìfẹ mímọ,
Wá jẹ kí ìjọ Rẹ l'ayé
Dàbí ìjọ t'ọrun.

Ẹmi ọrun gb'àdúrà wa,
S'ayé yìí d'ilé Rẹ,
Sọkalẹ pẹ'l'agbára Rẹ,
Wá, Ẹmí Mímọ wá.

englishTitle: COME HOLY GHOST

sections.text:
Come Holy Ghost descend
from high,
Baptizer of our spirits Thou,
The sacramental seal apply
And witness with the water now.

Pour faith Thy energy divine
And sprinkle the atoning blood,
May Father, Son and Spirit join
To seal this child, a child of God.
Amen.

Wá, Ẹmí Mímọ sọkalẹ,
Oníbaptisí ọkàn wa,
M'èdìdí májẹmú Rẹ wá.
K'O sì se ẹrí omi yìí.

Tú agbára ńlá Rẹ jáde,
K'O si wọn ẹjẹ ètùtù;
Kí Baba, ọmọ at'Ẹmi,
S'àwọn yìí d'ọm'Ọlọrun.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: ART THOU WEARY, ART THOU LANGUID
yorubaTitle: ÀÀRẸ MU Ọ, AYE SU Ọ

sections.text:
Art thou weary, art thou languid
Art thou sore distressed?
Come to Me, saith One, and coming,
Be at rest!

Hath He marks to lead me to Him,
If He be my guide?
In His feet and hands are wound prints,
And His side.

Hath He diadem as Monarch,
That His brow adorns?
Yea, a crown in very surety
But of thorns!

If I find Him if I follow.
What His guerdon here?
Many a sorrow, many a labour
Many a tear.

If I still hold closely to Him,
What hath He at last?
Sorrow vanquished, Labour ended,
Jordan past.

If I ask Him to receive me,
Will He say me nay?
Not till earth and not till heaven
Pass away.

Finding, following, cleaving, trusting,
Is He sure to bless?
Saints, apostles, Prophets, martyrs.
Answer: Yes! Amen.

Àrẹ mú ọ, ayé sú ọ,
Làáláá pọ fún ọ?
Jésù wí pé, “Wá s'ọdọ Mi,
K'ó sinmi.

Àmì wo lèmí ó fí mọ
Pé Òun l'ó ń pè mí?
Àmì'só wà lọwọ àti
Ẹsẹ Rẹ.

Ó ha ní adé bí ọba
Tí mo lè fí mọ?
Tòótọ́ adé wà lori Rẹ,
T'ẹgún ni.

Bí mo bá rí I, bí mo tẹl'E,
Kí ni èrè mí?
Ọpọlọpọ ìyà àti ìbànújẹ.

Bí mo tẹl'E tít'ayé mi,
Kí ni n ó rí gbà?
Ẹkún á dòpin, n ó sinmi
Tít'ayé.

Bí mo bèèrè pé k'ó gbà mí,
Yóó kọ fún mi bí?
B'ọrun àt'ayé ń kojá lọ,
Kò jẹ kọ.

Bí mo bá rí I, bí mo tẹl'E,
Yóó ha bùkúún mi?
Àwọn ogun ọrun wí pé,
“Yóó se É. Ààmín.

englishTitle: REVIVE THY WORK, O LORD

sections.text:
Revive Thy work, O Lord,
Thy mighty arm make bare;
Speak with the voice that wakes the dead,
And make Thy people hear,

Revive Thy work, O Lord,
While here to Thee we bow;
Descend, O gracious Lord, descend!
O come and bless us now.

Revive Thy work, O Lord,
Create soul-thirst for Thee;
And hung' ring for the Bread of Life,
O may our spirits be.

Revive Thy work, O Lord,
Exalt Thy precious name;
And, by the Holy Ghost, our love
For Thee and Thine inflame

Revive Thy work O Lord,
Give pow'r unto Thy word,
Grant that Thy blessed Gospel
May in living faith be heard.

Revive Thy work, O Lord
And give refreshing show'rs
The glory shall be all thine own,
The blessing Lord be ours.
Amen

Jí 'sẹ Rẹ nde, Jésù
Fi agbara Rẹ han,
Fọ 'hùn t'ó lè j'òkú dìde,
Mú k'ènyìàn Rẹ gbọ.

Jí'sẹ Rẹ nde Jésù
'Gbà t'a ń sìn Ọ, níhin-ín,
Sọkale wá, Olóore wa,
Sì bùkún wa níhin-ín.

Jí 'sẹ Rẹ nde, Jésù,
Mú k'òngbẹ Rẹ gbẹ wá,
Sì mú k'ebi pa ọkan wa;
Fún oúnjẹ iyè náà.

Jí 'sẹ Rẹ nde, Jésù,
Gbé orúkọ Rẹ ga,
Mú k'ìfẹ Rẹ kún ọkàn wa,
Nípa Ẹmí Mímọ.

Jí 'sẹ Rẹ nde, Jésù
F'agbára f'óókọ Rẹ,
Ká gbọ 'yìnrere 'bùkún Rẹ,
Ní igbagbo ààyè.

Jí 'sẹ Rẹ nde, Jésù,
Rọ 'jo ìtura Rẹ
Ògo yóó jẹ Tirẹ nìkan,
Kí'bùkún jẹ tiwa. Ààmín.

englishTitle: TIS SO SWEET TO TRUST IN JESUS
yorubaTitle: B'O TI DUN LATI GBA JESU

sections.text:
'Tis so sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just to take Him at His Word,
Just to rest upon His promise;
Just to know, “Thus saith the Lord.”
Jesus, Jesus, How I love You!
How I've proved Him o'er and o'er
Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus!
O for grace to trust Him more!

O how sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just to trust His cleansing blood;
Just in simple faith to plunge me
'Neath the healing,
Cleansing flood!

Yes, 'tis sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just from sin and self to cease;
Just from Jesus simply taking
Life and rest, and joy and peace.

I'm so glad I learn'd to trust Thee,
Precious Jesus, Saviour, Friend,
And I know that Thou art with me.
Will be with me to the end.
Amen.

B' ó ti dùn láti gba Jésù,
Gbo gẹgẹ bí ọrọ Rẹ;
K'á sinmi lórí 'lérí Rẹ;
Sá gbàgbọ l'Olúwa wí,
Jésù, Jésù, èmi gbàgbọ,
Mo gbẹkẹlé ń'gbà gbogbo,
Jésù, Jésù, alábùkún
Kí n lè gbẹkẹlé Ọ sí i.

B' ó ti dùn láti gba Jésù,
K'a gb'ẹyẹ 'wẹnúmọ Rẹ,
Ìgbàgbọ ni kí á fí bọ
Sí 'n'ẹyẹ 'wẹnúmọ náà.

B' ó ti dùn láti gba Jésù,
Kí n k'ara ẹṣẹ sílẹ,
Kí n gb'ayo, ìyè, ìsinmi
Láti ọdọ Jésù mi.

Mo yọ mo gbẹkẹ mi lé Ọ,
Jésù mi, Alábùkún;
Emi mọ p'Ó wà pẹlú mi,
Wọ Ó sì pẹlú mi d'ópin.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: MORE HOLINESS GIVE ME
yorubaTitle: FUN MI NI 'WA MIMO, IGBONA OKAN

sections.text:
More holiness give me,
More strivings within,
More patience in suffering,
More sorrow for sin;
More faith in my Saviour,
More sense of His care;
In joy in His service,
More purpose in prayer.

More gratitude give me,
More trust in the Lord,
More zeal for His glory,
More hope in His word;
More tears for His sorrows,
More pain at His grief;
More meekness in trial,
More praise for relief.

More purity give me,
More strength to o'ercome;
More freedom from earth-stains
More longings for home;
More fit for Thy kingdom
O Lord, would I be,
More fruitful, more holy,
More Saviour, like Thee.
Amen.

Fun mi ni 'wa mimo;
igbona okan,
Suru ninu iya; aro fun ẹṣẹ;
Igbagbo ń'nú Jésù!
Kí n mọ 'tọju Rẹ,
Ayo ń'nú isin Rẹ,
Ẹmi adura.

Fun mi n'iwa funfun,
Fun mi n'isegun,
Wẹ àbàwọn mi nù,
Fa 'fẹ mi s'ọrun,
Mú mi ye 'jọba Rẹ,
Kí n wúlò fún Ọ,
Kí n j' alábùkúnfún;
Kí n dàbí Jésù.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: FAITH OF OUR FATHERS! LIVING STILL

sections.text:
Faith of our fathers! Living still,
In spite of dungeon,
fire and sword
O how our hearts beat high
with joy,
Whene'er we hear that
glorious word!
Faith of our fathers,
holy faith
We will be true to
Thee till death

Faith of our fathers!
We will strive,
To win all nations unto Thee,
And through the truth that
comes from God,
Mankind shall then
be truly free.

Faith of our fathers!
We will love,
Both friend and foe
in all our strive,
And preach Thee, too,
as love knows how,
By kindly words and
Virtuous life.

Ìgbàgbọ àwọn baba wa,
Kò bẹrù idà àt'iná,
Àwọn ọmọ wọn sì 'láyọ,
'Gbà t'a gbọ 'ròyìn
‘gbàgbọ wọn;
Ìgbàgbọ mímọ baba wa,
A o j'olóòótọ sí ọ d'opin.

Ìgbàgbọ àwọn baba wa,
A ó jèrè gbogb 'ayé fún ọ,
Pẹlú òtítọ Ọlọrun,
Àwọn èèyàn yóó d'òminira.

Ìgbàgbọ àwọn baba wa,
A ó fẹràn ọrẹ àt'ọta,
A ó sì fi'fẹ ílá ròyìn Rẹ,
Nínú ọrọ àt'iṣẹ wa. Ààmín.

englishTitle: BLESSED ASSURANCE

sections.text:
Blessed assurance
Jesus is mine!
Oh, what foretaste of
glory divine
Heir of salvation,
purchased of God,
Born of His Spirit,
Washed in His blood.

This is my story,
This is my song.
Praising my Saviour
all the day long.

Perfect submission,
perfect delight,
Visions of rapture burst
on my sight
Angels descending,
bring from above ;
Echoes of mercy,
whispers of love,

Perfect submission, all is at rest
I in my Saviour am happy
and blest.
Watching and waiting,
looking above.
Filled with His goodness,
lost in His love. Amen.

Ó dá mi lójú! Mo ní Jésù,
Ìtowò adùn ọrun l'èyíi;
Mo di ajogún ìgbàlà nlá,
Ẹjẹ Rẹ wę mí, a tún
mi bí.

N ó sọ ìtàn náà, n ó
kọrin náà,
N ó yin Olùgbàlà mi títí,
N ó sọ ìtàn náà,
n ó kọrin náà,
N ó yin Olùgbàlà mi títí.

N ó tęrí ba fún Un tayọtayọ;
Mo lè rí ìran ògo bíbọ Rẹ,
Ańgẹlì ń mú ìyìn dídùn wá,
Ti ifẹ àt'áánú Rẹ sí mi.

N ó tęrí ba fún Un, n ó
sinmi lé E,
Mo di ti Jésù, mo d'ẹni
ìbùkún,
N ó máa sọra, n ó sì gbàdúrà,
Kí oore Rẹ má fi mi sílẹ.
Ààmin.

englishTitle: THERE IS NO FRIEND LIKE JESUS
yorubaTitle: ỌRẸ BÍ JÉSÙ KÒ SÍ L'ÁYÉ YÍÍ

sections.text:
There is no friend like
Jesus in this world,
Jesus is the only sincere friend,
The friend of this world will
one day leave us,
But the Lord will never
forget us.

He'll never forget us,
He'll never forget us,
But the Lord will never
forget us.

Not caring for foes,
the time is passing,
Drawing near to our home
day by day,
The great judge will come,
the world will tremble,
There will be no excuse
on that day.

Now, wait on the Lord,
never doubt again,
Whatever now may betide thee,
Where there is no more
hope then,
His help will come,
Jesus our Lord's a
wonderful King. Amen.

Ọrẹ bí Jésù kò sí l'áyé yíi,
Òun nikan l'ọrẹ òtítọ,
Ọrẹ ayé yíi yóó fi wa sílẹ;
Sùgbọn Jésù kò ję
gbàgbé wa.

Háà! Kò ję gbàgbé wa,
Háà! Kò ję gbàgbé wa,
Sùgbọn Jésù kò ję
gbàgbé wa.

Àkókò ń kojá lọ lái f'ọtá pè,
A f'ọjọ kan sún
mọ 'lé wa sí i,
Onídàájọ ń bọ, gọngọ
ńlá yóó sọ.
Àwáwí kan kò sí l'ọjọ náà.

Dúró d'Olúwa, má
s'iyèmèji,
Ohunkóhun t'ó wù kó lè dé;
'Gbà t'ó rò p'ó pin,
'Rànwọ Rẹ yóó dé'
Ẹni'yanu l'Ọba Olúwa.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: BREATHE ON ME, BREATH OF GOD

sections.text:
Breathe on me , Breath of God;
Fill me with life anew,
That I may love what
Thou dost love,
And do what Thou wouldst do.

Mí sí mi Ọlọrun,
S'ọkàn mi di mímọ;
Kí'fẹ mi òun Tirẹ j'ọkan,
L'érò àti ní'se.

Mí sí mi Ọlọrun,
Títí n ó di Tirẹ;
Tí ara erùpẹ mi yìí,
Yóó tàn'mọlẹ ọrun.

englishTitle: COME HOLY GHOST, OUR HEARTS INSPIRE

sections.text:
Come, Holy Ghost,
our hearts inspire,
Let us Thine influence prove,
Source of the old prophetic
fire;
Fountain of life and love.

Àdàbà ọrun nà'yẹ Rẹ,
Bo òòkùn ẹdá wa;
Jẹ kí'mọlẹ Rẹ tàn s'órí
Ẹmí àis'òótọ wa. Ààmín.

englishTitle: COME HOLY SPIRIT, HEAVENLY DOVE

sections.text:
And shall we then forever live,
At this poor dying rate?
Our love so faint,
so cold to Thee,
And Thine to us so great?

Come Holy Spirit,
heavenly Dove,
With all Thy quickening
pow'rs;
Come, shed abroad the
Saviour's love;
And that shall kindle ours.
Amen.

Olúwa, a ó ha wà títí
Ní kíkú òsi yì?
Ìfẹ wa tutu bẹẹ sí Ọ;
Tírẹ tobi sí wa.

Ẹmí Mímọ, 'Dàbà orun,
Wá ní agbára Rẹ,
Wá d'áná ifẹ, Olùgbàlà;
Tá'wa ó sì gbiná.
Àmín.

englishTitle: GOD IS HERE, AND THAT TO BLESS US

sections.text:
God is here, and that
to bless us
With the Spirit's quick'ning
pow'r;
See the cloud already bending,
Waits to drop the grateful
shower.
Let it come, O Lord,
we pray Thee!
Let the show'r
of blessing fall:
We are waiting,
we waiting,
Oh, revive the hearts of all.

God is here! We feel
His presence,
In this consecrated place;
But we need the soul
refreshing,
Of His free unbounded grace.

God is here! Oh,
then, believing,
Bring to Him our one desire:
That His love may
now be kindled,
Till its flame each
heart inspire.

Saviour, grant the prayer
we offer,
While in simple faith we bow,
From the windows of Thy mercy
Pour us out a blessing now.
Amen

Ọlọrun wa ńbẹ láàrin wa,
Yóó sì bùkún gbogbo wa;
Wo ojú ọrun b'ó ti sú.
Yóó rọjò 'bùkún fún wa.
K'ó dé, Olúwa, a ń bẹ Ọ,
Jẹ k'ójò ìbùkún dé,
Àwa ń dúró, àwa ń dúró;
M'ọkàn gbogbo wa sọjí.

Ọlọrun wa ńbẹ láàrin wa,
Nínú ilé mímọ yìí,
Sùgbọn a ń fẹ 'tura ọkàn;
Àt'ọpọ oor'ọfẹ Rẹ.

Ọlọrun wa ńbẹ láàrin wa,
K'á f'ọkàn 'gbàgbọ bèèrè;
Ohun t'a ń fẹ lọwọ Rẹ, kí
'Fẹ Rẹ m'ọkàn wa gbóná.

englishTitle: NOW I FEEL THE SACRED FIRE

sections.text:
Now I feel the sacred fire,
Kindling, flaming, glowing,
Higher still, and still rising higher,
All my soul o'erflowing;
Life immortal I receive;
Oh, the wondrous story!
I was dead but now live
Glory! glory! Glory!

Now I am from bondage freed
Ev'ry bond is riven,
Jesus makes me free indeed,
Just as free as heaven
'Tis a glorious liberty;
Oh, the wondrous story!
I was bound, but now I'm free,
Glory! glory! Glory!

Let the testimony roll,
Roll thro' every nation
Witnessing from soul to soul
This immense salvation.
Now I know it's full and free
Oh, the wondrous story!
For I feel it saving me
Glory! glory! Glory!

Glory be to God on high
Glory be to Jesus!
He hath brought salvation nigh
From all sin He frees us;
Let the golden harp of God,
Ring the wondrous story;
Let pilgrims shout aloud!
Glory! glory! Glory!

Let the trump of jubilee
The glad tidings thunder
Jesus sets the captives free
Burst their bond asunder
Fetters break and dungeons fall;
Oh, the wondrous story!
This salvation's free to all,
Glory! glory! glory! Amen.

Jesu da'na Ẹmi Rẹ
Sí 'nu ọkàn mi,
'Joojúmọ ni 'ná náà ń jó
Ó ń m'ọkàn mi gbóná;
Jésù fi ìyè fún mi
Ìyè àìnípẹkun
Ọ sọ ókú d'alààyè;
Ògo! ògo! Ògo!

Sẹkẹsẹkẹ náà ti já
Tí Èṣù fi dè mí
Jésù ló já ìdè náà
Ó sọ mì d'òminira
Oore-ọfẹ ìyanu
N ó máa sọ ìtàn náà,
Pé Ó dá ọndè sílẹ;
Ògo! ògo! Ògo!

Gbogb'ẹniyàn yẹ kó mọ
Ohun t'ó se fún mi,
N ó jẹrii náà káàkiri
F'ọmọdé àt'àgbà
Ayo ń bẹ nínú Jésù,
F'áwọn t'ó d'átúnbí;
Àwọn t'ó wò mọ pé,
Rere ni Olúwa.

Ògo ni f'Ọlọrun mi,
Ògo ni fún Jésù,
Ó mú'gbàlà wá fún mi;
Ẹsẹ kò ní'pá mọ,
Dùùrù wúrà Ọlọrun,
N sọ ìtàn'yanu náà,
Àwọn èrò ń kọrin pé,
Ògo! ògo! Ògo!

Kọrin'dàsílẹ kíkan,
Kọrin'yin sí Jésù,
Igi alàìléso di
Ẹka ń'nú àjàrà;
Ó ń rọ'jò ìbùkún sí I,
Ó ń bu ìlẹdú sí I,
Ọ mú'gbàlà kíkún wá;
Ògo! ògo! ògo! Àmín.

englishTitle: HEAR FROM THY THRONE

sections.text:
Hear from Thy throne, the Prince of Peace,
Thy various gifts, send unto us,
Thy children who are seeking Thee,
Fulfill their desires O Lord.

Come, Holy Spirit from above,
With Thy love fill the weary hearts,
The stony heart, turn them to Thee,
And let Thy might be known o Lord.

Speak, and the eyes of hardhearted
Shall weep and shout and cry aloud
And with their zealous spirits shall
Seek the goodness once cast away.

O let the holy multitude
Waiting at the gate of Thy house
Let every one of them prepare
To sacrifice themselves to Thee.
Amen.

Gbo l'or'ite Re Alade,
F'oniruuru 'bukun ranse,
B'awon omo Re ti n wa O,
Gb'adura t'oro Re ko ni.

Wa, Emi Mimo l'atoke,
F'ife kun okan t'o tutu;
Ha-a! s'okan okuta d'eran
K'O je k'ipa Re di mimo.

S'oro, oju t'o da yoo sun
Ekun 'robinuje jade;
Won yoo si f'igbona okan
Wa oore ti won ko naani.

Ha-a! je k'opo awon mimo
Duro n'ilekun ile Re;
K'olukuluku se 'tara
Lati f'ara rubo fun O.
Aamin.

englishTitle: FROM EVERY STORMY WIND THAT BLOWS
yorubaTitle: NINU GBOGBO IJI TI N JA

sections.text:
From every stormy wind that blows,
From every swelling tide of woes,
There is calm, a sure retreat;
'Tis found beneath
The mercy seat.

There is a spot where spirits blend,
And friend holds fellowship with friend;
Though sunder'd far, by faith they meet,
Around one common
Mercy-seat.

Ah, whither could we flee for aid,
When tempted, desolate, dismay'd?
Or how the hosts of hell defeat,
Had suffering saints no
mercy-seat?

There, there on eagle wings we soar,
And time and sense seen all no more,
And heaven comes down our souls to greet,
And glory crowns the
Mercy-seat. Amen

Nínú gbogbo ìjì tí ń jà,
Nínú gbogbo ìgbì 'pọnjú,
Ààbò kan ńbẹ, tí ó dájú;
O wà lábẹ ìtẹ-áánú.

Ibi kan wà tí Jésù ń da
Oróró àyọ s' órí wa;
O dùn ju ibi gbogbo lọ
Ìtẹ-áánú t'áa f'ẹjẹ wọn

Ibi kan wà fún ìdàpọ,
Ní'bi ọrẹ ń pàdé ọrẹ;
Láìrí 'ra, nípa ìgbàgbó
Wọn yí'tẹ-áánú kan náà ká.

A! Níbo ni à bá sá sí,
Nígbà 'dánwò àt' ìpọnjú?
À bá se lè borí Èsù,
B'ó se pé kò sí 'tẹ-áánú?

A! bí idì l'a fò síbẹ,
B'ẹni pé ayé kò sí mọ,
Orun wa pade okan wà
Ògo sì bo ìtẹ-áánú. Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS MY LORD TO THEE I CRY
yorubaTitle: OLÚWA MI MO Ń KE PÈ Ọ

sections.text:
Jesus my Lord, to Thee I cry
Unless Thou help me,
I must die;
Oh, bring Thy free
salvation nigh,
And take me as I am!
And take me as I am!
And take me as I am!
My only plea,
Christ died for me!
Oh take me as I am!

Helpless I am, and full of guilt;
But yet for me Thy blood
was spilt,
And Thou canst make me
what Thou wilt
And take me as I am!

No preparation can I make;
My best resolves I only break
Yet save me for Thine
own name's sake
And take me as I am!

Behold me, Saviour,
at Thy feet,
Deal with me as Thou
seest meet;
Thy work begin,
Thy work complete
But take me as I am!

To Thee my God I humbly cry;
Rescue and heal
my soul disease,
Apply the blood,
and set me free,
And take me as I am! Amen.

Olúwa mi mo ń ké pè Ọ:
N ó kúù b'Ó kò ràn mí lọwọ:
Jọọ, fi ìgbàlà Rẹ fún mi,
Gbà mí bí mo ti rí.
Gbà mí bí mo ti rí!
Gbà mí bí mo ti rí!
Krìstì kú fún mi l'ẹbẹ mi
Gbà mí bí mo ti rí.

Èmi kún fún ẹṣẹ púpọ
O ta'jẹ Rẹ sílẹ fún mi
O lè se mí bí O bá ti fẹ,
Gbà mí bí mo ti rí.

Kò sí'lẹ tí mo lè pamọ
N kò lè dúró t'ìpinnu mi
Síbẹ, 'torí Tire, gbà mí,
Gbà mí bí mo ti rí.

Wò mí! Mo wólẹ l'ẹṣẹ Rẹ
Se mí bí ó bá ti tọ sí,
Bẹrẹ'sẹ Rẹ, sì parí rẹ,
Gbà mí bí mo ti rí.

Jésù mó f'irẹlẹ bẹ Ọ
Gbà mí là, wo ẹmí mi sàn
Tú mi sílẹ pẹ'ẹjẹ Rẹ
Gbà mí bí mo ti rí. Ààmín.

englishTitle: O LORD MY GOD ON THEE I'LL CALL

sections.text:
O Lord my God on Thee
I'll call,
I am in pains, O hear my cry;
When floods of water cover me
Forbid that my heart should
backslide.

Thou Lord art friend
of the infirm,
To whom shall I make
my complaint?
If not to Thee, and only Thee,
Who calls the miserable
to Him.

Who has e'er wept to Thee
in vain?
Has Thou e'er shunned
anyone's cry?
Art Thou not the One who
promis'd
No one shall e'er seek
Thee in vain?

This could have been
my heart' sorrow;
That thou Lord does not
answer pray'r;
But Thou has been answ'ring
my pray'rs
O Lord, Thou has been
my helper.

I know I am needy and poor,
But Thou God would not
forget me,
He, for whom Jesus is pleading
Is set free from all his troubles.
Amen

Ọlọrun mi 'Wọ lèmi ń pè,
Ara ń ni mí, gbọ igbe mi;
'Gba 'sàn omi bá borí mi,
Má ję kọkàn mi fà sẹhìn.

Ìwọ ọrẹ aláìlera
Taa ni bá s'àròyé mi fún?
Bí kò se 'Wọ nìkan soso,
T'O ń pe òtòsì w'ọdọ Rẹ?

Ta l'ó sọkún tọ Ọ lásán rí?
'Wọ kọ igbe ẹṇikan rí?
Sé Ìwọ ni o ti sọ pé
Ẹṇikan k' yó wá Ọ lásán.

Èyí 'bá ję 'bìnújẹ mi
Bí O kò ń dáhùn àdúrà,
Sùgbón 'Wọ tí ń gbọ àdúrà,
Iwo l'o ń se ìrànwọ Ii.

Mo mọ pé aláìní l'èmi
Ọlọrun kò ní gbàgbé mi,
Eni tí Jésú ń bẹbẹ fún,
O bọ lọwọ gbogbo 'yọnu.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I ALWAYS GO TO JESUS

sections.text:
I always go to Jesus,
When troubled or distressed
I always find a refuge;
Upon His loving breast,
I tell Him all my grief,
And while my lips are speaking,
He gives my heart relief.

When full of dread forebodings,
And flowing o'er with tears
He calms away my sorrow,
And hushes all my fears,
He comprehends my Weakness,
The peril I am in,
And He supplies the armour,
I need to conquer sin.

I always go to Jesus,
No matter when or where,
I seek His gracious presence,
I'm sure to find Him there.
In times of joy or sorrow,
Whate'er my need may be;
I always go to Jesus,
And Jesus comes to me. Amen.

'Gbàtí 'dánwò yí mi ká
Ọdọ Kríst' ni mo ń lọ
Ní oókan àyà Rẹ ni
Ibi ìsádi mi
Mo s'ọkan mi payá fún Un
O mọ gbogb' ẹdùn mi
Bí mo ti ń sọ nkan wọn yí,
O m' ẹdùn mi kúrò.

'Gbàtí mo kún fún ẹrù
Tí mo ń sunkún pẹẹrẹ,
O tán ìbànújẹ mi
O lé ẹrù mi lọ
O r'éwu tó yí mi ká
Ati àilera mi,
O fún mi lohun ìjà,
Láti sẹgun ẹṣẹ.

N ó sá lọ s'ọdọ Jésù
Níbi t' ó wù kó ję,
N ó sáà máa wá ojú Rẹ
O dájú pé n ó rí I,
'Gb'ayo tabí 'banuje;
Ohun t'ó wù k' ó ję,
Ọdọ Jésù ni n ó lọ;
Òun y'ó sì tọ mí wá.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: AS PANTS THE HART FOR COOLING STREAMS
yorubaTitle: BI ÀGBỌNRÍN TI Ń MÍ HẸLẸ

sections.text:
As pants the hart for cooling streams,
When heated in the chase;
So longs my soul, O God,
For Thee
And Thy refreshing grace.

For Thee, my God the living God,
My thirsty soul doth pine;
Oh when shall I behold Thy face,
Thou Majesty divine.

Why restless, why cast down, my soul?
Trust God, who will employ
His aid for thee and change these sighs
To thankful hymns of joy.

God of my strength, How long shall I,
Like one forgotten mourn?
Forlorn, forsaken, and exposed
To my oppressor's scorn!

Why restless, why cast down, my soul?
Hope still, and thou shalt sing
The praise of Him who is thy God,
Thy health's eternal spring.

The Father, Son and Holy Ghost
Thou God that we worship
Worthy of glory and honour
For evermore be praised.
Amen.

Bí àgbọnrín ti ń mí hẹlẹ,
S'ípa odò omi;
Bẹẹ ni ọkàn mi ń mí sí Ọ
Ìwọ Ọlọrun mi.

Òùngbẹ Rẹ ń gbẹ ọkàn Mi,
Ọlọrun alààyè
Nígbà wo ni n ó r'ójú Rẹ
Ọlọrun Qlá ílá?

Ọkàn mi, ò se rẹwẹsì?
Gbẹkẹlé Ọlọrun;
Ẹni tí y'ó sọ ẹkún rẹ
D' orin ayọ fún ọ.

Y'ó ti pẹ tó, Ọlọrun mi
Tí n ó d'ẹni ìgbàgbé;
T'á ó máa tì mí síhíín sọhùn-ún
B'ẹni kò ní bùgbé?

Ọkàn mi, ó se rẹwẹsì?
Gbàgbọ, 'wọ ó sì kọ
Orin ìyin s'Ọlọrun rẹ,
Orísun ẹmi rẹ.

Sí Baba, Ọmọ àt'Ẹmí,
Ọlọrun tí a ń sin
Lògo áti ọlá yẹ fún
Títí ayérayé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: FROM THEE ALL SKILL AND SCIENCE FLOW

sections.text:
From Thee all skill and science flow,
All pity, care, and love,
All calm and courage, Faith and hope:
O pour them from above!

And part them, Lord,
to each and all,
As each and all shall need
To rise, like incense.
each of Thee,
In noble thought and deed.

And hasten, Lord,
that perfect day,
When pain and death
shall cease,
And Thy just rule shall fill
the earth
With health, and light,
and peace.

When ever blue the sky
shall gleam,
And ever green the sod,
And man's rude work deface
no more
The paradise of God. Amen

Baba, 'Wọ orísun ire.
Àánu, at' oore-ọfẹ,
Iranwo, 'gbàgbọ, ìrètí
Má sài fi bùkún wa.

F' ẹbùn Rẹ ọtọọtọ wọnyní
Fún wa n'íwọn tó yẹ:
Kí gbogbo wa sì lè wúlò
Nín'ogbà Rẹ láyé.

Jẹ k' ígbà náà sì yára dé,
'Gbà t' íkú yóó d'ópin
T' íjọba 'láàfìà òun 'rọrùn,
Yóó bẹrẹ láìlópin.

'Gbà náà, ogun, ọtẹ,
yóó tán;
Àìní, ìyàn, yóó pin
'Gbànáà, Èsu k'yóó r'áyè mọ
Ní párádísè Rẹ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: AS THAT PUBLICAN OH MY LORD

sections.text:
As that publican O my Lord
I place my heart in Thee
Lord speak to my heart with
Thy grace
“Have mercy on me, Lord.”

My unrest heart I always beat,
From where tears
and pains flow
Hear me in this most
painful state,
“Have mercy on me, Lord.”

In shame I confess all my sins,
Strengthen my sincere hope:
I plead for sake of Jesus' blood
“Have mercy on me, Lord.”

Greatest of all sinners I am
Count not my sins O Lord
But for the sake of Jesus' death
“Have mercy on me, Lord”.

I stand by the most painful cross,
I fear not thy shadow
Because God of merciful eyes,
Forgiven me my sins.
Amen.

Olúwa, b'agbowó-òde nì,
Mo gb'ọkan mi lé Ọ;
Olúwa, f'oore-ọfẹ wí,
K'O se àánú fún mi.

Mo lu àìdúró àyà mi
Ẹkún àt'ìrora
K'O gb'ọkàn mi ń'nú ìrora,
K'O se àánú mi.

N'ítijú mo jew'ẹsẹ mi,
Jọọ fún mi n'ìrètí;
Mo bẹ 'torí ẹjẹ Jésù,
K'O se àánú fún mi.

Olori ẹlẹsẹ ni mí,
Ẹsẹ mi pàpojù;
Nitori iku Jésù wá,
K'O se àánú fún mi.

Mo dúró ti àgbélébùú,
N kò sá f' òjiji Rẹ;
Ti Ọlọrun t'Ó pọ l'áàánú
O ti sàánú fún mi. Ààmín.

englishTitle: THERE IS VICT'RY WITHIN MY SOUL

sections.text:
There is vict'ry within my soul
For the Spirit with me abides,
Let the waves of temptation roll,
Jesus keeps me what-e'er betides.

Victory, victory,
Vict'ry in my soul I have
Glorious victory since
Jesus took control
Victory, victory,
Sweeping like a flood,
I have glorious victory
Thro' Jesus' blood

Tho' the conflict be fierce and long,
Tho' the tempter my heart assail
In my weakness yet I am strong
For with Jesus I'll e'er prevail.

I have victory over sin,
I have victory o'er grave;
Even death now has lost its sting,
Hallelujah I know I'm saved.
Amen.

Ìṣẹgun wà lí ọkàn mi
Nítorí Ẹmí ń gbé 'nú mi
Jẹ kí ìgbi 'dánwò dé
Jésù múra láti gbà mí

Ìṣẹgun; ìṣẹgun!
'Ṣẹgun l'ọkan mi
Mo ní ìṣẹgun ílá 'torí
Jésù gb'ọkàn mi
Ìṣẹgun, Ìṣẹgun bí
Odò sísàn
Mo ní 'ṣẹgun ílá nínú
Ẹjẹ Jésù.

Bí 'jà tilẹ le tó sì pẹ
B' Esù tilẹ b' ọkàn mi jà
Síbẹ mo jẹ alágbára
L'ágbára Jésù, ń ó ṣẹgun.

Mo ní 'ṣẹgun lórí ẹṣẹ,
Mo ní 'ṣẹgun lórí Esù,
Àní ikú kò nípá mọ,
Aleluya! Emí ti là. Ààmín.

englishTitle: THOUGH THE WORLD ALLURE
yorubaTitle: B'ÁYÉ BÁ Ń FÀ MÍ PẸLÚ ÒGO RẸ

sections.text:
Though the world allure with its gilded charm,
I'm a child of God whom it cannot harm,
He will uphold me by his mighty arm
Ev'ry moment of my day.
I've a friend who will
Ev'ry need supply
I've a home far beyond
The starry sky,
And you know that is just
The reason why
I am singing Hallelujah.

I can ne'er forget how upon the tree
Laid the son of God, There to die for me,
Yet to save my soul, thus it had to be
There could be no other way.

I would e'er be true to my Lord and King,
Ev'ry waking hour praises to Him sing
Knowing that at last He my soul shall bring
Evermore with him to stay.
Amen.

B'áyé bá ń fà mí pẹlú ògo rẹ,
Kó s'éwu ọmọ Ọlọrun ni mí,
Ọwọ Agbára Rẹ y'ó Dì mí mú,
L'ọjọ ayé mi gbogbo,
Mo l'ọrẹ t'ó ń pèsè
F'àní gbogbo
Mo ní 'lé kan lókè
Orun gíga
Wòó nitorí ìdí èyí nàá ni
Ẹmi se ń kọ “Alelúyà!”

Èmi kò jẹ gbàgbé pé l'órí 'gi,
Ni ọmọ Ọlọrun gbé kú fún mi,
Kò lè s'àikú láti gb'ọkàn mi là,
Kò tún sí ọnà miíràn.

N ó j'ólóòótọ s'Olúwa Qba mi
N ó máa kọrin yìn sí I nígbà gbogbo
Mo mọ pé níkẹyìn Òun y'ó gbà mí
Láti máa bá A gbé títí.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: TRUST ON, TRUST ON, BELIEVER

sections.text:
Trust on, trust on, be-liever
Though long the con-flict be,
Thou yet shall prove Vic-to-rious
Thy God shall fight for thee.
Trust on, trust on
Tho' dark the night
And drear
Trust on, trust on,
The morn-ing dawn is near.

Trust on! The dan-ger pres-ses,
Temp-ta-tion strong is near,
O-ver life's dange-rous ra-pids,
He shall thy pas-sage steer.

The Lord is strong to save us
He is a faith-ful friend:
Trust on, trust on, be-liver!
Oh trust Him to the end. Amen

Gbẹkẹl'E Onígbàgbọ!
Bí 'jà náà tilẹ pẹ
Ìwọ ni y'ó sa sẹgun
Baba y'ó jà fún ọ.
Sá gbẹ-kẹ-le,
B' okunkun tilẹ su,
Sa gbẹ-kẹ-le,
Ilẹ ferẹ mọ ná.

Gbẹkẹl'E láàrín ewu,
'Dánwò ńla wà ńtòsí,
Láàrín wàhálà ayé,
Y'ó máa s'amọ̀nà rẹ.

Jésù tó láti gbà wá,
Ọrẹ tòótọ l'Ó jẹ,
Gbẹkẹle ónígbàgbọ,
Sá gbẹkẹle d'ópin. Ààmín.

englishTitle: BE GONE, UNBELIEF!

sections.text:
Be gone, unbelief!
My Saviour is near,
And for my relief
Will surely appear;
With Christ in the vessel,
I smile at the storm.

Though dark be my way,
Since He is my guide,
'Tis mine to obey
'Tis His to provide;
Though cisterns be broken,
And creatures all fail,
The word He hath spoken,
Shall surely prevail.

His love, in time past,
Forbids me to think,
He'll leave me at last
In trouble to sink;
Each sweet Ebenezer
I have in review,
Confirms His good pleasure
To help me quite through.

Why should I complain
Of want or distress?
Temptation or pain,
He told me no less;
The heirs of salvation,
I know from His word
Through much tribulation
Must follow their Lord.

How bitter that cup
No heart can conceive,
Which He drank quite up,
That sinners might live!
His way was much rougher
And darker than mine;
Did Christ, my Lord, suffer
And shall I repine?

Since all that I meet
Shall work for my good
The bitter is sweet,
The medicine, food;
Though painful at present,
'Twill cease before long,
And then, oh how peasant
The conqueror's song!
Amen

Àìgbàgbọ bìlà,
T'èmi l'Olúwa,
Òun Ó sì dide fún ìgbàlà mi,
Kí ń sá máa gbàdúrà, Òun
ó se 'rànwọ;
'Gbà Krist wà lọdọ mi,
ìfòyà kò sí.

B'ọna mi bá sú, òun l'ó
sá ń tọ mi,
Kí ń sá gbọràn sá, Òun
ó sì pèsè,
Bí ìrànwọ ẹdá gbogbo sàkì,
Ọrọ t'ẹnu Rẹ sọ y'ó borí
dandan.

Ìfẹ t'ó fi hàn kò jẹ kí n rò pé,
Y'ó fi mí sílẹ nínú wàhálà,
Ìrànwọ tí mo sì ń rí
lójoo júmọ,
Ó ń kì mí láyà pé èmi
ó là á já.

Èmi ó se kùn torí ìpọnjú,
Tàbí ìrora? Ó ti sọ tẹlẹ
Mo m'ọrọ Rẹ p'áwon
ajogún 'gbàlà
Wọn kò lè s'àìkọjá láàrin
wàhálà.

Ẹdá kò lè sọ kíkorò aago
T' Ólùgbàlà mu, k'ẹlẹsẹ
lè yè
Ayé Rẹ tilẹ burú ju t'emi lọ,
Jésù ha lè jìyà, k'émi sì
máa sá!

Njẹ b'óhun gbogbo ti ń
sisẹ ire,
Fún àwon t'ó dúró de Olúwa
B'óníi tilẹ korò, sá kò ní
pẹ mọ
'Gbà náà orin'sẹgun yóó
ti dùn tó.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: SAFE IN THE ARMS OF JESUS

sections.text:
Safe in the arms of Jesus
Safe on His gen-tle breast,
There by His love
O'er-shadowed,
Sweet-ly my soul shall rest.
Hark! 'tis the voice of an-gels,
Borne in a song to me,
O-ver the fields of glory
O-ver the Jasper Sea.

Safe in the arms of Je-sus.
Safe on His gentle breast,
There by His love
O'er-shadowed,
Sweet-ly my soul shall rest.

Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe from cor-roding care,
Safe from the world's
temptations,
Sin can-not harm me there,
Free from the blight of sor-row
Free from my doubts and fears;
On-ly a few more tri-als
On-ly a few more tears.

Jesus, my heart's dear ref-uge,
Je-sus has died for me
Firm on the rock of A-ges
E-ver my trust shall be
Here let me wait with pa-tience,
Wait till the night is o'er
Wait till I see the morn-ing
Break on the gold-en shore.
Amen.

Láìfòyà l'ápá Jésù,
Láìfòyà láyà Rẹ
L'ábe òjìji ifẹ Rẹ,
L'ọkàn mi ó simi,
Gbọ! ohùn Ángẹlì ni,
Orin wọn d'étí mi,
Láti pápá Ògo wá,
Láti òkun Jaspà,

Láìfòyà l'ápá Jésù,
Láìfòyà láyà Rẹ
L'ábe òjìji ifẹ Rẹ l'ọkàn
Mi ó simi.

Láìfòyà lapa Jesu
Mo bọ l'ọw' àníyàn
Mo bọ l'ọwọ ìdánwò
Ẹsẹ kò n'ípá mọ
Mo bọ l'ọwọ ẹrú,
O ku ìdánwò díẹ
O k'omijé díẹ
Láìfòyà l'ápá Jésù,
Láìfòyà láyà Rẹ
L'ábẹ òjìji ifẹ Rẹ l'ọkàn
Mi ó simi.

Jésù ààbò ọkàn mi
Jésù ti kú fún mi;
Àpáta ayérayé
L'èmi ó gbekele,
Níhìín l'èmi ó dúró
Tít' ó y'ó kọjá;
Títí n ó fi r'ímọlẹ
Ní ébúté ògo
Láìfòyà l'ápá Jésù,
Láìfòyà láyà Rẹ
L'ábẹ òjìji ifẹ Rẹ
L'ọkàn mi ó simi. Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHEN SHADOWS DARKEN MY EARTHLY WAY
yorubaTitle: NIGBA TI ONA MI BA SOOKUN

sections.text:
When shadows darken my
earthly way,
And long and dreary seems
the day,
This promise sweet comes my
soul to greet,
He never forgets His own.
He never forgets His own,
He never forgets His own,
Though friends deny
There is one so nigh
Who never forgets His own.

When cherished plans all here
seem to fail,
And doubt and fear my soul
assail,
'Tis then I rest on His loving
breast
Who never forgets His own.

O no, He never forgets
His own,
And dearer He has daily
grown,
Since that glad day when He
came to stay,
He never forgets His own.
Amen.

Nigba ti ona mi ba sookun,
Ti ojo ibi si de;
Emi n ranti ileri yii pe;
Oun ko je gbagbe Tire.
Oun ko je gbagbe Tire
Oun ko je gbagbe Tire
Bi ore sa, Oun wa nitosi,
Oun ko je gbagbe Tire.

Nigba t'ireti gbogbo ba pin,
T'iyemeji at'eru de;
N o wa sinmi l'aya Eni ti,
Ko le je gbagbe Tire.

Oun ko je gbagbe Tire
laelae,
O se owon fun mi pupo;
Lati 'gba ti O ti sokale,
Ti O n gbe'nu okan mi.
Aamin.

englishTitle: MY HOPE IS BUILT ON NOTHING LESS

sections.text:
My hope is built
on nothing less
Than Jesus' blood and
righteousness;
No merit of my own I claim,
But wholly lean on Jesus'
name.
On Christ, the solid rock,
I stand;
All other ground is sinking
sand.

When long appears my
toilsome race,
I rest on His unchanging grace;
In every high and stormy gale,
My anchor holds within
the veil.

His oath, His covenant,
His blood,
Support me in the
whelmingflood;
When every earthly prop
gives way,
He then is all my hope and stay.

When the last trumpet's voice
shall sound,
Oh may I then in Him be found,
Clothed in His righteousness
alone.
Faultless to stand before
The throne.
Amen.

Ìgbàgbọ mi dúró l'ori
Ẹjẹ at'òdodo Jésù,
N kò jẹ gbẹkẹle ohun kan,
Lẹyin orukọ íla Jésù.
Mo dúró lé Kristi Àpátá,
Ilẹ míràn iyanrìn ni.

B'iré-ije mi tilẹ gun,
Oor'ọfẹ Rẹ ko yí padà;
B'ó ti wù kí 'jì náà le tó,
Ìdákọró mi kò ní yẹ.

Májemú, àti ẹjẹ Rẹ,
L'emi'ó rọ mọ, b'i'kun 'mi dé;
'Gba ti kò s'àtilẹyin mọ,
Oun jẹ ìrètí íla fún mi.

'Gba t'ipè 'kẹyin bá sì dún,
Áà! n bá lè wà nínú Jésù,
Kí n wọ òdodo Rẹ nikan;
Kí n dúró níwájú ìtẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS, I MY CROSS HAVE TAKEN

sections.text:
Jesus, I my cross have taken
All to leave and follow Thee:
Destitute, despised, forsaken,
Thou from hence my all
shall be:
Perish every fond ambition,
All I've sought, or hoped,
or known;
Yet how rich is my condition
God and heaven are still
my own.

Man may trouble and
distress me;
'Twill but drive me to
Thy breast;
Life with trials hard may
press me;
Heaven will bring me
sweeter rest:
Oh, 'tis not in grief to harm me,
While Thy love is left to me:
Oh, 'twere not in joy to
charm me,
Were that joy unmix'd
With Thee.

Jésù, mo gb'ágbèélébùú mi,
Kí n lè máa tọ Ọ lẹyìn,
Òtòsì àt' ẹni ẹgàn,
'Wọ l'ohun gbogbo fún mi.
Bí ìní mi gbogbo sègbé,
Tí èrò mi gbogbo pin,
Síbẹ ọlọrọ ni mo jẹ;
T'èmi ni Kríst' àt'ọrun.

Ẹdá lè máa wàhálà mi,
Y'ó mú mi súnmọ Ọ ni,
Ìdánwò ayé lè bá mi;
Ọrun ó mú 'sinmi wá.
Ìbànújẹ kò lè se nnkan,
Bí 'fẹ Rẹ bà wà fún mi;
Àyọ kò sì lè dùn mọ mi,
B'Íwọ kò sí nínú rẹ.

Ọkàn mi gba ìgbàlà rẹ,
Bo'rí ẹsẹ àt' ẹrù;
F' ayọ wà ní ìpòkípò,
Máa sisẹ lọ má węyìn,
Ro t'Ẹmi t'ó wà nínú rẹ
Àti 'fẹ Bàbá sí ọ;
W'Olùgbàlà t'ó kú fún ọ,
Ọmọ ọrun, má se kùn.

Njẹ koja lát' oore s' ògo,
Ń'n' àdúrà òun ìgbàgbọ;
Ọjọ àilópin wà fún Ọ,
Bàbá y'ó mú ọ dé'bẹ;
Isẹ rẹ láyé fẹrẹ pin,
Ọjọ àjò rẹ ń bùse,
Ìrẹtí y'ó padà s'áyọ.
Adura s'orin ìyìn. Ààmín.

englishTitle: OH FOR A FAITH THAT WILL NOT SHRINK

sections.text:
O for a faith that will not shrink
Beneath the chast'ning rod
That will lean upon its own God
Declares, “We will conquer.”

This is incomprehensible
Yet will I fear no foe
For God has given me promise
His word shall never fail.

Lord, give us such a faith
As this
That faith that never fails
The faith like ever fix'd mark
Bends not till its victory.
Amen.

Ìgbàgbọ tó rí 'lérí nàá,
Tí kò ka 'sòro sí,
T'ó ń wo Ọlọrun nikanso
T'ó ń wí pé, “A ó sẹgun.”

Àà! Èyí kojá òye mi,
Sùgbọn n kì y'ó bẹrù,
To r' Olúwa ti se'lérí,
Ọrọ Rẹ kìí tàsé.

Ìgbàgbọ ńlá tí kìí tàsé;
Bàbá jọo fi fún mi,
Ìgbàgbọ t'ó ń dúró gangan,
Títí y'ó fi sẹgun. Ààmín.

englishTitle: OH FOR A FAITH THAT WILL NOT SHRINK

sections.text:
Oh for a faith that will not shrink,
Though pressed by many foes,
That will not tremble
On the brink,
Of poverty or woe.

That will not murmur
or complain,
Beneath the chast'ning rod,
But in the hour of grief
or pain,
Can lean upon its God.

A faith that shines more
bright and clear,
When tempests rage without,
That when in danger knows
no fear,
In darkness feels no doubt.

A faith that keeps the
narrow way,
Till life's last spark is fled,
And with a pure and
heavenly ray,
Lights up a dying bed.

Lord give me such a faith
as this,
And then whate'er may come,
I taste e'en now the hallowed
bliss
Of an eternal home. Amen.

A bá lè ní 'gbàgbọ ààyè,
B' ó ti wù k'ọta pọ;
Ìgbàgbọ tí kò jẹ mira,
Fún áiní àt'òsi.

Ìgbàgbọ́ tí kò jẹ ráhùn
L'ábẹ́ ìbáwí Rẹ,
Sùgbọ́n tí o sinmi l'Ọlọrun
Nígbà ìbànújẹ́.

Ìgbàgbọ́ tí ń tàn síwájú,
'Gbà t' ìjì 'pọnjú dé;
Tí kò sì jẹ siyèmėjì,
N'nú wàhálà gbogbo.

Ìgbàgbọ́ tí ń gb'ọna tóóró
Títí ẹmí ó pin,
Tí y'ó sì f'ìmọlẹ́ ọrun,
Tan àkete ikú.

Jésù f' ìgbàgbọ́ yìí fún mi,
Nję bó ti wù kó rí
Lát' ayé yìí lọ n ó l'áyọ
Ìlú ọrun rere. Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE HOLY MUST UNDAUNTED BE
yorubaTitle: KÒ TỌ K' ÀWỌN MÍMỌ́ BẸ̀RÙ

sections.text:
The holy must undaunted be
They are not to lose hope,
When they feel they are
despondent;
The Saviour will appear.

When father Abram took
His knife
God implored him to stop,
With that ram standing afar off
His child it should replace.

When Jonah in the water sank,
And hopeless to emerge
To Him God sent a saving
whale
That drove him to the shore.

What an effort and genuine love
That evolve in His words;
My cares will I entrust to Him
My Lord and great Saviour.

His divine succour ye await
Wait though it may tarry,
Though the promise may be delayed,
It will materialize.
Amen.

Kò tọ k'àwọn mímọ́ bẹ̀rù
Kí wọn sọ 'rétí nù
'Gbà wọn kò retí 'ràn-wọ Rẹ
Olùgbàlà y'ó dé.

Nígbà tí Abram mú ọbẹ,
Ọlọrun ní, “Dúró”
Àgbò tí ó wà lọhùn-ún nì,
Y'ó dípò ọmọ nàá.

'Gbà Jónà rì sínú omi,
Kò rò láti yọ mọ;
Sùgbọ́n Ọlọrun rán ẹja,
T'ó gbé e lọ s'ébúté.

B' írú ipa àt' ifẹ yíi
Ti pọ l'ọrọ Rẹ tó
Èmi bá ma k'àníyàn mi
Lé Olúwa lọwọ.

Ẹ dúró de ìrànwọ Rẹ,
B'ó tilẹ pẹ, dúró,
B' ilérí náà tilẹ falẹ,
Sùgbọn kò lè pẹ dé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: GOD MOVES IN A MYSTERIOUS WAY

sections.text:
God moves in a mysterious way
His wonders to perform;
He plants His footsteps in the sea,
And rides upon the storm.

Deep in unfathomable mines
Of never failing skill,
He treasures up His bright design,
And works His sovereign will.

Ye fearful saints, fresh courage take:
The clouds ye so much dread
Are big with mercy, and shall break
In blessing on your head.

Judge not the Lord by feeble sense
But trust Him for His grace;
Behind a frowning providence
He hides a smiling face.

His purposes will ripen fast,
Unfolding every hour;
The bud may have a bitter taste
But sweet will be the flower.

Blind unbelief is sure to err,
And scan His work in vain,
God is His own interpreter,
And He will make it plain.
Amen.

Ọnà àrà l'Ọlọrun wa,
Ń gbà sisẹ Rẹ láyé;
A ń rí ipasẹ Rẹ l'ór'òkun,
Ó ń gun ìgbì l'ẹsin.

Ọnà Rẹ ẹnikan kò mọ,
Àwámárídíi ni;
Ó pa isẹ ìjìnlẹ mọ,
Ó sì ń se bí Ọba.

Má bẹrù mọ, ẹyin mímọ.
Ọrun t'ó sú bẹẹ ni,
Ó kún fún àánú: y'ó rọjò
Ìbùkún s'orí yín.

Má se dá Olúwa lẹjọ,
Sùgbọn gbẹkẹ rẹ lé E:
'Gbà tí o rò pé Ó bínú,
Inú Rẹ dùn sí ọ.

Isẹ Rẹ fẹrẹ yé wa ná,
Y'ó máa hàn síwájú;
Bí ó tilẹ kòrò l'òní,
Ó ń bọ wá dùn lọla.

Afojú ni alàigbàgbọ,
Kò mọ 'ṣẹ Ọlọrun;
Ọlọrun ni Olùtumọ,
Y'ó m'ọna Rẹ yé ni.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: PRAY, ALWAYS PRAY; THE HOLY SPIRIT PLEADS
yorubaTitle: MÁA GBÀDURA; ẸMI Ń BẸBẸ, Ń'NU RẸ

sections.text:
Pray, always pray; the Holy
Spirit pleads.
Within thee all thy daily
hourly needs

Pray, always pray; beneath
sin's heaviest load,
Prayer sees the blood from
Jesus' side that flow'd.

Pray, always pray; though
weary, faint, and lone.
Prayer nestles by the Father's
shelt'ring throne.

Pray, always pray; amid the
world's turmoil.
Prayer keeps the heart at rest,
and nerves for toil.

Pray, always pray; if joys thy
pathway throng,
Prayer strikes the harp and
sings the angels' song.

Pray, always pray if loved
one pass the veil.
Prayer drinks with them of
springs that cannot fail

All earthly things with earth
shall tide away
Prayer grasps eternity, pray,
always pray.
Amen.

Máa gbàdúrà; Ẹmi ń
bẹbẹ, ń'nu rẹ,
Fun gbogbo àìní rẹ igba
gbogbo.

Máa gbàdúrà; l'abe ẹru ẹṣẹ,
Àdúrà ń ri ẹjẹ Jesu ti ń san.

Máa gbàdúrà; b'aarẹ tilẹ
Mu ọ,
Àdúrà l'o ń fun ọkan n'simi

Máa gbàdúrà; ń'nu
Wàhálà aye
Àdúrà l'o ń fún ọkan
n'simi.

Máa gbàdúrà; b'ayọ bá
yí ọ ká,
Àdúrà ń lu háàp' ọ ń kọrin
angel'.

Máa gbàdúrà; b'àwọn t'o
feran kú,
Àdúrà ń ba wọn mu omi
iyè.

Gbogb'ohun aye y'ó b'ayé
kojá,
Àdúrà wa titi; máa gbàdúrà.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHAT A FRIEND WE HAVE IN JESUS
yorubaTitle: ỌRẸ WO L'A NI BI JESU

sections.text:
What a Friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear?
What a privilege to carry,
Everything to God in prayer!
O what peace we often forfeit
O what needless pain we bear,
All because we do not carry
Everything to God in prayer!

Have we trials and temptations!
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a friend so faithful,
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness:
Take it to the Lord in prayer.

Are we weak and heavy laden.
Cumbered with a load of care
Precious Saviour, still our refuge
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do thy friends despise, forsake thee?
Take it to the Lord in prayer;
In His arms He'll take and shield thee,
Thou wilt find a solace there.
Amen.

Ọrẹ wo l'a ni bi Jesu
Ti o ru 'banuje wa?
Ànfààní wo l'o pọ báyìí
Lati máa gbadura si Ì?
Àlàáfíà pupo l'a ń sọnu
A si ti ję 'rora 'pọ,
N'tori a ko ń fi gbogbo nnkan
S'adura níwájú Rẹ

Idanwo ha wa fun wa bi?
A ha ni wahala bi?
A ko gbodo so reti nu,
Sa gbadura s'Oluwa,
Ko s'olóòótọ ọrẹ bí Rẹ;
Ti ó lè ba wa dárò
Jesu ti mọ àìlera wa,
Sáa gbàdúra s'Oluwa.

Ẹru ha ń wọ wa l'ọrun bi?
Àniyan ha pọ fun wa?
Olugbala ję ààbò wa,
Ṣa gbadura s'Oluwa,
Àwọn ọrẹ ha sa ọ ti,
Sa gbadura s'Oluwa,
Y'o gbe ọ s'oke l'apa Rẹ,
Iwọ y'ó sì ni 'tùnú.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HE WILL ANSWER EVERY PRAY'R

sections.text:
He will answer every pray'r
This, His promise and His will
He has never chang'd nor fail'd
Glory, glory to His name.
He will answer every pray'r
To His promise I will cling
I know He'll ne'er deceive me.
Glory, glory to His name.

He will answer every pray'r
Let us ask from Him in faith
With his Holy Spirit's help
Glory, glory to His name.

He will answer every pray'r
Come thou to the mercy seat
Blest assurance you'll receive
Glory, glory to His name.
Amen.

Y'ó dáhùn gbogb'àdúrà,
Ileri at'ifẹ Rẹ
Kò sá tì yí padà rí,
Ògo, ògo f'óókọ Rẹ.

Y'ó dáhùn gbogb'àdúrà,
N ó rọ mọ ileri Rẹ
Mo mọ Òun kò ję dà mí,
Ògo, ògo f'óókọ Rẹ.

Y'ó dáhùn gbogb'àdúrà,
Jẹ ká beere ni 'gbagbo
Emi Rẹ ń ràn ni lọwọ
Ògo, ògo f'óókọ Rẹ.

Y'ó dáhùn gbogb'àdúrà,
Wá sí'bi ìtẹ àánú,
Wọ ó rí 'dánilójú,
Ògo, ògo f'óókọ Rẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I NEED THEE EVERY HOUR
yorubaTitle: MO Ń FẸ Ọ ŃGBÀ GBOGBÒ

sections.text:
I Need Thee every hour
Most gracious Lord;
No tender voice like Thine
Can peace afford.

I need Thee, O I need Thee,
Every hour I need Thee:
O bless me now,
My Saviour.
I come to Thee.

I need Thee every hour;
Stay Thou nearby:
Temptations lose their power
When Thou art nigh.

I need Thee every hour.
In joy or pain;
Come quickly and abide.
Or life is vain.

I need Thee every hour:
Teach me Thy will.
And Thy rich promises
In me fulfil.

I need Thee every hour,
Most holy One;
O make me Thine indeed.
Thou blessed Son.
Amen.

Mo ń fẹ Ọ ńgbà gbogbo
Iwọ Olóore;
K'o s'ohun bi Tirẹ
T'o m'aláàfià wá.

Mo ń fẹ O, A! mo ń fẹ O,
Ni wakati gbogbo;
Bukun mi, Olugbala!
Mo wa s'odo Rẹ.

Mo ń fẹ Ọ ńgbà gbogbo
Duro ti mi
Idanwo ko n'ipa
B'o wa n'tosi.

Mo ń fẹ Ọ ńgbà gbogbo
L'ayo niṣẹ
Yara wa ba mi gbe,
Asán l'aye.

Mo ń fẹ Ọ ńgbà gbogbo
Ko mi ni'fẹ Rẹ
Mu ileri Rẹ sẹ,
Si mi l'ara.

Mo ń fẹ Ọ ńgbà gbogbo
Ẹni Mimo,
Ṣemi ń'Tirẹ tòótọ
Ọmọ 'bukun!
Ààmín.

englishTitle: NEARER, MY GOD TO THEE
yorubaTitle: N Ó SUN MỌ Ọ, ỌLỌRUN,

sections.text:
Nearer, my God to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!
E'en though it be a cross
That raiseth me,
Still all my song shall be,
Nearer, my God to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

Though like the wanderer,
The sun gone down,
Darkness be over me,
My rest a stone.
Yet in my dreams I'd be,
Nearer, my God to Thee!
Nearer to Thee!

There let the way appear
Steps unto heaven;
All that Thou send'st to me
In mercy given:
Angels to beckon me
Nearer, my God, to Thee.
Nearer to Thee!

Then, with my waking thoughts
Bright with Thy praise,
Out of my stony grief
Bethel I raise
So by my woes to be
Nearer, my God to Thee!
Nearer to Thee!

Or if on joyful wing
Cleaving the sky
Sun, moon and star forgot
Upward I fly
Still all my songs shall be
Nearer, my God to Thee!
Nearer to Thee!
Amen.

N ó sún m'Ọ Ọlọrun,
N ó sún mọ Ọ
Bo tilẹ se' pọnju
L'ó mu mi wa,
Sibe, orin mi ję;
N ó sún m'Ọ Ọlọrun,
N ó sún mọ Ọ.

Ní ọna àjò mi
B'ilẹ ba su;
Bi okuta si je
Irori mi;
Sibe, ń'nu àlá mi,
N ó sún m'Ọ Ọlọrun,
N ó sún mọ Ọ.

Nibe, ję ki ń r'ọna
To lo s'orun
Gbogb'ohun t'O fun mi
Nin' àánú Re,
Angel' lati pe mi,
N ó sún m'Ọ Ọlọrun,
N ó sún mọ Ọ.

Nję 'gba ti mo ba ji
Em'o yin Ọ;
N ó f'akete mi se
Betel fun Ọ
Bẹẹ, nínú osi mi,
N ó sún m'Ọ Ọlọrun,
N ó sún mọ Ọ.

'Gba ń ba fi ayọ lọ
S'oke ọrun
To ga ju ọrun lo
S'oke giga;
Orin mi yo ję!
N ó sún m'Ọ Ọlọrun,
N ó sún mọ Ọ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: SWEET HOUR OF PRAYER!

sections.text:
Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer!
That calls me from a world of care.
And bids me at my Father's throne
Make all my wants and wishes known;
In seasons of distress and grief,
My soul has often found relief.
And oft escaped the tempter's snare
By thy return, sweet hour of prayer

Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
Thy wings shall my petition bear
To Him whose truth and faithfulness
Engage the waiting soul to bless.
And since He bids me seek His face,
Believe His word and truth His grace
I'll cast on Him my every care
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer.

Sweet hour of prayer!
Sweet hour of prayer!
May I thy consolation share.
Till, from Mount Pisgah's lofty height
I view my home, and take my flight
This robe of flesh I'll drop, and rise
To seize the everlasting prize:
And shout, while passing through the air,
Farewell, farewell, sweet hour of prayer.
Amen.

Wakati adura didun!
Iyẹ Rẹ y'o gbe ẹbẹ mi
Lọ s'ọd'Ẹni t'O se 'leri
Lati bukun okan adura,
B'O ti kọ mi ki n w'oju Rẹ,
Ki n gbẹkẹle E, ki n sì gbàgbọ;
N ó kó gbogb'àníyàn mi Lé E;
Ní àkókò àdúa dídùn.

Wakati adura didun!
Jẹ ki n máa rí'tùnú Rẹ gbà
Titi n o fi goke Pisga
Ti n o r'ile mi l'okèèrè;
N ó bọ agọ ara silẹ,
N ó gba ere ainipekun,
N ó korin bi mo ti ń fo lọ!
O digbose adu'a didun.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: GIVE TO THE WINDS THY FEARS

sections.text:
Through waves, and clouds,
and storms;
He gently clears thy way,
Wait thou His time; so shall
this night
Soon end in joyous day.

Still heavy is thy heart?
Still sink thy spirit down?
Cast off the weight, let fear
depart
Bid every care be gone.

What though thou rulest not?
Yet heav'n and earth, and hell
Proclaim, God siteth on the
throne,
And ruleth all things well!

Leave to His sovereign sway
To choose and to command;
So shall thou wond'ring own
His way
How wise, how strong
His hand.

Far, far above thy thought.
His counsel shall appear,
When fully He the work hath
wrought.
That caused thy needless fear!

Thou seest our weakness, Lord,
Our hearts are known to Thee;
O lift Thou up the sinking hand,
Confirm the feeble knee!

Let us in Life, in death.
Thy steadfast truth declare,
And publish with our latest
breath
Thy love and guardian care.
Amen.

N'irumi at'iji,
Y'o s'ọna rẹ fefe;
Duro de igba Rẹ; oru
Y'o pin s'ọjo ayo.

Ọkan re ha wuwo?
Ò rẹ ẹmi re bi?
Gbon gbogbo ifoya kuro,
Le gbogbo ẹrù lọ.

B'o ko tile kuro,
Sibẹ ọrun, ayé
Ń sọ p'Ọlọrun wà lórí 'tẹ
O ń jọba lododo!

Fi yíyàn oun sise,
Le ase Rẹ lọwọ
'Wọ y'ó sì f'iyanu jęwọ
Ọgbọn at'ipá Rẹ.

Yóó hàn pé ìmọ Rẹ
Ga ju èrò rẹ lọ
'Gbà t' Òun bá yọrí isẹ náà
Ti ń fò ọ lí àyà.

Ìwọ r'àilera wa,
O sì mọ èrò wa;
Gbe ọwọ t'áàárẹ mu s'oke,
M'éékun àilera le!

Ń'nú iyè tàb'ikú,
K'a kede òótọ Rẹ,
K'a so t'ife oun 'tojú Rẹ
Tit' opin emi wa.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I COULD NOT DO WITHOUT THEE
yorubaTitle: LÁÌSÍ RẸ N KO LE SE NNKAN

sections.text:
I could not do without Thee,
O Saviour of the lost,
Whose precious blood redeemed me
At such tremendous cost;
Thy righteousness, Thy pardon,
Thy Sacrifice must be
My only hope and comfort,
My glory and my plea.

I could not do without Thee;
I cannot stand alone,
I have no strength or goodness.
No wisdom of my own,
But Thou, beloved Saviour,
Art all in all to me,
And weakness will be power,
If leaning hard on Thee.

I could not do without Thee;
No other friend can read
The spirit's strange deep longings.
Interpreting its need:
No human heart can enter
Each dim recess of mine,
And soothe, and hush, And calm it,
O blessed Lord, but Thine.

I could not do without Thee;
For years are fleeting fast
And soon in solemn loneness
The river must be passed.
But Thou wilt never leave me;
And though the waves roll high,
I know Thou will be near me,
And whisper, “It is I.”
Amen

Láìsí Rẹ n kò lè se nnkan,
'Wọ Olùgbàlà mi'
Ẹni t'ó f'ẹjẹ rà mí
T'ó sì dáríjì mí
Òdodo Rẹ di tèmi
Nípa ẹjẹ ọwọn
Ìrètí, ìtúnú mi
L'ẹjẹ iyebíye.

Láìsí Rẹ n kò lè se nnkan
N kò lè nìkan dúró
Ko s'agbara ninu mi
Ko s'ohun rere kan
Ìwọ Olùgbàlà mi
L'ohun gbogbo fun mi
Agbára mi ń di otun
Bí mo ti ń rọ mọ Q.

Láìsí Rẹ n kò lè se nnkan
Ọrẹ mìíràn kò mọ
Gbogbo ifẹ ínú mi
At' òngbẹ ọkàn mi
Kò sí ẹdá tó lè mọ
Ìrora ọkàn mi
T'ó sì lè tù mí nínú
Àf' Ìwọ Olúwa.

Láìsí Rẹ n kò lè se nnkan
Ọdun ń sare tete
Láìpẹ èmi y'ó nikan
Ré odò nì kojá
'Wọ kì ó fi mí sílẹ
Bí 'gbì bá ń ru sókè
'Wọ ó sọ bíi t'ìgbàanì
“Èmi ni, má bẹrù.”
Ààmín.

englishTitle: TELL IT TO JESUS, ALL OF THY SORROW

sections.text:
Tell it to Jesus, all of thy sorrow,
All of thy cares whate'er they be;
Surely and sweet He will deliver
He will sustain and Comfort thee.

Tell it to Jesus,
tell it to Jesus
Tell it to Jesus He will hear
Only believe Him trust and receive
He will sustain and comfort thee.

Tell it to Jesus, He is thy Savior,
Tell it, and His salvation see;
Do not deny Him, do not defy Him
He will sustain and comfort thee

Tell it to Jesus, He is a refuge.
Into His arms for mercy flee;
Tell it believing, tell it receiving
Grace to sustain and comfort thee.
Amen.

Sọ gbogbo 'bànújẹ rẹ Fún Jésù
Àti gbogbo àníyàn rẹ;
Dájúdájú yóó dá ọ ní'dè
Òun yóó sì tù ọ nínú.

Sọ wọn fún Jésù,
Sọ wọn fún Jésù,
Sọ wọn fún Jésù,
Òun yóó gbọ;
Sa gbẹkẹle E
Ki o sì gbà A gbọ;
Òun yóó sì tù ọ ninu.

Sọ wọn fún Jésù
Olùgbàlà rẹ,
Sọ wọn k'ó sì rí 'gbàlà Rẹ;
Má se sẹ Jesu, má se d'oju tì Í,
Òun yóó sì tù ọ nínú.

Sọ wọn fún Jésù, Òun ni ààbò rẹ,
Lọ sí ọdọ Rẹ fún àánú;
Sọ fún Jésù, gbàgbọ,
‘wọ ó sì rí
Oore-ọfẹ àti 'tùnú.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THERE SHALL BE SHOWERS OF BLESSING

sections.text:
“There shall be showers of blessings”
This is the promise of love;
There shall be seasons refreshing
Sent from the Saviour above.

Showers of blessings
Showers of blessings we need
Mercy drops round us are falling
But for the showers we plead.

“There shall be showers of blessing,”
Precious reviving again;
Over the hills and the valleys
Sound of abundance of rain.

“There shall be showers of blessing,”
Sent them upon us, O Lord!
Grant to us now a refreshing;
Come, and now honour Thy word,

“There shall be showers of blessing,”
Oh that today they might fall,
Now as to God we're confessing,
Now as on Jesus we call.
Amen.

“Òjò ìbùkún yóó sì rọ”,
Ìlérí ifẹ l'èyí,
A ó ní ìtùra dídùn,
Lát'ọdọ Olùgbàlà,

Òjò ìbùkún,
Òjò ìbùkún l'a ń fẹ;
Ìrì àánú ń sẹ yí wa ká,
Sùgbọn òjò l'à ń tọrọ.

“Òjò ìbùkún yóó sì rọ”,
Ìṣojí iyebíye,
Lorí òkè òun pẹtẹlẹ,
Ìró ọpọ òjò ń bọ.

“Òjò ìbùkún yóó sì rọ”,
Rán wọn sí wa, Olúwa;
Fún wa ní ìtura dídùn,
Wá f'ọlá fún ọrọ Rẹ.

“Òjò ìbùkún yóó sì rọ”,
Ìbá jẹ lè rọ lónìí,
B'á ti ń jęwọ f'Ọlọrun wa,
T'á ń pe orúkọ Jésù.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: ROCK OF AGES, CLEFT FOR ME

sections.text:
Rock of Ages, cleft for me
Let me hide myself in Thee;
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy riven side which flowed,
Be of sin the double cure,
Cleanse me from its guilt and power.

Not the labours of my hands
Can fulfill Thy law's demands,
Could my zeal no respite know,
Could my tears for ever flow,
All for sin could not atone,
Thou must save,
and Thou alone.

While I draw this fleeting breath,
When my eyelids close in death,
When I soar to worlds unknown,
See Thee on Thy judgment throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.
Amen.

Àpata ayeraye,
Se ibi ìsádi mi,
Jẹ kí omi òun ẹjẹ
T'ó sàn láti ìhà Rẹ,
Se ìwòsàn f'ẹṣẹ mi,
K'ó sì sọ mí di mímọ.

Kìí se iṣẹ ọwọ mi,
L'ó lè mú òfin Rẹ sẹ.
B'ítara mi kò l'àárẹ,
T'omijé mi ń sàn títí,
Wọn kò tó fún ètùtù;
'Wọ nikan l'ó lè gbàlà.

Kò s'ohun tí mo mú wá,
Mo rọ mọ àgbélébúú;
Mo wá k'ó dasọ bò mí,
Mo ń wò Ọ fún 'rànwọ,
Mo wá s'ib'orísun nì,
Wẹ mí, Olùgbàlà mi.

englishTitle: PASS ME NOT, O GENTLE SAVIOUR

sections.text:
Pass me not, O gentle Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

Saviour! Saviour!
Hear my humble cry,
And while others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

Let me at a throne of mercy
Find a sweet relief;
Kneeling there in deep contrition,
Help my unbelief.

Trusting only in Thy merit
Would I seek Thy face:
Heal my wounded, broken spirit,
Save me by Thy grace.

Thou the spring of all my comfort,
More than life to me,
Who have I on earth beside Thee?
Whom in heaven but Thee?
Amen.

Má kojá mi Olùgbàlà,
Gbọ àdúrà mi;
'Gbà t'Ìwọ bá ń p'ẹlòmíràn,
Má se kojá mi.

Jésù, Jésù, gbọ àdúrà mi
'Gbà t'Ìwọ bá ń p'ẹlòmíràn,
Má se kojá mi.

Ní'tẹ àánú ję k'èmi rí,
Ìtura dìdùn;
T'ędùn tędùn ni mo wólę,
Jọọ ràn mí lọwọ.

Ní'gbẹkẹlé ìtoye Rẹ,
L'èm'ó w'ójú Rẹ,
Wò bànuję ọkàn mi sàn,
F'ìfẹ Rẹ gbà mí.

'Wọ orisun ìtùnú mi,
Ju'yè fún mi lọ,
Ta ni mo ní l'áyé l'ọrun;
Bí kò se Ìwọ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE GREAT PHYSICIAN NOW IS NEAR

sections.text:
The Great Physician
now is near,
The sympathizing Jesus;
He speaks the drooping
hear to cheer,
Oh, hear the voice of Jesus!
Sweetest not in seraph song,
Sweetest name on mortal
tongue,
Sweetest carol ever song;
Jesus! Blessed Jesus!

Your many sins are all forgiven,
Oh, hear the voice of Jesus!
Go on your way in peace
to heaven
And wear a crown with Jesus.

All glory to the risen Lamb!
I now believe in Jesus;
I love the blessed Saviour's
name,
I love the name of Jesus.

His name dispels my guilt
and fear,
No other name but Jesus:
Oh, how my soul delights
to hear,
The precious name of Jesus.

Come, brethren, help me sing
His praise,
Oh, praise the name of Jesus!
Come, sisters, all your voices
raise,
Oh, bless the name of Jesus!

The children too,
both great and small,
Who love the name of Jesus!
May now accept the gracious
call
To work and live for Jesus.

And when to the bright
world above,
We rise to see our Jesus,
We'll sing around the throne
Of love,
His name, the name of Jesus.
Amen.

A fi gbogbo'ẹsẹ rẹ jìn ọ
A gbọ ohùn Jésù;
Rìn lọ s'ọrun l'álàáfíà,
Sì bá Jésù dé adé.

Gbogb'ògo fún Kríst' t'ó
jíde,
Mo gbàgbọ níisinsìnyí;
Mo f'orúkọ Olùgbàlà,
Mo fẹ orúkọ Jésù.

Orúkọ Rẹ l'ẹrù mi lọ,
Kò sí orúkọ mìíràn;
B'ọkàn mi ti ń fẹ láti gbọ'
Orúkọ Rẹ iyebíye.

Arákùnrin, ẹ bá mi yìn Ín,
A yin orúkọ Jésù,
Arábinrin gbóhùn s'ókè;
A yin orúkọ Jésù.

Ọmọdé àt'àgbàlagbà,
T'ó fẹ orúkọ Jésù,
Lèè gb'pè 'fẹ nísinsìnyí;
Láti s'iṣẹ fún Jésù.

Nígbà tí a bá sì dé ọrun,
Tí a bá sì rí Jésù,
A ó kọrin yí 'tẹ ìfẹ ká;
Orin orúkọ Jésù. Ààmín.

englishTitle: THOU MY EVERLASTING PORTION

sections.text:
Thou my everlasting portion,
More than friend or life to me,
All along my pilgrim journey;
Savior, let me walk with Thee.
Close to Thee, Close to Thee,
Close to Thee, Close to Thee,
All along my pilgrim journey;
Savior, let me walk with Thee.

Not for ease or worldly pleasure,
Nor for fame my prayer shall be,
Gladly will I toil and suffer,
Only let me walk with Thee
Close to Thee, Close to Thee,
Close to Thee, Close to Thee,
Gladly will I toil and suffer,
Only let me walk with Thee.

Lead me through the vale
Of shadows,
Bear me o'er life's fitful sea,
Then the gates of life eternal,
May I enter Lord with Thee;
Close to Thee, Close to Thee,
Close to Thee, Close to Thee,
Then the gates of life eternal,
May I enter Lord with Thee.
Amen.

Jésù, 'Wọ n'ìpín mi títí,
'Wọ ju ọrẹ ayé yíì,
Ní gbogbo irin-àjò mi,
Jésù, jẹ kí n bá Ọ rìn;
Sún mọ Ọ, sún mọ Ọ,
Sún mọ Ọ, sún mọ Ọ,
Ní gbogbo irin-àjò mi,
Jésù, jẹ kí n bá Ọ rìn.

Kìí se fún ọrọ ayé yíì,
Ni mo se ń gbàdúrà yíì,
Tayọtayọ ni n ó jìyà;
Bí n bá sá lè sún mọ Ọ,
Sún mọ Ọ, sún mọ Ọ,
Sún mọ Ọ, sún mọ Ọ,
Tayọtayọ ni n ó jìyà;
Bí n bá sá lè sún mọ Ọ.

'Gbà t'àjò mi bá sì d'ópin,
Mú mi gúnlẹ sọdọ Rẹ,
Sí ilẹkùn ayeraye,
Kí n sún mọ Ọ títí láé,
Sún mọ Ọ, sún mọ Ọ,
Sún mọ Ọ, sún mọ Ọ,
Sí ilẹkùn ayeraye,
Kí n sún mọ Ọ títí láé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: MAY THE GRACE OF CHRIST OUR SAVIOUR

sections.text:
May the grace of Christ our Saviour,
And the Father's boundless love,
With the Holy Spirit's favour,
Rest upon us from above.
Thus may we abide in union,
With each other and the Lord,
And possess, in sweet communion,
Joys which earth cannot afford.
Amen.

K'oore-ọfẹ Krist' Olúwa,
Ìfẹ Baba àìlópin,
Ojú rere Ẹmí Mímọ,
K'ó t'òkè bà s'órí wa;
Báyìí la lè wà n'ìrẹpọ,
Àwa àti Olúwa;
K'á sí lè ní 'dàpọ dìdùn,
Àt'ayọ t'áyé kò ní.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: COME, MY SOUL, THY SUIT PREPARE

sections.text:
Come, My soul, thy suit prepare,
Jesus loves to answer prayer;
He Himself has bid thee pray,
Therefore will not say thee nay.

Thou art coming to a king,
Large petitions with thee bring;
For His grace and power are such,
None can ever ask too much.

Lord I come to Thee for rest
Take possession of my breath:
There Thy blood-bought right maintain,
And without a rival reign.

As the image in the glass
Answer the beholder's face,
Thus unto my heart appear;
Print Thine own resemblance there.

While I am a pilgrim here,
Let Thy love my spirit cheer;
As my guide, my guard, My friend,
Lead me to my journey's end.
Amen.

Múra lati gbàdúrà,
Jésù ń dáhùn àdúrà,
Òun l'ó pe k'ó gbàdúrà;
Kò lè s'àìdá ọ lóhùn.

Ní'rìn àjò mi láyé
Kí'fẹ Rẹ máa tù mí ń'nú
Bí ọrẹ àti Àmọnà;
Mú mi d'òpin àjò mi.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HE HEALETH ME, O BLESSED TRUTH
yorubaTitle: O Ń WO MI SAN, OTITỌ NI

sections.text:
He healeth me, o blessed truth,
His mighty word renews
my youth
By His own power from
sickness free.
My precious Saviour
healeth me.

He healeth me, He healeth me,
By His own word He
healeth me;
His faithful witness
I would be,
For by His word He healeth me.

Sometimes through testing
times I go
Dark seems the way and full
of woe;
But in the furnace though I be,
My great Physician healeth me.

Lord, I would spread this truth
aboard,
The mighty power of Thy word;
It's just the same the blind
now see,
And demons at Thy presence
flee.

For sin and sickness doth
depart,
When thou dost reign within
the heart;
And I from all the curse am
free,
Since Christ, my Saviour,
healeth me.
Amen.

Ó ń wò mi sàn,
Ó ń wò mi sàn,
Ọrọ Rẹ ló fi ń wò mí sàn
N ó ję ẹlẹriì náà títí.

Nígbà miíràn a ń dán mi wò,
Ọnà mi sì lè s'ókùnkùn
Nínú iná ìdánwò náà;
Olùwòsàn ń bẹ pẹlú mi.

N ó sọ ìtàn náà káàkiri
Agbára tí ń bẹ ń'nú ọrọ Rẹ;
Tí ń m'áfojú ríran síbẹ
Tí ń lé ẹmí Èsù jáde.

Ẹṣẹ àt'àìsàn yóó fò lọ,
Nínú ọkàn tí'Wọ ń jọba;
Mo bọ lọwọ ègún òfin,
'Tor' Olúwa mi ń wò
mí sàn.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HE WHO WOULD VALIANT BE
yorubaTitle: ẸNI TI Y'O SẸGUN GBOGBO ÌDANWO

sections.text:
He who would valiant be
'Gainst all disaster,
Let him in constancy follow
the Master.
There's no discouragement,
Shall make him once relent
His first avowed intent
to be a pilgrim.

Who so beset him round,
with dismal stories,
Do but themselves confound,
His strength the more is;
No foes shall stay his might,
Though he with giants fight;
He will make good his right,
to be a pilgrim.

Since,Lord,Thou dost defend
Us with Thy spirit,
We know we at the end,
Shall life inherit.
Then fancies flee away!
I'll fear not what men say,
I'll labour night and day,
to be a pilgrim. Amen.

Ẹni tí yóó sẹgun gbogbo
ìdánwò,
Jẹ k'ó farabalẹ, tẹle Olúwa;
Kò sí ìdààmú kan t'ó lè
m'gbàgbọ wọn
Torí wọn ti pinnu láti
s'ọm'oogun.

Bí ẹṇikan f'ọrọ asán tàn
wọn jẹ,
Èyí yóó túnbọ fún wọn
l'ágbára síi;
Ọtá kò lè mì wọn, 'torí ohun-
ijà wọn,
Láti òkè wá ni, Ọm'oogun
Krístì.

Ẹmí Olúwa ni Olùgbèjà wa,
Àwa mọ, ní'kẹyin, ìyè ni ti wa;
Jẹ kí aráyé sọ ohun tí ó
wù wọn;
N ó s'isẹ f'Olúwa, bí
ọm'oogun Rẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE GOD WHO LED HIS PEOPLE THRO' THE PARTED SEA
yorubaTitle: OLUWA T'O MU ISRAEL LA OKUN JA

sections.text:
The God who led His people
thro' the parted sea,
And from Egyptian bondage
get His children free,
Who rained down bread from
heaven all the pilgrim way,
Is the God to whom I pray.

Just the same today,
Just the same today,
(O the God to Whom
I pray is just the same today)
As when He led His people
Through the sea
His trustful child I'll be,
For in His word I see
The God who doeth
wonders is just the same
today.

The God who rescued Daniel
from the Lion's den,
And from the fiery furnace
save the three young men,
Who speaks and constellations
will His voice obey,
Is the God to Whom I pray.

The God who stills the
tempest with the word divine,
And on clouds of sorrow
makes His rainbows shine,
Whom from the tomb of Jesus
rolled the stone away
Is the God to whom I pray.

The God who clothes the lily
in its robes of snow,
Who in the barren desert made
His rivers flow,
The God who lifts the sinner
from the miry clay,
Is the God to whom I pray.
Amen.

Olúwa t'ó mú Israel
la òkun já,
Tí ó sì gbà wọn kúrò
lí oko ẹrú
Tí ó rọjo oúnjẹ sílẹ
Láti ọrun
Òun ni mo ń gbàdúrà sí.

Ọkan náà lónìí, ọkan
náà lónìí;
(Bakan náà ni Ọlọrun tí
mo ń gbàdúrà sí)
B'àkókò t'ó sin Israel
la okun
Ìgbé ayé onígbàgbọ: Àdúrà
Ọmọ Rẹ ni ó jẹ torí ọrọ
Rẹ sọ
Pé ọkan náà ni Ọlọrun
ìyanu lónìí.

Ọlọrun t'ó gba Daniel
lọwọ kínniún
T'ó sì yọ àwọn mẹta ń'nú
iná 'l'éru
Ẹni tí àwọn ìràwọ ń gba
Tirẹ gbọ
Òun ni mo ń gbàdúrà sí.

Ọlọrun t'ó fọrọ Rẹ
d'afẹfẹ dúró
T'ó si ń sọ 'bànújẹ ònì
D'ayo l'ọla
Ẹni tí ó ýí òkúta 'bojì kúrò
Òun ni mo ń gbàdúrà sí.

Ọlọrun t'ó wọ ìtànná
Ìgbẹ l'ásọ
Ẹni tí ó sì mú omi sàn l'áginjù
Tí ó wẹ ẹlẹsẹ mọ nínú éérí rẹ
Òun ni mo ń gbàdúrà sí
Ààmín.

englishTitle: PEACE, PERFECT PEACE

sections.text:
Peace, perfect peace, in this
dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers
peace within.

Peace, perfect peace,
By thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus,
this is rest.

Peace, perfect peace,
With sorrows surging round?
On Jesus' bosom naught
but calm is found.

Peace, perfect peace,
With loved ones far away?
In Jesus' keeping we are safe
and they.

Peace, perfect peace,
Our future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and He is on
the throne.

Peace, perfect peace,
Death shad'wing us and ours?
Jesus has vanquish'd death
and all its pow'rs.

It is enough; earth's struggles
soon shall cease,
And Jesus calls us to heav'n's
Perfect peace. Amen.

Àlàáfíà, ní ayé ẹṣẹ yìí?
Ẹjẹ Jésù ń wí pé, “Àlàáfíà.”

Àlàáfíà, nínú ọpọ làáláá?
Láti se ìfẹ Jésù ni 'sinmi.

Àlàáfíà, ńnú ìgbì 'bànújẹ?
L'áyà Jésù ni 'dàkẹ rọrọ wà.

Àlàáfíà, 'gbà'rá wa wà l'ájò?
Ní 'pamọ Jésù, ìbẹrù kò sí.

Àlàáfíà, b'á kò tilẹ mọ'la,
A mọ pé Jésù jọba títí láé.

Àlàáfíà, nígb' àkókò ikú?
Olùgbàlà wa ti sẹgun ikú.

Ó tó! Jàkadì ayé fẹrẹ pin.
Jesù yóó pè wá s'ọrun
àlàáfíà.
Àmín.

englishTitle: SINFUL, SIGHING TO BE BLEST

sections.text:
Goodness I have none to plead;
Sinfulness in all I see,
I can only bring my need:
God be merciful to me.

Broken heart and downcast eyes,
Dare not lift themselves
To Thee;
Yet Thou canst interpret sighs:
God be merciful to me.

From this sinful heart of mine;
To Thy bosom I would flee:
I am not my own but Thine:
God be merciful to me.

There is One beside the Throne,
And my only hope and plea
Are in Him and Him alone;
God be merciful to me.

Ẹlẹṣẹ: mo ń fẹ 'bukun
Òndè: mo ń fẹ
d'om'nira,
Alá'árẹ: mo ń fẹ 'sinmi
Ọlọrun s'àánú fún mi.

Ire kan èmi kò ní
Ẹṣẹ sa lo yí mi ka,
Èyí nìkan l'ẹbẹ mi
Ọlọrun s'àánú fún mi.

Ìròbinujẹ ọkàn!
N kò gbọdọ gbójú s'oke,
Ìwọ sa mọ ẹdùn mi;
Ọlọrun s'àánú fún mi.

Ọkan ẹṣẹ mi yìí ń fẹ
Sá wá sinmi láyà Rẹ
Lat'óní mo di ti Rẹ:
Ọlọrun s'àánú fún mi.

Ẹnikan ń bẹ lor'itẹ;
Nínú Rẹ nìkan soso
N' ìrèti at'ẹbẹ mi
Ọlọrun s'àánú fún mi.

Òun ó gba ọràn mi rò,
Òun ni alágbàwí mi
Nítorí Tirẹ nìkan;
Ọlọrun s'àánú fún mi.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: UNWORTHY I AM LORD

sections.text:
Unworthy I am Lord,
My Lord my God Saviour,
May I draw nearer to
Thee Lord?
With all my sinful load.

My sins do press on me
With my uncleansed heart,
How sorrowful this may
be Lord?
In this Thy Holy sight.

Do I move to the grave
In this my hopeless state?
I have joy in Thy painful death
For me the miserable.

The blood which Thou has shed
Which is free given grace,
Can clean me a sinner so bad;
Can soften hardened heart.

I worship at Thy feet
Forgive to me my sins
Here I'll not arise on my knees
Till thou shalt say, “Arise”.

Aláimọ ni èmi,
Ọlọrun Oluwa
Emi ha gbọdọ sun mọ Ọ,
T' emi t'ẹru ẹṣẹ?

Ẹrù ẹṣẹ yìí ń pa,
Ọkàn búburú mi;
Yio ha si ti búru to,
L'oju Rẹ mimọ ni!

Èmi ó ha se kú
Ni alàìní 'reti?
Mo r' àyò nínú ikú Rẹ,
Fun ótósì b'emi.

Ẹjẹ ni tí O ta,
T'iṣẹ oor' ọfẹ Rẹ;
Le w'ẹlẹṣẹ t'o burú jù
Le m'ọkàn líle rọ.

Mo wólẹ l'ẹsẹ Rẹ,
Jọọ k'o dáríjì mí,
Níhin lemi ó wà títí;
'Wọ o wí pé, “Dide.”
Àámín.

englishTitle: LOVING SAVIOUR, HEAR MY CRY

sections.text:
Loving Saviour, Hear my cry
Hear my cry, hear my cry
Trembling to Thine arms I fly
O save me at the cross,
I have sinn'd but Thou
Hast died,
Thou hast died, Thou hast died,
In Thy mercy let me hide;
O save me at the cross.
Lord Jesus, receive me,
No more would I grieve Thee,
Now blessed Redeemer,
O save me at the Cross.

Tho' I perish I will pray.
I will pray, I will pray,
Thou of life the Living way
O save me at the cross
Thou hast said Thy grace
is free,
Grace is free, grace is free
Have compassion, Lord on me.
O save me at the cross.

Wash me in Thy cleansing
Blood,
Cleansing blood, cleansing
blood,
Plunge me now beneath
The flood,
O save me at the cross.
Only faith will pardon bring
Pardon bring, pardon bring,
In that faith to Thee I cling
O save me at the cross.
Amen.

Olùgbàlà gb'óhùn mi,
Gb'óhùn mi, gb'óhùn mi,
Mo wá s'ọdọ Rẹ, gbà mí;
Ní'bi àgbélébúù.
Èmí sẹ, sùgbọn O kú,
Ìwọ kú, Ìwọ kú;
Fi àánú Rẹ pa mí mọ,
Ní'bi àgbélébúù.
Olúwa, Jọọ gbà mí,
N kì y'ó bí Ọ nínú mọ!
Alábùkún, gbà mí,
Ní'bi àgbélébúù.

Bí n ó bá tilẹ sègbé,
N ó bẹbẹ! N ó bẹbẹ!
Ìwọ li ọ̀nà Ìyè,
Ní'bi àgbélébúù.
Oore-ọfẹ Rẹ t'á gbà;
L'ọfẹ ni! L'ọfẹ ni!
F'ojú àánú Rẹ wò mi,
Ní'bi àgbélébúù.

F'ẹjẹ mímọ Rẹ wẹ mí,
Fi wẹ mí, fi wẹ mí!
Rì mí sínú ibú Rẹ;
Ní'bi àgbélébùú.
'Gbàgbọ l'ó lè fún wa ni
'Dàríji! 'Dàríji!
Mo fi 'gbàgbọ rọ mọ Ọ
Ní'bi àgbélébùú. Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHO WOULD HELP RAISE FALLEN JACOB?

sections.text:
Who would help raise
fallen Jacob?
Jacob's friends are too few,
The most surprising is this fact
They are disunited.

Who would help raise
fallen Jacob?
His enemies proved tough
I could now read victorious
bliss
They thought that was his end.

Who would help raise fallen
Jacob?
And make this
pronouncement,
“A branch that's hewn
and still lies down”
Can still resuscitate.

My God, my Lord it is
Thy work,
There's no one beside Thee,
Shower blessings on fallen
Jacob,
And Jacob shall arise.
Amen.

Ta ni yóó gbe Jakọb' dìde?
Ọrẹ Jakọb kò pọ
Èyí t'ó ję 'yanu ni pé,
Ìmọ wọn kò sọkan.

Ta ni yóó gbe Jakọb dìde?
Ọtá Jakọb ni 'pa
Mo r'ayọ 'sẹgun l'oju wọn,
Wọn ní, “O parí fún Un.”

Ta ni yóó gbe Jakọb dìde?
A ha r'ẹni lè wí
P'ẹka t' o rọ ni'bulẹ yìí
Yóó tun lè dìde bi?

Oluwa mi ise Rẹ ni!
Kò s'ẹni t'ó lè se é
Sẹ bi 'ri s'órí Jakọbu,
Òun yó sì tún dìde.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: AND DOST THOU SAY, "ASK WHAT THOU WILT?"

sections.text:
And dost Thou say,
"Ask what thou wilt?"
Lord, I would seize the
golden hour,
I pray to be released from guilt,
And freed from sin and
Satan's power.

More of Thy presence Lord
impart,
More of Thine image let me bear;
Erect Thy throne within my heart,
And reign without a rival there.

Give me to read my pardon
seal'd,
And from Thy joy to draw my
strength,
To have Thy boundless love
reveal'd
Its height, and depth, its breadth
and length.

Grant these requests,
I ask no more,
But to Thy care the rest resign,
Living or dying, rich or poor,
All shall be well if Thou
Art mine. Amen.

Oluwa, Ìwọ ha wí pé,
Kí n bèèrè ohun tí mo fẹ?
Jọọ ję kí n bọ lọwọ ẹbi
Ati lọw' ẹṣẹ òun Èsù.

Jọọ, fi ara Rẹ hàn fún mi,
Sí ję kí n ru àwòrán Rẹ.
Tẹ ìtẹ Rẹ sí ọkàn mi,
Sì máa nìkan jọba ní'bẹ.

Ję kí n mọ p'O dáríjì mi'
Kí ayọ Rẹ s'agbára mi,
Ki n mọ gíga, ìbú, jíjin.
Ati gígùn ifẹ ílá Rẹ.

Èyí nìkan ni ẹbẹ mi
Èyí t'ó kù di ọwọ Rẹ;
Ìyè, ikú, àiní ọrọ
Kò ję nkan b'O bá ję tèmi.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHEN AT THY FOOTSTOOL, LORD, I BEND

sections.text:
When at Thy footstool,
Lord, I bend,
And plead with Thee for
mercy there,
Think of the sinner's dying
friend,
And for His sake receive
My prayer.

Oh think not of my shame and guilt,
My thousand stains of deepest dye;
Think of the blood which Jesus spilt
My pardon and my life to buy.

Think, Lord, how I am still Thine own,
The trembling creature of Thy hand;
Think how my heart to sin is prone,
And how temptations round me stand.

Oh think upon Thy holy word,
And every plighted promise there;
How prayer should evermore be heard,
And how Thy glory is to spare.

Oh think not of my doubts and fears,
My striving with Thy grace divine,
Think upon Jesus' woes and tears,
And let His merits stand for mine.

Bi mo ti kunlẹ, Oluwa,
Ti mo ń bẹ f'àánú lọdọ Rẹ,
Wo ti Jésù Olugbala
Si tori Rẹ gb'adura mi

Má ro 'tijú at'ẹbi mi,
At'aimoye àbàwọn mi,
Ro t'ẹjẹ ti Jésù ta 'lẹ
Fun dariji òun ìyè mi.

Ranti bi mo ti jẹ Tirẹ
Ti mo jẹ ẹda ọwọ Rẹ
Ro b'ọkàn mi ti ń fà s'ẹṣẹ
Bí'danwo si ti yí mi ka.

A! ronu ọrọ mimọ Rẹ
Ati gbogbo ileri Rẹ
Pe 'Wọ o gbọ adua titi,
Ògo Rẹ ni láti dásí.

A! má ro ti 'yèméjì mi,
Ati àilo oor'ọfẹ Rẹ,
Ro ti omije Jésù mi,
Si fi 'toye Rẹ di t'emi.

Ojú, òun etí Rẹ kò sé
Agbara Rẹ kò lè yẹ láé;
Jọọ wò mi; ọkàn mi wúwo
Da mi si k'o ràn mi lọwọ.

englishTitle: APPROACH, MY SOUL, THE MERCY-SEAT

sections.text:
Approach, my soul,
the mercy-seat,
Where Jesus answers prayers;
There humbly fall before
His feet,
For none can perish there.

Thy promise is my only plea,
With this I venture nigh;
Thou callest burden'd souls
to Thee,
And such, O Lord, am I.

Bow'd down beneath a load
of sin,
By Satan sorely press'd,
By war without, and
fears within,
I come to Thee for rest.

Be Thou my shield
and hiding-place,
That, shelter'd near Thy side,
I may my fierce accuser face,
And tell them, Thou hast died.

Oh wondrous love,
to bleed and die,
To bear the cross and shame,
That guilty sinners, such as I,
Might plead Thy gracious
name.
Amen.

Ọkàn mi, sún mọ'tẹ àánú,
Ni'bi Jésù ń gb' ẹbẹ,
F' irẹlẹ wólẹ I'ẹsẹ Rẹ
'Wọ kò lè s'ègbé ńbẹ.

Ileri Rẹ ni ẹbẹ mi,
Èyí ni mo mú wá;
Iwo ń pe ọkàn t'ẹrù ń pa,
Bí èmi, Oluwa.

Ẹrù ẹsẹ wọ mi l'ọrun
Èsù ń sẹ mi n'ìsẹ;
Ogun l'ode, ẹrù nínú
Mo wá isinmi mi,

Se Apata at'Asa mi,
Kí ń fí Ọ se ààbò;
Kí ń dójú ti Olùfisùn,
Kí ń sẹ pé Kristi kú

Ìfẹ ìyanu! Ìwọ kú,
Ìwọ ru ìtìjú,
Kí ẹlẹsẹ b'iru emi,
Le bẹ l'Orukọ Rẹ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: O THOU FROM WHOM ALL GOODNESS FLOWS
yorubaTitle: ÌWỌ LỌW' ẸNI T'IRE Ń SÀN

sections.text:
O Thou from whom all
goodness flows,
I lift my heart to Thee;
In all sorrows, conflicts, woes,
Dear Lord, remember me.

When on my aching
Burden'd heart
My sins lie heavily,
Thy pardon grant,
Thy peace impart;
In love remember me.

When trials sore obstruct
my way
And ills I cannot flee,
Oh let my strength be
as my day;
For good remember me.

And oh, when in the hour
of death
I own Thy just decree,
Be this the prayer of my last
breath;
Dear Lord remember me.
Amen.

Ìwọ lọw' ẹni t' ire ń sàn,
Mo gb' ọkan mi si Ọ;
Ní'bànújẹ àt'isẹ mi
Oluwa, ranti mi.

'Gba mo ń ke'rora l'ọkan mi
T'ẹṣẹ wọn mi lọrun;
Dárí gbogbo ẹṣẹ ji mi
Ní ifẹ, ránti mi

'Gba danwo kikan yi mi ka.
Tí ibi lé mi bá;
Oluwa fún mi l'agbara
Fún rere, ranti mi

Bí 'tijú at'ẹgàn bá dé
'Tori orukọ Rẹ;
N ó yọ s'ẹgàn, n ó gba'tijú,
Bi 'Wọ bá ranti mi.

Oluwa, 'gba ikú bá dé.
Èm'ó sa kú dandan
K'éyíí j'adura gbẹyin mi
Oluwa, ranti mi.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I AM COMING TO THE CROSS

sections.text:
Here I give my all to Thee
Friends and time and
Earthly store,
Soul and bod-y Thine to be
Wholly Thine for-ev-er more.
Amen.

Mo ń bọ ní'b'àgbélébùú
Èmi abòsì jùlọ
Mo ka gbogbo nkan s'ofo
Lati ri 'gbàlà kíkún
Mo gbẹkẹle Ọ Jésù
Ọd'agùntàn Kalfari
Mo fì 'rẹlẹ tẹríba
Gbà mi Jésù l'ònìí yìí.

Mo gbẹkẹle 'lérí Rẹ
At'agbára ẹjẹ nì
Mo pọn ara mi lójú
Mo ń ru àgbélébùú Rẹ.

Jésù fi ayọ kún mi
O sì sọ mi di pípé
Mo ní ìlera pípé
Ògo ni f'Ọd'agùntàn.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: O LORD, TURN NOT THY FACE FROM ME

sections.text:
O Lord, turn not Thy face
from me,
Who lie in woeful state
Lamenting all my sinful life
Before Thy mercy gate.

A gate which open
wide to those
That do lament their sin;
Shut not that gate against me,
Lord,
But let me enter in.

I need not to confess my life
To Thee, who best can tell
What I have been and what
I am,
I know Thou know'st it well.

So come I to Thy mercy gate,
Where mercy doth abound,
Imploring pardon for my sin,
To heal my deadly wound.

O Lord, I need not to repeat
The comfort I would have
Thou know'st, O Lord
Before I ask
The blessing I do crave.

'Lẹkùn àánú t'ó sí sílẹ
F'akérora ẹṣẹ
Má se ti mọ mi Olúwa
Jẹ kí èmi wọlé.

Èmi kò ní pẹ mo ń jẹwọ
B'ayé mi ti ri ri;
Gbogbo re l' at' ẹyin wa, ni
'Wọ mọ dájúdájú.

Mo wá sí 'lẹkùn àánú Rẹ,
Ní'bi tí àánú pọ;
Mo fẹ 'daríjì ẹṣẹ mi,
K'ó mú ọkàn mi dá.

Èmi kò ní máa tẹ'nu mọ
Ìtúnú tí mo ń fẹ;
'Wọ mọ Bàbá, ki n tó bèèrè.
Ìbùkún t'emi ń wá.

Àánú, Olúwa ni mo ń fẹ
Èyí yìí l'òpin náà
Olúwa, àánú l'ó yẹ mi,
Jẹ kí àánú Rẹ wá.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: YET THERE IS ROOM!
yorubaTitle: ÀÀYE ṢÍ Ń BẸ! NÍLÉ ỌD'ÀGÙNTÀN

sections.text:
Yet there is room! The Lamb's
bright hall of song,
With its fair glory,
beckons thee a-long.
Room, room, still room,
Oh, enter, enter now!

Day is declining, and the sun
is low;
The shadows lengthen, light
makes haste to go.
Room, room, still room,
Oh enter, enter now!

The bridal hall is filling
for the feast,
Pass in, pass in! And be the
Bride-groom's guest.
Room, room, still room,
Oh enter, enter now!

Yet there is room! Still open
stands the gate
The gate of love;
it is not yet too late!
Room, room, still room,
Oh enter, enter now!

All heaven is there all joy go in go in
The angels beckon thee the prize to win
Room, room, still room,
Oh enter, enter now!

Louder and sweeter sounds the loving call;
Come, lingerer, come!
Enter that festal hall:
Room, room, still room,
Oh enter, enter now!

It fills, it fills, that hall of Jubilee!
Make haste, make haste! 'Tis not too full for thee!
Room, room, still room!
Oh enter, enter now!

Ààyè ṣí ń bẹ!
Níle Ọd'agùntàn
Ẹwà ògo Rẹ ń pè ọ pé,
“Máa bọ”
Wọlé, wọlé, wọlé
nísinsìnyíi

Ọjọ lọ tán oòrùn sì fẹrẹ
wọ; Òkùnkùn dé tán,
’mọlẹ ń kọjá lọ
Wọlé, wọlé, wọlé
nísinsìnyíi.

Ilé ìyàwó náà kún fún àsè
Wọlé, wọlé, tọ ọkọ 'yàwó
lọ
Wọlé, wọlé, wọlé
nísinsìnyíi.

Ààyè ṣí ń bẹ! Ìlẹkùn sí sílẹ
Ìlẹkùn ìfẹ ìwọ kò pẹ jù
Wọlé, wọlé, wọlé
nísinsìnyíi.

Wọlé, wọlé, tìrẹ ni àsè náà
Wá gb'ẹbùn 'fẹ ayérayé
lọfẹ, Wọlé, wọlé, wọlé
Nísinsìnyíi.

Kìkì ayọ l'ó wà ní'bẹ wọlé
Àwọn Áńgẹlì ń pè ọ fún adé
Wọlé, wọlé, wọlé
nísinsìnyìí.

L'óhùn rara ni'pè ìfẹ náà ń dún
Wá, má jáfara, wọlé àsè náà
Wọlé, wọlé, wọlé
Nísinsìnyìí.

O ń kún! O ń kún! Ilé ayọ náà ń kún!
Yára! Má se pẹ,
kò kún jù fún ọ
Wọlé, wọlé, wọlé
nísinsìnyìí.

Kí'lẹ tó sú ìlẹkùn náà lè tì
'Gbà náà o ó k'ábamọ,
Ó se! Ó se!
Ó se! Ó se! Kò sáyè mọ,
Ó se!
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS, KEEP ME NEAR THE CROSS

sections.text:
Jesus, keep me near the cross,
There a precious fountain
Free to all a healing stream,
Flows from Calv'ry's mountain.
In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever;
Till my raptured soul
Shall find
Rest beyond the river.

Near the cross, a trembling soul,
Love and mercy found me;
There the Bright and Morning Star
Sheds its beams around me.

Near the cross, O Lamb of God,
Bring its scenes before me;
Help me walk from day to day
With its shadows o'er me

Near the cross I'll watch
And wait,
Hoping, trusting ever,
Till I reach the golden strand,
Just beyond the river.
Amen.

Ní'bi Àgbélébúú Rẹ
Jésù pa mi mọ si,
Ní'b' orísun ẹjẹ ń sàn
Fún ìwòsàn ẹṣẹ.
Nínú àgbélébúú
Jésù n o màa s'ògo
Tít' ọkàn mi yó sìnmi.
L'ọdọ Olúwa mi

Ní'bi Àgbélébùú Rẹ,
Èmi ti n wárìrì
Tít' Ifẹ àt' àánú Rẹ,
Sì wá mi l'àwárí.

Ní'bi Àgbélébùú Rẹ,
Olus'agùntàn mi
Jẹ kí n rìn lójoo júmọ,
Lábẹ òjìji Rẹ.

Ní'bi Àgbélébùú Rẹ,
Èmi yó máa sọnà
N ó retí, n ó gbẹkẹl' E,
Títí dé 'nú ògo.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: O LORD HEAR MY SUPPLICATIONS

sections.text:
O Lord hear my supplications,
O listen to my secret prayer
From Thee alone, my gracious King
I would seek for my pressing help.

Thou shalt hear me early at dawn,
Early morning of every day,
I shall look upon Thee alone
To Thee I shall send my prayer.

When Lord, Thy ever standing grace
Take me to Thy gracious garden,
I shall fasten my eyes to Thee;
There I shall worship Thee humbly.

Let those who rely on
Thee Lord,
Earnestly express their
