He does full salvation
bring,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
Now with heart and voice
I sing Hallelujah!

Jesus is a wondrous name,
Now and evermore the same,
He can cleanse from
Every stain,
Only trust Him.
He will fill your soul with joy
And your talents will employ
Satan's kingdom to destroy;
Hallelujah!

If from every sin you part,
And let Christ have all
Your heart,
You need fear no fiery dart;
While you Trust Him,
For while Jesus reigns within,
You are proof against all sin,
And his perfect peace you ‘ll
win, Hallelujah!
Amen.

Ẹni ti ń gba elese
Kuro ninu ese re
Y'o wo inu okan re,
B'iwo gbagbo
Y'o le gbogbo ese lọ,
Eru at'iyemeji
Iwo y'o ma ba won kọ
Aleluya!
Aleluya! Aleluya!
Jesu li Olugbala
T'o mu 'gbala kikan wa
Aleluya! Aleluya!
Mo le f'itara korin,
Aleluya!

Jesu Oruko 'yanu,
Ọkan náà ni titi laé
Ò ń wę gbogbo abawọn
Ẹsẹ wa nù
Y'o f'ayo kun okan re,
Lati fọ 'jọba esu,
Aleluya!

B'o ba kọ ẹṣẹ sílẹ,
K'o si pe Jésù wọle
Ko si ọta t'o le d'ẹru ba ọ mọ
Ibi tí Jésù ń jọba,
Ẹṣẹ ko lè jọba mọ
Y'o fún ọ l'aláàfià,
Aleluya! Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHAT CAN WASH AWAY MY SIN?
yorubaTitle: KÍ LỌ LÈ W'ẸṢẸ MI NÙ?

sections.text:
What can wash away my sin?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
What can make me whole
again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!

Oh, precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow!
No other fount l know;
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!

For my cleansing this I see-
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
For my pardon this my plea-
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!

Nothing can for sin atone-
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
Nothing of good that I have
done-
Nothing but the blood of Jesus

This is all my hope and peace
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
This is all my righteousness
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
Amen.

Kí ló lè w'ẹṣẹ mi nù?
Kò sí lẹyìn ẹjẹ Jésù.
Kí ló tún lè wò mí sàn?
Kò sí lẹyìn ẹjẹ Jésù.

Àà! Ẹjẹ 'yebíye,
T'ó mú mi fun bíi sno,
Kò sí'sun mìíràn mọ,
Kò sí lẹyìn ẹjẹ Jésù.

Fún 'wẹnúmọ mi n kò rí
'Kan míl, lẹyìn ẹjẹ Jésù
Ohun tí mo gbẹkẹlé,
Fún 'daríjì, l'ẹjẹ Jésù.

Ètùtù f'ẹṣẹ kò sí,
Kò sí lẹyìn ẹjẹ Jésù.
Iṣẹ rere kàn kò sí
Kò sí lẹyìn ẹjẹ Jésù.

Gbogbo ìgbẹkẹlé mi,
Ìrètí mi l'ẹjẹ Jésù;
Gbogbo òdodo mi,
Ẹjẹ kìkì ẹjẹ Jésù.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WITHIN THE VEIL: BE THIS, BELOV'D, THY PORTION
yorubaTitle: NIBI 'KOKO', K'EYI LE JE IPIN RE

sections.text:
"Within the veil:" be this, belov'd, thy portion,
Within the secret of thy Lord to dwell;
Beholding Him, until thy face His glory,
Thy life His love, thy lips His praise shall tell.

"Within the Veil," for only as thou gazest
Upon the matchless beauty of His face
Canst thou become a living revelation
Of His great heart of love, His untold grace.

"Within the veil," His fragrance pour'd upon thee,
Without the Veil, that fragrance shed abroad
"Within the Veil His hand shall tune the music
Which sounds on earth the praise of thy Lord.

"Within the Veil," thy spirit deeply anchored,
Thou walkest calm above a world of strife;
"Within the Veil," thy soul with Him united,
Shall live on earth His resurrection life.
Amen.

“Ní'bi 'kọkọ:” K'éyìí lè jẹ ìpín rẹ:
Ní'bi 'kọkọ pẹlú Olúwa rẹ
Tejú mọ ògo Olúwa rẹ níbẹ
Máa fi ayé rẹ kọrin ìyìn sí I.

“Ní'bi 'kọkọ”, sá tẹjú mọ Olúwa:
Máa se àfẹrí ẹwà ojú Rẹ,
Kí 'wọ lè rí àwòrán Rẹ l'ára rẹ;
Àt'oore-ọfẹ ìyanu fún ọ.

“Ní'bi 'kọkọ”, yóó da òróró ayọ:
'Wọ yóó máa mú ayọ wá f'ẹlòmí,
“Ní'bi 'kọkọ”, Òun yóó kọ mi lí orin;
Gbogbo ayé yóó f'ayọ gberin náà.

“Ní'bi 'kọkọ”, ibi ìsinmi f'ọkàn rẹ:
Rúdurùdu ayé kò lè mì ọ,
“Ní'bi 'kọkọ”, ìwọ d'ọkan pẹlú Rẹ;
Ayé yóó sì dàbí ọrun fún ọ.
Àmín

englishTitle: HE GAVE TO ME A SEAL

sections.text:
He gave to me a seal
Of the great debt I owe
And as He gave, He smiled
and said,
“Always remember Me.”

He gave to me a seal
All of my debts He paid,
And as He gave He smiled
and said
“Always remember Me.”

I shall treasure the seal,
Though the debts is all paid,
The seal told of the love
of One
Who paid the debt for me.

I looked at it and smiled,
Again, I looked and wept
The earnest of His love for me
I'll ever treasure it.

It is more than a seal
It is in remembrance,
That all the debt of sin
Was paid,
By Lord Emmanuel.
Amen.

Ó fún mi lédìídí
'Gbèsè ńlá tí mo ję;
B'Ó ti fún mi Ó sì rẹrín
Pé, “Má se gbàgbé mi!”

Ó fún mi lédìídí
Ó san ìgbèsè nàá;
B'Ó ti fún mi Ó sì rẹrín
Wí pe, “Máa rántí Mi!”

N ó p'èdìídí náà mọ
Bí 'gbèsè tilẹ tán;
Ó ń sọ ìfẹ ẹni t' ó san
Ìgbèsè náà fún mi

Kíi tún s'èdìídí mọ
Sùgbọn ìrántí ni:
Pé gbogbo ìgbèsè mi ni
Ìmmanueli san.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: MORE LOVE TO THEE
yorubaTitle: KÍ N FẸ Ọ SÍ Í KRÍSTÌ

sections.text:
More love to Thee, O Christ,
More love to Thee!
Hear Thou the pray'r I make,
On bended knee;
This is my earnest plea,
More love O Christ,
To Thee
More love to Thee,
More love to Thee.

Once earthly joy I craved,
Sought peace and rest!
Now Thee a-lone I seek
Give what is best!
This all my pray'r shall be,
More love O Christ,
to Thee,
More love to Thee,
More love to Thee.

Let sorrow do its work,
Send grief and pain;
Sweet are thy messengers,
Sweet their refrain,
When they can sing with me.
More love O Christ,
to Thee,
More love to Thee,
More love to Thee.

Then shall my latest breath,
Whisper Thy praise;
This be the parting cry,
My heart shall raise,
This still its prayer shall be
More love O Christ,
to Thee,
More love to Thee,
More love to Thee. Amen

Kí n fẹ Ọ síí Krístì
Kí n fẹ Ọ síí!
Gb'àdúrà tí mo ń gbà
L'ór'éékún mi;
Èyí ni ẹbẹ mi;
Kí n fẹ Ọ síí Krístì
Kí n fẹ Ọ síí
Kí n fẹ Ọ síí.

L'ẹẹkan ohun ayé
Ni mo ń tọrọ
Nísinsinyí, 'Wọ nìkan
Ni èmi ń wá;
Èyí l'àdúrà mi,
Kí n fẹ Ọ síi Krístì
Kí n fẹ Ọ síi
Kí n fẹ Ọ síi.

Jẹ kí 'bànújẹ dé,
Àt'irora,
Dídùn l'òjíṣẹ Rẹ,
Àt'iṣẹ wọn
Gbà wọn bá mi kọrin
Kí n fẹ Ọ síi Krístì
Kí n fẹ Ọ síi
Kí n fẹ Ọ síi.

Njẹ òpin ẹmí mi
Y'ó jíyìn Rẹ
Èyí y'ó jẹ ọrọ
Ìkeyìn mi;
Àdúrà mi y'ó jẹ;
Kí n fẹ Ọ síi Krístì
Kí n fẹ Ọ síi
Kí n fẹ Ọ síi.
Ààmín

englishTitle: BLEST BE THE TIE

sections.text:
Blest be the tie that binds
Our hearts in Christian
love,
The fellowship of kindred
minds;
Is like to that above.

Before our Father's throne,
We pour our ardent prayers,
Our fears, our hopes, our aims are one;
Our comforts and our cares.

We share our mutual woes,
Our mutual burdens bear,
And often for each other flows,
The sympathizing tear.

When we asunder part,
It gives us inward pain;
But we shall still be joined in heart,
And hope to meet again
Amin.

Bukun ni fun ohun,
T'o de wa po n'nu 'fe,
Idapo awon olufe,
Dabi ijo t'orun.

Niwaju 'te Baba,
Li awa n gbadaura,
Okan ni'reti at'eru,
Ati ni itunu.

Awa n ba'ra wa pin,
Ninu wahala wa,
Awa si n ba'ra wa sokun;
Ninu 'banuje wa.

Nigba t'a ba pinya,
Inu wa a baje,
Sibe okan wa y'o jokan,
N'ireti ipade.
Aamin.

englishTitle: OH LOVE OF GOD HOW STRONG AND TRUE

sections.text:
O Love of God, how strong and true,
Eternal, and yet ever new,
Uncomprehended and unbought,
Beyond all knowledge and all thought!

O heavenly love,
how precious still,
In days of weariness and ill,
In night of pain and helplessness,
To heal, to comfort,
And to bless!

O wide-embracing
wondrous love,
We read Thee in the
sky above;
We read Thee in the earth
below,
In seas that swell and
streams that flow.

We read Thee in the flowers,
the trees,
The freshness of the fragrant
breeze,
The songs of birds upon
the wing,
The joy of summer
and of spring.

We read Thee best in Him
who came
And bore for us the cross
of shame,
Sent by the Father from
on high,
Our life to live, our death
to die.

O love of God, our shield
and stay
Through all the perils
of our way;
Eternal love, in Thee we
rest.
For ever safe, for ever bless.
Amen

Ìfẹ Ọlọrun, 'yebíye
Wà títí ayé, láilópin:
Ìfẹ pípé aílábàwọn,
T'ó kọjá òye gbogb' ẹdá.

Ìfẹ Ọlọrun ti dùn tó
Nígbà àárẹ àt' àìlera
Ń'n'ohun gbogbo,
L'ọsàn-án, l'óru
Fún 'ranwọ,
Òun 'bùkún ọrun.

Ìyanu ìjìnlẹ ìfẹ;
A rí ọ ń'nú ẹdá ọrun
Àní gbogbo' ẹdá alààyè
Ń fi hàn pé 'fẹ ni Ọlọrun.

Ewéko 'gbẹ ń f'ògo Rẹ hàn;
Afẹfẹ ń sọ t'agbára Rẹ:
Àwọn ẹyẹ ń kọ 'rin 'yìn Rẹ
Ìgbà t'ó ń yí ń sọ t'ifẹ náà.

A rí ìjìnlẹ ìfẹ yìí
Nínú Jésù Olùgbàlà
Ẹni t'ó ku t'or'ẹsẹ wa
T'ó kú, k' òun lè gba ni là.

Ìfẹ Ọlọrun, ààbò wa!
Nínú ewu àti 'pọnjú
Ìfẹ ńlá yìí l'a sinmi lé
Fún 'rànwọ òun ìgbàlà wa.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: MY TIMES ARE IN THY HAND
yorubaTitle: ÌGBÀ MI Ń BẸ NI ỌWỌ RẸ

sections.text:
My times are in Thy hand,
My God, I wish them there;
My life, my friends my soul
I leave
Entirely to Thy care.

My times are in Thy hand,
Whatever they may be,
Pleasing or painful,
dark or bright,
As best may seem to Thee.

My times are in Thy hand,
Why should I doubt or fear?
A father's hand will never cause
His child a needless fear.

My times are in Thy hand,
Jesus the crucified;
The hand my cru-el sins had pierced,
Is now my guard and guide.

My times are in Thy hand,
I'll always trust in Thee,
And after death at Thy right hand,
I shall for ever be.
Amen.

Ìgbà mi ńbẹ ní ọwọ Rẹ,
Mo fẹ k'ó wà níbẹ;
Mo f'ara, ọrẹ, ẹmi mi,
Sí abẹ ìsọ Rẹ.

Ìgbà mi ń bẹ ní ọwọ Rẹ,
Ẹyí tó wù kó ję
Dídùn ni tàbí kíkoró
B'Ó bá ti ríi p'ó tọ

Ìgbà mi ń bẹ ní ọwọ Rẹ,
Èmi yóó se bẹrù?
Bàbá kì y'ó ję k'ọmọ Rẹ
Sọkún lí àinídìí.

Ìgbà mi ń bẹ ní ọwọ Rẹ,
Jésù t'á kàn mọ'gi;
Ọwọ náà t'ẹṣẹ mi dálu
Wá di aláàbò mi.

Ìgbà mi ń bẹ ní ọwọ Rẹ,
N o máa sinmi lé Ọ;
Lẹyìn ikú, l'ọw'ọtun Rẹ
L'èm'ó wà títí láé.
Ààmín

englishTitle: JESUS MY LORD, MY GOD, MY ALL

sections.text:
Jesus my Lord, my God,
my All,
Hear me, blest Saviour when
I call;
Hear me, and from Thy
dwelling place;
Pour down the riches of
Thy grace;
Jesus my Lord,
I Thee adore,
Oh make me love Thee
more and more.

Jesus, too late I Thee have
sought,
How can I love Thee
as I ought?
And how extol Thy
matchless fame,
The glorious beauty of
Thy name?

Jesus, what didst Thou find in me,
That Thou hast dealt so lovingly?
How great the joy that Thou hast brought?
So far exceeding hope or thought!

Jesus, of Thee shall be my song,
To Thee my heart and soul belong,
All that I have or am is Thine,
And Thou blest Saviour; Thou art mine. Amen.

Jésù Olúwa Ọba mi,
Gb'ohùn mi nígbà tí
mo ń pè,
Gb'ohùn mi làti 'bùgbé
Rẹ,
Rọ'jò oore-ọfẹ sí 'lẹ.
Olúwa mi mo fẹràn
Rẹ,
Jẹ kí n lè máa fẹràn
Rẹ sí i.

Jésù, mo ti jáfara jù,
N ó se lè fẹ Ọ b'ó ti yẹ?
Em'ó se lè gb'ogo Rẹ ga
Àti ẹwà orúkọ Rẹ?

Jésù, kí l'O rí ninu mi,
Tí 'fẹ náà fi pọ to bàyìí?
Oore Rẹ sí mi ti pọ tó?
Ó ta gbogbo èrò mi yọ.

Jésù, wọ ó ję orin mi,
Tirẹ àyà àt'ọkàn mi,
Tirẹ ni gbogbo ínì mi,
Olùgbàlà, 'Wọ ni t'èmi. Ààmín.

englishTitle: ONE THERE IS ABOVE ALL OTHERS
yorubaTitle: ẸNÌKAN Ń BẸ T'O FẸRÀN WA

sections.text:
One there is above all others,
Oh, how He loves!
His is love beyond a brother's,
Oh, how He loves!
Earthly friend may fail or leave us,
One day soothe, the next day grieve us,
But this friend will ne'er deceive us,
Oh, how He loves!

'Tis eternal life to know Him,
Oh, how He loves!
Think, o think, how much we owe Him;
Oh, how He loves!
With His precious blood He bought us.
In the wilderness He sought us,
To His fold He safely brought us,
Oh, how He loves!

We have found a friend in Jesus,
Oh, how He loves!
'Tis His great delight to bless us,
Oh, how He loves!
How our hearts delight to hear Him?
Bid us dwell in safety near Him,
Why should we distrust or fear Him?
Oh, how He loves!

Through His name we are forgiven,
Oh, how He loves!
Backward shall our foes be driven,
Oh, how He loves!
Best of blessings He'll provide us,
Naught but good shall e'er betide us,
Safe to glory He will guide us,
Oh, how He loves!
Amen.

Ẹnìkan ń bẹ t'ó fẹràn wa,
Àà! Ó fẹ wa!
Ìfẹ Rẹ ju t'ìyekan lọ,
Àà! Ó fẹ wa!
Ọrẹ ayé ń kọ wa sílẹ,
B'ònìí dùn, ọla lè korò,
Sùgbọn ọrẹ yìí kì ń tàn ni;
Àà! Ó fẹ wa!

Ìyè ni fún wa b'á bá mọ Ọn,
Àà! Ó fẹ wa!
Rò bá ti ję ní gbèsè tó;
Àà! Ó fẹ wa!
Ẹjẹ Rẹ ló sì fi rà wá,
Nín'aginjù l'ó wá wa rí,
Ó sì mú wa wá s'agbo Rẹ,
Àà! Ó fẹ wa!

Ọrẹ òdodo ni Jésù,
Àà! Ó fẹ wa!
Ó fẹ láti máa bùkún wa;
Àà! Ó fẹ wa!
Ọkàn wa fẹ gbọ ohùn Rẹ,
Ọkàn wa fẹ láti sún mọ Ọn,
Òun náà kò sì ní tàn wá jẹ;
Àà! Ó fẹ wa!

englishTitle: WOULD YOU KNOW WHY I LOVE JESUS
yorubaTitle: 'WỌ HA MỌ PÉ MỌ FẸ JÉSÙ?

sections.text:
Why He is so dear to me?
'Tis because my blessed Saviour
From my sins has ransomed me.
This is why I love my Je...sus.
This is why I love Him so:
He has pardoned my transgres...sion,
He has washed me while as snow.

Would you know
Why I love Jesus?
Why He is so dear to me?
'Tis because the blood of Jesus
Fully saves and cleanses me.

Would you know
why I love Jesus?
Why He is so dear to me?
'Tis because, amid
Temptation,
He supports and
strengthens me.

Would you know why
I love Jesus?
Why He is so dear to me?
'Tis because, in ev'ry conflict,
Jesus gives me victory.

Would you know why
I love Jesus?
Why He is so dear to me?
'Tis because my Friend
And Saviour,
He will ever, ever be.
Amen

'Wọ ha mọ pé mọ fẹ Jésù?
Pe Ó sọwọn fún mi jù?
Ó gbà mí nínú ẹṣẹ mi,
'Torí Òun l'Olúwa mi.
Èyí ló mú kí n fẹràn Rẹ,
Ló mú mi fẹràn Jésù;
Ó dárí gbob'ẹṣẹ mi jì
Ó sì wẹ mí mọ láúláú.

'Wọ ha mọ pé mọ fẹ Jésù?
Pe Ó sọwọn fún mi jù?
Ó gbà mí Ó sì wẹ mí mọ;
Nínú ẹjẹ 'yebíye.

'Wọ ha mọ pé mo fẹ Jésù?
Pe Ó sọwọn fún mi jù?
Ó ń gbà mí Ó ń ràn mí
lọwọ;
Nínú gbogbo ìdánwò.

'Wọ ha mọ pé mo fẹ Jésù?
Pe Ó sọwọn fún mi jù?
Òun l'ó ń fún mi ní
Ìṣẹgun;
Nínú gbogbo ìsòro.

'Wọ ha mọ pé mo fẹ Jésù?
Pe Ó sọwọn fún mi jù?
Olúwa àt' Ọrẹ mi ni;
Nísìnyí àti láéláé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: MY JESUS I LOVE THEE
yorubaTitle: JESU, MO FẸ Ọ MO MỌ P'O JẸ

sections.text:
My Jesus, I love Thee,
I know Thou art mine,
For Thee all the pleasures of
sin I resign;
My gracious Redeemer, my
Saviour art Thou,
If ever I loved Thee,
My Jesus, 'tis now!

I love Thee because Thou
hast first lovèd me,
And purchased my pardon
when nailed to the tree;
I love Thee for wearing the
thorns on Thy brow;
If ever loved Thee, my Jesus
'tis now!

I'll love Thee in life, I will
love Thee in death;
And praise Thee as long as
Thou lendest me breath,
And say, should the death
dew lie could on my brow,
If ever I loved Thee,
My Jesus 'tis now!

In mansions of glory and
endless delight,
I'll ever adore Thee in
heaven so bright;
I'll sing with the glittering
crown on my brow.
If ever I loved Thee,
My Jesus, 'tis now!
Amen.

Jesu, mo fẹ Ọ mo mọ
p'O jẹ t'èmi,
Mo f'ayé ẹṣẹ sílẹ nítorí
Rẹ;
Ìwọ l'Olùgbàlà,
Olùràpadà;
Bí n kò fẹ Ọ tẹlẹ,
Ńsìnyí, mo fẹ Ọ.

Mo fẹ Ọ nítorí 'Wọ
ló kọkọ fẹ mi,
O ra 'dáríjì fún mi ní
Kálfàri
Mo fẹ Ọ 'Wọ ló d'ádé
ẹgún fún mi:
Bí n kò fẹ Ọ tẹlẹ,
Ńsìnyí, mo fẹ Ọ.

N ó máa fẹ Ọ ní yíyè tàbí
ní kíkú,
N ó fi gbogbo ọjọ ayé mi
yìn Ọ;
Nígbà ikú n ó sì kọ orin
yí pé:
Bí n kò fẹ Ọ tẹlẹ,
Ńsinyí mo fẹ Ọ.

Nínú ògo dí-dán ti
àìnípẹkun,
Ìwọ l'èmi a máa f'iyìn
fún títí;
N ó kọrin pẹl'ádé ògo
lórí mi,
Bí n kò fẹ Ọ tẹlẹ,
Ńsinyí mo fẹ Ọ. Ààmín.

englishTitle: GOD IS LOVE: THAT ANTHEM OLDEN

sections.text:
God is love: that anthem
olden,
Sing the glorious orbs of light
In their language glad
and golden.
Telling to us day and night
Their great story.
God is love and God is light.

Through that precious love
He sought us,
Wandering from His holy
ways,
With that precious Life
He bought us;
Then let all our future days,
Tell this story!
Love is life-our lives be
praise.

Gladsome is the theme
and glorious,
Praise to Christ our gracious
Head,
Christ, the risen Christ,
victorious,
Death and hell hath captiv led.
Glory, glory!
Love is life-and Death is dead.

Up to Him let each affection
Daily rise and round
Him move;
Our whole lives one
resurrection,
To the Life of life above;
Their glad story.
God is life, and God is love.
Amen.

Ìfẹ li Ọlọrun: kọrin
Kọrin ògo tí kíí sá
Kí gbogbo orílẹ-èdè
Kọrin náà t'sán t'òru
Sọ ìtàn náà!
Pé ìfẹ li Ọlọrun.

A! Ìtàn náà ti dùn pọ tó,
Ògo ni f'Olùgbàlà
Krístì jínde Ó ti ṣẹgun
Ikú, ọrun-àpáàdì
Ògo ni fún Ọd'àgùntàn
Ó gbé 'kú mì ní 'ṣẹgun.

À bá lè túnbo fẹràn Rẹ!
Kí 'fẹ wa máa gbóná síi;
K'á fi gbogb'ayé wa rúbọ
Ẹbọ ààyè f'Ọlọrun;
Títí l'a ó máa kọ orin náà
Pé ìfẹ li Ọlọrun.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS LOVER OF MY SOUL

sections.text:
Jesus, lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bossom fly,
While the nearer waters roll,
While the tempest still is high;
Hide me, o my Saviour, hide
Till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide,
Oh, receive my soul at last.

Thou, o Christ! Art all I want;
More than all in Thee I find:
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
Heal the sick and lead the blind.
Just and holy is Thy name,
I am all unrighteousness;
Vile and full of sin I am,
Thou art full of truth and grace.

Plenteous grace with Thee is found,
Grace to cover all my sin;
Let the healing streams abound,
Make and keep me pure within:
Thou of life the fountain art,
Freely let me take of Thee;
Spring thou up within my heart,
Rise to all eternity.
Amen.

Jésù Olùf'ọkàn mi,
Jẹ kí n sá là s'áyà Rẹ,
Sáà t'irúmi sún mọ mi;
Sáà tí ìjì ń fẹ s'ókè,
Pa mí mọ Olùgbàlà,
Tít'ìjì ayé y'ó pin,
Tọ mi lọ s'ébuté Rẹ;
Níkeyìn gba ọkàn mi.

Ààbò míì, èmi kò ní,
Ìwọ l'ọkàn mi rọ mọ,
Má f'èmi nikan sílẹ,
Gba mí, sì tù mí nínú;
Ìwọ n'ìrànlọwọ mi,
Má sài f'iyẹ apá Rẹ,
D'áàbò b'orí àìbò mi.

Krístì 'Wọ nìkan ni mo fẹ,
Ń'nú Rẹ, mo r'óhun gbogbo,
Gb'ẹni t'ó subú dìde,
W'aláisàn, tọ afọjú,
Aláis'òdodo l'èmi;
Mo kún fún ẹṣẹ púpọ
Ìwọ kún fún òdodo.

'Wọ l'ọpọ oore-ọfẹ,
Láti fi bọ ẹṣẹ mi,
Jẹ kí omi ìwòsàn
Wẹ inú ọkàn mi mọ;
Ìwọ l'orísun ìyè,
Jẹ kí n bù ń'nú Rẹ l'ọfẹ;
Ru jáde ń'nú ọkàn mi,
Sí iyè àinípẹkun.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE KING OF LOVE MY SHEPHERD IS

sections.text:
The king of love my shepherd is,
Whose good-ness fail-eth nev-er;
I no-thing lack if I am His
And He is mine for ev-er.

Where streams of liv-ing wa-ter flow,
My ran-somed soul He lead-eth,
And where the ver-dant pas-tures grow;
With food ce-les-tial feed-eth.

Per-verse and fool-ish oft I strayed,
But yet in love He sought me,
And on His- shoul-der gen-tly- laid,
And home rejoic-ing
Brought me.

In death's dark vale
I fear no ill
With Thee, dear Lord, beside me;
Thy rod and staff my comfort still
Thy cross before to guide me.

Thou spread'st a table in my sight;
Thy unction grace bestoweth:
And O what transport of delight
From Thy pure chalice floweth!

And so through all the length of days,
Thy goodness faileth never;
Good Shepherd, may I sing Thy praise
Within Thy house for ever.
Amen.

Jésù l'Olùṣọ-àgùntàn mi
Oore ẹni tí kíí yẹ
Kò s'éwu bí mo jẹ Tirẹ
T'Òun sì jẹ t'èmi títí.

Ní'b'odò omi ìyè ń sàn
Ní'bẹ l'Ó ń m'ọkàn mi lọ
Ní'bi tí oko tútù ń hù
L' Ó ń fọúnjẹ ọrun bọ mi.

Mo ti fi wèrè sáko lọ
Ní'fẹ Ó sì wá mi rí
L'éjiká Rẹ l' Ó gbé mi sí
Ó f'ayọ mú mi wà 'lé.

N kò bẹrù òjiji ikú
Bí 'Wọ bá wà lọdọ mi
Ọgọ Rẹ àti ọpá Rẹ
Àwọn l'ó tù mí nínú.

Ìwọ tẹ tábìlì fún mi
'Wọ d'òróró s'órí mi
Háà! Ayọ náà ha ti pọ to?
Tí ń t'ọdọ Rẹ wá bá mi.

Bẹẹ, l'ọjọ ayé mi gbogbo
Oore Rẹ kì ó yẹ láé
Olùs'àgùntàn ń ó yìn Ọ
Nínú ilé Rẹ títí.
Àmín.

englishTitle: THE LOVE THAT JESUS HAS FOR ME
yorubaTitle: ÌFẸ TÌ JÉSÙ NÍ SÍ MÍ

sections.text:
The love that Jesus had for me,
To suffer on the cruel tree,
That I a ransomed soul might be,
Is more than tongue can tell.

His love is more than
tongue can tell
His love is more than
tongue can tell
(Than tongue can tell ...)
The love that Jesus
Has for me,
Is more than tongue
can tell.

The bitter sorrow that
He bore,
And oh, that crown of thorns
He wore;
That I might live for
evermore,
Is more than tongue can tell.

The peace I have in Him,
my Lord;
Who plead before the throne
of God,
The merit of His precious
blood,
Is more than tongue can tell.

The joy that comes when
He is near,
The rest He gives so free
from fear,
The hope in Him so bright
And clear,
Is more than tongue can tell.
Amen.

Ìfẹ tí Jésú ní sí mi,
T'Ó jìyà l'ór' àgbélébùú,
Kí n ba lè d'ẹni 'ràpadà;
Jù 'yìí t'áhọn lè sọ.

Ìfẹ Rẹ sí mi pọ jọjọ,
Ìfẹ Rẹ sí mi pọ jọjọ,
(Jù 'yìí tí mo lè ròyìn
lọ;)
Ìfẹ tì Jésú ní sí mi,
Jù 'yìí t'áḥọn lè sọ.

Ìyà kíkòrò tí Ó jẹ,
Àt'adé ẹgún t'á fí dé E,
Kí n ba lè yè títí ayé,
Jù 'yìí t'áḥọn lè sọ.

Ìbàlẹ ọkàn t'Ó ń fún mi,
Ẹbẹ t'Ó ń bẹ fún mi l'ókè,
Òore t'ẹjẹ Rẹ ń se fún mi,
Jù 'yìí t'áḥọn lè sọ.

Ayọ tí mo ní nínú Rẹ,
Ìsinmi àt'àlàáfíà;
Ìrètí pé Ó tún ń bọ wá,
Jù 'yìí t'áḥọn lè sọ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: O HAPPY DAY THAT FIXED MY CHOICE
yorubaTitle: ỌJỌ ŃLÁ L'ỌJỌ TÍ MO YAN

sections.text:
Oh happy day that fixed
my choice
On Thee, my Saviour
and my God.
Well may this glowing heart
rejoice,
And tell its raptures all

a-broad.
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my
sins away
He taught me how to
watch and pray
And live rejoicing
every day.
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my
sins away.

O happy bond, that seals
my vows
To Him who merits all my
love;
Let cheerful anthems fill His
house,
While to that sacred shrine I
move.

'Tis done; the great
transaction's done
I am my Lord's and He is mine
He drew me, and I
followed on
Charmed to confess the
voice divine.

Now rest, my long-divided
heart,
Fixed on this blissful centre,
rest;
Nor ever from thy Lord
depart,
With Him of every good
possessed.

High heav'n, that heard the
solemn vow,
That vow renewed shall
daily hear,
Till in life's latest hour I bow,
And bless in death a bond
So dear.
Amen.

Ọjọ ńlá l'ọjọ tí mo yan
Òlùgbàlà l'Ọlọrun mi;
Ó yẹ kí ọkàn mi máa yọ,
K'ó sì ròyìn náà ká 'lẹ.

Ọjọ́ ńlá l'ọjọ́ náà!
Tí Jésù wẹ ẹṣẹ mi nù:
Ó kọ mi kí n máa
Gbàdúrà
Kí n máa sọra, kí n sì
máa yọ,
Ọjọ́ ńlá l'ọjọ́ náà!
Tí Jésù wẹ ẹṣẹ mi nù.

Isẹ ìgbàlà parí ná,
Mo di t'Olúwa mi lónìí,
Òun ló pè mí tí mo sì jẹ
Mo f'ayọ j'ípè mímọ náà,

Ẹjẹ mímọ yíi ni mo jẹ,
F'Ẹni tó yẹ láti fẹràn;
Jẹ k'orin dídùn kún 'lé Rẹ,
Nígbà mo bá n lọ sìn ní'bẹ.

Sinmi àìdúró ọkàn mi,
Sinmi lé Jésù Olúwa;
Tani jẹ wí pé ayé dùn
Ju ọdọ àwọn Ańgẹli?

Ẹyin ọrun gbọ ẹjẹ mi,
Ẹjẹ mi ní ojooJúmọ
Èm' ó máa sọ ọ dọtun títí
Ikú y'ó fi mú mi re'lé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: A WONDERFUL SAVIOUR IS JESUS MY LORD

sections.text:
A Wonderful Saviour is Jesus my Lord,
A Wonderful Saviour to me,
He hideth my soul in the cleft of the rock,
When rivers of pleasure I see.
He hideth my soul in the cleft of the rock,
That shadows a dry thirsty land;
He hideth my life in the depth of His love
And covers me there with His hand.

A wonderful Saviour is Jesus my Lord,
He taketh my burden away,
He holdeth me up, and I shall not be moved,
He giveth me strength as my day.

With numberless blessing Each moment he crowns
And filled with His fullness divine;
I sing in my rapture, Oh, glory to God
For such a Redeemer as mine.

When clothed in His brightness Transported I rise,
To meet Him in clouds of the sky,
His perfect salvation, His wonderful love,
I'll shout with the millions on high. Amen.

Jèsù Olúwa mi, Ẹni'yanu ni,
Olùgbàlà ìyanu ni,
Ó fọkàn mi pamọ sí'nú àpáta;
Ní'bi tí omi ìyè ń sàn.
Ó fọkàn mi pamọ
sí'nú àpáta,
Ó sì ń tẹ òngbẹ mi lọrùn,
Ó n'apá ifẹ àt'àánú
Rẹ bò mí;
Ó ń fi ọwọ'tún Rẹ tọ mi.

Jèsù Olúwa mi, Ẹni'yanu ni,
Ó kó gbogbo ẹṣẹ mi lọ,
Ó ń gbé mi sókè,
Ẹṣẹ mi kò lè yẹ;
Ó ń sọ agbára mi d'ọtun.

Ọpẹ ni fún aláilẹṣọ ẹbùn Rẹ,
Ó ń tọjú, Ó sì ń bùkún mi,
Mo bú s'ayo mo ń f'ògo fún Olúwa;
Fún ìgbàlà ńlá bí èyí.

Y'ó pa mí láradà y'ó gbé mi sókè,
Láti pàdé Rẹ ní sanmọ
Ìgbàlà kíkún yìí, ifẹ 'yanu yìí;
L'èmi ó máa fi s'orin kọ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: O LORD, WOULD THY PARDON

sections.text:
O Lord, would Thy pardon accept
Such a sinner like me?
Has my sins been carried away
And has Thou made me glad?

Could it be that the Cross you bore
For me, despising shame?
Ought I then, Lord, to be ashamed
Of thus being baptised?

Thou made Thyself an example
In waters of Jordan;
Why should my pride refuse to yield
To do what Thou has done?

Jesus, the zeal of love Thou shows
Blames my own cold response,
But my feet now is swift to walk
In the way of Thy will.
Amen.

Olúwa nje 'dárìjì Rẹ
Yóó gb'ẹni bí èmi?
Njẹ, O ó gbé ẹṣẹ mi kúrò
O ó f'ẹrín bùkún mi?

Njẹ fún mi l'ór'àgbélébúú
Láìnáání ẹgàn Rẹ?
Jésù, ó ha tọ kí n tijú
Bíbá Ọ lọ s'ódò?

O se 'ra Rẹ l'ápẹẹrẹ ílá
Lí odò Jọdánì?
Ìgbéraga mi yóó ha kọ
Láti s'ohun t'Ó se?

Jésù, ìtara ìfẹ Rẹ
Ń bá ìlọra mi wí;
Ẹṣẹ mi nísìnyí sì ń rìn
Lí ọnà dídùn Rẹ.
Amin.

englishTitle: I HEAR THY WELCOME VOICE

sections.text:
I hear Thy welcome voice,
That calls me, Lord, to Thee,
For cleansing in Thy precious blood;
That flowed on Calvary.
I am coming Lord,
Coming now to Thee:
Trusting only in the blood
That flowed on Calvary.

Tho' coming weak and vile,
Thou dost my strength assure:
Thou dost my vileness fully cleanse.
Till spotless all and pure.

'Tis Jesus calls me on,
To perfect faith and love,
To perfect hope, and peace, and trust
For earth and heaven above.

'Tis Jesus who confirms,
The blessed work within,
By adding grace to welcomed grace;
Where reigned the power of sin.

And He the witness gives,
To loyal hearts and free,
That every promise is fulfilled;
If faith but brings the plea.

All hail, th' atoning blood!
All hail, redeeming grace!
All hail, the gift of Christ our Lord,
Our strength and righteousness!
Amen.

Mo gb'óhùn Rẹ Jésù,
Ti ń pè mí s'ọdọ Rẹ,
Fún 'wẹnúmọ ń'nú ẹjẹ Rẹ;
T'ó ń sàn ni Kálfári
Mo ń bọ Olúwa,
Mo ń bọ l'ọdọ Rẹ,
Wẹ mi mọ ń'nú ẹjẹ Rẹ;
T'ó ń sàn ni Kálfári.

Ẹṣẹ ti bà mí jẹ,
N kò ní agbára kan,
'Wọ ló lè wẹ mí l'áwẹmọ;
Láisí àbàwọn kan.

Jésù li ó pè mí,
Sí ìgbàgbọ pípé
Sí 'rètí, ifẹ Àlàáfíà;
Sí 'lúú ọrun lókè.

Jésù l'ó sisẹ náà,
Ló sọ mí d'àtúnbí,
Ló ń fún mi l'oore-ọfẹ Rẹ;
T'ẹṣẹ kò lè borí.

Ó sọ mí d'òm'nira
Ó ń jẹrii nínú mi,
O ń mú 'lèérí Rẹ sí mi;
'Gbà tí mo bá gbàgbọ.

Ọpẹ fún ẹjẹ Rẹ,
Ọpẹ f'óor'ọfẹ Rẹ,
Ọpẹ f'ẹbùn Olùgbàlà
Jésù, Òdodo wa.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HAVE YOU BEEN TO JESUS
yorubaTitle: S'Ó TI LỌ BÁ JÉSÙ F'ÁGBÁRA 'WẸNÚMỌ?

sections.text:
Have you been to Jesus for the cleansing power?
Are you wash'd in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you fully trusting in His grace this hour?
Are you wash'd in the blood of the Lamb?

Are you wash'd in the blood-
In the soul-cleansing blood
of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless?
Are they white as snow?
Are you wash'd in the
blood of the Lamb?

Are you walking daily by the
Savior's side?
Are you wash'd in the blood
of the Lamb?
Do you rest each moment in
the Crucified?
Are you wash'd in the blood
of the Lamb?

When the Bridegroom cometh
Will your robes be white?
Pure and white in the blood
of the Lamb?
Will your soul be ready for
the mansions bright?
And be washed in the blood
of the Lamb?

Lay aside the garments that
are stained with sin,
And be washed in the blood
of the Lamb!
There's a fountain flowing
for the soul unclean
Oh, be washed in the blood
of the Lamb!
Amen.

S'ó ti lọ bá Jésù f'ágbára 'wẹnúmọ?
S'á wẹ ọ nín'ẹj'Ọd'àgùntàn?
Ìwọ ha gbẹkẹlé oore-ọfẹ Rẹ?
S'á wẹ ọ nín'ẹj'Ọd'àgùntàn?

S'á wę ọ nín'ẹjẹ?
Nínú ẹjẹ tí ọ wę ọkàn mọ?
Asọ rę ha funfun, s'ó sì mọ
láúláú?
S'á wę ọ nín'ẹj'Ọd'àgùntàn?

S'ó ń bá Olùgbàlà rìn
lójoojúmọ?
S'á wę ọ nín'ẹj'Ọd'àgùntàn?
O ha ń gbẹkẹlé Ẹni t'á kàn
m'ogi?
S'á wę ọ nín'ẹj'Ọd'àgùntàn?

Asọ rę ha mọ láti pádé Jésù?
A fọ mọ ń'n' ẹjẹ Ọd'àgùntàn?
Ọkàn rę ha múra fún 'lé
dídán ni?
K'á wę ọ ń'n' ẹjẹ Ọd'àgùntàn?

Bọ ẹwù èérí-ẹsẹ sí apá kan,
K'á wę ọ ń'n'ẹjẹ Ọd'àgùntàn,
Ìsun kan ń sàn fún gbogbo
ọkàn àìmọ;
Jọ'ọ, lọ wę ń'n'ẹjẹ Ọd'àgùntàn.
Ààmín

englishTitle: REST IN THE LORD FROM HARPS ABOVE

sections.text:
Rest in the Lord from
harps above,
The music seems to thrill,
Rest in His everlasting love;
Rest and be still.

And thou whose trustful
hand is given,
Avouching here thy spouse.
Rest, for a father seals in
heaven;
His children's vows.

Rest ye who cluster round
them both,
To mingle praise and prayers,
Your God affirms the
plighted troth;
Your God and theirs.

Rest, for the heavenly
Bridegroom here
Is standing by your side
And in this union draws
more near
His mystic bride.

Rest in the Lord, Thrice
Holy Dove,
In us Thy word fulfill
Rest in His everlasting love
Rest and be still.
Amen.

Sinmi lé Olúwa, ẹ gbọ
Orin dùùrù ọrun,
Sinmi lé 'fẹ Rẹ àìlópin
Sì dúró jẹẹ.

Sinmi, ìwọ ọkọ t'ó gba
Ìyàwó rẹ lóní ,
Nínú Jésù 'yàwó rẹ ni
Títí ayé.

Ìwọ tí a fa ọwọ rẹ
F'ọkọ ń'nú ilé yìí
Sinmi, Baba f'èdidí Rẹ
Sí 'lèrí yín.

Ẹ sinmi, ẹyin ọrẹ wọn
T'ẹ wá bá wọn pé jọ
Ọlọrun wọn àti ti yín
Gba ohùn wọn.

Sinmi: Jésù Ọkọ Ìjọ
Dúró tì yín níhìn-ín
Nínú ìdàpọ yín,
Ó ń fa Ìjọ mọra.

Ẹ sinmi: Àdàbà Mímọ
M'ọrọ Rẹ ṣ ń'nú wa
Sinmi le 'fẹ Rẹ àìlópin
Sì dúró jẹẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE VOICE THAT BREATHED O'ER EDEN

sections.text:
The voice that breathed o'er Eden
That earliest wedding day,
The primal marriage blessing,
It hath not passed away.

Still in the pure espousal,
Of Christian man and maid,
The Holy Three are with us,
The threefold grace is said.

For dower of blessed children,
For love and faith's sweet sake,
For high mysterious union
Which naught on earth may break.

Be present, heavenly Father,
To give away this bride,
As Eve Thou gav'st to Adam,
Out of his own pierced side.

Be present, gracious Saviour,
To join their loving hands,
As Thou didst bind two natures
In Thine eternal bands.

Be present, Holy Spirit,
To bless them as they kneel,
As Thou for Christ the Bridegroom
The heavenly spouse dost seal.

O spread Thy pure wings o'er them!
Let no ill power find place,
When onward through life's journey
The hallowed path they trace.

To cast their crowns before Thee,
In perfect sacrifice,
Till to the home of gladness
With Christ's own bride
They rise.
Amen.

Ìre t'á sú ní Eden
Ní'gbèèyàwó kìnní
Ìbùkún t'á bù kún wọn
Ó wà síbẹsíbẹ.

Síbẹ títí di ònì,
Ní'gbèèyàwó Krístẹn,
Ọlọrun wà láàrin wọn,
Láti súre fún wọn.

Ìre kí wọn lè máa bí,
Kí wọn k'ó sì máa rẹ,
Kí wọn ní 'dàpọ mímọ
T'ẹ́nikan k'y'ó lè tú.

Bá ni pé, Baba, sì fa
Obìnrin yìí f'ọkọ,
Bí O ti fa Eéfà fún
Adam l'ọjọ kìnní.

Bá wa pé, Ìmánúẹl'
Sì so ọwọ wọn pọ,
B'ẹdá méjì ti papọ,
L'ara ìjìnlẹ Rẹ.

Bá wa pé Ẹmi Mímọ
F'ìbùkún Rẹ fún wọn,
Sì se wọn ní àsepé
Gẹgẹ b'Ó ti máa ń se.

Fi wọn sábẹ ààbò Rẹ,
Kí 'bi kan má bá wọn,
'Gbà wọn ń pààrà ilé Rẹ;
Máa tọjú ọkàn wọn.

Pẹlú wọn l'ọjọ ayé wọn,
Àt'ọkọ àt'aya,
Títí wọn ó d'ọdọ Rẹ;
Ní 'lé ayọ l'ọrun.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: FOR IN CANA OF GALILEE

sections.text:
For in Cana of Galilee
At that blest marriage feast
Jesus was present in that place
And His disciples too.

Jesus, reveal Thyself we pray
At this holy wedding
And bestow all of Thy blessing
Upon husband and wife.

Let them both be in fellowship
All the days of their life,
Let Thy divine love be the tie
That the world cannot break.

That they may one another help
By working together
Grant them Thy peace,
O Lord, we pray
And true satisfaction,

Like the first blessings
Thou gave in the garden of Eden.
That they may go and multiply
Until their lives shall end.
Amen

Ní'lùú Kánà ti Gálílì,
Ní'b'àsè 'gbéyàwó,
Jésù f'ara Rẹ hàn níbẹ,
Pẹl'àwọn 'mọ-ẹyin.

Jésù má sài f'ara Rẹ hàn
Ní'bi 'gbéyàwó yìí,
K'Ó sì fi 'bùkún Rẹ fún,
Ọkọ àti aya.

Jẹ kí wọn lé wà ní 'rẹpo,
Ní ọjọ ayé wọn;
Kí ifẹ àt'ọrun wá so wọn,
K'áyé má lè já wọn.

Kí wọn máa ran 'ra wọn Lọwọ
Nípa àjùmọṣe;
Fi àlàáfíà Rẹ kún wọn,
Fúnwọn ní'tẹlọrun.

Gẹgẹ bí're ọjọ kínní,
Ní ọgbà Edeni,
Kí wọn máa bí,
Kí wọn máa rẹ,
Tít'òpin ẹmi wọn.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: O GOD OF LOVE, TO THEE WE BOW

sections.text:
O God of Love, to Thee
And pray for those before
Thee now.
That, closely knit in holy vow,
They may in Thee be one.

When days are filled with
pure delight,
When paths are plain and
skies are bright.
Walking by faith and not
by sight,
May they in Thee be one.

Whate'er in life shall be
their share
Of quick'ning joy or
burd'ning care.
In pow'r to do and grace to
bear,
May they in Thee be one.

Eternal Love, with them
abide;
In Thee for ever may
they hide.
For even death cannot divide
Those whom Thou makest
one.
Amen.

Ọlọrun ìfẹ, a júbà,
Gba 'dura awọn méjì yìí,
Tí a so pọ l'ọkàn, l'ára,
Mú wọn jẹ 'kan ń'nú Rẹ.

'Gbà tí gbogb' ọjọ kún f'ayọ
Ati 'imole t'ona si gun;
Nipa igbagbo ni airi
Mu wọn jẹ 'kan n'nu Re

'Gbà tí 'gba 'dánwò bá dé,
T'o dabi pe gbogbo re pin,
Ni gbekele O nikan,
Mu wọn jẹ 'kan n'nu Re.

Ìfẹ àilópin, bá wọn gbé,
Jẹ aláàbò wọn títí láé,
N'tori 'ku kò lè pín níyà
Awọn t'Iwo so pọ.
Ààmín.

Ọlọrun ìfẹ, a júbà,
Gba 'dura awọn méjì yìí,
Tí a so pọ l'ọkàn, l'ára,
Mú wọn jẹ 'kan í'nú Rẹ.

Ìfẹ àilópin, bá wọn gbé,
Jẹ aláàbò wọn títí láé,
N'tori 'ku kò lè pín níyà
Awọn t'Iwo so pọ.
Aàmín.

englishTitle: IN TH' EDENIC GARDEN

sections.text:
In th'Edenic garden,
We find this blest command
Thy Ordinance,
Two should come together
And they together dwell
And they together walk
Here in this world.

We are assembled here
For us Thy will to do;
Like in the past
Come down, O Lord we pray
Be present in our midst
With Thy gracious blessings
Descend, we pray.

That these two persons who
Are ready to be joined
Might live for Thee
At all times; teach them their
Duty to each other,
Continue to join them
Through all their life.
Amin

Krist' ń'nú ọgbà Eden,
L'a gbé ti r'aṣẹ yìí,
Aṣẹ Tirẹ.
P'ó yẹ f'ẹni méjì
Kí wọn jọ máa gbé pọ,
Kí wọn máa rìn pọ;
Nínú ayé.

Krist' í'nú ọgbà Eden,
L'a gbé ti r'ásẹ yìí,
Asẹ Tirẹ.
P'ó yẹ f'ẹni méjì
Kí wọn jọ máa gbé pọ,
Kí wọn máa rìn pọ;
Nínú ayé.

Njẹ a kó'ra wa jọ
Láti se àsè yìí:
T'ọjọ kinní
Jọ, má s'àìsọ kalẹ,
K'O wa si àárin wa,
Pẹlú ìbùkún Rẹ;
Sọkalẹ wa.

K'áwọn méjèèjì yìí,
T' á fẹ láti so pọ
Lè wà fún Ọ.
N'gbà gbogbo máa kọ wọn,
N'ise wọn s'ara wọn,
Kí wọn sì lè rẹpọ,
Tít'ayé wọn.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS, DO MANIFEST THYSELF

sections.text:
Jesus, do manifest Thyself
At this matrimony
We beseech Thee to come,
O Lord
Reveal Thyself to us.

Pour Thy blessings upon
these ones,
Whose hands are joined
in one,
Look down in favour of
their match,
And bless this their union,

Fill both their bosoms with
Thy love,
Give to them contentment,
Give them Thy peace O
Lord, we pray;
And supply all their needs.

Through Thy perfect love,
make them one,
That they, may by Christ's
love,
Make domestic cares
become light,
By helping each other.

Let them be help to each
other,
In matters of their faith,
And bless thou them with
good children
Who will stablish their
home.
Amen.

Jésù f'ara hàn ní tòótọ,
Ní'bi àsè 'yàwó,
Olúwa, àwá bẹ Ọ, wá
F'ara Rẹ hàn níhìn-ín.

Fi ìbùkún Rẹ fún àwọn
Tí ó da'wọ pọ yìí;
F'ojú Rẹ fún wọn,
Sì bù kún ẹgbẹ wọn.

F'ìfẹ mímọ sọ wọn d'ọkan
Kí wọn f'ìfẹ Krístì
Mú àníyàn ilé fẹrẹ;
Nípa àjùmọṣe.

Jẹ kí wọn ran'ra wọn lọwọ,
Nínú ìgbàgbọ wọn;
Kí wọn sì ní ọmọ rere,
Ti y'ó gbé 'lé wọn ro.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHAT A FELLOWSHIP, WHAT A JOY DIVINE

sections.text:
What a fellowship,
What a joy divine,
Leaning on the everlasting
arms;
What a blessedness, what a
peace is mine;
Leaning on the everlasting
arms.

Lean...ing, lean...ing
Safe and secure from all
alarms,
Lean...ing, lean...ing
Leaning on the everlasting
arms.

Oh, how sweet to walk in
this pilgrim way,
Leaning on the everlasting
arms;
Oh, how bright the path
grows from day to day,
Leaning on the everlasting
arms.

What have I to dread, what have I to fear,
Leaning on the everlasting arms
I have blessed peace with my Lord so near,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.
Amen.

Ìdàpọ mímọ, ayọ l'átọrun,
Sinmi lé apá ayérayé
Háà! Ìbùkún ńlá,
Mo l'álàáfíà
Sinmi lé apá ayérayé

Sinmi, sinmi,
Lé Jésù ni'bi t'áàbò ńlá wà
Sinmi, sinmi,
Lé Jésù ni'bi t'áàbò ńlá wà.

Ó dùn láti máa rìn lọna ìyè,
Sinmi lé apá ayeraye,
Ọna náà ń mọlẹ sí lójooojúmọ,
Sinmi lé apá ayeraye.

Kín ni n ó bẹ̀rù, kín ni n ó fòyà
Sinmi lé apá ayeraye
Ọkàn mi balẹ̀, mo l'álàáfíà;
Sinmi lé apá ayeraye.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WITH MY SAVIOUR EVER NEAR TO GUIDE ME
yorubaTitle: GB' OLÚWA ŃBẸ ŃTÒSÍ LÁTI TỌ MI

sections.text:
With my Saviour ever near to guide me,
I am safe, whatever may betide me;
From the storm and tempest He will hide me,
In the hollow of His hand!
In the hollow ... ... of His hand! ...
In the hollow ... ... of His hand! ...
I am safe, whatever may betide me;
In the hollow of His hand!

Yóó p'ẹmí mi mọ
Tít' ayérayé;

englishTitle: IN THE SECRET OF HIS PRESENCE
yorubaTitle: NIB' ÌKỌKỌ IWAJU RẸ YÓÓ PA MI MỌ

sections.text:
In the secret of His presence
He will hide me,
From the burden of a weary world of care;
Overshadowed by His mercy calmly resting,
My Redeemer will protect me there.

He will hide me ... safely hide ... me,
Where no sorrow nor temptation can betide me;
He will hide me ... safely hide ... me,
In the secret of His presence He will hide me.

In the secret of His presence
He will hide me,
And the brightness of His glory He will show:
While He covers me with light as with a garment,
Oh the rapture that my heart will know.

In the secret of His presence
He will hide me,
In the secret of His blessed,
boundless love;
There communing and
abiding with my Saviour;
What a foretaste of the joys
above!
Amen.

Níb' ìkọkọ iwájú Rẹ yóó pa mí mọ,
Kúrò ń'nú láàlàá òun òsì ayé yií;
N ó máa sinmi títí lábé òjìji Rẹ,
Olúgbàlà yóó pa mí mọ ńbẹ.

Yóó pa mí ... mọ,
Yóó pa mí ... mọ,
Ní'bi òfò òun àdánwò kò lè bá mi;
Yóó pa mí ... mọ, Yóó pa mí ... mọ,
Ní ìkọkọ iwájú Rẹ, Yóó pa mí mọ.

Níb' ìkọkọ iwájú Rẹ yóó pa mí mọ,
Yóó f'ìmọlẹ ẹwà ògo Rẹ hàn mí;
Nígbà t'ó bá fĩ ìmọlẹ wọ mí l'áṣọ,
Ayo 'gbàlà yóó kún ọkàn mi.

Níb' ìkọkọ iwájú Rẹ yóó
pa mí mọ,
Ní 'kọkọ 'bùkún 'fe Rẹ
aláìlegbẹ;
N ó máa b'Olúwa mi gbé
ń'nú dàpọ mímọ,
Ìtọwò ńlá ay'ọrun l'èyí!
Ààmín.

englishTitle: ALL THE WAY MY SAVIOUR LEADS ME
yorubaTitle: OLUWA L' Ó TI Ń TỌ MI LỌ

sections.text:
All the way my Saviour leads me:
What have I to ask beside?
Can I doubt His tender mercy,
Who thro' life has been my Guide?
Heav'nly peace, divinest comfort,
Here by faith in Him to dwell!
For I know whate'er befall me,
Jesus doeth all things well.

All the way my Saviour leads me.
Cheers each winding path I tread,
Gives me grace for every trial
Feeds me with the Living Bread.
Though my weary steps
may falter,
And my soul athirst may be,
Gushing from the Rock
before me,
Lo ! a spring of joy I see.

All the way my Saviour
leads me;
Oh, the fullness of His love!
Perfect rest to me is promised
In my father's house above.
When my spirit, clothed, immortal,
Wings its flight to realms of day,
This my song through
endless ages,
Jesus led me all the way.
Amen.

Olúwa l'ó ti ń tọ mi lọ,
Nínú-ìrin-àjo mi,
Ó ń fún mi l'oore-ọfẹ Rẹ;
Nínú gbogbo ìdánwò.
Ó ń fi oúnjẹ ìyè bọ mi;
Bí ẹsẹ mi tilẹ ń yọ,
Ó ń fomi ìyè fún mi mu.
Àpàta ayọ fún mi.

englishTitle: GUIDE ME, O THOU GREAT JEHOVAH

sections.text:
Guide me, O Thou Great Jehovah!
Pilgrim thro' this barren land;
I am weak, but Thou art mighty,
Hold me with Thy pow'rful hand
Bread of heaven!
Feed me now and ever more.

Open Thou the crystal fountain,
Whence the healing stream doth flow:
Let the fiery, cloudy pillar,
Lead me all my journey through.
Strong Deliverer!
Be Thou Still my strength and shield.

Saviour, come! We long to see Thee,
Long to dwell with Thee above;
And to know in full communion
All the sweetness of Thy love,
Come Lord Jesus!
Take Thy waiting people home.
Amen.

Olùgbàlà, a ń fẹ rí Ọ,
A ń fẹ ìbùgbé l'óké;
A ń fẹ mo ìdàpọ dídùn,
Adùn 'fẹ Rẹ ní kíkún;
Máa bọ Jésù!
Tètè bọ, mú wa re 'lé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: OH GOD OF BETHEL BY WHOSE HAND

sections.text:
O God of Bethel,
by whose hand,
Thy people still are led;
Who through this weary
pilgrimage,
Hast all our fathers led.

Our vows, our pray'rs we
now present,
Before Thy throne of grace;
God of our fathers,
be the God,
Of their succeeding race.

Through each perplexing
path of life,
Our wand'ring footsteps
guide;
Give us each day our daily
bread,
And raiment fn provide.

O spread Thy cov'ring
wings around,
Till all our wand'rings cease,
And at our Father's lov'd
abode
Our souls arrive in peace.

Such blessings from Thy
gracious hand
Our humble pray'r implore,
And Thou shalt be our
chosen God,
And portion evermore.
Amen.

Ọlọrun Bẹtẹl', Ẹni tí,
Ó ń bọ àwọn Tirẹ,
Ẹni t'ó mú Baba wa a
Qjọ ayé wọn já.

A mú ẹjẹ àt'ẹbẹ wá,
Wá iwájú 'tẹ Rẹ,
Ọlọrun àwọn baba wa,
Máa jẹ Ọlọrun wa.

Nínú ìdààmú ayé yìí,
Máa tọ ìsísẹ wa,
Fún wa ní oúnjẹ òòjọ wa;
Àt' asọ t'ó yẹ wá.

Na òjiji iyẹ Rẹ bò wá,
Tít' àjò wa ó pin,
Àti ní 'bùgbé Bàbá wa,
Ọkàn wa ó sinmi.

Irú ìbùkún bí èyí,
L'a ń bèèrè l'ọwọ Rẹ;
Ìwọ ó jẹ Ọlọrun wa,
Àt' ìpín wa láéláé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE LORD'S OUR ROCK

sections.text:
The Lord's our Rock, in Him we hide:
A shelter in the time of storm!
Secure whatever ill betide:
A shelter in the time of storm!
Oh, Jesus is a Rock in a weary land!
A weary land, a weary land;
Oh, Jesus is a Rock in a weary land,
A shelter in the, time of storm!

A shade by day, defence by night:
A shelter in the time of storm!
No fears alarm, no foes affright:
A shelter in the time of storm!

The raging storms may round us beat:
A shelter in the time of storm!
We'll never leave our safe retreat,
A shelter in the time of storm!

O Rock Divine,
O Refuge dear:
A shelter in the time of storm!
Be Thou our helper ever near,
A shelter in the time of !
Amen.

Olúwa li Àpata wa,
Ní ọdọ Rẹ l'àwá sá sí,
Ọhunkóhun tó wù kó dé;
Ààbò nín' ìjì 'pọnju.
Jésù li Àpata
f'áwọn aláàárẹ
Fun aláàárẹ, fun aláàárẹ
Jésù li Àpata f'áwọn aláàárẹ
Ààbò nín' ìjì 'pọnju

Ààbò l'o je fun wa l'osan,
Olugbala wa ni l'oru
Ọta ko le d'eru ba wa
Ààbò nín' ìjì 'pọnju.

Ìjì ńlá lè jà yí wa ká,
Ìkún omi lè n'de sí wa,
A ti rí 'bi t'á ó sá sí;
Ààbò nín' ìjì 'pọnju.

Àpata ayérayé wa,
Ìlú ààbò wa t'ó s'ọwọn,
Sún mọ wa láti se 'rànwọ;
Ààbò nín' ìjì 'pọnju.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: BE THOU WITH ME
yorubaTitle: PẸLÚ MI NÍBI TÍ MO Ń LỌ

sections.text:
Grant me abundance of Thy love,
Be my protection evermore,
Put Thou thy seal within my heart;
And let Thy Spirit be with me.

Do, teach me, dear Lord, how to pray,
Help me to believe Thee wholly,
That I might hate things Thou hatest,
And love those things which Thou lovest.
Amen.

Pẹlú mi ní'bi tí mo ń lọ,
Kọ mi l'óhun t'émi ó se,
Pasẹ èrò àt'ọrọ mi,
K'Ó fẹsẹ mi lé ọna Rẹ.

Fi ọpọ ifẹ Rẹ fún mi,
Máa se aláàbò mi láééláé
Fi èdìdí Rẹ s'áyà mi;
Jẹ kí Ẹmí Rẹ pẹlú Ii.

Kọ mi bí a ti gbàdúrà,
Sì jẹ kí èmi gbà Ọ gbọ;
Kí n kórira nnkan t'Ó kọ fẹ,
Kí n sì fẹ ohun tí Ó fẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: ALL THE ACTIONS WE CONTEMPLATE
yorubaTitle: ISẸ GBOGBO TI AWA N SE

sections.text:
All the actions we contemplate
Are all known unto God,
The thoughts that come from within us;
Are clearly known to God.

To think He knew them not.
Everything appear very clear,
In the sight of our God,
All darkness combined
And all light
Are the same unto Him.

Help us to remember O God,
That Thou art watching us;
May we live everyday to fear
To commit sins 'gainst Thee.
Amen.

Isẹ gbogbo tí àwa ń se,
Ni Ọlọrun ti rí;
Èro gbogbo t'ó wà nínú,
Ni Ọlọrun sì mọ.

A kò lè fẹsẹ wa pamọ
Gbogbo wọn l'Ó ti mọ;
A ń puro, a ń tan 'ra wa jẹ,
B' a rò pé kò mọ wọn.

Ohun gbogbo hàn ní
gbangba,
Ni ojú Ọlọrun;
Òkùnkùn àti ìmọlẹ,
Sì rí bákan náà fún Un.

englishTitle: WORK, FOR THE NIGHT IS COMING

sections.text:
Work for the night is coming,
Work thro' the sunny noon,
Fill brightest hours with
labour,
Rest comes sure and soon.
Give every flying minute,
Something to keep in store;
Work, for the night is coming,
When man works no more.

Work for the night is coming,
Under the sunset skies;
While their bright tint are
glowing
Work for day-light flies,
Work till the last beam fadeth,
Fadeth to shine no more;
Work while the night is
darkening.
When man's work is o'er.
Amen.

S'iṣẹ torí òru ń bọ!
S'iṣẹ lí òwúrọ:
S'iṣẹ nígbà irì ń sẹ,
S'iṣẹ ń'nú tànná
S'iṣẹ kí ọsán tó pọn,
S'iṣẹ nígb'òòrun ń ràn;
S'iṣẹ torí òru ń bọ!
'Gbà 'sẹ ó parí.

S'iṣẹ torí òru ń bọ!
S'iṣẹ lọsán gangan,
F'àkókò rere fún 'sẹ;
Isinmi dájú,
F'ólúkúlùkù ìgbà,
Ní nnkan láti pamo,
S'iṣẹ torí òru ń bọ!
'Gbà 'sẹ ó parí.

S'iṣẹ torí òru ń bọ!
Oòrùn fẹrẹ wọ ná,
S'iṣẹ 'gbà tí'mọlẹ wa,
Ọjọ bù lọ tán,
S'iṣẹ títí dé òpin;
S'iṣẹ títí d'alẹ,
S'iṣẹ gbà tí'lẹ bá ń sú,
'Gbà 'sẹ ó parí.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WORK ON AND NEVER BE WEARY

sections.text:
Work on and never be weary,
Do Thy Father's duty in faith,
So Jesus did while on this earth,
Should we not emulate our Christ?

Work on and do it everyday,
The world's darkness shall soon come in,
Work on and avoid insolence,
That He may save Thy soul at last.

Many are those that remaineth
Who do not have heavenly hope;
Light on the light of the Gospel,
Sink it not in the world's darkness.

Work on and be joyous in it
After the labour comes the rest
Soon the voice of Jesus you'll hear
That would declare 'I have arrived.'
Amen.

Máa s'iṣẹ má se sàárẹ
Fi ayọ s'iṣẹ bàbá rẹ,
Báyìí ni Jésù se l'áyé,
Kò ha yẹ k'áwa k'ó se bẹẹ?

Máa s'iṣẹ lọ lójooJúmọ,
Òkùnkùn ayé fẹrẹ dé,
Múra sí'ṣẹ má se s'ọlẹ,
Kó ba lè gba ọkàn rẹ là.

Púpọ púpọ l'àwọn t'ó kú,
Tí wọn kò ní 'rètí ọrun,
Gbé iná 'gbàgbọ rẹ, máa fí,
Máa fí sí òkùnkùn ayé.

Máa s'iṣẹ lọ máa yọ pẹlú,
Lẹyìn isé 'wọ ó sinmi,
O fẹrẹ gb'óhun Jésù ná;
Yóó ké tantan pé,
“Èmi dé.”
Ààmín.

englishTitle: TO THE WORK, TO THE WORK
yorubaTitle: A O S'IṢẸ! A O S'IṢẸ! ỌM'ỌLỌRUN NI WÁ

sections.text:
To the work, to the work,
We are servants of God:
Let us follow the path
That our Master has trod:
Let us do with our might
What our hands find to do:

Toiling on, toiling on,
Toiling on, toiling,
Let us hope, let us watch,
And labour till the
Master comes.

To the work, to the work
Let the hungry be fed,
To the fountain of life,
Let the weary be led:
In the cross and its banner
Our glory shall be
While we herald the tidings,
Salvation is free.

To the work, to the work
There is labour for all,
For the kingdom of
darkness,
And error shall fall,
And the name of Jehovah,
Exalted shall be;
In the loud-swelling chorus,
Salvation is free.

To the work, to the work,
In the strength of the Lord,
And a robe and a crown,
Shall our labour reward;
When the home of the
faithful,
Our dwelling shall be,
And we shout with the
ransom'd;
Salvation is free. Amen.

A ó s'iṣẹ! A ó s'iṣẹ!
Ọm'Ọlọrun ni wá,
Jẹ k'á tẹlé ipa tí Olúwa
wa tọ;
K'a f'imọràn Rẹ sọ agbára
wa dọtun;
K'á fi gbogbo okun wa
sisẹ t'á ó se.
F'orí tì! F'orí tì!
F'orí tì! F'orí tì!
Máa retí, máa ṣona,
Títí Olúwa yóó fì de.

A ó s'iṣẹ! A ó s'iṣẹ! ‘
Bọ àwọn t'ébi ń pa,
Ko àwọn aláàrẹ lọ
s'órísun iyè!
Nínú àgbélébùú l'àwa ó
máa s'ògo,
Gbà tí a bá ń kéde pé,
“Ọfẹ ni'gbàlà”

A ó s'iṣẹ! A ó s'iṣẹ!
Gbogbo wa ni yó se,
Ijọba òkùnkùn àt' ìsìnà
yóó fọ,
A ó sì gbé orúkọ
Jèhófà lékè,
N'nú orin iyin wa pé,
“Ọfẹ ni'gbàlà.”

A ó s'iṣẹ! A ó s'iṣẹ!
L'ágbára Olúwa
Agbára àt' adé yóó
sì jẹ èrè wa;
“Gba t' ile àwọn olóòótọ
bá di ti wa,
Gbogbo wa ó jọ hó pè,
“Ọfẹ ni'gbàlà.”
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS CALLS US O'ER THE TUMULT
yorubaTitle: JÉSÙ Ń PÈ WÁ, LỌSÀN-ÁN, L'ÓRU

sections.text:
Jesus calls us o'er the tumult,
Of our life wild, restless sea,
Day by day His sweet voice soundeth,
Saying, “Christian follow Me!”

As of old apostles heard it,
By the Galilean lake,
Turned from home, and toil, and kindred,
Leaving all for His dear sake.

Jesus calls us from the worship,
Of the vain world's golden store,
From each idol that would keep us,
Saying, “Christian, love me more.”

In our joys and in our sorrows,
Days of toil and hours of ease,
Still He calls in cares and pleasures,
“Christian, love me more than these.”

Jesus calls us; by Thy mercies,
Saviour, may we hear Thy call,
Give our hearts to Thy obedience.
Serve and love Thee best Of all.

Jésù ń pè wá, lọsàn-án, l'óru,
Láàrin ìrúmi ayé,
L'ójooújọmọ l'à ń gb'óhùn Rẹ;
Wí pé, “Krístẹn, tẹlé mi.”

Àwọn Àpọstélì 'gbàanì,
Ní odò Gálílì nì,
Wọn kọ ilé, ọna sílẹ;
Gbogbo wọn sì ń tọ Ọ l'ẹyìn.

Jésù ń pè wá kúrò nínú
Ohun asán ayé yìí,
Láàrin afẹ ayé, Ó ń wí,
Pé, Krístẹn ẹ fẹràn mi.”

Láàrin ayọ àt'ẹkún wa,
Láàrin làálàá oun 'ròrùn
Tantan l' Ó ń pè l'óhùn rara;
Pé, Krístẹn ẹ fẹràn mi.”

Olùgbàlà níp'áánú Rẹ,
Jẹ kí á gbọ ìpè Rẹ,
F'etí 'gbọràn fún gbogbo wa;
K'á fẹ Ọ ju ayé lọ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: SING THE WONDROUS LOVE OF JESUS

sections.text:
Sing the wondrous love of Jesus
Sing His mercy, and His grace
In the mansions bright and blessed,
He'll prepare for us a place.

When we all ... get to heaven,
What a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we all ... see Jesus,
We'll sing and shout the victory.

While we walk the pilgrims path-way,
Cloud will overspread the sky;
But when trav'lling days are over,
Not a shadow, not a sigh.

Onward to the prize before us!
Soon His beauty we'll behold;
Soon the pearly gates will open
We shall tread the street of gold.
Amen.

Kọrin 'yànu t'ìfẹ Jésù,
Kọrin àánú rẹ títí,
Y'ó pèsè ààyè kan fún wa;
Ní 'lé Bàbá Rẹ l'ókè.

'Gbà t'á bá d'ọrun rere,
Báwo li ayọ wa yóó ti pọ tó?
'Gbà t'á bá rí Jésù;
A ó yọ, a ó kọrin ìṣẹgun.

B'á ti ń rìn lọ lọn'àjò wa,
Òkùnkùn ń sú l'ọnà wa,
Láipẹ òru ẹkún y'ó di
Òwúrọ orin ayọ.

Ẹ jẹ k'á máa forí tì i lọ,
K'á sisẹ tọkàntọkàn
'Gbà t'á bá wọ 'nu Ògo Rẹ,
A ó gbàgbé ìpọnjú wa.

Tẹsíwájú, èrè dájú,
Láipẹ a ó r'ójú Rẹ,
A ó sílẹkùn ìta wúrà
'Bi tí a ó máa gbé títí.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: MUST I GO, AN EMPTY HANDED
yorubaTitle: N Ó HA LỌ NÍ ỌWỌ ÒFO?

sections.text:
“Must I go, an empty handed”
Thus my dear Redeemer meet?
Not one day of service give Him,
Lay no trophy at His feet?

“Must I go, an empty handed?”
Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him:
Must I empty- handed go?

Not at death I shrink nor falter,
For my Saviour saves me now;
But to meet Him empty-handed,
Tho't of that now clouds my brow.

Oh the years of sinning wasted,
Could I but recall them now,
I would give them to my Saviour,
To His will I'd gladly bow.

Up ye saints, arouse, be earnest,
Up and work while yet 'tis day;
Ere the night of death o'er-take thee,
Strive for souls while still you may.
Amen.

N ó ha lọ ní ọwọ òfo?
Kí n lọ pàdé Jésù bẹẹ?
N kò ì tìí s'iṣẹ ọjọ kan fún Un,
N kò ì tìí mú ẹnikàn wá.

N ó ha lọ ní ọwọ òfo?
N ó ha pàdé Jésù bẹẹ?
Kò sí èso kan l'ọwọ mi,
Tí mo lè mú pàdé Rẹ.

Ikú kọ ló ń d'ẹrù bà mí,
'Torí Jésù ti gbà mi,
Pé mo ń lọ ní ọwọ òfo,
Ìrò yìí ń b'ọkàn mi ję.

Háà! Àkókò tí mo sọnù,
N bá lè pè wọn padà bọ,
N bá fi wọn fún Olúwa mi,
Ìfẹ Rẹ ni mo fẹ se.

Ẹyin mímọ, tara sí'sẹ,
S'iṣẹ, 'gbà tí 'se ọsán,
Kí ìgbéayé yín tó pin,
So èso fún Olúwa.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: IT PAYS TO SERVE JESUS
yorubaTitle: JÉSÙ DÙN LÁTI SÌN, ẸRÍ MI L'ÈYÍ

sections.text:
It pays to serve Jesus;
I speak from my heart;
He'll always be with us,
If we do our part;
There's naught in this wide
World can pleasure afford,
There's peace and
contentment in serving
The Lord.
I love Him far better than
in days of yore,
I'll serve Him more truly
than ever before;
I'll do as he bids me
whatever the cost,
I'll be a true soldier -
I'll die at my post.

And oft when I'm tempted to
turn from the track,
I think of my Saviour, my
mind wanders back
To the place where they
Nail'd Him on Calvary's tree,
I hear a voice saying, “I
suffered for thee.”

A place I remember where
I was set free,
'Twas where I found pardon,
a heaven to me;
There, Jesus spoke sweetly
to my weary soul,
My sins were forgiven,
He made my heart whole.

How rich is the blessing the
world cannot give,
I'm satisfied fully for
Jesus to live,
Tho' friend may forsake me
and trials arise.
I am trusting in Jesus His
love never dies.

There is no one like Jesus
can cheer me today,
His love and His kindness
can ne'er fade away,
In winter, in summer,
in sunshine and rain,
His love and affection are
always the same.

Will you have this blessing
that Jesus bestows,
A free, full salvation from
sin's bitter throes?
O come to the Saviour,
to Calvary flee,
The fountain is opened,
Is flowing for thee.
Amen.

Jésù dùn láti sìn, ẹrí mi l'èyí.
Òun y'ó ràn wá lọwọ,
Bí a ń gbọ Tirẹ,
Asán l'ayé yìí jẹ,
Òmúḷẹmófo,
Àwọn tí ń sin Jésù ló
ní'tẹḷọrun.
N ó fi t'ara t'ọkàn mi fẹ
Olúwa
N ó fi gbogbo àkókò mi
s'iṣẹ fún Un,
N ó jísẹ t'ó rán mi bó ti
wù k'ó ri;
N ó f'ẹmí mi lélẹ bí
ọm'ogun Rẹ.

'Gbà bá sì dán mi wò,
kí n ba lè padà,
Mo gb'ójú mi s'òkè,
Mo rántí ọjọ,
Ọjọ t'Ó kú fún mi,
lór'àgbélébùú;
Mo gb'ohùn Rẹ wí pé,
“Mo jìyà fún ọ.”

Ikú yìí ló sọ mí d'ẹni 'ràpadà,
Ẹjẹ Rẹ ló fún mi ní ìdáríjì,
Ìfẹ Rẹ ló wá mi 'gbà mo ń
sáko lọ;
Ó gbé mi l'ápá Rẹ,
Ó mú mi wá'lé.

Ìbùkún t'Ó ń fún mi,
irú rẹ kò sí,
Òun nikan tó fún mi,
N ó f'ayé mi fún Un,
B'ará tàbí ọrẹ, bá kọ mí sílẹ
N ó fara mọ Jésù, ìfẹ Rẹ kìí sá.

Kò s'ẹlòmìí l'áyé tí ń mú'nú
mi dùn,
Ìfẹ Jésù sí mi, irú rẹ s'ọwọn,
Àánú àt'oore Rẹ, ọtun ni títí;
Ìyọnú Rẹ sí mi, kìí dẹkun rárá.

'Wọ ha ń fẹ 'bùkún yìí, tí
Jésù ń fún ni?
'Bùkún ìdásílẹ ń'nú ìdè ẹṣẹ
Yára tọ Jésù wá,
A ti sá A l'ọgbẹ;
Yóó f'isun ẹjẹ Rẹ se
Àwòtán rẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I CAN HEAR MY SAVIOUR CALLING
yorubaTitle: MO GBỌ OLÙGBÀLÀ MI Ń PÈ

sections.text:
I can hear my Saviour calling,
I can hear my Saviour calling,
I can hear my Saviour calling.
Take thy cross, and follow,
follow me.

Where He leads me
I will follow
Where He leads me
I will follow
Where He leads me
I will follow
I'll go with Him with Him,
all the way.

I'll go with Him thro'the
garden
I'll go with Him thro'the
garden
I'll go with Him thro'the
garden
I'll go with Him, with Him,
all the way.

I'll go with Him thro'the judgment,
I'll go with Him thro'the judgment,
I'll go with Him thro'the judgment,
I'll go with Him, with Him,
all the way

He will give me grace and glory
He will give me grace and glory
He will give me grace and glory
And go with me, with me,
All the way.
Amen.

Mo gbọ Olùgbàlà mi ń pè.
Mo gbọ Olùgbàlà mi ń pè
Mo gbọ Olùgbàlà mi ń pè
'Gb'agbelebu re si te le mi

Ona t'o la l'emi o rin
Ona t'o la l'emi o rin
Ona t'o la l'emi o rin
Em'o tele,tele titi lae.

Èm' ó ba kojá ọgbà nì,
Èm' ó ba kojá ọgbà nì,
Èm' ó ba kojá ọgbà nì,
Èm'ó tẹle, tẹle títí láé.

Èm' ó ba kojá ìdájọ,
Èm' ó ba kojá ìdájọ,
Èm' ó ba kojá ìdájọ,
Èm'ó tẹle, tẹle títí láé.

Y'ó fún mi l'òore àt'ògo,
Y'ó fún mi l'òore àt'ògo,
Y'ó fún mi l'òore àt'ògo,
Y'ó ję t'èmi, t'èmi títí láé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HO, REAPERS IN THE WHITENED

sections.text:
Ho, reapers in the whitened harvest
Oft, feeble, faint, and few
Come, wait upon the blessed Master,
Our strength He will renew
For they that wait upon the Lord
Shall renew their strength,
They shall mount up with wings,
They shall mount up a with wings as eagles
They shall run and not be weary
They shall walk and not faint;
They shall run and not be weary
They shall walk and not faint;
They shall run and not be weary
Shall walk and not faint.

Too oft a weary and discouraged,
We pour a sad complaint;
Believing in a living Saviour.
Why should we ever faint.

Rejoice! For He is with us always,
Lo ever to the end!
Look up! Take courage
And go forward
All needed grace He'll seed!
Amen.

Ẹyin olùkórè nín'oko
T'áàárẹ fẹrẹ mú tán;
Ẹ rojú dúró de Olúwa,
Y'ó s'agbára d'ọtun.
Àwọn t'ó dúró d'Olúwa,
Y'ó s'agbára wọn d'ọtun,
Wọn ó fi ìyẹ fò,
Wọn ó fi ìyẹ fò bí idì,
Wọn ó sáré,wọn kì y'ó káàárẹ,
Wọn ó rìn, kì y'ó rẹ wọn,
Wọn ó sáré, wọn kì y'ó káàárẹ,
Wọn ó rìn, kì y'ó rẹ wọn,
Wọn ó sáré, wọn kì y'ó káàárẹ,
Wọn ó rìn, kì y'ó rẹ wọn.

Nígbà àárẹ àt' ìrẹwẹsì,
A ń gb' ọkàn wa sí Ọ;
Lẹyin t'á gba Olùgbàlà gbọ,
Kí l'a ó tún bẹrù?

Ẹ yọ Ó ń bá wa gbé l'ọjọọjọ,
Àní títí d'ópin:
W' òkè! Ẹ sì máa tẹsíwájú.
Y'ó fún yín l'ágbára.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: TRUSTING IN THE LORD THY GOD

sections.text:
Trusting, in the Lord thy God,
Onward go! onward go!
Holding fast His promised word.
Onward go!
Ne'er deny His worthy name.
Though it bring reproach and shame,
Spreading still His wondrous; fame,
Onward go!

Has He called thee to the plough?
Onward go! onward go!
Night is coming serve Him now;
Onward go!
Faith and love in service blend;
On His mighty arm depend
Standing fast until the end,
Onward go!

Has He giv'n thee
golden grain?
Onward go! onward go!
Sow, and thou shalt reap
again;
Onward go!
To Thy Master's gate repair
Watching be and waiting
there;
He will hear and answer
prayer:
Onward go!

Has He said the end is near?
Onward go! Onward go!
Serving Him with holy fear,
Onward go!
Christ thy portion,
Christ thy stay,
Heav'nly bread upon the way;
Leading on to glorious day:
Onward go

In this little moment then,
Onward go! Onward go!
In thy ways acknowledge
Him.
Onward go!
Let His mind be found in thee;
Let His will thy pleasure be.
Thus in life and liberty,
Onward go!

Gbẹkẹlé Ọlọrun rẹ.
K'ó máa n só! K'ó máa n só!
D'ílérí Rẹ mú sinsin.
Má se sẹ orúkọ Rẹ.
B'ó tilẹ mú ẹgàn wá.
Máa tan ìyin Rẹ kálẹ.
Sá máa n só!

Ó ti pè ọ sí 'sẹ Rẹ?
Sá máa n só! Sá máa n só!
Oru ń bọ wa, mura sin!
Sá máa n só!
Sìn-ín n'ífe àt'ìgbàgbọ:
Gbẹkẹlé agbára Rẹ.
Fi orí tìí dé òpin.
Sa máa nso!

Ó ti fún ọ ní 'rúgbìn?
Sá máa n só! Sá máa n só!
Máa gbìn, 'wọ ó tún kórè;
Sá máa n só!

O ti wí pé òpin ń bọ?
Sá máa n só! Sá máa n só!
Njẹ fi ẹrù mímọ sì-ín!
Sá máa n só!
Krìstì l'àtìleyìn rẹ,
Òun náà sì ni oúnjẹ rẹ,
Y'ó sìn ọ dé 'nú ògo,
Sá máa n só!

Ní àkókò yìí:
Sá máa n só! Sá máa n só!
Jẹwọ Rẹ ní ọ̀nà rẹ;
Sá máa n só!
K'á rí ọkan Rẹ ń'nú rẹ,
K'ífẹ Rẹ jẹ ayọ rẹ,
L'ọjọ ayé rẹ gbobgo.
Sá máa n só!
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHAT IS THE THING THAT I LONG FOR?
yorubaTitle: KÍN NI OHUN TÍ MO Ń LÉPA?

sections.text:
What is the thing that
I long for?
What is my hope or
my desire?
How I crave to follow
The Lamb
And I His image to adopt.

All my hope Lord Thee is stayed
I long To be The one you love
I want la be saved here
on earth
And fellowship with
Thee above

I hunger for The Lord of life
Who died for me on Calvary
For the source of water
and blood
That from Thy wounded
Side which flow'd.

I desire Thy water of love
Spirit of joy that's yd
unknown
Grant that I may yet drink
above
As it does stream forth
from Thy throne.
Amen.

Kín ni ohun tí mo ń lépa?
Kín n' ìrètí àt'ìfẹ mi?
Kí n tẹlé Ọdọ-àgùntàn náà,
Kí n máa lépa àwòrán Rẹ.

Gbogbo 'r ètí mi ń bẹ ń'nú Rẹ,
Pé kí n tún ję ẹni t'ó fẹ;
Kí n rí ìgbàlà Rẹ láyé,
Kí n sì ję adùn Rẹ l'ókè.

Mo ń pòngbẹ f'Olúwa ìyè,
Tí ó kú l'ókè Kálfári;
F'órísun omi,òun ẹjẹ
Tí ń t' ìhà Ìmánuẹl jáde.

Mo ń pòngbẹ f'omi ìfẹ Rẹ,
Ẹmí ayọ tí a kò mọ,
Kí èmi sì t ún mu l'oókè,
B'ó ti n sun l'át orí ìtẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: BY FAITH, I CRAVE TO WALK WITH GOD

sections.text:
By faith, I crave to walk
with God,
The end of my journey is
heaven,
"Thy rod and staff, they
comfort me",
The way Thou has pav'd is
the best.

I walk amidst great
wilderness,
Where many souls have lost
their way,
But He that leads me on the
way,
Will not allow my foot to
stray.

I walk amidst dangers and snares,
Earth and hell against me arrayed,
Through Thy great pow'r I have gone through
By faith alone, I have vict'ry.

I pity those who are boasting
of fleeting pleasures of this life,
Oh, Jesus, let me walk with Thee
My Lord, my Saviour and my friend.
Amen.

Mo fi'gbagbo b'Olorun rin,
Orun ni opin irin ajo mi;
"Opa at'ogo Re tu mi ninu.
Ona didan l'ona t'O la.

Mo n rin laarin aginju nla,
Ni'bi opolopo ti nu;
Sugbon Oun s'amona mi,
Ko je ki n sina, ti n ba nu.

Mo n la 'kekun t' on ewu ja,
Aye at'Esu kolu mi;
Agbara Re ni mo fi la.
Igbagbo si ni 'segun mi.

Mo n kaanu awon ti n bale
F'afe aye ti n koja yii,
Oluwa je ki n ba O rin,
Olugbala at'Ore mi.
Aamin.

englishTitle: KEEP FROM PRESUMPTUOUS SIN
yorubaTitle: KI N MA BA TUN D'ESE

sections.text:
Keep from presumptuous sin
It is what my God hates
Lord, create in me a clean heart,
Renew a right spirit

Then shall this heart of mine
Hate filthiness within
In love Thou hast sanctified it
It will not sin again.

Thy commandment is pure
Jesus, teach me Thy laws
Thy spirit gives laws that bring life
Write them upon my heart.

Plant them deep in my heart
That it may ne'er be moved
Law of freedom from
The perfect love.

Let your life become mine
A life that is spotless
Draw Thou my heart closer to Thee
Every hour of the day.

Life and spirit Thou art
Redeemer of the world
Make Thou my father's will in heav'n
Be done in me, I pray.

Kí n máa ba tún d'ẹṣẹ,
Tí Ọlọrun mi kọ;
Olúwa, ṣe àtúndá mi,
Sì s'ọkàn mi d'ọtun.

Òfin Rẹ mímọ ni,
Jésù jọ'ọ fi kọ mi,
Òfin ẹmí nípa ìyè
Jọ'ọ kọ sí àyà mi.

Gbin-ín sinsin sínu mi,
Kó má ló s'ípò láé;
Òfin 'dàndè kúrò ń'n' ẹṣẹ.
Òfin pípé t'ìfẹ.

'Wọ n' iyè ẹmí mi,
Olùdándè ayé;
Mú ìfẹ Baba mi ọrun
Sẹ nínú ayé mi.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: TAKE UP THY CROSS, THE SAVIOUR

sections.text:
Take up thy cross,
the Saviour said,
If thou wouldst
My disciple be;
Deny myself, the world forsake,
And humbly follow after Me.

Take up thy cross: let not its weight
Fill thy weak spirit with alarm;
His str'ngth shall bear thy spirit up,
And brace thy heart,
and nerve thine arm.

Take up thy cross,
nor heed the shame,
Nor let thy foolish pride rebel;
Thy Lord for thee the Cross endured.
To save thy soul from death and hell

Take up thy cross then
in His strength,
And calmly every danger
brave;
Twill guide thee to a better
home.
And lead to victory o'er
the grave.

Take up thy cross, and"
follow Christ,
Nor think till death to
lay it down;
For only he who bears
the cross
May hope to wear the
glorious crown. Amen.

To Thee Great Lord,
The One in Three,
All praise for evermore
ascend;
O grants us in our Hope
to see
The heav'n'ly life that knows
no end.
Amen.

Gb'ágbèélébùú rẹ ni Kríst' wí,
B'ó bá fẹ s'ọmọ ẹyin Mi;
Sẹ 'ra rẹ, kọ ayé sílẹ,
Sì máa f' ìrẹlẹ tẹlé Ii.

Gb'ágbèélébùú rẹ, má jẹ kí,
Ìwúwo rẹ fò ọ l'áyà,
Ipá Rẹ y'ó gb'ẹmí rẹ ró,
Y'ó m'ọkàn àt'apá rẹ le.

Gb'ágbèélébùú rẹ, má tijú
Má jẹ k'ọkàn wèrè rẹ kọ;
Olúwa ru àgbélébùú
Láti gbà ọ lọwọ ikú.

Gb'ágbèélébùú rẹ, ma tele,
Má se gbé e sílẹ títí 'kú,
Ẹni t'ó ru àgbélébùú
L'ó lè retí láti d'ádé.

'Wọ Ọlọrun, Mẹtalọkan,
L'a ó máa yin títí ayé;
Fún wa, K'áwa lè rí n'ilé wa,
Ayọ ọrun tí kò l'ópin.
Aàmín.

englishTitle: IT IS GLORY JUST TO WALK
yorubaTitle: Ó TI DUN TO LATI MỌ JESU

sections.text:
It is glory just to walk with
Him whose blood has
ransomed me:
It is rapture for my soul
each day,
It is joy divine to feel
Him near where'er my path
may be,
Bless the Lord, it's glory
all the way!

It is glory just to walk
with him
It is glory just to walk with
him
He will guide my step aright
Through the vale and o'er
the height
It is glory just to walk
with Him

It is glory when the shadows
Fall to know that He is near;
Oh, what joy to simply trust
and pray!
It is glory to abide in Him
when skies above are clear;
Yes with Him, it's glory all
the way!

'Twill be glory when
I walk with Him on heaven's
golden shore,
Never from His side again
to stray.
'Twill be glory, wondrous
glory with the Saviour
evermore.
Everlasting glory all the
way!
Amen.

Ó ti dùn tó láti mọ Jésù,
Ẹni t'Ó tó gbà mí là,
'Joojúmọ ọkàn mi kún f'áyo,
Ayọ ni láti rí pé O ń bá
mi lọ sí 'bikíbi,
'Joojúmọ ayé ògo ni f'Olúwa.

Ó ti dùn tó láti máa bá
A rìn,
Ó ti dùn tó láti máa bá
A rìn
Yóó máa se amọna mi
N'nú 'mọlẹ àt'òkùnkùn:
Ó ti dùn tó láti máa bá
A rìn.

Ó ti dùn tó kí Ó wà nítọsí
nígbà ìdánwò,
Ká sá gbàgbọ ká sì
gbàdúrà;
Ó ti dùn tó kí a máa gbé
ń'nú
Krístì nígbàkugbà
Yóó máa fi ògo ọrun kún
wa.

Yóó ti dùn tó láti pàdé Rẹ
l'ébúté ògo náà,
Àwa óó pàdé l'àípínyà mọ;
Orin ògo, ògo, ògo, la máa
kọ títí láé;
Ní ilú ológo ti Baba.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THY WAY, NOT MINE, O LORD

sections.text:
Thy way, not mine, O Lord,
However dark it be!
Lead me by Thine own hand.
Choose the path for me.

Smooth let it be or rough. ,
It will be still the best:
Winding or straight, leads
Right onward to Thy rest.

I dare not choose my lot:
I would not. if I might:
Choose Thou for me,
My God;
So shall I walk aright.

The kingdom that I seek
Is Thine; so let the way
That leads to it be Thine,
Else I must surely stray.

Take Thou my cup, and it
With joy or sorrow fill
As best to Thee may seem;
Choose Thou my good and ill.

Not mine, not mine the choice
In things or great or small;
Be Thou my Guide,
my Strength,
My Wisdom, and my All.
Amen.

Ọnà Rẹ, Olúwa,
B'ó ti wù kó há tó!
Fi ọwọ Rẹ tọ mi;
Yàn ipa mi fún mi.

B'ó rọrun, b'ó sòro,
Dáradára ló jẹ;
B'ó wọ, b'ó tọ tààrà,
Lọdọ Rẹ l'ó pin sí.

Ìjọba tí mo ń wá,
Tìrẹ ni; jẹ k'ọnà
T'ó re 'bẹ jẹ Tirẹ,
Bí bẹẹ kọ, n ó sìnà.

Gba ago mi, f'ayọ
Tàbí 'bànújẹ kún-un
B'ó ti tọ l'ójú Rẹ
Yan 're tàbí 'bi mi.

Yíyàn kíi se t'èmi,
Nínú ohunkóhun;
Ìwọ s'Olútọ mi,
Ọgbọn, ohun gbogbo.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: SHINING FOR JESUS EVERYWHERE I GO
yorubaTitle: MO FE KI N JE IMOLE FUN JESU

sections.text:
Shining for Jesus everywhere
I go
Shining for Jesus in this
world of woe
Shining for Jesus, more like
Him I grow
Shining all the time for Jesus.

Shining all the time
Shining all the time
Shining for Jesus,
Glorifying Him every day
and hour
Shining all the time

Shining for Jesus when the
way is bright
Shining for Jesus in the
darkest night
Shining for Jesus, making
burdens light
Shining all the time for Jesus.

Shining for Jesus in a
world of sin
Shining for Jesus bringing
lost ones in,
Shining for Jesus,
glorifying Him;
Shining all the time for Jesus.

Shining for Jesus when
He gives me grace,
Shining for Jesus while I run
the race,
Shining for Jesus, till I see
His face;
Shining all the time for
Jesus. Amen.

Mo fẹ kí n jẹ ìmọlẹ fún Jésù
Níbíkíbi, kí n fi ẹwà Rẹ hàn;
Kí n máa dàgbà ń'nú
Oore-ọfẹ Rẹ,
Kí n jẹ ìmọlẹ Re l'ayé.

Kí n tan ìmọlẹ, kí n tan
ìmọlẹ,
Kí n tan ìmọlẹ,
ìfẹ àtọrun wá;
Kí n máa f'ògo fún
l'ọsan àt'oru
Kí n máa tàn 'mọlẹ fún
Jesu

Mo fẹ kí n jẹ ìmọlẹ fún Jésù,
Nínú ayọ tàbí ìbànújẹ;
Kí n jẹ 'rànlọwọ f'áwọn
t'ẹrú ń pa,
Kí n jẹ ìmọlẹ Rẹ l'ayé.

Mo fẹ kí n jẹ ìmọlẹ fún Jésù,
Ìmọlẹ nínú ayé yìí;
Kí n mú awọn ti ń sako
pada bọ,
Kí n máa gbé orúkọ Rẹ ga.

Mo fẹ kí n jẹ ìmọlẹ fún Jésù,
Kí n fi tayọtayọ súre'je mi;
Kí n gbẹkẹle oor'ọfẹ Rẹ nìkan,
Títí n ó fi rí ojú Rẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I STRIVE EARNESTLY DAY BY DAY

sections.text:
I strive earnestly day by day,
And with my might,
I strive to be,
That I may inherit the home;
Which Jesus had prepared
for me.

I crave earnestly day by day,
And to grasp it with all
my might,
The crown of glory that is
bright;
That is prepared for the lov'd
ones.

I hope earnestly day by day'
To listen to the voice of joy,
When here on earth my
labour ends;
Enter into thy Father's joy.

When friends and world and
foes now seek,
To draw me to perdition way,
Let me now with boldness
repeat;
That I'll follow Thee
To the end.

Look unto me my Lord and God,
Make me victorious o'er the flesh,
That I may not stumble and fall;
Away from path of glorious home. Amen.

Èmi ń lépa l'ójúojúmọ,
Mo sì tún ń làkàkà pẹlú;
Kí n lè jogún ibùgbé náà
Tí Jésù ti pèsè fún mi.

Èmi ń nọga l'ójúojúmọ,
Láti ríi pé ọwọ mi tẹẹ,
Adé ológo ti ń dán nì;
T'á se l'ọsọ fún àyànfẹ.

Èmi ń reti l'ojúojumo,
Láti gbọ ohùn ayọ nì,
'Gba ti ń ba síwọ isẹ pé:
“Bọ s'ínú ayọ Baba rẹ.”

B'áyé tàbí àwọn ọrẹ
Bá fẹ fà mí s'ọna ègbé,
Jẹ kí n lè f'igboyà sọ pé:
T'èm'ni Jésù, n ó bá A relé.

'Wọ Oluwa Ọlọrun mi,
Mu mi sẹgun ẹran ara,
K'émi má baà kọsẹ, subú
Kúrò lọ̀nà ile ògo.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: LORD, IF AT THY COMMAND

sections.text:
Lord, if at Thy command
The word of life we sow,
Water'd by Thy almighty hand,
The seed shall surely grow:

The virtue of Thy grace
A large increase shall give
And multiply the faithful race
Who to Thy glory live.

Now then the ceaseless show'r
Of gospel blessings send
And let the soul-converting pow'r
Thy ministers attend.

On multitudes confer,
The heart-renewing love,
And by the joy of grace prepare
For fuller joys above. Amen.

Jésù b'á ń fúnrúgbìn
Ọrọ 'yè l'àṣẹ Rẹ;
B'á ti ọwọ Rẹ b'ominrin,
'Rúgbìn náà yóó dàgbà.

Ipá oor'-ọfẹ Rẹ
Y'ó mú 'bisí púpọ;
Y'óó s'olóòótọ di púpọ
Ti ń wà fun ogo Rẹ,

Rọ òjò ìbùkún
T 'ìyìn-rere Rẹ,
K'ágbára tí ń y'ọkàn padà
Bá iránṣẹ Rẹ gbé.

Fún ọpọ ènìyàn
Ní 'fẹ ìsọdọtun;
F'ayọ oor'-ọfẹ pèsè wọn
F'ayọ kíkún l'ókè.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: YE SERVANTS OF THE LORD

sections.text:
Ye servants of the Lord,
Each in his office wait,
Observant of His heav'nly word,
And watch at His gate.

Let all your lamps be bright.
And trim the golden flame;.
Gird up your loins,
as in His sight,
For awful is His name.

Watch 'tis your Lord's
command.
And while we speak,
He's near:
Make the first signal
of His hand
And ready all appear.

Oh, happy servant he,
In such a posture found!
He shall his Lord with
rapture see,
And be with honour crown'd.

Christ shall the banquet
spread
With His own royal hand.
And raise that faithful
servant's head
Amid the angelic band.
Amen.

Ìránṣẹ Olúwa!
Ẹ dúró ní'iṣẹ
Ẹ tojú ọrọ mímọ Rẹ
Ẹ máa sọ̀nà Rẹ sá.

Jẹ kí 'mọlẹ yín tàn,
Ẹ tún fitílà se!
Ẹ dàmùrè gírígírí,
OrúRẹ l'ẹrù.

Irànṣẹ 're l'ẹni
Tí a bá nípò yìí;
Ayo l'ó máa fi r'Olúwa,
Yóó f'ọlá dée l'ádé.

Krístì tikálaarẹ,
Yóó tę tábìlì fún un;
Yóó gb'órí irànṣẹ náà ga,
Láàrin ẹgbẹ ángẹl'. Ààmín.

englishTitle: HOLY AND GRACIOUS LORD

sections.text:
Holy and gracious Lord
By heav'nly hosts ador'd.
Hear us, we pray
Cherubims, Seraphims
And all the angel hosts
Unto Thee they all bring
Their hymns of praise

Give might unto Thy word
Bless this Thy servant, Lord,
Accept His work
And as thou Lord follows
His message with signs
Send Thy Holy Spirit
To show it forth.

As year rolls into year
Let their joy be increased
Far more than now
Add more unto Thy fold
Send help to Thy servant
That all accept Thy truth
Our blest Saviour.
Amen.

Olúwa wa mímọ,
Tí ogun ọrun ń yìn,
Má sàì gbọ wa;
Kérúbù, Séráfù,
Àt' àwọn ángẹlì,
S'ọdọ Rẹ ni wọn ń mú
Ìyin wọn wá.

Fún ọrọ Rẹ n'ípá,
Bùkún 'rànṣẹ Rẹ yìí;
Gba iṣẹ rẹ;
Bí Jésù sì ti ń fi
Àmi sí ọrí Rẹ,
Rán Ẹmí Rẹ mímọ
Láti fi hàn.

B'ọdún ti ń ré kojá,
Kí ayọ máa pọ síi,
Ju t'óní lọ;
Yàn kún 'nú ilé náà,
Ran 'ránṣẹ Rẹ lọwọ,
K'áyé gba òótọ Rẹ,
Olúwa wa.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: LET ALL ZION'S WATCHMEN ARISE

sections.text:
Let all Zion's watchmen arise
And answer their own calls
Let them, their own commission take
Themselves from the Lord's mouth.

It's a very great work indeed
For which we need watchmen
It's a burden on angel's heart
Add it fills the Lord's hands.

They watch over one soul, for whom
The Lord left His glory
A soul who will have to be in
Eternal joy or loss

So, they also may see Jesus
As their Lord and Saviour
In watching their footsteps daily
Their hearts are kept for Him.
Amen.

Jẹ k' alóre Síon dìde,
Gba ìpè fún 'ra wọn;
Jẹ kí wọn gba àṣẹ wuwo
Lat'ẹnu Olúwa.

Kìí se'ṣẹ kékeré ni
A ń fẹ òlùṣẹ sí;
Ó tó kún ángẹlì l'ọkàn,
Ó kún Jésù lọwọ.

Wọn ń sọ ọkàn tí Olúwa
F'ògo ọrun 'lẹ fún,
Ọkàn tí yóó wà títí láé
N'nú ayọ tàb'ègbé.

K'áwọn ba lè rí Jésù náà,
Bí Olùgbàlà wọn;
Sì s'ọkàn wọn lójúojúmọ
Kí wọn lè sọ fún Ọ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS! AND SHALL IT EVER BE
yorubaTitle: JESU O HA LE JE BEE PE

sections.text:
Jesus! And shall it ever be,
A mortal man ashamed
of Thee,
Ashamed of Thee whom
angels praise,
Whose glories shine
through endless days?

Ashamed of Jesus! sooner far,
Let evening blush to
own a star;
He sheds the beams of light
divine,
O'er this benighted soul
of mine.

Ashamed of Jesus!
Just as soon
Let midnight be ashamed
of noon;
'Tis midnight with my soul
till He,
Bright Morning Star,
bid darkness flee.

Ashamed of Jesus,
that dear Friend
On whom my hopes
of heaven depend!
No! when I blush,
be this my shame,
That I no more revere
His name.

Ashamed of Jesus! Yes, I may
When I've no guilt to wash
away,
No tear to wipe no good
to crave,
No fears to quell,
No soul to save.

Till then- nor is
my boasting vain-
Till then I boast a Saviour
slain;
And O may this my glory
be,
That Christ is not ashamed
of me!
Amen

Jèsù, ó ha lè jẹ bẹẹ pé,
Kí Ẹni kíkú tijú Rẹ,
Tijú Rẹ, 'Wọ t'ángẹlì ń yìn;
Ògo Ẹni ń ràn títí láé.

Kí n tijú Jèsù, ó sàn pé,
Kí alẹ tijú ìràwọ,
Òun ní ń tan ìmọlẹ ọrun
S'ínú ọkàn òkùnkùn mi.

Kí n tijú Jèsù, bákan náà,
Jẹ kí òru tijú ọsán,
Òru ni mo jẹ tẹlẹ,
Kí Júsù tó tàn 'mọlẹ Rẹ.

Kí n tijú Jèsù, Ọrẹ nì,
Ẹni mo ń wò láti d'ọrun,ọ
B'ó bá rí bẹẹ, k'ójú tì mi;
Pé n kò bẹwẹ f'óókọ Rẹ mọ.

Kí n tijú Jèsù, mo lè seé,
Bí n kò bá l'ẹsẹ t'á ó wẹnù,
Tí n kò l'ẹdùn, tí n kò lẹrù,
Ti n kò f'ẹre tàbí 'gbàlá.

englishTitle: SOW IN THE MORNING THY SEED

sections.text:
Sow in the morning thy seed,
At eve hold not thine hand:
To doubt and tear give
thou no heed
Broadcast it o'er the land.

Thou not which may thrive
The late or early sown;
Grace keeps the chosen
germ alive,
When and wherever sown.

And duly shall appear,
In verdure, beauty, strength,
The tender blade, the stalk,
the ear,
And the full corn at length.

Thou canst not toil in vain;
Cold, heat, and moist, and dry,
Shall foster and mature
the grain
For garners in the sky.

Thence, when the glorious
end,
The day of God is come,
The angel reapers shall
descend.
And heaven cry: Harvest
home!
Amen.

Fún'rúgbìn l'ówúrọ,
Má sinmi tít'alẹ,
Fẹrù òun 'yèmèjì sílẹ;
Máa fún un sí'bi gbogbo.

'Wọ kò mọ'yíi tí ń hù,
Tòórọ tàbí t'alẹ,
Oore-ọfẹ yóó paá mọ,
'Bi t'ó wù k'ó bọ sí.

Yóó sì hù jáde,
L'ẹwà tutu yoyọ,
Bẹ ni yóó sì dàgbà s'ókè;
S'èso ní'keyìn.

'Wọ k'yóó s'iṣẹ lásán!
Òjò, ìrì, oòrùn,
Yóó jùmọ se iṣẹ pọ;
Fún ìkórè ọrun.

Nje ní 'keyìn ọjọ,
Nígbà t'ópin bá dé,
Àwọn ańgẹli yóó sì wá kó;
Ìkórè lọ sí 'lé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: KEEP STEP WITH THE MASTER WHATEVER BETIDE

sections.text:
Keep step with the Master,
whatever betide,
Though dark be the pathway,
keep close to your Guide;
While foes are alluring
and danger is near,
When walking with Jesus,
you've nothing to fear.
Keeping step ... go bravely forward,
And thy cou...rage still renew ...
Daily walk ... with Christ your Saviour,
He will lead you all the journey through.

Keep step with the Master,
wherever you go,
Through the darkness and
Shadow the way He will show,
The light of His presence
your path will illume;
And make all the desert a
garden of bloom.

Keep step with the Master,
nor halt by the way;
Whate'er He commands you,
oh, haste to obey!
Arise at His bidding, press
on in His might;
While walking with Jesus,
you're sure to be right.
Amen.

Máa b'Ólùgbàlà rìn,
Ohun t'ó wù k'ó dé,
B'ọnà rẹ s'ókùnkùn,
Sún m'Àmonà rẹ;
'Gbà t'éwu ìhàlẹ ọtá
bá ń wu ọ,
'Gbà t'ó ń b'Ólúwa rìn,
ìfòyà kò sí.
Tẹ sí ... wa ... jú pẹlú 'gboyà
K'á s'agbá ... ra rẹ di ọtun,
Má bá Jé ... sù rìn l'ójúmo;
Yóó s'Àmọnà rẹ ń'nú àjò rẹ.

Máa b'Ólùgbàlà rìn,
'bikíbi t'ó ń lọ,
'Gbà t'ó ń rìn l'ókùnkùn,
yóó f'ọnà hàn ọ,
'Mọlẹ iwájú Rẹ yóó mọlẹ s'ọnà rẹ;
Yóó sọ aginjù rẹ d'ọgbà Eédẹn'.

englishTitle: GLADLY, GLADLY, TOILING FOR THE MASTER
yorubaTitle: ẸLÚ AYỌ L'A Ó S'IṢẸ F'ÓLÚWA

sections.text:
Gladly, gladly, toiling for the Master,
Go we forth with willing hands to do,
Whatsoe'er to us He hath appointed;
Faithfully our mission We'll purse
Toiling for Jesus,
Joyfully we go, yes, joyfully we go;
Toiling for Jesus,
In His vineyard here below.

Sweetly, sweetly, we will tell the story
Of His love to mortals here below,
Christ, the brightness of the father's glory,
Freely here His blessings will bestow.

Meekly, meekly, toiling for the Master,
Walking, faithfully the path He trod,
Leading wand'rers to the dear Redeemer;
Pointing sinners to the Lamb of God.
Amen.

Pẹlú ayọ l'a ó s'iṣẹ f'Ólúwa,
Pẹlú ìfẹ l'a ó f'ọwọ wa se
Isẹkise tí Ó bá yàn fún wa!
L'ódodo l'a ó s'iṣẹ 'rànsẹ wa
S'iṣẹ fún Jésù,
L'áyo l'a ó lọ, L'áyo l'a ó lọ;
S'iṣẹ fún Jésù,
Nínú ọgbà Rẹ l'áyé.

Pẹlú adùn lí a ó sọ ìtàn náà;
T'ìfẹ Rẹ ńlá s'áwa ènìyàn,
Krístì ìtànsán ògo ti Baba,
L'ọfẹ l'Òun ó f' ìbùkún fún wa.

Pẹlú 'rẹlẹ l'a ó s'iṣẹ f'Ólúwa,
A ó fi òtítọ rìn l'ọnà Rẹ;
A ó tọ asáko s'ọd'Olùgbàlà,
A ó f'Ọd'àgùntàn han ẹlẹsẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: AND ARE WE YET ALIVE

sections.text:
And are we yet alive,
And see each other's face?
Glory and praise to
Jesus give,
For His redeeming grace!

Preserv'd by pow'r divine
To full salvation here.
Again in Jesus' praise we join.
And m His sight appear.

What troubles have we seen.
What conflicts have
we pass'd,
Fightings without and fears
within,
Since we assembled last!

But out of all the Lord
Hath brought us by His love;
And still He doth His help
afford,
And hides our life above.

Then Jet us make our boast
Of His redeeming pow'r.
Which saves us to the
uttermost.
Till we can sin no more.

Let us take up the cross,
Till we the crown obtain;
And gladly reckon all
Things loss,
So we may Jesus gain.
Amen.

A ń bẹ l'áyé síbẹ,
A si tún 'ra wa rí?
Ògo at'ìyìn fún Jésù
Fún oore-ọfẹ Rẹ!

Olúwa pa wá mọ,
S'ẹkùn-ún 'gbàlà níhìn-ín
A tún dàpọ k'á yin Jésù,
A ń bẹ níwájú Rẹ.

Ìpọnjú t'á ti rí,
Ìyà tí a ti jẹ
Ìjà l'óde, ẹrú nínú,
Lẹyìn t'á pé kẹhìn!

Sùgbọn Jesu fi 'fe
Y'o wa n'nu gbogbo rẹ;
Ò sì ń ràn wá lọwọ síbẹ
Ó ń pa ẹmí wa mọ.

Ẹ jẹ ká máa fi
'Ràpadà Rẹ s'ògo
Tí y'ó gbà wá là dé òpin,
'Gbà t'a kì ó sẹ mọ.

K'á gbé àgbélébùú,
Títí a ó gb'adé;
K'á ka ohun gbogbo s'ófo
K'á lè jèrè Jésù.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: O GOD, OUR HELP IN AGES PAST

sections.text:
O God, our help in ages past.
Our hope for years to come,
Our shelter from the stormy blast
And our eternal home:

Under the shadow of
Thy throne.
Still may we dwell secure;
Sufficient is Thine arm alone.
And our defence is sure.

Before the hills in order stood,
Or earth received her frame,
From everlasting Thou
art God
To endless years the same.

A thousand ages in Thy sight
Are like an evening gone.
Short as the watch that ends the night
Before the rising sun.

Time, like an ever-rolling stream.
Bears all its sons away:
They fly forgotten as a dream
Dies as at the opening day.

O God, our help in ages past
Our hope for years to come
Be Thou our guard while lire shall last,
And our perpetual home.
Amen.

Ọlọrun t'ọdún t'ó kọjá
Ìrèt' èyí tí ń bọ;
Ib'ísádi wa ní ìjì
Àt' ilé wa láéláé.

L'ábẹ ọ̀jìji ìtẹ Rẹ
L'àwọn ènìyàn Rẹ ń gbé,
Tító l'apá Rẹ nikan so,
Ààbò wa sì dájú.

K'àwọn òkè k'ó tó dúró,
Tàbí k'á t ó d'áye,
Láéláé Ìwọ ni Ọlọrun
Bákan náà, l'àìlópin!

Ẹgbẹrún ọdún l'ójú Rẹ,
Bí alẹ kan l'ó rí;
Bí 'sọ kan l'áfẹẹmọjúmọ
Kí oòrùn k'ó tó là.

Ọlọrun t'ọdún t'ó kọjá,
Ìrèt' èyí tí ń bọ,
Máa s'ààbò wa 'gbà 'yọnu dé;
Àt' ilé wa láélaáé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: LEAD US, HEAV'NLY FATHER
yorubaTitle: MÁA TỌ WA BABA WA ỌRUN

sections.text:
Lead us, heav'nly Father, lead us.
O'er the world's tempestuous sea;
Guard us, guide us, keep us, feed us,
For we have no help but Thee,
Yet possessing every blessing
If our God our Father be.

Spirit of our God, descending,
Fill Our hurts with heavenly joy.
Love with every passion blending.
Pleasure that can never cloy;
Thus provided, pardon'd, guided,
Nothing can our peace destroy.
Amen.

Máa tọ wa Baba wa ọrun
L'ààrin 'dánwò ayé yíì,
Pa wá mọ k'ó sì máa bọ wa;
A kò ní 'rànwọ mìíràn,
Sùgbọn gbogbo 'bùkún l'a ní,
B'Ọlọrun ję Baba wa.

Olùgbàlà, dáríjì wá,
Ìwọ sá rí àìlera wa,
'Wọ ti rin ayé saájú wa,
Bí aláàárẹ, Ẹni-'kááánú,
Ni 'Wọ l'aginjù yíì já.

Ẹmí Ọlọrun, sọkalẹ,
F'ayọ ọrun k'ọkàn wa,
Kí 'fẹ dàpọ mọ ìyà wa,
Àt'adùn tí kìí sú ni,
B'á bá pèsè fún wa bàyíì,
Kí l'ó lè dà wá láàmú?
Ààmín.

englishTitle: FORTH IN THY NAME
yorubaTitle: OLUWA MI, MO Ń JADE LỌ

sections.text:
Forth in Thy name, O Lord I go,
My daily labour to pursue,
Thee, only Thee, resolved to know
In all I think, or speak, or do.

The task Thy wisdom hath assigned,
O let me cheerfully fulfill,
In all my works Thy presence find,
And prove Thy good and perfect will.

Preserve me from my calling's snare
And hide my simple heart above,
Above the thorns of choking care;
The gilded baits of worldly love.

Thee may I see at my right hand,
Whose eyes my inmost substance sees.
And labour on at Thy command,
And offer all my works to Thee.

Give me to bear Thy easy yoke.
And every moment watch and pray,
And still to things eternal look,
And hasten to Thy glorious day.
For Thee delightfully employ.

Whate'er Thy bounteous
grace hath giv'n,
And run my course with
even joy,
And closely walk with
Thee to heaven.
Amen.

Olúwa mi, mo ń jáde lọ,
Láti se iṣẹ òòjọ mi;
Ìwọ nìkan l'èmi ó mọ
Lọrọ, lérò, àti ní'se.

Iṣẹ t'Ó yàn mí l'áánú Rẹ,
Jẹ kí n lè se é tayọtayọ,
Kí n r'ójú Rẹ ń'nú iṣẹ mi,
K'èmi sì lè f'ìfẹ Rẹ hàn.

Dáàbò bò mi lọwọ dánwò,
K' Ó pa ọkan mi mọ kúrò
Lọwọ àníyàn ayé yií;
Àti gbogbo ìfẹkúfẹ.

Ìwọ t'ójú Rẹ r'ọkàn mi,
Máa wà l'ọw' ọtún mi títí,
Kí n máa sisẹ lọ l'áṣẹ Rẹ,
Kí n fi'sẹ mi gbogbo fún Ọ.

Jẹ kí n rẹrù Rẹ t'ó fúyẹ,
Kí n máa sọra nígbà gbogbo;
Kí n máa f'ojú sí nkan t'ọrun,
Kí n sì múra d'ọjọ ògo.

Ohunkóhun t' Ó fi fún mi,
Jẹ kí n lè lò ó fún ògo Rẹ,
Kí n f'ayọ súré ije mi,
Kí n bá Q rìn títí d'ópin.
Amin.

englishTitle: ALMIGHTY GOD, GRANT THAT THY PRAISE

sections.text:
Almighty God, grant that
Thy praise,
All our voices employ,
Thy hand has made
the days go by
Another year has come.

Our sacrifice rise up to Thee
Father of all goodness
For Thy mercy,
from year to year,
That flows from Thy bosom.

In all the changing scenes
of life,
May Thy mercy endure.
As much as Thy goodness
to us,
So let our praises be.

In all the changing scenes
of life
We feel Thy anxious care,
Let that same mercy,
Lord we plead;
Bless the New Year begun.

And if Thou gives joy,
may that joy,
Draw us closer to Thee;
And if suffering, then we
Shall sing
As long as Thou bless us.
Amen.

Ọlọrun wa, jẹ k'iyin Rẹ
Gb'ohùn gbogbo wa kan;
Ọwọ Rẹ yí ọjọ wa po,
Ọdún míìràn sì dé.

Ẹbùn wa ń gòkè s'ọdọ Rẹ,
Baba, Olóore wa:
Fún àánú ọdọọdún tí ń sàn,
Láti ọdọ Rẹ wá.

Ńnú gbogbo àyídà ayé,
K'àánú Rẹ wà síbẹ:
B'óore Rẹ sí wa sì ti pọ,
Bẹẹ ni k'iyin wa pọ.
