Ńnú gbogbo àyídà ayé,
A ń rí àníyàn Rẹ;
Jọwọ, jẹ k'áàánú Rẹ
kan náà
Bùkún ọdún titun.

B'áyo bá sì wà, k'áyo náà.
Fà wá sí ọdọ Rẹ;
Bí'yà ni, àwa ó kọrin.
Bí 'bùkún Rẹ pẹlú.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: STANDING AT THE PORTAL
yorubaTitle: NÍ BẸRẸ ỌDÚN YÍÍ, ỌDÚN TITUN YÍÍ

sections.text:
Standing at the portal
Of the op'ning year
Words of comfort meet us
Hushing ev'ry fear
Spoken through the silence
By our Father's voice
Tender, strong, and faithful,
Making us rejoice.
Onward, then, and fear not
children of the day!
For His Word shall never,
Never pass away!

I, the Lord, am with thee,
Be thou not afraid!
I will help and strengthen
Be Thou not dismayed!
Yea, I will uphold thee
With my own right hand
Thou art called and chosen
In my sight to stand.

For the year before us
O what rich supplies!
For the poor and needy
Living streams shall rise!
For the sad and sinful,
Shall His grace abound.
For the faint and feeble,
Perfect strength be found.

He will never fail us
He will not forsake;
His eternal cov'nant
He will never break!
Resting on His promise
What have we to fear?
God is all-sufficient,
For the coming year.

Ní 'bẹrẹ ọdún yi,
odun titun yi
Ọrọ ìtùnú dé, tí ń lé ẹrù lọ
Ohun jęję, ti Baba ọrun
Ododo l'ọrọ náà,
Tí ń m'ọkàn wa yọ;
Ẹ máa tęsíwájú, ọmọ
ìmọlẹ,
Ọrọ Rẹ kò lè yẹ,
O ń dúró títí.

“Má bẹrù”, l'ọrọ náà,
“Mo wà pẹlú yín!”
Èmi n'ìránwọ yin
àt'agbára yin,
Èmi yóó dì yín mú,
lí ọwọ'tún mi,
Mo pè yín, mo yàn yín,
láti ję t'Èmi.

Fún ọpọ ọdún tí ń bẹ
níwájú wa,
Ọpọ ni ìpèsè t'ó ti sèlérí,
Ìpèsè fáláìní, f'áwọn ẹlẹsẹ,
F'áwọn t'á ń pọn lójú, fún
aláilera.

Kò ję fi wá sílẹ,
kò sì ní kọ wá,
Májemú Rẹ dájú tí
kò lè yẹ láé,
A rọ mọ 'lérí yìí, ẹrù kò
bà wá,
Ọlọrun wa ti tó fún ọdún
tí ń bọ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: ANOTHER YEAR HAS ROLLED BY

sections.text:
Another year has rolled by
The time flies so quickly by,
This year which is to pass by;
May be the last year for some,
It's Thy mercy kept us through
Have we been benefited?
We should ask are we prepar'd
If we are call'd home
this year?

This world is a battle ground,
Thousands are falling down
dead,
The arrows of death that fly
Can be sent to me, to you
When the word is preached,
we hear
Help our hearts to meditate,
Eternity's close at hand
We are standing on the brink.

If we are saved from our sins,
By the grace of God divine,
We shall hear Him say,
“Come home!”
May we see His face in
heav'n.
For Thy people here on earth
Grant us mercy this new year
The year that's more full
Of joy;
Is the one that sees them home.
Amen.

Ọdún mìíràn ti kọjá
Wawa l'àkókò náà lọ
Nínú èyí t'á wà yìí
Yóó s'arímọ f'ọpọ:
Àánú ló fi dá wa sí,
A ha lo àánú náà bí?
K'á bi 'ra wa bá se tán?
B'á ó pè wá l'ọdún-níí.

Ayé bí ibi ìjà,
Ẹgbẹẹgbẹrun l'ó ń subú;
Ọfà ikú t'ó sì ń fò,
A lè ran s'émi sí 'wọ;
Nígb'a ń wàásù t'á sì ń gbọ,
Olúwa ję k'á sáàrò
P'áyérayé sún mọlẹ
A ń dúró l'étí, bèbè.

B'á gbà wá lọwọ ẹṣẹ
Nípa oore-ọfẹ Rẹ,
Njẹ, 'Máa bọ', ni 'pè ó ję,
K'á lè lọ, k'á r'ójú Rẹ:
F'éniyàn Rẹ l'áyé yìí;
K'ààánú wà l'ọdún titun:
Ọdún t'ó l'áyọ jù yìí,
L'èyí t'ó mú wọn dé 'lé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: RIDE ON, RIDE ON IN MAJESTY

sections.text:
Ride on, ride on in majesty,
Hark! All the tribes
“Hosanna!” cry;
O Saviour meek,
pursue Thy road,
With palms and scattered
garments strow'd

Ride on, ride on in majesty,
In lowly pomp, ride on to die,
Oh Christ, Thy triumph
now begin;
O'er captive death and
conquer'd sin.

Ride on, ride on in majesty,
The winged squadrons
of the skies,
Look sad with sad and
wondering eyes;
To see approaching sacrifice.

Ride on, ride on in majesty,
Thy last and fiercest strife
is nigh,
The Father on His sapphire
throne;
Expects His own anointed
Son.

Ride on, ride on in majesty,
In lowly pomp, ride on to die,
Now Thy meek head to
mortal pain;
Then take, oh God, Thy
power, and reign.
Amen.

Máa g'ẹṣin lọ l'ọlánlá Rẹ,
Gbọ! Gbogbo'ayé ń ké,
“Hòsánà”
Olùgbàlà, Máa lọ pẹlẹ,
Lórí im'ọpẹ àt'asọ.

Máa g'ẹṣin lọ l'ọlánlá Rẹ,
Máa f'irẹlẹ g'ẹṣin lọ kú;
Krístì, 'ṣegun Rẹ bẹrẹ ná
Lórí ẹṣẹ àti ikú.

Máa g'ẹṣin lọ l'ọlánlá Rẹ,
Ogun ángẹlì lát'ọrun
Ń f'iyanu pẹlú ikáàánú
Wo ẹbọ t'ó sún mọ'le yìí.

Máa g'ẹṣin lọ l'ọlánlá Rẹ,
Ìjà ìkẹyìn náà dé tán,
Baba l'ór'itẹ Rẹ l'ọrun,
Ń retí àyànfẹ Ọmọ Rẹ.

Máa g'ẹṣin lọ l'ọlánlá Rẹ,
Máa f'irẹlẹ g'ẹṣin lọ kú;
F'ara da ìrora fẹdàá,
Lẹyìn náà nde,
K'Ó máa jọba.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: CHRIST OUR REDEEMER DIED ON THE CROSS

sections.text:
Christ our redeemer died on the cross,
Died for the sinner,
Paid all his due;
All who receive Him need never fear,
Yes, He will pass, will pass over you.

When I see the blood,
When I see the blood,
When I see the blood,
I will pass, I will pass over you.

Chiefest of sinners, Jesus can save,
As He has promised, so He will do;
Oh, sinner, hear Him, trust in His Word,
Then He will pass, will pass over you.

Judgment is coming, all will be there
Who have rejected, who have refused!
Oh, sinner, hasten, let Jesus in,
Then God will pass, will pass over you.

Oh, what compassion, oh boundless love!
Jesus hath power, Jesus is true;
All who believe are safe from the storm,
For He will pass, will pass over you.
Amen.

Krístì kú lórí àgbélébùú,
Ó kú f'ẹlẹṣẹ, san 'gbèsè rẹ,
Ẹrù kò sí f'awọn t'ó gbàgbọ,
Nítorí y'ó ré wọn kọja.

Gba mo bá rí ẹjẹ,
Gba mo bá rí ẹjẹ,
Gba mo bá rí ẹjẹ,
N ó ré, n ó ré yín kọjá

Krist' lè gba olórí ẹlẹṣẹ,
B'Ó ti se'lérí,
y'ó sì mú un sẹ,
Ẹlẹṣẹ gbóhùn Rẹ, sì gbàgbọ
Gbà náà y'ó ré, y'ó ré ọ kọja

Ìdajo ń bọ, ẹṣẹ wa y'ó pé
Àwọn t'ó pa, at'awọn t'ó ko
Ẹlẹṣẹ tèté pe Krist wọlé
Gba náà, Baba y'ó ré ọ kọja.

Wo ìyọnú Rẹ! Wo ìfẹ Rẹ!
Alágbára ni; Olóòótọ ni!
Kò s' ewu fún àwọn t'ó gbàgbọ
'Torí y'ó ré, y'ó ré wọn kọja.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: A-LAS, AND DID MY SAV-IOUR BLEED?

sections.text:
A-las, and did my Sav-iour bleed?
And did my Sov-ereign die?
Would He de-vote that sacred head,
For such a worm as I?
At the cross, at the cross
where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled a-way
It was there by faith
I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day

Was it for crimes that I have done,
He groaned up-on the tree?
A-mazing pit-y! Grace un-known!
And love be-yond degree!

Well might the sun in dark-ness hide,
And shut his glo-ries in,
When Christ, the might-y mak-er died,
For man the crea-ture's sin.

Thus might I hide my blushing face,
While His dear cross appears
Dissolve my heart in thankfulness,
And' melt mine eyes to tears.

But drops of grief can ne'er repay
The debt of love I owe;
Here, Lord I give my-self A-way,
'Tis all that I can do!
Amen.

O se! Olùgbàlà mi ta 'jẹ
Rẹ sílẹ, Ó kú
Njẹ ó jẹ f' ori mimọ náà
Fún kòkòrò b'emi?
Ní'bi àgbélébùú ni mo kọ rí ìmọlẹ
Ní'bẹ, ẹrù ọkàn mi sì fò lọ;
Ní'bẹ nípa ìgbàgbọ,
mo ríran
Nísìn, mo wà l'alàáfíà títí.

Njẹ tor'ẹṣẹ tí mo ti dá
L'o se jìyà oró?
Àánú àt' oore-ọfẹ yìí
Kò se díwọn rárá.

O tọ k'ọrun k'ó s'òkùnkùn,
K'o f'ògo Rẹ pamọ,
Nígbà Krist Ẹlẹdàá ńlá kú
F'ẹṣẹ àwa ẹdá.

Bẹẹ l'ó yẹ kí ń f'ojú pamọ
Ní'bi àgbélébùú
K'ọkàn mi sì yọ ní dúpẹ.
K'ojú mi s'omijé.

Sùgbọn 'bànújẹ kó lé san
'Gbèsè 'fẹ tí mo jẹ,
Kristi mo f'ara mi fún Ọ.
Èyí ni mo lè se!
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I GAVE MY LIFE FOR THEE

sections.text:
I gave my life for thee,
My precious blood I shed,
That thou might'st
Ransom'd be
And quicken'd from the dead,
I gave my life for thee;
What hast thou given for Me?

I spent long years for thee,
In weariness and woe,
That on eternity
Of joy thou mightest know
I spend long years for thee;
Hast thou spent one for Me?

My Father's home of light.
My rainbow circled throne,
I left for earthly night,
For wandering sad and lone
I left it all for thee;
Hast thou left aught for Me?

I suffer'd much for thee,
More than thy tongue can tell,
Of bitterest agony,
To rescue thee from hell,
I suffer'd much for thee;
What canst thou bear for Me?

And I have brought to thee,
Down from my home above,
Salvation full and free,
My pardon and my love
Great gifts I brought to thee;
What hast thou brought
to me?

Oh, let thy life be given,
Thy years for me be spent
World fetters all be riven,
And joy with suffering blent
I gave myself for thee;
Give thou thyself to me.
Amen.

Mo fara mi fún Ọ,
Mo kú nitorí rẹ,
Kí n lè rà ọ padà,
K'ó lè jínde ń'nòkú;
Mo f'ara mi fún Ọ,
Kín n'iwọ se fún mi?

“Mo f' ọjọ ayé mi,
Se wàhálà fún Ọ,
Kí ìwọ ba lè mọ,
Adùn ayérayé.
Mo l'ọpọ 'dún fún Ọ
O lò kan fún mi bí?

“Ilé ti Baba mi
Àt'ilé ògo mi
Mo fi sílẹ wa'yé
Mo fi'lẹ tori rẹ
Kí lo fi'lẹ fún mi?

Mo jìyà pọ fún Ọ
Ti ẹnu kò lè sọ
Mo jìjàkadì ńlá
Torí ìgbàlà rẹ;
Mo jìyà pọ fún Ọ
O lè jìyà fún mi?

Mo mu igbala ńlá
Lat' ile Baba mi
Wa lati fi fun o
Ati idariji;
Mo m'ebun wa fun O
Ki l'o mu wa fun mi?

Fi ara re fun mi
Fi aye re sin mi
Diju si nnkan t'aye
Si wo ohun t'orun
Mo f'ara mi fun ọ
Si f'ara rẹ fun mi. Ààmín.

englishTitle: HAVE YOU READ THE STORY OF THE CROSS

sections.text:
Have you read the sto-ry of the cross
Where Jesus bled and died?
Where your debt was paid by his precious Blood
That flowed from His wounded side?

Chorus: He died of a bro-ken heart for you
He died of a bro-ken heart
Upon a tree, for you for me,
He died of a bro-ken heart.

Have you read how they placed the crown of thorns,
Up-on His brow for you?
When he prayed, For-give them, oh! Forgive,
They know not what they do.

Have you read how He save the dying thief
When hanging on the tree?
When He looked with pleading eyes and said,
“Dear Lord, re-mem-ber me.”

Have you read that He looked to heaven and said,
Tis finished “'t was for thee!”
Have you ev-er said, I thank Thee, Lord,
For giv-ing Thy life for me!

O ti ka itàn àgbélébúú
Ní'bi tí Jésù kú,
Ní'bi tí ẹjẹ Rẹ iyebíye,
Ti ń san gbogbo gbèsé mi
Ó kú ikú 'bànúje fun mi
Ó kú ikú 'bànúje
A! Ìfẹ ìyanu fún mi
Ó kú ikú 'bànúje

O ti kà b'á ti f'adé ẹgún
Dé orí Rẹ fún mi
'Gba t' Ó gbàdúrà pé,
“Dáriji wọn,
Wọn se 'laimọkan sa ni!”

O ti ka b' Ó ti gb'olè nì là
T'o ń kú lo l'orí 'gi,
Nígbà tí ó fi ikààánú wí pé
“Oluwa jọọ ránti mi?”

O ti k àb'ó ti gbójú s'okè
T' o wí pé, 'Ó parí'
O ti sọ pé, 'Mo dúpẹ Olúwa
Nitori O kú fún mi?
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHEN I SURVEY THE WONDROUS CROSS

sections.text:
When I survey the wondrous cross
On which the prince of Glory died,
My richest gain I count but loss;
And pour contempt on all my pride.

Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast,
Save in the death of Christ, my God;
All the vain things that charm me most,
I sacrifice them to His blood.

See, From His head, His hands, His feet,
Sorrow and love flow mingled down,
Did e'er such love and sorrow meet,
Or thorns compose so rich a crown?

Were the whole realm or nature mine,
That were an offering far too small;
Love so amazing, so divine,
Demands my soul, my life, my all.
Amen.

'Gbà tí mo rí àgbélébúú,
Tí a kan Ọba Ògo mọ,
Mo ka gbogbo ọro s'ofo;
Mo kẹgàn gbogbo ògo mi.

K'á má se gbọ pé, mo ń halẹ,
B'ó yẹ n'íkú Olúwa mi;
Gbogbo nkan asán ti mo fẹ,
Mo dà á sílẹ fún ẹjẹ Rẹ.

Wòó lát' orí, ọwọ, ẹsẹ,
Bí 'káánú àt' ìfẹ ti ń sàn,
'Bànújẹ àt' ìfẹ papọ,
A f'ẹgún se adé ògo.

englishTitle: ON A HILL FAR AWAY
yorubaTitle: LÓR' ÒKÈ LEYÌN 'LÚ, L' ÀGBÉLÉBÙÚ KAN WÀ

sections.text:
Oh! That old rugged cross so
despised by the world
Has a wondrous attraction
for me;
For the dear Lamb of God
left His glory above.
To bear it to dark Calvary.

In the old rugged cross;
Stained with blood so divine
A wonderful beauty I see
For 'twas on that old cross,
Jesus suffered and died
To pardon and sanctify me.

To the old rugged cross I
will ever be true;
It's shame and reproach
gladly bear;
Then He'll call me some day
to my home far away
Where His glory forever
I'll share.

Lór' òkè lẹyìn'lú, l'àgbélébùú kan wà,
Apere ìyà àt' ẹgàn,
Ọkàn mi fà síbẹ b'olùfẹ mi ọwọn,
T'á pa f'ẹsẹ gbogbo ayé.
N ó gbé àgbélébùú Rẹ náà rù....
Títí n ó fì kó èrè mi jọ,
N ó rọ mọ àgbélébùú Mi náà....
K'émi lè dé adé níkẹyìn.

Lór' àgbélébùú yìí, tí
aráyé kẹgan,
Òun l'ó sì lẹwà lójú mi,
Nítor' Ọm' Ọlọrun bọ
ògo Rẹ sílẹ,
Ó sí ti lọ sí Kálfári.

L'ár' àgbélébùú yìí,
l'ẹjẹ mímọ sàn sí,
Ó lẹwà púpọ l'ójú mi,
Torí pé l'órí rẹ, Jésù jìyà
fún mi,
Ó f' ẹṣẹ jì, Ó wẹ mí mọ.

S'Ẹni t'ó kú fún mi, Èmi
yóó j' ólóòótọ,
N ó yọ s'ẹgàn àt' ìtijú,
Nígbòóse yóó pè mí lọ
'le ayeraye;
Kí n lè pín nínú ògo Rẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WELCOME HAPPY MORNING
yorubaTitle: KÁÀBỌ ỌJỌ RERE, L'AÓ MÁÀ WÍ TÍTÍ

sections.text:
'Welcome happy morning,'
age to age shall say;
Hell today is vanquish'd,
heaven is won today
Lo the Dead is living, God
for evermore!
Him their true Creator all
His works adore,
Welcome happy morning
age to age shall say
Hell today is vanquish'd
heaven is won today.

Maker and redeemer, life
and health of all,
Thou from heaven beholding
human nature's fall,
Of the father's Godhead true
and only son
Manhood to deliver,
manhood didst put on,

Thou, life the Author,
  death didst undergo,
Tread the path of darkness,
  saving strength to show,
Come then, True and
Faithful, now fulfill Thy
  word
'Tis Thine own third
  morning; rise,
My buried Lord.

Loose the hearts long
  prison'd bound with
Satan's chain
All that now is fallen raise
  to life again,
Show Thy face in
  righteousness,
Bid the nations see;
Bring again our daylight day
  returns with Thee.
Amen.

“Káàbọ ọjọ rere”,
l'a ó máa wí títí,
A sẹgun 'kú lóní,
ọrun di tiwa.
'Wọ Ọkú d'alààyè,
Ọba tít'ayé!
Gbogb' ẹdá Rẹ, Jésù,
Ni wọn ń júbà Rẹ.
“Káàbọ ọjọ rere”,
l'aó máa wí títí;
A sẹgun 'kú lóní,
ọrun di tiwa.

Ẹlẹdàá Olúwa Ẹmí alààyè!
Lát'ọrun l'O ti bojú
wo'sìnà wa,
Ọm' Ọlọrun pààpàá ni
‘Wọ tilẹ se,
K'O bàá lè gbà wá là;
O di eniyan.

'Wọ Olúwa ìyè O wá
  tọ'kú wò;
Láti f'ipá Rẹ hàn,
O sùn n'ibojì;
Wa, Ẹni Olóòótọ, sì
  m'ọrọ Rẹ sẹ,
Ọjọ kẹta Rẹ dé,
Jínde Olúwa,

Tú ìgbèkùn sílẹ,
  t'Èṣù dè l'ẹwọn,
Àwọn t'ó si subú jọọ
  gbé wọn dìde;
F'ojúrere Rẹ hàn jẹ
  k'ayé ríran,
Tún mú 'mọlẹ wa dé,
'Wọ sa ni'Mọlẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: LISTEN TO HYMNS OF DELIVERANCE

sections.text:
Listen to hymns of deliv'rance
The new songs of praises
They sing praises to glorious lamb
They sing the hymn this way:
Praise Him who shows us
  His blood
Who cleansed us with
  His blood
Who sacrificed our defiled
  mind
According to His word.

Our robes were washed in
  His own blood
They are just white as snow
The light which shineth on
  our hearts
Showeth Thy glorious truth.

Through the precious blood of Jesus
We route the Christian foe
Through that power of thy word of truth
Who could be victorious?

Let us adore the precious lamb
Who sends this light to us.
Thine is glory Thine is power
The greatest power on earth
Amen.

Gbọ orin ẹni 'ràpadà,
Orin ìyìn títún,
Wọn yin Ọd'àgùntàn logo,
Wọn ń kọrin náà bàyíì.
Ògo f'Ẹni to fẹ wa
T'ó f'ẹjẹ Rẹ wẹ wá
Tí o sì sọ wá di mímọ
Gẹgẹ bí ọrọ Rẹ.

A f'ọṣọ wa nín'ẹjẹ Rẹ,
Ó sì funfun láúláú,
'Mọlẹ tó tàn sí ọkàn wa,
Ń f'ipa òótọ Rẹ hàn.

Nípa 'gbára ẹjẹ Jésù,
L'a ń fọ 'tẹgun Èsù,
Nípa agbára òtítọ Rẹ,
L'a lè borí ọtá.

Jẹ k'á júbà ọd'àgùntàn,
Tó fún wa ni'mọlẹ,
Tirẹ l'ògo àt'agbára,
Qlánlá àt'ipá.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS LIVES; THY TERRORS NOW

sections.text:
Jesus lives; thy terrors now
Can, O death, no more appall us;
Jesus lives; by this we know
Thou, O Grave, canst not enthrall us.
Alleluia!

Jesus lives henceforth is death
But the gate of life immortal:
This shall calm our trembling breath
When we pass its gloomy portal.
Alleluia!

Jesus lives for us He died;
Then alone to Jesus living
Pure in heart may we abide,
Glory to our Saviour giving.
Alleluia!

Jesus lives our hearts know well
Naught from us His love shall sever;
Life, nor death, nor powers of hell
Tear us from His keeping ever,
Alleluia!

Jesus lives; thy terrors now
Can, O death, no more
appall us;
Jesus lives; by this we know
Thou, O Grave, canst not

Jésù yè, lát'óní lọ,
Ẹrù ikú kò ba mí mọ;
Jésù yè; nítorí náà,
Ìsà òkú kò ní 'pa mọ.
Alelúyà!

Jésù yè; lát'óní lọ,
Ikú jẹ ọna sí ìyè!
Èyí y'ó jẹ 'túnú wa
'Gbàt' àkókò ikú baá dé.
Alelúyà!

Jésù yè; fun wa l'O ku
Nje Tire ni a o maa se
A o f'okan funfun sin In
A o f'ogo f'Olougbala;
Aleluya!

Jésù yè; èyí dájú,
Ikú àt'ipá òkùnkùn
Kì y'ó lè yà 'ni kúrò
Nínú ìfẹ ńlá ti Jésù.
Alelúyà!

Jesu ye, gbogbo joba
L'orun, li aye, di tire
E je ki a maa te l'e
Ki a le joba pelu Re
Aleluya.
Aamin.

englishTitle: I KNOW THAT MY REDEEMER LIVES
yorubaTitle: MO MỌ P'OLÙDÁŃDÈ MI Ń BẸ

sections.text:
I know that my Redeemer
lives
Oh the sweet joy this
sentence gives;
He lives, He lives,
who once was dead,
He lives my everlasting Head.

He lives, my kind, wise,
constant Friend;
Who still will keep me
to the end,
He lives, and while
He lives I'll sing
Jesus, my Prophet,
Priest, and King.

He lives my mansion to
prepare;
And He will bring me safely
there:
He lives, all glory to
His name
Jesus, unchangeably the
same.
Amen.

Mo mọ p'Olùdáńdè mi ń bẹ
Ìtúnú ńlá l'èyí fún mi;
Ó ń bẹ, Ẹni t'ó kú lẹẹkan,
Ó ń bẹ, Ẹni yè títí láé.

Ó ń bẹ, láti máa bùkún mi,
Ó sì ń bẹbẹ fún mi l'ókè
Ó ń bẹ láti jí mi ń'bojì,
Láti gbà mí là, títí láé.

Ó ń bẹ, Ọrẹ kòríkòsún,
Tí y'ó pa mí mọ dé òpin
Ó ń bẹ, èmi ó máa kọrin,
Wolìi, Àlùfáà, Ọba mi

Ó ń bẹ láti pèsè ààyè,
Yó sì mú mi dé 'bẹ láyọ,
Ó ń bẹ, ògo f'orúkọ Rẹ,
Jésù, ọkan títí láé.

Ó ń bẹ, mo bọ lọw'áníyàn
Ó ń bẹ, mo bọ lọwọ ewu,
Háà! ayọ l'ọrọ yìí fún mi,
Mo mọ p'Olùdáńdè
Mi ń bẹ.
Ààmn.

englishTitle: JESUS STAND AMONG US

sections.text:
Jesus, stand among us
In Thy risen power;
Let this time of worship
Be a hallow'd hour.

Breathe the Holy Spirit
Into every heart,
Bid the fears and sorrows
From each soul depart.

Thus with quicken'd footsteps
We pursue our way,
Watching for the dawning
Of eternal day.
Amen.

Jésù, wá s'áàrin wa
L'agbár 'àjínde;
Jẹ k'ìsin wa níhìn
Jẹ ìsin ọwọ.

Mí Emí Mímọ Rẹ,
Sínú ọkàn wa;
Mú 'fòyà àt'arò
Kúrò l'ọkàn wa.

Bí a ti ń yára lọ
L'ọnà àjò wa;
K'a máa sọnà f'òrọ
T'oj'ayérayé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: ALLELUIA! ALLELUIA! ALLELUIA!

sections.text:
Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!
The strife is o'er,
The battle done:
The victory of life is won:
The song of triumph has
begun,
Alleluia!

The powers of death have
done their worst,
But Christ their legions hath
dispersed;
Let shouts of holy joy
outburst.
Alleluia!

He brake the age-bound
chain of hell;
The bars from heaven's high
portals fell;
Let hymns of praise His
triumph tell:
Alleluia!

Lord, by the stripes which
wounded Thee,
From death dread sting Thy
servants free,
That we may live and sing
to Thee.
Alleluia! Amen

Aleluya! Aleluya! Aleluya!
Ija d'opin, ogun si tan,
Olugbala jagun molu,
Orin ayo la o máa ko;
Aleluya!

Ọjọ mẹta náà ti kọja,
O jinde kuro nín'òkú;
Ẹ fọgo fún Oluwa wa
Aleluya!

O d'ẹwọn ọrun àpáàdì,
O silẹkun ọrun silẹ,
Ẹ kọrin iyin 'sẹgun Rẹ.
Aleluya!

Jesu, nipa iya t'O jẹ
Gba wa lọwọ oro ikú,
K'a le yó, ká si máa yìn Ọ.
Aleluya. Ààmín.

englishTitle: CHRIST THE LORD IS RISEN TODAY

sections.text:
Christ the Lord is risen
to-day: Alleluia!
Sons of men, and angels, say:
Alleluia!
Raise your joys and triumphs
high: Alleluia!
Sing, ye heav'ns; thou earth,
reply: Alleluia!

Love's redeeming work is
done: Alleluia!
Fought the fight, the battle
won: Alleluia!
Lo! our Sun's eclipse is o'er:
Alleluia!
Lo! He sets in blood no
more: Alleluia!

Vain the stone, the watch,
the seal: Alleluia!
Christ hath burst the gates of
hell: Alleluia!
Death in vain forbids His
rise: Alleluia!
Christ hath opened Paradise:
Alleluia!

Lives again our glorious
King; Alleluia!
Where, O death, is now thy
sting? Alleluia!
Once He died our souls to
save; Alleluia!
Where thy victory, O grave?
Alleluia!

Soar we now where Christ
hath led: Alleluia!
Following our exalted Head:
Alleluia!
Made like Him, like Him we
rise: Alleluia!
Ours the cross, the grave, the
skies: Alleluia!

Hail the Lord, of earth and
heaven: Alleluia!
Praise to Thee by both be
given: Alleluia!
Thee we greet triumphant
now: Alleluia!
Hail the Resurrection thou!
Alleluia!
Amen.

Krist' Olúwa jí loníi ...
Aleluyà!
Ẹdá àt'Ańgẹlì ń wí ...
Aleluyà!
Gb'ayọ àt'ìṣẹgun ga ...
Aleluyà!
K'ọrun àt'ayé gberin ...
Aleluyà!

Iṣẹ ti ìdándè tán ... Aleluyà!
O jìjà, O ti sẹgun ...
Aleluyà!
Wo sisu ọrun kọja ...
Aleluyà!
Ko wọ sinu ẹjẹ mọ ...
Aleluyà!

Lásán n'ìsó àt'àmì ...
Aleluyà!
Krist' wo ọrun àpáàdì ...
Aleluyà!
Lásán l'agbara ikú ...
Aleluyà!
Kristi sí Párádísè ...
Aleluyà!

O tún wá ọba ógo ...
Aleluyà!
“Ikú, ìtàni rẹ dà?” ...
Aleluyà!
L’ẹẹkan l’O kú, ko gba wa
... Aleluyà!
“Bojì, ìṣẹgun rẹ dà?” ...
Aleluyà!

Ẹ jẹ ká wa gòkè lọ ...
Aleluyà!
S’ọdọ Krístì, Orí wa ...
Aleluyà!
A sá jínde pẹlú Rẹ ...
Aleluyà!
Bí a ti kú pẹlú Rẹ ...
Aleluyà!

Olúwa t’ayé t’ọrun ...
Aleluyà!
Tìrẹ ni gbogbo ìyìn ...
Aleluyà!
A wolẹ n’iwajú Rẹ ...
Aleluyà!
’Wọ àjínde àt’ìyè ...
Aleluyà!

englishTitle: REJOICE, THE LORD IS KING!

sections.text:
Rejoice, the Lord is King!
Your Lord and King adore;
Mortals, give thanks and sing,
And triumph evermore;
Lift up your heart lift up
your voice.
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice.

Rejoice in glorious hope;
Jesus the judge shall come,
And take His servants up
To their eternal home:
We soon shall hear
th'archangel's voice;
The trump of God shall
sound, rejoice!
Amen.

Ẹ yọ, Jésù j’ Ọba,
Ẹ wolẹ f’Ọba yin,
Ẹni kíkú s’ọpẹ
Y’ayo ’ṣẹgun títí,
Gb’ọkan at’ohun yin
soke,
“Ẹ yọ”, mo si tun wi,
“Ẹ yọ”.

Olùgbàlà jọba,
Ọlọrun òtítọ,
’Gbà t’ Ó wẹ’sẹ wa nù,
O gòkè lọ jókòó.

O ń bẹ lọdọ Baba,
Títí gbogbo ọtá
Yó tẹriíwọn ba,
Nípa àṣẹ Tirẹ.

Yọ n'ireti ògo
Onídàájọ ń bọ wá
Láti mú 'rànsẹ Rẹ,
Lọ 'lé ayérayé
A fe ghohun Angel'
ńlá náà
Ipe yó dun wi pe, “Ẹ
yọ.”
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THE LORD IS RISEN INDEED

sections.text:
The Lord is risen indeed
Is the glad message true?
Those who saw that the
Saviour died
Saw Him also risen.

The Lord is risen indeed
This is the truth indeed
Mercy and truth in warm
embrace
They were past enemies.

The Lord is risen indeed
Thy work is now complete
Our Savior broke the sting
of death
And pow'r of death
vanquished.

The Lord is risen indeed
The grave cannot hold Him
The saints who died also rose
And they shall no more die.
Amen.

“Oluwa ji lóòótọ,”
Ihin náà ha s'òòtọ?
Wọn ti rí p'Olugbala ku,
Wọn rí l'áàyè pẹlu.

“Oluwa ji lóòótọ”
Òòtọ ko fe ju yi;
Àánú at'otito pade,
Ti wọn ti ń s'ọta ri.

“Oluwa ji lóòótọ”
Ise Rẹ l'o se tan;
A dá ide onigbọwọ.
A sẹ apá iku.

“Oluwa ji lóòótọ”
Bojì kò le se' mọ:
Awọn t'o kú si jí pẹlu,
Wọn ki ó si kú mọ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHAT A WONDERFUL, WONDERFUL SAVIOUR

sections.text:
What a wonderful,
wonderful Saviour,
Who would die on the cross
for me!
Freely shedding His precious
life blood,
That the sinner might be
made free
He was nail'd to the cross
for me,
He was nail'd to the cross
for me,
On the cross crucified for me
He died;
He was nail'd to the cross
for me.

Thus He left His heavenly
glory
To accomplish His Father's
plan
He was born of the virgin
Mary,
Took upon Him the form
of man.

He was wounded for our
transgressions,
And He carried our sorrow
too;
He's the Healer of every
sickness,
This He came to the world
to do.

So He gave His life for others
In redeeming this world
from sin,
And He's gone to prepare a
mansion,
That at last we may enter in.
Amen.

Ìyanu ni Olùgbàlà wa,
Ẹni t'ó kú lórí igi,
Ó ta ẹ̀jẹ Rẹ sílẹ̀ fún wa;
Láti sọ wá d'òmìnira.
A kàn m'àgbélébúú fún mi;
A kàn m'àgbélébúú fún mi,
Ní'bẹ l' Ó jiyà t' Ó sì kú fún mi,
A kàn m'àgbélébúú fún mi.

Ó f'ilé ògo Rẹ sílẹ̀,
Láti se ìfẹ Baba Rẹ,
Ẹni t'á bí nínú Màríà;
Ó sì gbé àwórán wa wọ.

A s'A lí ọgbẹ 'torí wa,
Ó sì ru ìbànújẹ wa,
Olùwòsàn gbogbo àisan ni;
Èyí l Ó wá se lí ayé.

Báyìí l' Ó f'ẹmí Rẹ lélẹ̀,
Láti gbà wá nínú ẹ̀ṣẹ,
Ó ti lọ pèsè ààyè sílẹ̀
Ní'bi tí àwa yóó bá gbé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THERE IS A GREEN HILL FAR AWAY

sections.text:
There is a green hill far away,
Without the city wall,
Where the dear Lord was
crucified,
Who died to save us all.

We may not know, we cannot tell,
What pains He had to bear;
But we believe it was for us
He hung and suffered there.

He died that we might be forgiven,
He died to make us good,
That we might go at last to heaven,
Saved by His precious blood.

There was no other good enough
To pay the price of sin;
He only could unlock the gate
Of heaven and let us in.

O dearly, dearly has He loved,
And we must love Him too,
And trust in His redeeming blood,
And try His work to do.
Amen.

Oke kan nbe jinna rere
Leyin odi ilu,
N'ibi t'a kan Oluwa mo,
Eni t'o ku fun wa.

A ko le mo, a ko le so
B'irora Re ti to,
Sugbon a mo pe 'tori wa
L'O se jiya ni'be.

O ku k'a le r'idariji,
K'a le d'eni rere
K'a si le d'orun n'ikeyin
N'itoye eje Re.

Ko tun s'eni rere miiran mo
T'o le sanwo ese
Oun l' o le s'ilekun orun
K'o si gba wa s'ile.

Ha! B'ife Re ti s'owon to,
O ye k'a feran Re
K'a si gbekele eje Re
K'a si se ife Re.

englishTitle: HOLY BIBLE, BOOK DIVINE

sections.text:
Holy Bible, book divine,
Precious treasure,
thou art mine;
Mine, to tell me whence
I came
Mine, to teach me what I am.

Mine, to chide me when
I rove
Mine, to show a Saviour's
love;
Mine, art thou to guide
my feet;
Mine, to judge, condemn,
acquit.

Mine to comfort in distress,
If the Holy Spirit bless:
Mine, to show by living faith
Man can triumph over death.

Mine to tell of joys to come
Light and life beyond
The tomb
Holy Bible, book divine.
Precious treasure,
thou art mine.
Amen.

Bíbélì Mímọ t'Ọrun
Ọwọn ìsura t'èmi!
'Wọ tí ń wí bí mo ti rí;
'Wọ tí ń sọ bí mo ti wà.

'Wọ ń kọ mi, bí mo sànà,
'Wọ ń fi 'fẹ Olúwa hàn,
'Wọ ló ń tọ ísísẹ mi;
'Wọ ló ń d'áre àt'ẹbi.

'Wọ ní máa tu ni nínú,
Nínú wàhálà ayé,
'Wọ ń kọ ni, nípa 'gbàgbọ
Pé, a lè ṣẹgun ikú.

'Wọ lo ń sọ t'ayọ tí ń bọ,
Àt' ìparun ẹlẹsẹ,
Bíbélì Mímọ t'ọrun;
Ọwọn ìsura, t'èmi.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS LOVES ME THIS I KNOW
yorubaTitle: JÉSÙ FẸ MI, MO MỌ BẸẸ

sections.text:
Jesus loves me this I know,
For the bible tells me so
Little ones to Him belong,
They are weak, but He is strong

Yes, Jesus loves me
Yes, Jesus loves me
Yes, Jesus loves me
The Bible tells me so.

Jesus loves me He who died
Heaven's gates to open wide,
He will wash away my sin,
Let His little child come in

Jesus loves me, loves me still,
Thou' I'm very weak and ill,
From His shining throne on high,
Comes to watch me where I lie.

Jesus loves me He will stay
Close beside me all the way,
If I love him when I die,
He will take me home
On high.
Amen.

Jésù fẹ mi, Mo mọ bẹẹ.
Bíbélì l'ó sọ fún mi;
Tirẹ l'àwọn ọmọde.
Wọn kò l'ágbára, Òun ní.

Háà! Jésù fẹ mi
Háà! Jésù fẹ mi
Háà! Jésù fẹ mi
Bíbél' sọ fún mi bẹẹ.

Jésù fẹ mi síbẹ sí,
Bí èmi tilẹ s'àìsàn,
L'ór' àkéte àìsàn mi;
Yóó t'ìtẹ Rẹ wá sọ mi.

Jésù fẹ mi yóó dúró,
Tì mí ní gbogb' ọ̀nà mi,
'Gbà n bá f'ayé yìí sílẹ.
Yóó mú mi re'lé ọrun.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: AROUND THE THRONE OF GOD

sections.text:
Around the throne of God in heaven,
Thousands children stand!
Children whose sins are forgiven,
A holy, happy band;
Singing: glory, glory, glory.

In flowing robes of spotless white
See everyone array'd!
Dwelling in everlasting light;
And joys that never fade.
Singing, glory, glory, glory.

What brought them to that world above,
That heaven so bright and fair?
Where all peace and joy and love;
How came those children there?
Singing, glory, glory, glory.

Because the Saviour shed His blood
To wash away their sin;
Bathed in that precious purple flood,
Behold, them white and clean.
Singing glory, glory, glory.

On earth they sought the Saviour's grace,
On earth they love His Name:
So now they see His Blessed face;
And stand before the Lamb.
Singing, glory, glory, glory.

And is that fountain
flowing yet?
Blessed Saviour, lead us
there;
That we those happy ones
may meet,
And in there praises share;
Singing, glory, glory, glory
Amen.

Wòó! olúkúlùkù wọn wọ
Aṣọ àlà mímọ,
Nínú ìmọlẹ àìlópin;
Àt'ayọ tí kìí sá,
N kọrin, ògo, ògo, ògo.

Kí l'ó mú wọn dé ibẹ na?
Ọrun t'ó se mímọ,
Ní'b'aláàfìà àt'ayọ;
Bí wọn ti se dé'bẹ?
N kọrin, ògo, ògo, ògo.

Nítorí Jésù tà'jẹ Rẹ,
Láti k'ẹṣẹ wọn lọ,
A rí wọn nínú ẹjẹ náà,
Wọn di mímọ láúláú;
N kọrin, ògo, ògo, ògo.

Láyé, wọn wá Olùgbàlà,
Wọn fẹ orúkọ Rẹ,
Nísinsinyí, wọn r'ójú Rẹ,
Wọn wà níwájú Rẹ;
N kọrin, ògo, ògo, ògo.

Orísun náà ha ń sàn lónìí?
Jésú, mú wa dé'bẹ,
K'á lè àwọn mímọ náà
K'á sì bá wọn yìn O;
N kọrin, ògo, ògo, ògo.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I WANT TO BE LIKE JESUS
yorubaTitle: MO FẸ KÍ N DÀBÍ JÉSÙ

sections.text:
I want to be like Jesus
So lowly and so meek,
For no one marked
an angry word
That ever heard Him speak:

I want to be like Jesus,
So frequently in prayer,
Alone upon the mountain top
He met His father there.

I want to be like Jesus:
I never, never find
That he, though persecuted,
was,
To anyone unkind:

I want to be like Jesus,
Engaged in doing good
So that of me it may be said,
“She hath done what
she could.”

I want to be like Jesus,
Who kindly said to all,
“Let little children come to
me”
I would obey the call:

But oh! I'm not like Jesus,
As anyone may see,
O gentle Saviour,
send Thy grace,
And make me like to
Thee! Amen.

Mo fẹ kí n dàbí Jésù,
Nínú ìwà pẹlẹ,
Kò s'ẹni t'ó gbọ'rọ 'bínú,
L'ẹnu Rẹ lẹkan rí .

Mo fẹ kí n dàbí Jésù,
L'ádúrà 'gbà gbogbo,
L'órí òkè ni Oun nìkan;
Lọ pàdé Baba Rẹ.

Mo fẹ kí n dàbí Jésù,
Èmi kò ríi kà pé,
Bí wọn ti kórira Rẹ tó;
Ó s'ẹnikan ní'bi.

Mo fẹ kí n dàbí Jésù,
Nínú iṣẹ rere,
K'á lè wí nípa t'èmi pé;
“Ó se'wọn t'ó lè se!”

Mo fẹ kí n dàbí Jésù,
T'ó f'iyọnú wí pé,
“Jẹ k'ọmọdé wá s'ọdọ mi”;
Mo fẹ jẹ ìpè Rẹ.

Èmi yóó sì dàbí Jésù,
Ó ti se 'léri bẹẹ
Nípa Ẹmí oore-ọfẹ
“Se mí kí n dàbí Rẹ!”
Ààmín.

englishTitle: FAITHFUL SHEPHERD, FEED ME

sections.text:
Faithful Shepherd, feed me
By the pastures green
Faithful Shepherd, lead me
Where Thy steps are seen.

Hold me fast and guide me
In the narrow way.
So, with Thee beside me,
I shall never stray,

Daily bring me nearer
To the Heav'nly shore;
May Thy love grow dearer,
May I love Thee more.

Give me joy or sadness,
This be all my care
That Eternal gladness
I with Thee may share,

Day by day prepare me
As Thou seest best,
Then let Angel bear me
To Thy promised rest.
Amen.

Olùs'àgùntàn mi,
Máa bọ mi títí;
Olùs'àgùntàn mi,
Máa tọ ẹsẹ mi.

Dì mí mú, sì tọ mi,
Ní ọ̀nà híhá
B'ó bá wà l'ọdọ mi,
Èmi kì'ó sìnà.

Sìn mí s'ọ̀nà ọrun
Ní ojooJúmọ,
Máa bù sí 'gbàgbọ mi,
Sì mú mi fẹ Ọ.

K'áyo tàb ẹkún,
Ti ọdọ Rẹ wá;
Kí 'yè âinípẹkun
Lè jẹ ayọ mi.

Máa pèsè ọkàn mi
Ní ojooJúmọ;
Sì jẹ k'Áńgẹlì Rẹ,
Sìn mí lọ ilé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: OUR GREAT CAPTAIN AND OUR SAVIOUR

sections.text:
Our great Captain and our Saviour
These children we give
to Thee;
Pray, make them fit for
Thy service;
Heirs of life these children
are.

Thou the beauty of the Father
Make these little ones like Thee
Create them in Thy own image
Prepared for Thy courts above

Make them valiant warriors for Thee,
Soldiers brave and strong we pray.
Strong to vanquish hosts of Satan
And to overcome the world.

Let Thy words like coals of fire
In the mouth of Thy children
Burn sin totally to ashes
That our bodies be made whole.

Keep them all for Thy glorious work
And that spotless they may be;
Teach them all how to bear the cross
Each day they live here on earth .

Bless'd be the plan of salvation
For the good of these Thy youth;
Deliver them, lead them, watch them
And at last, do save their souls.
Amen

Balógun! Olùgbàlà wa.
Gb'ọmọ wọnyní t'á bùn Ọ,
Se wọn yẹ fún isẹ Tìrẹ.
Àrólé ìyè wọnyní.

Arẹwà Baba wa ọrun.
Mú k'áwọn wọn yí ọ Ọ,
N'nú àwòrán Tìrẹ pàápàá,
Lò wọn l'ágbàlá òkè.

Se wọn ń'jagunjagun mímọ,
Ọmọ-ogun t'o le'ra:
Kí wọn fọ ìtegun Èsù.
Kí wọn sì sẹgun ayé.

K'ọrọ Rẹ dàbí ògúnná,
L'ẹnu àwọn ọmọ Rẹ;
Tí y'ó jó ẹṣẹ l'ájóórun,
Kí wọn sì sẹgun ayé.

Pa wọn mọ fún 'sẹ ògo Rẹ,
Kí wọn wà láilábàwọn;
Kọ wọn láti r'ágbélébúú,
Lójoojúmọ ayé wọn.

Bù kún'lànà ìgbàlà yíì,
Fún ire ọmọ wọn yí;
Gbà wọn, tọ wọn, sì máa sọ wọn,
Ní 'kẹyìn gb' ọkàn wọn là.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: BY THE COOL SILOAN'S SHADY HILL

sections.text:
By the cool Siloan's
shady hill,
How sweet the lily grows!
How sweet the breath
beneath the hill,
Of Sharon's dewy rose?

Lo such the child whose
early feet,
The parts of peace have trod,
Whose secret heart with
influence sweet;
Is upward drawn to God.

By the cool Siloan's
shady hill,
The lily must decay,
The rose that blooms
beneath the hill;
Must shortly fade Divine.

O thou, whose infant feet
were found,
Within Thy Father's shrine,
Whose years with
changeless virtue crown'd;
Were all alike Divine.

Dependent on Thy
bounteous breath,
We seek Thy grace alone,
In childhood, manhood age
and death;
To keep us still Thine own.
Amen.

Bí osùn gbẹgẹ etí 'dò,
Tutù mini-mini,
Bí 'gbó dúdú etí omi,
Bí 'tànná ipadò.

Bẹẹ l'ọmọ náà yóó
dàgbà,
Tí ń rìn l'ọnà rere,
T'ọkàn rẹ ń fà sí Ọlọrun
Lát' ìgbà èwe rẹ.

Ewé tútù l'ẹba odò,
B'ó pẹ a rẹ dànù,
Bẹẹ n'ìtànná ipa omi;
Sì ń rẹ l'ákókò rẹ.

Ìbùkún ni fún ọmọ náà,
Tí ń rìn l'ọnà Baba,
Ọba tí kíi pa ipò dà;
Yóó máa se ààbò rẹ.

Olúwa, 'Wọ l'agbẹkẹlé,
Fún wa l'oore-ọfẹ,
L'éwe, l'ágbà, níbikíbi,
Pa wá mọ b'ọmọ Rẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: ALL THINGS BRIGHT AND BEAUTIFUL

sections.text:
All things bright and beautiful
All creatures' great and small
All things wise and wonderful
The Lord God made them all

Each little flower that opens
Each little bird that sings,
He made their glowing colours
He made their tiny wings.

The purple-headed mountain,
The river running by
The sunset, and the morning
That brightens up the sky.

The cold wind in the winter,
The pleasant summer sun,
The ripe fruits in the garden,
He made them every one.

He gave us eyes to see them
And lips that we might tell
How great is God Almighty,
Who has done all things well.
Amen.

Gbogbo ohun t'ó dára,
Gbogb'ẹdá alààyè,
Nnkan t'ó gbọn t'ó sì dára,
Ọlọrun ló dá wọn.

Gbogbo ìtànná t'ó ń tàn
Àti ẹyẹ tí ń kọrin,
Ó fún wọn l'áwọ dáadáa,
Ó tún fi 'yẹ fún wọn.

Gbogb' àwọn òkè gíga,
Àti odò ti ń sàn,
Ìrọlẹ àt'òwúrọ,
Fi 'mọlẹ s'ójú ọrun.

Afẹfẹ 'gbà òtútù,
Àti oòrùn tí ń ràn,
Èso tí ń so ń'nú ọgbà;
Òun ló dá gbogbo wọn.

Igi gíga ní igbó,
Pápá t'á ti ń s'iré,
Ewéko t'ẹbá odò;
T'á ń rí lójooújúmọ.

Ó fún wa lójú 'ríiran,
Ètè láti sọ'rọ,
Ọlọrun tó tóbì jùlọ,
Òun ló dá gbogbo
nnkan.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: THERE'S A FRIEND FOR LITTLE CHILDREN

sections.text:
There's a friend for little children,
Above the bright blue sky.
A friend who never changes,
Whose love can never die;
Unlike our friends by nature,
Who change with changing years,
This Friend is always worthy;
The precious name he bears.

There's a rest for little children,
Above the bright blue sky.
For those who love the Saviour,
And Abba father cry,
A rest from every trouble,
From sin and danger free,
Where every little pilgrim;
Shall rest eternally.

There's a home for little children,
Above the bright blue sky.
Where Jesus reigns in glory;
A home of peace and joy,
No home on earth is like it,
Nor can with it compare,
For every one is happy;
Nor can be happier there.

There's a crown for little children.
Above the bright blue sky.
And all who look to Jesus,
Shall wear it by and by.
A crown of brightest glory,
Which he will then bestow,
On those who found his favour;
And loved him here below.

There's a song for little children,
Above the bright blue sky.
A song that will not weary ,
Though sung continually;
A song, which even angels
Can never, never sing,
They know not Christ as Saviour;
But worship him as King.

There's a robe for little children,
Above the bright blue sky.
A harp of sweetest music,
A palm of victory,
All, all above is treasured,
And found in Christ alone;
Oh, come, dear little children,
That all may be your own.
Amen.

Ọrẹ kan ńbẹ fún ọmọdé,
L'ókè ọrun lọhùn-ún;
Ọrẹ tí kìí yí padà,
Tí'fẹ Rẹ kò lè kú;
Kò dàbí ọrẹ ayé,
Tí ó bàje l'ọdọọdún:
Ọrẹ yíi yẹ láti ję,
Orúkọ Rẹ ọwọn.

Ìsinmi kan ńbẹ fọmọdé,
L'ókè ọrun lọhùn-ún;
F'áwọn t'ó f'Ólùgbàlà,
Tí ń ké, “Àbà Bàbá”.
'Sinmi lọwọ ìyọnu,
Lọw'ẹṣẹ àti ewu,
Ní'bi àwọn ọmọdé,
Yóó sinmi títí láé.

englishTitle: LITTLE DROPS OF WATER

sections.text:
Little drops of water,
Little grains of sand,
Make the mighty ocean;
And the beauteous land.

And the little moments,
Humble though they be,
Make they mighty ages
Of eternity.

Little deeds of kindness,
Little words of love,
Make our earth an Eden;
Like the heav'n above.

So our little errors,
Lead the soul astray,
From the paths of virtue;
Into sin to stray.

Little seeds of mercy,
Sown by youthful hands,
Grow to bless the nations;
Far in heathen lands.

Little ones in glory,
Swell the angels' song;
Make us meet, dear Saviour,
For the holy throng.
Amen.

Ọpọ ìkán omi,
'Yanrìn kékèké,
'Wọnyí l'ó d'òkun nlá;
Àt'ilé ayé.

Ìṣẹjú wa kọọkan,
Tí a kò kà sí,
L'ó ń d'ọdún àimoye;
Ti àinípẹkun.

Ìwà oore díẹ,
Ọrọ 'fẹ díẹ,
L'ó ń s'ayé di Éden
Bí òkè ọrun.

Ìsise kékèké,
L'ó ń m'ọkàn sìnà,
Kúrò l'ọnà rere;
Sí ipa ẹṣẹ.

Isẹ àánú díẹ,
T'á se l'ọmọdé,
Dì 'bùkún f'órílẹ;
T'ó jìnnà réré.

Àwọn èwè l'ógo,
Ń gberin ángẹli;
Se wá yẹ, Olúwa,
F'ẹgbẹ mímọ wọn.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS, MEEK AND GENTLE

sections.text:
Jesus, meek and gentle,
Son of God Most High,
Pitying, loving Saviour,
Hear Thy children's cry.

Pardon our offences,
Loose our captive chains,
Break down every idol,
Which our soul detains.

Give us holy freedom,
Fill our hearts with love;
Draw us, holy Jesus,
To the realms above.

Lead us on our journey,
Be Thyself the way,
Through terrestrial
darkness;
To celestial day.

Jesus, meek and gentle,
Son of God Most night
Pitying, loving Saviour,
Hear Thy children's cry.
Amen.

Jésù Onírẹlẹ,
Ọmọ Ọlọrun,
Àláàánú, Olùfẹ;
Gbọ 'gbe Ọmọ Rẹ.

Fi ẹṣẹ wa jì wá,
Sì dá wa ní 'dè,
Fọ gbogbo òrìsà
Tí ńbẹ l'ọkàn wa.

Fún wa ní l'òminira,
F'ifẹ s'ọkàn wa;
Fà wá, Jésù mímọ
Sí 'bùgbé l'ókè.

Tọ wa l'ọnà àjò,
Sì jẹ ọnà wa,
La òkun ayé já;
Sí'mọlẹ ọrun.

Jésù Onírẹlẹ,
Ọmọ Ọlọrun,
Àláàánú, Olùfẹ;
Gbọ 'gbe Ọmọ Rẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHEN LITTLE SAMUEL WOKE

sections.text:
When little Samuel woke,
And heard his master's voice,
At ev'ry word he spoke,
How much did he rejoice?
Oh, blessed happy child
to find;
The God of heavn'n so near
and kind.

If God would speak to me,
And say He is my Friend,
How happy I should be
Oh how would I attend?
The smallest sin I then
should fear;
If God Almighty were so near.

And does, He never speak?
Oh, yes, for in His word,
He bids me come and seek,
The God that Samuel heard.
In almost ev'ry page I see,
The God of Samuel calls
to me.

And I beneath His care,
May safely rest my head,
I know that God is there;
To guard my humble bed.
And very sin I well may fear,
Since God Almighty is
so-near.

Like Samuel let me say,
When'er I read thy word,
Speak, Lord, I would obey;
The voice that I have heard,
And when I in Thy house
appear;
Speak for Thy servant waits
to hear.
Amen.

'Gbà tí Sámúẹl' jí,
T'ó gb'óhùn Ẹlẹda,
Ní gbólóhùn kọọkan,
Ayo rẹ ti pọ tó!
Ìbùkún ni f'ọmọ t'ó rí,
Ọlọrun nítosí rẹ bẹẹ.

Kò ha ń bá ni sọrọ?
Bẹẹ ni, ń'nú ọrọ Rẹ,
Ó ń pè mí láti wá,
Ọlọrun Sámúẹl;
Ń'nú ìwé náà ni mo kà pé,
Ọlọrun Sámúẹl ń pè mí.

'Gbà n bá ń ka ọrọ Rẹ,
Kí n wí bí Sámúẹl pé,
“Máa wí, Olúwa mi,
Èmi yóó gbọ Tirẹ”
Gba mo ba si wa n'ile Re
“Maa wi, tori ranse Re
n'gbo”
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS, WHO LIVED ABOVE THE SKY

sections.text:
Jesus, who lived above the sky,
Came down to be a Man and die;
And in the Bible we may see,
How very good He used to be.

He went about - He was so kind,
To cure poor people who were blind;
And many who were sick and lame,
He pitied them and did the same.

And more than that,
He told them, too,
The things that God would have them do,
And was so gentle and so mild,
He would have listened to a child.

But such a cruel death He died!
He was hung up and crucified!
And those kind Hands that did such good,
They nailed them to a cross of wood.

And so He died! - and this is why,
He came to be a Man and die!
The Bible says He came from Heav'n,
That we might have our sins forgiven.

He knew how wicked man had been,
And knew that God must punish sin;
So, out of pity, Jesus said,
He'd bear the punishment instead.
Amen.

Jésù t'ó wà l'ókè ọrun,
Sọkalẹ d'èniyàn, Ó kú;
Nínú Bíbélì l'a lè rí,
Bí Òun ti máa se rere.

Ó ń kiri, Ó sì ń se rere
Ó ń la'jú àwọn afojú;
Ọpọ àwọn t'ó sì yarọ,
Ó sáánú wọn, Ó sì wò wọn.

Sùgbọn ikú t'Ó kú burú;
A fi kọ s'ór'àgbélébú,
Ọwọ rere t'ó se nnkan yìí,
Wọn kàn-án mọ 'gi àgbélébúù.

Bẹẹ l'Ó kú nítorí yìí náà,
Ó d'èniyàn, k'ó ba lè kú;
Bíbélì ní Ó t'ọrun wá,
K'Ó lè dárí ẹsẹ ji ni.

Ó mọ b'èniyàn ti burú,
Ó mọ bí 'yà ẹsẹ ti rí,
Nínú àánú, Jésù wí pé,
Òun ó gba ìyà ẹsẹ jẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: DO NO SINFUL ACTION

sections.text:
Do no sinful action,
Speak no angry word;
Ye belong to Jesus,
Children of the Lord.

Christ is kind and gentle,
Christ is pure and true;
And His little children,
Must be holy too.

There's a wicked spirit,
Watching round your soul,
And he tries to tempt you,
To all harm and ill.

But ye must not hear him,
Though 'tis hard for you,
To resist the evil,
And the good to do.

For ye promised truly,
In your infant days,
To renounce him wholly,
And forsake his ways.

Ye are Christian soldiers,
Ye must learn to fight,
With the bad within you,
And to do the right.

Christ is your own Master
He is good and true,
And His little children,
Must be holy too.
Amen.

Má se hùwà ẹṣẹ,
Má sọrọ'bínú;
Ọmọ Jésù l'ẹ se,
Ọmọ Olúwa.

Kríst' ję Onínúre,
Àt'Ẹni mímọ;
Bẹẹ l'àwọn ọmọ Rẹ,
Yẹ k'ó ję mímọ.

Ẹmi ibi kan wà,
T'ó ń sọ ìrin rẹ;
Ó sì ń fẹ dán ọ wò,
Láti se ibi.

Ẹ má se gbọ tirẹ,
B'ó tilẹ soro,
Láti bá Èsù jà,
Láti se rere.

Ẹyin ti sè 'lérí,
Ní ọmọ ọwọ,
Láti k' Èsù sílẹ
Àti ọna rẹ.

Ọm'oogun Kríst'ni yín,
Ẹ kọ láti bá,
Ẹṣẹ inú yín jà,
Ẹ máa se rere.

Jésù l'Olúwa yín,
Ó se Ẹni 're;
Kí ẹyin ọmọ Rẹ,
Sì máa se rere.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HOSANNA! RAISE THE PEALING HYMN

sections.text:
Hosanna! raise the pealing hymn,
To David's Son and Lord;
With Cherubim and Seraphim,
Exalt the incarnate Word.

Hosanna! Lord, our feeble tongue,
No loft strains can raise:
But Thou will not despise the young,
Who meekly chant Thy praise.

Hosanna! Sovereign Prophet, Priest,
How vast Thy gifts, how free!
Thy blood, our life; Thy word, our feast
Thy name our only plea.

Hosanna! Master, lo, we bring
Our offerings to Thy throne:
Not gold, nor myrrh, nor mortal thing,
But hearts to be Thine own.

Hosanna! once Thy gracious ear
Approved a lisping throng;
Be gracious still, and deign to hear
Our poor but grateful song.

O Saviour, if, Redeemed by Thee,
Thy temple we behold,
Hosannas through eternity;
We'll sing to harps of gold.
Amen.

Hòsánà! Ẹ kọrin s'ókè,
S'ọmọ ńlá Dáfídì,
Pẹlú Kérúb' àti Séráf',
K'á yin Ọm'Ọlọrun.

Hòsánà! Èyí náà nìkan,
L'àhọn wa lè máa kọ!
Ìwọ kì ó k'ẹgán éwe
Tí ń kọrin ìyìn Rẹ.

Hòsánà! Àlùfáà, Ọba,
Ẹbùn Rẹ ti pọ tó!
Ẹjẹ Rẹ l'ó jẹ ìyè wa,
Ọrọ Rẹ ni oúnjẹ.

Hòsánà! Baba àwá mú,
Ọrẹ wa wá fún Ọ,
Kíi 'se wúrà tàb'ójìá,
Bí kò se ọkàn wa.

Hòsánà! Jésù lẹẹkan rí,
O yin àwọn èwe;
S'àánú fún wa, sì f'etí sí,
Orin àwa èwe.

Jésù b'Ó bá rà wá padà,
T'á sì wọ 'jọba Rẹ;
A ó fĩ fèrè wúrà kọ
Hòsánà! títí láé.
Ààmin.

englishTitle: JESUS, HIGH IN GLORY

sections.text:
Jesus, high in glory,
Lend a listening ear,
When we bow before Thee,
Children's praises hear.

Though Thou art so holy,
Heav'ns Almighty King,
Thou wilt stoop to listen,
When Thy praise we sing.

We are little children,
Weak and apt to stay,
Saviour guide and keep us,
In the Heav'nly way.

Then, when thou shall call us,
To our heav'nly home,
We will gladly answer,
Saviour, Lord, we come!
Amen.

Jèsù, t'ó pọ l'ógo,
Jọ'ọ, dẹ'tí sílẹ,
Gbọ 'yin àwa èwe,
B'á ti ń júbà Rẹ.

B' Ó ti jẹ mímọ tó,
Olódùmarè,
'Wọ yóó tẹ'tí sílẹ,
'Gbà t'á bá yin Ọ.

Gbà wá lọwọ ẹṣẹ,
Sọ wa l'ọjọọjọ;
Jẹ k'á lè fẹràn Rẹ,
Kó ẹṣẹ wa lọ.

englishTitle: WHEN JESUS ENTER'D THE TEMPLE

sections.text:
When Jesus enter'd the Temple,
The shout of praise, we heard,
The children acknowledged His right;
And they rejoic'd in Him.

Hosannah raise the Temple high,
And mixed with divers tongues,
Hosannah to the King of heav'n;
Unto the Davd's seed.

Renew our days, O Lord in Thee,
O when children praise Thee,
Great is Thy strength and goodness Lord;
As in the days of old. Amen.

'Gbà Jésù wọ Tẹmpìlì lọ,
Ohùn ìyin l'a gbọ;
Ọmọdé jẹwọ ẹtọ Rẹ,
Gbogbo wọn si ń yọ sí I.

Olúwa s'ọjọ wa d'ọtun,
'Gbà t'ọmọdé yin Ọ;
Agbára àt'oore Rẹ pọ,
Bí t'ọjọ ìgbàani.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: YE LITTLE ONES KEEP CLOSE TO GOD

sections.text:
Ye little ones keep close to God,
In trembling and humility,
Let all knees bow down before Him;
Our Lord and Saviour and our friend.

O Saviour, let Thy great mercy,
Fill us with gratitude to Thee,
And in our pilgrimage on earth;
May we receive more of Thy grace.

O Saviour, may all evil thoughts,
Be far away flung from our hearts,
And each day, give us Thy wisdom;
To choose to walk the narrow way.

In times of sickness and good health,
In time of plenty or in need,
And when the hour of death shall come;
Deliver us with Thy great pow'r.
Amen.

Ọmọdé ẹ sún m'Ọlọrun,
Pẹlú irẹle àt'ẹrú,
Kí eékún gbogbo wólẹ fún Un,
Olùgbàlà àt'ọrẹ wa.

Olúwa, jẹ k'áàánú Rẹ ílá,
Mú wa kún fún ọpẹ sí Ọ;
Àti b'á ti ń rin lọ l'áyé,
K'á máa rí ọpọ àánú gbà.

Olúwa m'èrò búburú,
Jinnà réré sí ọkàn wa;
L'ójooújúmọ fún wa l'ọgbọn
Láti yàn ọna tooro nì.

Ìgbà àìsàn àt'llera,
Ìgbà àìní tàbí ọrọ;
Àti l'ákókò ikú wa,
Fi agbára Tìrẹ gbà wa.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I CHERISH THEE, MY SUNDAY SCHOOL

sections.text:
I cherish thee my Sunday school
Oh how precious thou art,
Happy I am cheerful
And rejoice in thy joy.

I cherish thee my Sunday school,
Thy friends are numerous,
Both youths and elders come to sing,
Always long to see Thee.

I cherish thee my Sunday school,
Jesus established Thee,
Holy Spirit, Holy teacher
'Tis that cater for Thee.

I cherish thee my Sunday school,
We have the assurance
That God the Almighty Father
Has poured blessing on Thee.

I cherish thee my Sunday school,
Let sun be vehement,
The sky may be cloudy with rain
In Thee shall I e'er be.

I cherish thee my Sunday school,
I rejoice to see Thee,
Would thou pas me by unnoticed,
Today without blessing.
Amen.

Ilé-ẹkọ ọjọ 'sinmi,
Háà! Mo ti fẹ ọ tó
Inú mi dùn, mo dárayá.
Láti yọ ayọ rẹ.

Ilé-ẹkọ ọjọ 'sinmi,
Oore rẹ p'àpo̟jù
T'àgbà t'èwe wa ń kọrin
A ń se àfẹri rẹ.

Ilé-ẹkọ ọjọ 'sinmi,
Jésù lo ti kọ ọ
Ẹmi Mímọ Olùtùnú
L'ó sì ń se 'tọjú rẹ.

Ilé-ẹkọ ọjọ 'sinmi,
Àwa rí ẹrí gbà
P'Ọlọrun Olódùmarè
F'ìbùkún s'órí rẹ.

Ilé-ẹkọ ọjọ 'sinmi,
B'óòrùn ń ràn l'árànjù
Bí ọjọ sú dudu l'ọrun
Nínú rẹ l'èmi ó wà.

Ilé-ẹkọ ọjọ 'sinmi,
Mo yọ láti rí ọ,
Wọ kì yóó kojá lórí mi,
Loni láìrí 'bukun.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: CHRIST IS MADE THE SURE FOUNDATION

sections.text:
Christ is made the sure
Foundation.
Christ the Head and
Corner-stone,
Chosen of the Lord and
precious,
Binding all the Church in one,
Holy Zion's help for ever,
And her confidence alone.

To this Temple, where we
call Thee,
Come, O Lord of Hosts,
today;
With Thy wanted loving-
kindness
Hear Thy people as they
pray;
And Thy fullest benediction
Shed within its walls always.

Here vouchsafe to all Thy
servants
What they ask of Thee to gain,
What they gain from Thee
for ever
With the Blessed to retain,
And hereafter in Thy glory,
Evermore with Thee to reign.

Praise and honour to the
Father,
Praise and honour to the Son,
Praise and honour to the spirit
Ever three and ever one
One in Might, and One
In Glory,
While Eternal ages run.
Amen.

Krístì n'ìpìlẹ t'ó dájú,
Kríst' l'Orí àt' Igunlé
Àsàyàn àt' Iyebíye,
Ó so gbogbo ìjọ pọ;
Ìrànwọ Síonì Mímọ,
Ìgbẹkẹlé rẹ títí.

Fún àwọn ọmọ Rẹ l'ẹbùn,
Tí wọn bá tọrọ níhìn-ín,
Oore tí wọn bá sì rí gbà,
Kó máa ję ti wọn títí;
Ní'keyìn, nínú ògo Rẹ
Kí wọn máa bá Ọ jọba.

Ògo àt'ọlá fún Baba,
Ògo àt'ọlá f'Ọmọ,
Ògo àt'ọlá fún Ẹmí,
Mẹtalọkan títí láé;
Àt'ayérayé, ọkan náà.
Bákan náà títí ayé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: CHRIST IS OUR CORNER-STONE

sections.text:
Christ is our Corner-stone,
On Him alone we build,
With His true Saints alone
The courts of Heaven are filled
On His great Love,
Our hopes we place,
Of present grace,
And joys above.

Oh, then with hymns of praise,
These hallow'd courts shall ring:
Our voices we will raise,
The Three in One to sing:
And thus proclaim
In joyful song,
Both loud and long,
That glorious Name.

Here, gracious God do Thou
For evermore draw nigh;
Accept each faithful vow,
And mark each suppliant sigh;
In copious shower
On all who pray,
Each holyday
Thy blessings pour.

Here may we gain from Heaven
The grace, which we implore,
And may that grace, once given,
Be with us evermore;
Until that day,
When all the blest,
To endless rest,
Are call'd away.
Amen

Krístì n'ìpìlẹ wa,
L'órí Rẹ l'a ó kọ'lé,
Àwọn mímọ̀ nìkan
L'ó ń gb'àgbàlá ọrun;
Ìrétí wa t'oore ayé
T'ayọ̀ tí ń bọ wà ń'nú 'fẹ Rẹ.

Àgbàlá mímọ̀ yìí,
Yóó hó f'órin ìyin,
A ó kọrin ìyin s'I;
Mẹtalọkan Mímọ̀,
Bẹẹ la ó f'órin ayọ̀
K'ede orúkọ Rẹ títí ayé.

Ọlọrun Olóore,
Fí'yè sí mi níhìn-ín,
Gba ẹjẹ t'á mú wá,
Àt'ẹbẹ wa gbogbo;
K'Ó sì f'ọpọ 'bùkún dáhùn
Àdúrà wa, nígbà gbogbo.

Níhìn-ín, ję k'oore Rẹ,
T'á ń tọrọ lát'ọrun,
Bọ s'órí wa lẹ́kan,
K'ó má sì tún lọ mọ;
Tít'ọjọ náà t'á ó s'àkójọ
Àwọn mímọ̀ sí'bi 'sinmi.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WE LAY DOWN THIS FOUNDATION, LORD
yorubaTitle: A FI ÌPÌLẸ YÌÍ LÉ LẸ

sections.text:
We lay down this
foundation, Lord;
In Thy name, Our Lord
Jesus Christ,
We beseech Thee our dear
Saviour,
Keep this holy place in
Thy care.

And when these Thy
people seek Thee,
And sinners seek Thee in
this house,
Hear, Almighty from heave'n
above
O Lord our God,
forgive their sins.

When Thy minister preach
the Word,
The gospel of Jesus Thy Son,
Almighty God, in Thy great
name
Wrought out wonderful
miracles.

And when the little children
sing,
Their hymns of praise unto
their king
Let angels join them in
His praise
And earth and heav'n lend
their chorus,

Jehovah will Thou dwell
with us
In this our wicked, sinful
world?
Jesus Christ will Thou be
our King?
Holy Ghost will Thou find
rest here?

May Thy glory never depart
From this house that we are building
Make Thy kingdom within our heart
And establish Thy throne within.
Amen.

A fi ìpìlẹ yìí lé lẹ,
Ní orúkọ Rẹ Olúwa,
Àwá ń bẹ Ọ, Olúwa wa;
Máa tọjú ibi mímọ yìí.

'Gbà t'áwọn 'rànsẹ Rẹ
Níhìn-ín,
Bá ń wàásù 'yìnrere Krísti;
Síbẹ ję kí 'sẹ 'yanu ílá
Máa se nípa orúkọ Rẹ.

'Gb' àwọn ọmọde bá sì ń ké,
Hòsánà sí Krísti Ọba wọn,
K'ángẹlì bá wọn pẹlú,
K'ọrun àt' ayé jọ gberin.

Jèhòfà Ó ha bá ni gbé
Ní ayé búburú wa yìí?
Jésù Ó ha ję Ọba wa?
K'Ẹmí Mímọ sì máa gbé
hìn-ín?

Má ję kí ògo Rẹ kúrò
Nínú ilé tí a ń kọ yìí;
Sè 'jọba Rẹ ní ọkan wa,
Sì tę ìtę Rẹ sínú wa.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: O THOU WHOSE HAND HATH BROUGHT US

sections.text:
O Thou whose hand hath brought us
Upon this joyful day,
Accept our glad thanksgiving,
And listen as we pray,
And may our preparation
For this day's service be
With one accord to offer
Ourselves, O Lord to Thee.

For this new house we praise Thee
Reared at Thine own command,
For every gen'rous bosom,
And every willing hand;
And now within Thy temple
Thy glory let us see,
For all its strength and beauty
Are nothing without Thee,

And of as here wt gather
And heart in worship bland
May truth reveal it's power
And fervent prayer ascend
Here may the busy toiler
Rise to the thing above
The young, the old, be strengthen'd,
And all men learn Thy love.

And as the years roll onward.
And strong affections twine,
And tender mem'ries gather
About this sacred shrine.
May this its chiefest honour,
Its glory, ever be
That multitudes within it
Have found their way to Thee.

Lord God, our fathers' helper.
Our joy, and hope, and stay,
Grant now a gracious earnest
Of many a coming day
Our yearning hearts
Thou knowest;
We wait before Thy Throne:
O come, and by Thy presence
Make this new house Thine
own.
Amen.

'Wọ Ẹni tí ọwọ Rẹ.
Mú wa d'ọjọ óní,
Jọ'ọ, tęwọ gba ọpẹ wa
F'etí s'àdúrà wa;
Kí ìmúrasílẹ wa;
Fún ísìn óní ję,
Láti f'ara wa fún Ọ
Pẹl' ọkàn ìṣọkan.

Nígbà t'á bá ń pé jọ,
Láti jọsìn níhìn-ín,
Jẹ k'á r'ágbára òótọ
K'ádúrà wa gòkè;
K'ósísẹ gb'ọkàn s'ókè
Sí ohun ti ọrun,
Kí t'àgbà t'èwe l'okun;
Kí ayé mọ'fẹ Rẹ.

B'ọdún ti ń yí lu ọdún,
Tí ìfẹ tòótọ ń pọ
Sí ilé mímọ Rẹ yìí,
Tí a sì ń rántí Rẹ,
Kí ọlá àt'ògo Rẹ
Jẹ èyí títí láé
Pé, ọpọlọpọ t'ìhín,
Rí ọna s'ọdọ Rẹ.

'Rànwọ àwọn Baba wa,
Ayọ òun'rètí wa;
Olúwa fún wa l'ẹbùn
Ọpọ ọjọ l'áyé,
'Wọ mọ ẹdùn ọkàn wa,
A ńbẹ níwájú Rẹ,
Jọ'ọ, wá f'ojúrere Rẹ,
Se 'lé yìí ní Tirẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: GOD'S PEACE BE UNTO THIS HOUSE

sections.text:
God's peace be unto this
house
And all those dwelling therein
May God's peace from
heav'n above
Dwell on earth with men of
peace,
Let the Holy Ghost descend
That the blessing may come
down;
Prince of peace, receive
Thy crown
And the fullness of Thy grace.

Christ, Thou art my Lord and God
Let me Thy good herald be,
Remember Thy word, we pray
Visit them and visit me,
Let salvation enter in
This house and all that dwell there,
Deliver our hearts from sin
Make us Thy holy abode.

Do not let us grow weary
Till The promise is fulfilled.
Until we shall be Thine own
By our being sanctified;
Grant that our love be renewed
That we find our lost blessing
And may we be temple of
Father, Son and Holy Ghost.
Amen.

Àlàáfíà fún'lé yìí,
Àt'àwọn tí ń gbé'nú rẹ;
K'álàáfíà Ọlọrun
B'ẹni àlàáfíà gbé.
Jẹ kí Ẹmí sọkalẹ
Kí'bùkún náà bà lé wa!
Ọm'Àlàáfíà gb'adé Rẹ;
Ekún-rẹrẹ oor'-ọfẹ.

Krístì, 'Wọ l'Olúwa mi,
Jẹ kí n jẹ akéde Rẹ,
Má s'àìrántí ọrọ Rẹ;
Bẹ wọn wò, sì bẹ mí wò!
Kí'gbàlà wọ ilé yìí,
F'áwọn tí ń gbé inú rẹ,
Gba ọkàn wa lọwọ ẹṣẹ,
Fi wa se ìbùgbé Rẹ.

Má se jẹ k'a se àárẹ,
Títí ìlérí náà yóó sẹ,
Títí a ó fi jẹ Tirẹ,
Nípa ìṣọdimímọ;
Fún wa ní'fẹ àkọtun,
K'á lè rí're t'ó sọnù;
K'á jẹ Tẹńpil' Ọlọrun,
Baba, Ọmọ àt'Ẹmí.
Aàmín.

englishTitle: LORD, DISMISS US WITH THY BLESSING
yorubaTitle: FI ÌBÙKÚN RẸ TÚ WA KÁ

sections.text:
Thanks we give, and adoration.
For Thy Gospel's joyful sound;
May the fruits of Thy salvation
In our hearts and lives abound:
May Thy presence, may Thy presence
With us evermore be found.

So, whene'er the signal's given.
Us from earth to call away
Borne on angels' wings to heaven.
Glad the summons to obey.
May we ever, may we ever
Reign with Christ in endless
day.
Amen.

englishTitle: GOD BE WITH YOU TILL WE MEET AGAIN!
yorubaTitle: K'OLORUN SO O K'A TUN PADE!

sections.text:
God be with you till
we meet again!
By His counsel guide,
uphold you.
With His sheep securely
fold you:
God be with you till we meet
again.

Till we meet, till we meet.
Till we meet at Jesus' feet.
Till we meet, till we meet
God be with you till we
meet again.

God be with you till
we meet again,
'Neath His wings protecting
hide you,
Daily manna still provide you
God be with you till we meet
again,

God be with you till we meet again
When life's perils thick confound you
Put His arms unfailing round you
God be with you till we meet again.

God be with you till we meet again,
Keep love's banner floating o'er you,
Smite death's threat'ning wave before you.
God be with you till we meet again.
Amen.

K'á pàdé K'a tun pàde!
K'á pàdé lese Jésù;
K'á pàdé, K'á pàdé!
K'Ọlọrun sọ ọ k'a tún
pàdé!

K 'Ọlọrun sọ ọ k'á tún pàdé!
K'o f'iye Rẹ dáàbo bo ọ,
K'ó máa pèsè fún àiníi rẹ,
K'Ọlọrun sọ ọ k'a tún pàdé!

K 'Ọlọrun sọ ọ k'á tún pàdé!
Nígbà t' éwu bá yí ọ ká,
K'ó fọwọ 'fẹ Rẹ gbá ọ mú,
K'Ọlọrun sọ ọ k'a tún pàde.

K 'Ọlọrun sọ ọ k'á tún pàdé!
K'ó fi ìfẹ ràdọ bò ọ,
K'ó pa oró ikú fún ọ,
K 'Ọlọrun sọ ọ k'á tún pàdé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: IN THE HOUR WE HAVE TO PART

sections.text:
In the hour we have to part,
Let us all commend ourselves,
To the watchful eye and heart
Of our dearest and close Friend.

Jesus Christ, hear Thou our pray'rs,
Thou, the guardian of Thy sheep;
May Thy mercy and Thy care,
All our hearts in safety keep.

Grant that we have strength through Thee,
Add pleasure to every pain;
Spare our lives we pray, Dear Lord,
Until we shall meet again.
Amen.

Ní àkókò ìpinyà,
Jẹ kí a fi ara wa,
S'ábẹ ojú àt'ọkàn,
Ọrẹ kòríkòsùn wa.

Jésù gbọ àdúrà wa,
'Wọ tí ń sọ àgùntàn Rẹ,
K'áàánú àt'ìtọjú Rẹ,
Pa gbogbo ọkàn wa mọ.

K'á l'ágbára nípa Rẹ,
F'adùn sí'rora gbogbo,
K'Ó sì dá ẹmí wa sí;
Títí a ó fi tún pàdé.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WITH THE SWEET WORD OF PEACE
yorubaTitle: ỌRỌ ÀLÀÁFÍÀ L'A FI SÌN YÍN

sections.text:
With the sweet word of peace,
We bid our brethren go;
Peace as a river, to increase,
And ceaseless flow.

With the calm word of pray'r,
We earnestly commend,
Our brethren to Thy
watchful care,
Eternal Friend.

With the strong word of Faith,
We stay ourselves on Thee;
That Thou O Lord in life and
death,
Their help shall be.

Farewell in hope and love,
In faith and peace and prayer,
Till He whose home is ours
above;
Unite us there.
Amen.

Ọrọ àlàáfíà,
La fi sìn yín, ará,
K' àlàáfíà bí odo ńlá
Máa bá yín lọ.

Ńnú ọrọ àdúrà,
A f'àwọn ará wa,
Lé ìṣọ Olúwa lọwọ;
Ọrẹ tòótọ.

Ọrọ ìfẹ dídùn,
La fi p'òdigbòòse,
Ìfẹ wa àti t'Ọlọrun;
Yóó bá wọn gbé.

Ọrọ 'gbàgbọ líle,
Ni ìgbẹkẹlé wa,
Pé Olúwa yóó se'rànwọ;
Nígbà gbogbo.

Ọrọ 'rètí dídùn,
Yóó mú 'pinyà wa dùn,
Yóó sọ ayọ t'ó lè dùn ju;
Ayọ t' ayé.

Ó d'ìgbòòse ará,
Ní'fẹ àt'ìgbàgbọ,
Tít'a ó fi tún pàdé l'ókè;
Ní'lé l'ọrun.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JESUS WE LOOK TO THEE

sections.text:
Jesus we look to Thee,
Thy promised presence claim,
Thou in the midst of us
shalt be;
Assembled in Thy name.

Thy name salvation is,
Which here we come to pride,
Thy name is life, and health,
and peace
And everlasting love.

Not in the name of pride,
Or selfishness we meet;
From nature's paths we turn aside,
And worldly thoughts forget.

We meet, the grace to take,
Which Thou hast freely given,
We meet on earth for thy dear
sake;
That we may meet in heaven.

Present we know Thou art,
But O Thyself reveal!
Now, Lord, let every
bounding heart,
Thy mighty comfort feel.

Jésù, 'Wọ li a ń wò,
A dì 'lérí Rẹ mú,
Pé 'Wọ yóó wà l'áàrin àwa
T'ó pé jo l'óókọ Rẹ.

Oókọ Rẹ n'ìgbàlà,
Tí a ń wá láti mọ;
Ìyé, àlàáfíà lóokọ Rẹ,
Àt'ìfẹ àilópin.

Kíi se ní'gbéraga,
Tàb'àinífẹ tòótọ,
La yà kùrò l'ọnà t'ẹda,
T'á wá pàdé níhìn-ín.

A wá gba oor'ọfẹ,
T'Ó fi fún wa l'ọfẹ,
A pé jo l'áyé ńtorí Rẹ;
K'á lè pé jo l'ọrun.

A mọ p'Ó wà níhìn-ín,
Sùgbọn, f'ara Rẹ hàn!
Olúwa, ję kí gbogbo wa,
Mọ ìtùnú ńlá Rẹ.

englishTitle: AND LET OUR BODIES PART

sections.text:
And let our bodies part,
To different climes repair,
Inseparably joined in heart,
The friends of Jesus are.

Jesus, the cornerstone,
Did first our hearts unite,
And still He keeps our spirits one;
Who walk with Him in white.

O let us still proceed,
In Jesus' work below,
And, following our triumphant Head;
To further conquest go.

The vineyard of their Lord,
Before His labourers lies;
And, lo! We see the vast reward,
Which waits us in the skies.

O let us hearts and mind,
Continually ascend,
That haven of repose to find;
Where all our labours end.

Where all our toils are o'er'
Our suff'ring and our pain,
Who meet on that eternal shore,
Shall never part again.

O happy, happy place,
Where saints and angels meet,
There we shall see each other's face;
And all our brethren greet.

The church of the first-born;
We shall with them be blest,
And, crowned with endless joy, return
To our eternal rest.
Amen.

A ó pínyà l'ára lọ,
S'ónirúurú ilú,
Sùgbọn àwọn ọrẹ Jésù
Wà ní'sọkan ẹmí.

Jésù, Olórí wa,
L'ó da ọkàn wa pọ,
Àwa t'á ń b'A rìn ní mímọ;
L'ó sọ d'ọkan l'ẹmí.

Jẹ ká tę síwájú,
Nínú iṣẹ Jésù;
K'á máa tẹlé Olùṣẹgun,
K'á bá lè ṣẹgun sí.

Ọgbà Olúwa ńbẹ,
Ní'wájú Ońṣẹ Rẹ;
Àwa sì wo èrè ńlá náà,
Tí a ń lọ bá l'ókè.

K'ífẹ àt'èrè wa
Gòkè ní'gbà gbogbo,
Láti d'ébùúté 'sinmi nì;
Ní'bi t'sẹ wa pin.

Ní'bẹ ní'sẹ wa tán,
Ìyà òun 'rora wa!
L'ébùúté ayérayé nì;
A kì yóó pínyà mọ.

Ìlú àlàáfíà,
T'áwọn mímọ pàdé!
Ní'bẹ la ó r'ójú ara wa.
T'á ó yọ mọ ara wa.

englishTitle: ON THE RESURRECTION MORNING

sections.text:
On the Resurrection morning
Soul and body meet again:
No more sorrow, no more weeping.
No more pain!

Here a while they must be parted.
And the flesh its Sabbath keeps,
Waiting in a holy stillness,
Wrapt in sleep.

For a while the tired body
To its resting place is borne;
Till there dawns the last and brightest
Eastern morn.

But the soul in contemplation
Utters earnest prayer and strong,
Bursting at the Resurrection.
into song.

Soul and body reunited
Thenceforth nothing shall divide,
Waking up in Christ's own likeness.
Satisfied.

Oh! the beauty, oh! the gladness
Of that Resurrection day,
Which shall not through endless ages
Pass away!

On that happy Easter morning
All the graves their dead restore;
Father, sister, child, and mother,
Meet once more.

To That brightest of all meetings
Bring us, Jesus Christ, at last;
To Thy Cross, through death and judgment,
Holding fast.
Amen.

L' òwúrọ ọjọ àjinde.
T'ara t'ọkan yó pade,
Ẹkun, 'káàànu oun irora
Yo dopin.

Níhin, wọn kò lè sàì pinya
Ki ara ba le sinmi
Ko si fi ìdákẹ rọrọ
Sùn fọnfọn.

Fun 'gba die ara àárẹ yíì
La gbe si 'bi 'sinmi rẹ
Titi di imọlẹ òórọ
Àjinde.

Sugbon ọkan to ń s'àsàrò
To si ń gbàdúrà kíkan
Yo bu s'orin ayọ lọjọ
Àjinde.

Ara at'ọkan yó dapọ.
Ipinya ko ni si mọ;
Wọn wa l'aworan Krist' ni
'Tẹlọrun.

A! ẹwà náà àt'ayọ náà
Yó ti pọ tó l'Àjinde!
Yó dúró bọrun àtayé
Bá fò lọ.

L'òórọ ọjọ ajinde wa
'Boji yo m'oku re wa
Baba, iya, omo, ara
Yo pade.

Sí 'dàpọ tí ó dùn báyìí,
Jésù má sài kà wá yẹ;
Ń'nú 'kú, 'dájo, ká lè rọ
M'a-gbélébúú.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: PLEASANT ARE THY COURTS ABOVE

sections.text:
Pleasant are Thy courts above,
In the land of light and love
Pleasant are thy courts below,
In this land of sin and woe,
Oh, my spirit longs and faints
For the converse of Thy saints,
For the brightness of Thy face,
For Thy fullness,
God of grace.

Happy birds, that sing and fly
Round Thy altars, O Most High;
Happier souls that find a rest
In a heavenly Father's breast;
Like the wandering dove, that found
No repose on earth around,
They can to their ark repair,
And enjoy it ever there.

Happy souls their praises flow
Ever in this vale of woe;
Waters in the desert rise,
Manna feeds them from the skies,
Oh they go from strength to strength,
Till they reach Thy throne at length
At Thy feet adoring fall,
Who hast led them safe through all.

Lord, be mine prize to win
Guide me through a world of sin,
Keep me by Thy saving grace,
Give me at Thy side a place
Sun and shied alike Thou art,
Guide and guard my erring heart;
Grace and glory flow from Thee
Shower, o shower them, Lord, on me.
Amen.

Bùgbé Rẹ ti l'ẹwà tó
N'ilé 'mọlẹ àt'ifẹ
Bùgbé Rẹ ti l'ẹwà tó
Láyé ẹṣẹ àt'òsì
Ọkàn mi ń fà nítòótọ
Fún ìdàpọ èèyàn Rẹ
Fún ìmọlẹ ojú Rẹ,
Fún ẹkún Rẹ Ọlọrun.

Àyọ bá àwọn ẹyẹ,
Tí ń fò yí pẹpẹ Rẹ ká;
Ayọ ọkàn t'ó sinmi
L'àyà Bàbá l'ó pọjù,
Gẹgẹ b'àdàbà Nóà
Tí kò rí 'bi sinmi lé
Wọn padà s'ọdọ Bàbá,
Wọn sì ń yọ títí ayé.

Wọn kò sinmi ìyìn wọn
Nínú ayé òsi yìí;
Omi ń sun ní aginjù
Mánà ń t'ọrun wá fún wọn;
Wọn ń lọ lát'ipá dé 'pá
Títí wọn fi yọ sí Ọ
Wọn sì wólẹ lẹṣẹ Rẹ
T'ó mú wọn la ewu já.

Bàbá jẹ kí ń j'èrè bẹ
S'amọnà mi láyé yìí
F'oore-ọfẹ pa mí mọ
Fún mi l'áàyè lọdọ Rẹ.
Ìwọ l'oòrùn àt'asà
Tọ ọkàn ìsìnà mi;
Ìwọ l'Orísun oore
Rọ òjò rẹ sórí mi.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JERUSALEM MY HAPPY HOME

sections.text:
Jerusalem my happy home,
Name ever dear to me,
When shall my labours have an end
In joy, and peace, and thee.

When shall these eyes
Thy heaven built walls,
And pearly gates behold,
Thy bulwarks with salvation strong,
And streets of shining gold.

There happier bowers than Eden's bloom,
Nor sin nor' sorrow know;
Blest seats through rude and stormy scenes
I onward press to you.

Why should I shrink from pain and woe,
Or feel at death dismay?
I've Canaan's goodly land in view,
And realms of endless day.

Apostles, martyrs, prophets, there
Around my Saviour stand,
And soon my friends in Christ below
Will join the glorious band.

Jerusalem my happy home,
My Soul still pants for thee
Then shall my labour have an end,
When I thy joys shall see.
Amen.

Jerusalem ibi ayọ,
T'ó se ọwọn fún mi
'Gbàwo n'iṣẹ mi ó parí
Layo l'àlàáfià?

'Gbàwo ni ojú mi y'ó rí
Ẹnu-bodè Pearl Rẹ
Òdi Rẹ t'ó le fún 'gbàlà
Ìta wúrà dídán.

'Gbàwo, ìlú Ọlọrun mi
L'èmi ó d'ààfin Rẹ?
Níbi tí ijọ kíí túká
Níb'ayọ àìlópin.

Èése t'èmi ó kọ ìyà
Ikú àt'ìpọnjú?
Mo ń wo ilẹ rere Kénaan,
Ilẹ 'mọlẹ títí.

Àpọstéli, Martyr, Wòlíì,
Wọn y'Olùgbàlà ká:
Awa tikára wa, fẹrẹ
Dàpọ mọ ogun náà.

Jerusalem ilú ayọ,
Ọkàn mi ń fà sí Ọ;
'Gbàtí mo bá rí ayọ rẹ
Isẹ mi y'ó parí.
Aàmín,

englishTitle: AT THE END OF THIS WICKED LIFE

sections.text:
At the end of this wicked life
Life of sorrow and vanity
A good place there exists
There remain no changes of life
Excepting day there is no night
Tell me wouldst thou be there?

Its glorious gate shuts away sins
Things filthy never attend it
To mingle its beauty
By its beautiful surroundings
We hear no more of damnations
Tell me wouldst thou be there?

Only the meek shall reach its ground
Who worship the Lord with reverence
Who never mind the world
Who or by Holy Ghost guided
Who by the narrow road walketh
They alone would be there.

Lẹyìn ayé búburú yíì,
Ayé ẹkún òun òsì yíì,
Ibi rere kan wà
Àyípadà kò sí níbẹ,
Kò s'òru, àf'ọsán títí,
Wí mi,'wọ ó wà ní'bẹ?

'Lẹkùn Ògo rẹ tì m'ẹṣẹ
Ohun èérí kò lè wọ'bẹ
Láti b'ẹwà rẹ ję
L'ébúté Dáradára nì
A kò ní gbúròó ègún mọ
Wí mi,'wọ ó wà ní'bẹ?

Ta n' y'ó dé' bẹ? Onírẹlẹ
T'ó f'ìbẹrù sin Olúwa,
T'wọn kò náání ayé;
Àwọn t'á f'Ẹmí Mímọ tọ,
Àwọn t'ó ń rìn lọ̀nà tóóro,
Àwọn ni ó wà ní'bẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JERUSALEM ON HIGH

sections.text:
Jerusalem on high
My song and city is
My home whene'er I die,
The centre of my bliss.
Oh happy place,
when shall I be
My God, with Thee,
to see Thy face.

There dwells my Lord
My King,
Judged here unfit to live;
There angels to Him sing
And lowly homage give.

The patriarchs of old
There from their travels cease;
The prophets there behold
Their long'd for Prince
Of Peace.

The Lamb's apostles there
I might with joy behold,
The harpers I might hear
Harping on harps of gold.

The bleeding martyrs they
Within those courts are found,
Clo-thed in pure array
Their scars with glory crown'd.

Ah, woe is me, that I
In Kedar's tents here stay
No place like that on high
Lord thither guide my way.
Amen.

Jerusalẹm' t'ọrun
Orin mi ìlú mi!
Ilé mi bí n bá kú,
Ẹkún ìbùkún mi;
Ibi ayọ!
Nígbàwo l'èmi
Ó r'ojú Rẹ
Ọlọrun mi?

Ní'bẹ l'Ọba mi wà,
T'a dá lẹbi láyé
Ángẹli ń kọrin fún Un
Wọn sì ń tẹríba fún Un.

Patriak ìgbàànì,
Par 'àjò wọn níbẹ
Àwọn wòlíì, wọn ń wo
Ọmọ Aládé wọn.

Ní'bẹ ni mo lè rí
Àwọn Àpóstélì
Àt'àwọn Akọrin
Tí ń lu harpù wúrà.

Ní àgbàlá wọn-nì
Ni àwọn Martyr wà;
Wọn wọ aṣọ àlà,
Ògo bo ọgbẹ wọn.

T'èmi yìí sá sú mi
Tí mo ń gb'àgọ Kédarì!
Kò sí 'rú 'yíi lókè
Ní'bẹ ni mo fẹ lọ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: FOREVER WITH THE LORD

sections.text:
For ever with the Lord:
Amen, so let it be
Life from the dead is in that word
“Tis immortality.”
Here in the body pent,
Absent from Him I roam,
Yet nightly pitch my moving tent
A day's march nearer home.

My Father's house on high,
Home of my soul, how near
At times to faith's foreseeing eye
Thy golden gates appear
Ah, then my spirit faints
To reach the land I love;
The bright inheritance of saints,
Jerusalem above.

Yet clouds will intervene,
And all my prospect flies;
Like Noah's dove, I flit between,
Rough seas and stormy skies,
Anon the clouds depart,
The winds and waters cease,
While sweetly o'er my gladden'd heart
Expands the bow of peace.

I hear at morn and even,
At noon and midnight hour
The choral harmonies of heaven,
Earth's babel tongues o'er power
That resurrection world
That shout of victory,
Once more, For ever with the Lord;
Amen, so let it be.
Amen.

“Láé lọdọ Olúwa!”
Ààmín béè ni k'ó rí
Ìyè wà nínú ọrọ náà,
Àikú ni títí láé
Níhìn-ín nínú ara
Mo sáko jìnnà sí I
Síbẹ, alaale ni mo ń fi,
Ọjọ kan sún mọlé!

Ilé Bà'mi lókè,
Ilé ọkàn mi ni;
Èmi ń fi ojú ìgbàgbọ
Wo bodè wúrà rẹ
Ọkàn mi ń fà púpọ,
S'ilé náà tí mo ń fẹ
Ilé dídán t'àwọn mímọ,
Jérúsálẹm' t'ọrun

Àwọsánmọ dide,
Gbogbo èrò mi pin
Bí àdàbà Núà mo ń fò
Láàrin ìjì líle,
Sùgbọn sánmọ kúrò,
Ìjì sì rékọjá
Ayo àti àlàáfíà
Sì gba ọkàn mi kan.

Lóóórọ àti lálẹ,
Lọsàn-án àti lóru
Mo n gbọ orin ọrun bori
Rúdurùdu ayé,
Òórọ àjínde ni,
Híhó ìṣegun ni,
Lẹẹkan síi, “Láé lọd'Olúwa”
Ààmín, bẹẹ ni kó rí.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WE SPEAK OF THE REALMS OF THE BLEST
yorubaTitle: A Ń SỌRỌ ILẸ BÙKÚN NÌ

sections.text:
We speak of the realms of the blest,
Of that country so bright and so fair,
And oft are its glories confess'd
But what must it be there.

We speak of its pathways of gold,
Of its walls deck'd jewels most rare,
Its wonders and pleasures untold;
But what must it be to Be there.

We speak of its freedom from sin,
From sorrow, temptation, and care,
From trials without and within;
But what must it be to be there.

We speak of its anthems of praise,
With which we can never compare
The sweetest on earth we can raise;
But what must it be to be there.

A ń sọrọ ilẹ 'bùkún nì,
Ilẹ dídán àt'ilẹ ẹwà,
'Gbàgbogbo l'a ń sọ t'ògo rẹ;
Y'ó ti dùn tó láti dé 'bẹ!

A ń sọrọ ilẹ wúrà rẹ,
Ọsọ odi rẹ tí kò l'ẹgbẹ
Fàájì rẹ kò seé fẹnu sọ
Y'ó ti dùn tó láti dé 'bẹ!

A ń sọ p'ẹṣẹ kó sí níbẹ,
Kó s'àníyàn àt'ìbànújẹ
Pẹlú 'dánwò lóde nínú;
Y'ó ti dùn tó láti dé 'bẹ!

A ń sọrọ orin ìyìn rẹ,
Tí a kó lè f'orin ayé wé,
B'ó ti wù k'orin wa dùn tó;
Y'ó ti dùn tó láti dé 'bẹ!

A ń sọrọ Ìsìn ìfẹ rẹ,
Ti agbádá t'àwon mímọ
ń wọ,
Ìjọ àkọbi ti òkè;
Y'ó ti dùn tó láti dé 'bẹ!

Jọọ, Olúwa, t'ibi t'ire
Sá se ẹmí wa yẹ fún ọrun
Láipẹ àwa náà yóò mọ;
B'ó ti dùn tó láti dé 'bẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: JERUSALEM MY HAPPY HOME WHEN

sections.text:
Jerusalem, my happy home,
When shall I come to thee?
When shall my sorrows have an end?
Thy joys when shall I see?

O happy harbour of the saints!
O sweet and pleasant soil!
In thee no sorrow may be found
No grief, no care, no toil.

In thee no sickness may be seen,
No hurt, no ache, no sore;
There is no death nor ugly devil
There's life for evermore.

Jerusalem, Jerusalem,
God grant I once may see
Thy endless joys, and of the same
Partaker aye to be!
Amen.

Jèrúsálẹmù ìlú ayọ mi,
Nígbàwo ni èmi ó tọ ọ wá?
Nígbàwo ni ìbànújẹ mi yóó pin?
Nígbàwo ni n ó rí ayọ rẹ?

Ibi ìsinmi t'ènìyàn mímọ!
Ilẹ dídára nì!
Kò sí'dààmú, kò sí ẹrù,
Kò sí 'bànújẹ ńbẹ

A kò lè rí àìsàn nínú rẹ
Tábí 'palára kan
Ikú kó sí, èsù kó sí
Ìyè ni títí láé.

A kò lè rí ọ̀rìnrìn ńbẹ
Bẹẹ ni kò s'òtútù
Níbẹ, gbogbo ọkàn mọlẹ
Fún 'mọlẹ t'Ọlọrun.

Ìfẹ-kúfẹ kò sí níbẹ
Kò sí oní-lara
Òru, ebi, kò sí lọhùn-ún
Ayọ ló gb'òde kan.

Jèrúsálẹmù dídára
Ọlọrun ká mí yẹ
Níbẹ l'ayọ àìlópin wà
Kí n lè bá wọn gbé'bẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: IN THE LAND OF FADELESS DAY
yorubaTitle: N'ILẸ TÍ ỌJỌ KÌ Ń SÚ

sections.text:
In the land of fade-less day
Lies the city four square,
It shall never pass away,
And there is no night there.
God shall wipe a-way all tears,
There's no death, no pain, nor fears,
And they count not time by years,
For there is no night there.

All the gates of pearl are made
In the city foursquare,
All the streets with gold are laid,
And there is no night there.

And the gates shall never close,
To the city foursquare,
There life's crystal river flows,
And there is no night there.

There they need no sunshine bright,
In the city foursquare,
For the Lamb is all the light,
And there is no night there.
Amen.

N'ilẹ tí ọjọ kì ń sú
N'ilú Ọlọrun wa
Ìlú náà yóó wà títí
Kò sì s'òru níbẹ
Bàbá yóó n'omijé nù
Kò sí kíka àkókò
'Torí kò s'òru níbẹ

Ẹnu ọna rẹ jẹ pearli
N'ilú Ọlọrun wa,
Ìta rẹ sì jẹ wúrà
Kò sì s'òru níbẹ.

A kì ń ti ẹnu ọna
T'ilú Ọlọrun wa,
Omi iyè ń sàn níbẹ
Kò sì s'òru níbẹ.

Wọn kò fẹ 'tànsán òòrun
Ní'lúù Ọlọrun wa
'Torí Kríst' ni 'mọlẹ rẹ
Kò sì s'òru níbẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: OH PARADISE, OH PARADISE

sections.text:
Oh paradise, oh paradise,
Who doth not crave for rest?
Who would not seek the happy land,
The mansion of the blest.
Where loyal hearts, and true
Stand over in the light,
All rapture, through and through
In God's most holy sight.

Oh paradise, oh paradise,
The world is growing old
Who would not be at rest and free
Where love is never cold.

Oh paradise, oh paradise,
I want to sin no more
I want to be where Jesus is
Upon thy spotless shore.

Oh paradise, oh paradise,
I shall not wait for long
E'en now the loving ear may catch
Faint fragments of thy song.

Lord Jesus, King of Paradise,
Oh keep me in Thy love,
And guide me to that happy land
Of perfect rest above.
Amen.

Párádísè! Párádísè!
Tani kò fẹ sinmi?
Tani kò fẹ 'lẹ ayọ náà,
Ilẹ alábùkún;
Níb' àwọn olóòótọ
Wà láé ninu 'mọlẹ
Wọn ń yọ nígbà gbogbo,
Níwájú Ọlọrun

Párádísè! Párádísè!
Ayé ń darúgbó lọ
Tani kò sì fẹ lọ sinmi!
Níb' ifẹ kíi tutù?

Párádísè! Párádísè!
Mo fẹ kí n yé d'ẹṣẹ,
Mo fẹ kí n wà l'ọdọ Jésù
Lí èbúteé mímọ;

Jésù, Ọba Párádísè
Pa mí mọ ń'nú 'fẹ Rẹ
Mú mi dé ilẹ ayọ náà
Níb' ìsinmi l'ókè.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I AM A STRANGER HERE, HEAVEN

sections.text:
I am a stranger here,
Heav'n is my home
Only a sojourner,
Heav'n is my home
Danger and sorrow stand
Round me on every hand
Heav'n is my Fatherland
Heav'n is my home.

What though the tempest rage
Heav'n is my home
Short is my pilgrimage
Heav'n is my home
And time's wild wintry blast
Soon will be over-past,
I shall reach home at last
Heav'n is my home.

There at my Saviour's side
Heaven is my home
I shall be glorified
Heaven is my home
Where all the saints of God,
After life's weary road
Have their divine abode
Heav'n is my home

Therefore I'll murmur not
Heaven is my home
Whate'er my earthly lot,
Heaven is my home
And I shall surely stand
There at my Lord's right hand
Heav'n is my Fatherland
Heav'n is my home.
Amen.

Níhìn-ín mo j'àlejò,
Ọrun n'ilé
Àtìpó ni mo ń se
Ọrun n'ilé
Éwu òun 'bànújẹ
Wà yí mi káàkiri
Ọrun ni ilú mi,
Ọrun n'ilé.

B'ìjì bá tilẹ ń jà
Ọrun n'ilé
Kúkurú l'àjò mi,
Ọrun n'ilé
Ìjì líle tí ń jà,
Fẹrẹ kojá lọ ná
N ó sá dé 'lé dandan
Ọrun n'ilé

Lọdọ Olùgbàlà
Ọrun n'ilé
À ó se mí lógo
Ọrun n'ilé
Níb' àwọn mímọ wà,
Lẹyin 'rìn àjò wọn
Tí wọn ní 'sinmi wọn
Níbẹ n'ilé.

Njẹ n kì ó kùn, torí
Ọrun n'ilé
Ohun t'ó wù kí n rí
Ọrun n'ilé
N ó sá dúró dandan,
L'ọtún Olúwa mi:
Ọrun ni ìlú mi.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WE'VE NO ABIDING CITY HERE

sections.text:
We've no abiding city here
This may distress the
worldling's mind;
But should not cost the saint
a tear,
Who hopes a better rest
to find.

We've no abiding city here:
Sad truth, were this to be
our home;
But let the thought our
spirits cheer,
We seek a city yet to come.

O sweet abode of peace and love:
Where pilgrims freed from toil are blessed
Had I the pinions of a dove,
I'd fly to thee and be at rest.

A kò ní 'bùgbé kan
níhìn-ín,
Èyí ba ẹlẹṣẹ ńnú jẹ,
Kò yẹ k'èniyàn
Mímọ káàánú,
Torí wọn ń fẹ 'sinmi t'ọrun.

A kò ní 'bùgbé kan níhìn-ín
Ó burú bí'hìn-ín jẹ 'lé wa;
Kí'róò yìí mú inú wa dùn,
Awa ń wá ìlú ńlá t'ó ń bọ.

A kò ní 'bùgbé kan níhìn-ín,
A n wá ìlú ńlá t'a kò rí;
Síon ìlú Olúwa wa,
Ó ń tàn ìmọlẹ títí láé.

Ìwọ tí ń se 'bùgbé ìfẹ
Ibi tí èrò gbé ń sinmi;
Èmi bá ní'yẹ b'àdàbà
N bá fò sínú rẹ, n bá sinmi,

Dákẹ ọkàn mi, má bínú,
Àkókò Olúwa l'ó yẹ;
T'èmi ni láti se 'fẹ Rẹ,
Tirẹ láti se mí lógo.
Àmín.

englishTitle: HERE WE SUFFER GRIEF AND PAIN

sections.text:
Here we suffer grief and pain
Here we meet to part again;
In heaven we part no more.
Oh that will be joyful!
Joyful, joyful, joyful!
Oh, that will be joyful
When we meet to part no more.

All who love the Lord below
When they die to heaven will go,
And join with saints above.

Little children will be there,
Who have sought the Lord
By prayer
From every Sunday school.

Teachers, too will meet above,
Pastors, parent, whom we love,
Shall meet to part no more.

Oh, how happy we shall be!
For our Saviour we shall see
Exalted on His throne.

There we all shall sing for joy,
And eternity employ
In praising Christ the Lord.
Amen.

Níhìn-ín l'àwa ń jẹ 'rora
Níhìn-ín ni a máa pínyà
L'ọrun kò sí 'pinyà,
Áà! bí ó ti dùn tó!
Dun to, dun to, dun to!
Áà! bí ó ti dùn tó,
'Gbà t'a kì ó pínyà mọ

Àwọn t'ó fẹràn Jésù,
Wọn o lọ sókè ọrun,
Lọ b'àwọn t'ó ti lọ

Bí a ó ti yọ pọ to!
'Gbà t'a bá r'Olùgbàlà,
Ní orí ìtẹ Rẹ!

Ní'bẹ l'a ó kọrin ayọ
Títí ayé àìlópin,
L'a ó máa yin Jésù.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: SHALL WE GATHER AT THE RIVER

sections.text:
Shall we gather at the river
Where bright angels’ feet have trod;
With its crystal tide for ever
Flowing by the throne of God

On the margin of the river
Guided by our Shepherd King
We will walk and worship ever,
His dear footsteps following.

But before we gain the river
Lay we every burden down,
Jesus, here from sin deliver
Those whom there Thy grace will crown.

Soon we'll reach the crystal river,
Soon our pilgrimage will cease;
Soon our golden harp-strings quiver
With the melody of peace.
Amen.

A o pàdé létí odò,
T'ẹṣẹ ángẹlì ti te;
T'ó mọ gaara bíi krístàlì
Lẹbáà ìtẹ Ọlọrun?

A ó pàdé létí odò,
Odò dídán,
odò dídán náà,
Pẹl' àwọn mímọ
lẹbáà odò
T'ó ń sàn lẹbáà ìtẹ nì.

Létí bèbè odò náà yìí,
Pẹl' Olùs'àgùntàn wa,
A ó máa rin, a ó máa sìn
B'á ti ń tẹle 'pasẹ Rẹ.

K'á tó dé odò dídán náà
A ó s'ẹrù wa kalẹ
Jésù, jọọ gba ẹrù ẹṣẹ
Àwọn tí O ó dé l'ádé.

Nje l'ẹbàá odò tútù náà,
A ó r'ojú Olùgbàlà
Èmí wa kì ó pínyà mọ
Yóó kọrin ògo Rẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HARK, HARK, MY SOUL ANGELIC SONGS
yorubaTitle: GBỌ, ỌKAN MI BÍ ANGẸLI TI Ń KỌRIN

sections.text:
Hark, hark, my soul, angelic songs are swelling
O'er earth's green fields and ocean's wave beat shore;
How sweet the truth those blessed strains are telling
Of that new life when sin shall be no more.
Angels of Jesus,
Angels of light,
Singing to welcome the pilgrims of the night.

Onward we go, for still we hear singing,
Come weary souls for Jesus bids you come
And thro' the dark, its echoes sweetly ringing
The music of the gospel leads us home.

Far, far away, like bells at evening pealing
The voice of Jesus sounds o'er land and sea;
And laden souls by thousands meekly stealing
Kind Shepherd, turn their weary steps to Thee.
Amen.

B'á sì ti ń lọ, bẹẹ l'a sí ń gbọ orin wọn,
Wá, aláàárẹ, Jésù l'ó ní k'ẹ wá;
L'ókùnkùn ni a ń gbọ orin dídùn wọn,
Ohùn orin wọn ni ń fọnà hàn wá,

Ohùn Jésù ni a ń gbọ l'ọnà réré,
Ohùn náà ń dún b'agogo y'áyé ká,
Ẹgbẹẹgbẹrun àwọn t'ó gbọ ni sì ń bọ:
Mú wọn w'ọdọ Rẹ, Olùgbàlà wa.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: WHEN THE TRUMPET OF THE LORD

sections.text:
When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound
And time shall be no more,
And the morning breaks, eternal, bright and fair
When the saved of earth shall gather
Over on the other shore,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there.

On that bright and cloudless morning,
When the dead in Christ shall rise,
And the glory of His resurrection share,
When His chosen ones Shall gather
To their home beyond the skies
And the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there.

Let me labor for the Master
From the dawn till setting sun,
Let me talk of all His wondrous love and care
Then when all of life is over
And my work on earth is done,
And the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there.
Amen.

'Gbà tí ipè Olúwa bá dún
t'ayé yó sì fò lọ

bá péjo l'òkè
T'a bá sì ń p'orúkọ lohun-un
n ó wà ńbẹ.

'Gbat' a ba p'oruko lohun-un
'Gbat' a ba p'oruko lohun-un

òkú ń'nú Kríst’ yóó jínde

Ògo àjínde
