englishTitle: WHEN JESUS COMES TO REWARD
yorubaTitle: 'GBÀ JÉSÙ DÉ LÁTI F'ÈRÈ FÚN WA

sections.text:
When Jesus comes to reward
His servants,
Whether it be noon or night,
Faithful to Him will He find
us watching
With our lamps all trimmed
and bright
Oh can we say we are
ready, brother?
Ready for the soul's
bright home?
Say, will He find you
and me still watching,
Waiting, waiting when the
Lord shall come?

If at the dawn of the early
morning,
He shall call us one by one.
When to the Lord we restore
our talents
Will He answer thee,
“Well-done”?

Have we been true to the
trust He left us?
Do we seek to do our best?
If in our hearts there is
naught condemns us,
We shall have a glorious rest?

Blessed are those whom the
Lord finds watching,
In His glory they shall share;
If He shall come at the dawn
or midnight,
Will He find us watching
there?

'Gbà Jésù dé láti f'èrè
fún wa,
Yálà l'ọsán tàb'álẹ,
Y'ó ha bá wa k'á máa
f'òótọ sọnà,
K'àtùpà wa sì máa jó.
A hà lè wí pé a setán, Ará,
Fún 'lé wa dídán lókè?
Wí! yóó ha bá 'wọ àt'
èmi ń sọnà
Sọnà, sọnà,
ń'gb' Olúwa ó dé?

Nje bó bá ję l'òòró
kùtùkùtù,
Tó bá pè wá ní kọọkan
'Gbà t'á bá dá Tálẹ́ntì
wa padà
Yó ha wí fún ọ, “O seun”?

A ha sòótọ s'èyí
t'Ó fi fún wa
Gbogbo ipá wa l'a ń sà
Tí kò bá sí 'dálẹbi lọkàn wa,
'Sinmi ológo la ó ní?

Bùkún l'àwọn tí Kríst' rí
Tó ń sọnà
Wọn ó pín ń'nú ògo Rẹ
Bí l'ààárọ tàbí ọgànjọ òru
Yó ha bá wa bẹ ń sọnà?
Ààmín.

englishTitle: SLEEP ON BELOVÈD, SLEEP AND TAKE THY REST
yorubaTitle: MÁA SUN, OLUFẸ K'O SI MÁA SINMI

sections.text:
Sleep on belovèd,
Sleep and take thy rest;
Lay down thy head upon thy
Saviour's breast:
We love thee well;
But Jesus loves thee best,
Good night! Good night!
Good night!

Calm is thy slumber as an
infant's sleep;
But thou shall wake no more
to toil and weep;
Thine is a perfect rest
secure and deep,
Good night! Good night!
Good night!

Until the shadows from this
earth are cast
Until He gathers in His
sheaves at last;
Until the twilight gloom is
over-past;
Good night! Good night!
Good night!

Until the Easter glory lights
the skies;
Until the dead in Jesus
shall arise,
And He shall come but not
in lowly guise;
Good night! Good night!
Good night!

Only “Good night”
beloved, not “farewell!”
A little while and all his
saints shall dwell'
In hallowed union,
indivisible,
Good night! Good night!
Good night!

Until we meet again before
His throne,
Clothed in the spotless robe
He gives His own;
Until we know even as we
are known;
Good night! Good night!
Good night!
Amen.

Máa sùn, Olùfẹ k'o si
Máa sinmi
Gb'ori rẹ le aya Olugbala
A fẹ ọ sugbọn Jésù fẹ ọ jù,
Sùn 're, sùn 're, sùn 're.

ọmọde,

Titi a o fi ko ikore 'wọle,
Titi ọyẹ aye yio fi la,
Sùn're, sùn 're, sùn 're.

Titi oorun àjínde y'o fi yọ,
T'awon òku ń'nú Jésù
y'o dìde
Oun y'o si wa nínú ọlá-ńlá
Rẹ,
Sùn're, sùn 're, sùn 're.

Titi ẹwá ọrun 'yo jẹ tirẹ,
Ti iwọ o máa ràn nínú ògo
Oluwa y'o de ọ l'ade wura
Sùn 're, sùn 're, sùn 're.

O d'òwúrọ sa ni, olufẹ mi,
A tun fẹrẹ ri 'ra ná; ní'bi tí
Ìpinyà ati ítúká kò sí,
Sun 're, sun 're, sun 're.

Tit' aó fi pade niwaju 'tẹ Rẹ,
Nín'asọ ìgúnwà àwọn Tirẹ
Tit' aó mọ gẹgẹ bí a ti
Mọ wa.
Sùn 're, sùn 're, sùn 're.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: HOW SWEET THE HOUR OF CLOSING DAY

sections.text:
How sweet the hour of
closing day,
When all is peaceful and
serene,
And the broad sun's retiring
ray
Shead a mild lustre o'er
the scene!

Such is The Christian's
parting hour,
So peacefully he sinks to rest;
And faith, rekindling
all its pow'r,
Lights up the languor
of his breast.

There is a radiance in his eye,
A smile upon his wasted
cheek,
That seems to tell of glory
nigh,
In language that no tongue
can speak.

A beam from heav'n is sent to cheer,
The pilgrim on his gloomy road.
And angels are attending near,
To bear him to their bright abode.

O Lord, that we may thus depart
Thy joys share Thy face to see,
Impress Thine image on our heart,
And teach us now to walk with Thee.
Amen.

Igba asalẹ ti dùn tó!
Ti a rẹ ohun gbogbo,
'Gba ti ìtànsán oòrùn alẹ
Bá ń tàn 'mọlẹ s'ohun
gbogbo!

Bẹẹ ni 'kẹyìn onigbagbo,
Oun á sinmi l'alàáfíà;
Igbagbo t'o gbona janjan
A mọlẹ nínú ọkàn rẹ.

Ìmọlẹ kan mọ l'oju Rẹ,
Ẹrin sì bo ní ẹnu rẹ;
O ń f'èdè t'ahọn wa kò mọ,
Sọrọ ògo t'o sun mọ 'le.

Ìtànsán 'mọlẹ t'ọrun wá
Lati gbàá ni 'yànjú l'ọna
Awọn angẹli duro yíi ká
Lati gbé e lọ sí 'bugbe wọn.

Oluwa, ję k'a lọ báyìí,
K'a ba Ọ yọ, k'a r'oju Rẹ;
Tẹ aworan Rẹ s'ọkan wa
Si kọ wa b'a tií bá Ọ rìn.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: I AM BOUGHT NOT FOR RICHES
yorubaTitle: A KÒ RÀ MI PẸL' ỌRỌ

sections.text:
I am bought not with riches,
Neither silver nor gold;
But Christ hath redeemed me,
I am safe in His fold;
In the Book of His Kingdom with its pages so fair,
Through Jesus my Savior, My name's written there!
My name's written there
On the page white and fair,
In the Book of God's Kingdom,
My name's written there.

My sins, they were many,
Like the sands of the sea,
But the blood of my Savior,
Is sufficient for me
For His promise is written
In bright letters that glow,
“Tho' your sins be as scarlet,
I will make them like snow”.

Oh that beautiful city,
With its mansions of light,
With its glorified beings,
In pure garment of white;
Where no evil thing cometh
To despoil what is fair,
Where the angels are watching,
My name's written there.
Amen.

A kò rà mí pẹl'ọrọ,
Fàdákà òun wúrà;
Sùgbọn Kríst rà mi padà,
Mo sì wọ 'nu agbo;
Nínú ìwé 'jọba Rẹ
Tí ó l'ẹwà púpọ,
Nípasẹ Olùgbàlà, Orúkọ mi wà ńbẹ.
Orúkọ mi wà ńbẹ
Nínú ìwé ńlá nì;
Ìwé ti ìjọba Rẹ,
Orúkọ mi wà ńbẹ

Ẹṣẹ mi pọ púpọ,
Bí iyanrìn òkun,
Sùgbọn ẹjẹ Rẹ Jésù,
Ti tó fún gbogbo wọn;
'Torí 'Wọ ti se'lérí,
Nínú ọrọ Rẹ pé,
“B'ẹṣẹ rẹ pọn b'òdòdó,
Èmi ó fọ ọ mọ láú.”

N'ílú dáradára nì,
Àt'ọpọ 'bùgbé rẹ,
Ní'bi t'àwọn mímọ wà,
Ń'nú aṣọ funfun wọn,
'T'ohun èérí kò lè dé,
Láti b'ẹwà rẹ jẹ,
'Bi t'àwọn áńgẹlì ń sọ;
Orúkọ mi wà ń bẹ.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: AH! THEY'VE SAILED TO OTHER SIDE

sections.text:
Ah! they've sailed to other side,
In Heavens, in Heavens,
No more hunger there again
They are free from every pain
In Heavens, in Heavens.

Ah! they need no light again,
In Heavens, in Heavens;
It is light at every time
Jesus supplies every light
In Heavens, in Heavens.

Ah! the streets are paved
with gold,
In Heavens, in Heavens;
Their glory can't be assessed,
They all belong to Jesus
In Heavens, in Heavens.

Ah! they never attract cold,
In Heavens, in Heavens;
Their cold seasons come
no more
All weather are bright and gay
In Heavens, in Heavens.

There they won't fight
anymore,
In Heavens in Heavens;
Jesus was their deliverer
They with Him keep
compa-ny
In Heavens, in Heavens.

Ah! yonder they weep
no more,
In Heavens in Heavens
Jesus stays always with them
He supplies them every joy,
In Heavens, in Heavens.

Ah! we shall mingle
with them;
In Heavens, in Heavens;
We are expecting our turns
When the Lord shall call us up
To Heavens to Heavens.
Amen.

Háà! wọn ti gún s'ébúté
Lókè ọrun; lókè ọrun;
Ebi kò ní pa wọn mọ,
Wọn bọ lọwọ ìrora,
Lókè ọrun; lókè ọrun.

Háà! wọn kò wá fitílà,
Lókè ọrun; lókè ọrun;
'Mọlẹ ni l'ọjọ gbogbo,
Jésù ni Ìmọlẹ wọn
Lókè ọrun; lókè ọrun.

Háà! wọn dẹkun ìjà 'jà,
Lókè ọrun; lókè ọrun;
Jésù l'ó ti gbà wọn là,
T'àwọn Tirẹ l'ó sì ń rìn,
Lókè ọrun; lókè ọrun.

Háà! wọn kò ní sọkún mọ,
Lókè ọrun; lókè ọrun;
A ń retí àkókò wa,
'Gbà Olúwa bá pe ni,
Lókè ọrun; lókè ọrun.

Haa A ò dapo mo wọn
Loke ọrun; loke ọrun
A n reti akoko wa
'Gba Oluwa ba pe ni
S'oke ọrun; S'oke ọrun
Ààmín.

englishTitle: BROTHER, THOU ART GONE BEFORE US

sections.text:
Brother, thou art gone
before us,
And thy saintly soul is flown
Where tears are wiped from
every eye,
And sorrow is unknown.

From the burden of thy flesh,
And from care and fears
re-leased
Where the wicked cease
from troubling
And the weary are at rest.

The toilsome way thou'st
travell'd o'er
And borne the heavy load,
But Christ hath taught thy
languid feet
To reach His blest abode

Thou art sleeping now like
Lazarus
Upon his Father's breast
Where the wicked cease
from troubling
And the weary are at rest.

Sin can never taint thee now,
Nor doubt thy faith assail;
Nor thy meek trust in
Jesus Christ
And the Holy Spirit fail.

And there thou'rt sure to
meet the good
Whom on earth thou
lovedst best.
Where the wicked cease
from troubling
And, the weary are at rest

Earth to earth, and dust
to dust,
The solemn priest hath said,
So we lay the turf above
thee now,
And we seat thy narrow bed.

But thy spirit, brother,
soars alway
Among the faithful blest,
Where the wicked cease
from troubling
And the weary are at rest.

And when the Lord shall summon us
Whom thou hast left be-hind
May we, untainted by the world
As sure a welcome find.

May each like thee, depart in peace
To be a glorious guest,
Where the wicked cease from troubling

Ará, ìwọ sí/wájú wa lọ
Ẹmí rẹ mí/mọ sì ti fò lọ
Sí'bi tí kò ní/s'ẹkún mọ;
Tí/ kò sí ìrora.

Àti lọwọ/áníyàn aye\é;
Ní'bẹni búburú/yé yọnu,

'Wọ ti rin àjò/ayé já,
O ti/gb' àgbèélébùú rẹ;
Kríst ti fi ẹṣẹ rẹ/lé ọna,
Láti/dé ib'ìsinmi

Bíi Lásárù/ló sì sùn,
L'óó/k'àyà Bàbá rẹ,
Ní 'bẹni búburú yé yọnu

Ẹṣẹ kò lè/bà ọ jẹ mọ
I/yèmèjì d'ópin

Àt'Ẹmí/kò ní yẹ mọ láé.

Àwọn ọrẹ/t'ó ti lọ saájú;

Awa sì kó e/rùpẹ bò ọ
A sì/sàmì s'orí rẹ.

Ní 'bẹni búburú yé yọnu

'Gbà t' Olúwa bá sì pè
À/wa t'ó kù lẹyìn;
Olúwa wa,/àwa bẹ Ọ
K' á/yé má bà wá jẹ.

K'olúkúlùkù wa,
B'á/rá wa yíi,
Lè rí/ààyè lọdo Rẹ
Ní 'bẹni búburú yé yọnu

englishTitle: WHEN OUR HEADS ARE BOW'D WITH WOE

sections.text:
When our heads are bow'd with woe,
When our bitter tears o'erflow,
When we mourn the lost, the dear,
Jesus, Son of Mary, hear.

Thou our throbbing flesh hast worn,
Thou, mortal griefs hast borne,
Thou hast shed the human tear;
Jesus, Son of Mary, hear.

When the heart is sad within
With the thought of all its sin;
When the spirit shrinks with fear,
Jesus, Son of Mary, hear.

Thou the shame, the grief
hast known
Though the sins were not
Thine own,
Thou hast deign'd their load
to bear;
Jesus, Son of Mary, hear.

Thou hast pass'd through
death's dark shade;
Thou hast full atonement
made,
Thou to God's right hand
art near;
Son of God, Emmanuel, hear.
Amen.

'Gbà t'a kún fún 'bànújẹ,
'Gb'omijé ń sàn lójú wa;
'Gbà t'a ń sọkún t'a ń sọfọ,
Olùgbàlà, gbọ tiwa.

'Gbà t'ọkàn wa bá bàjẹ
Nítorí ẹṣẹ t'a dá;
'Gbà t' ẹrù bá b'ọkan wa
Olùgbàlà, gbọ tiwa.

'Wọ ti mọ ẹrú ẹṣẹ,
Ẹṣẹ tí kíí se Tìrẹ,
Ẹrú ẹṣẹ náà l'O gbé,
Olùgbàlà, gbọ tiwa.

O ti sí'lẹkùn ikú,
O ti s'ètùtù fẹṣẹ;
O wà lọw'ọtún Bàbá,
Olùgbàlà, gbọ ti wa.
Ààmín.

englishTitle: FADING AWAY LIKE THE STARS
yorubaTitle: A Ó KOJÁ LỌ BÍ ÌRÀWỌ ÒWÚRỌ

sections.text:
Fading away like the stars of
the morning,
Losing their light in the
glorious sun:
Thus would we pass from
the earth and its toiling;
Only remembered by what
we have done.
Only remembered,
Only remembered,
Only remembered by what
we have done;
Thus would we pass from
the earth and its toiling;
Only remembered by what
we have done.

Shall we be missed, though
by others succeeded;
Reaping the fields we in
spring-time have sown:
Yes, but the sowers must
pass from their labours;
Ever remembered by what
they have done.

Only the truth that in life
we have spoken,
Only the seed that on earth
we have sown:
These shall pass onward
when we are forgotten;
Fruits of the harvest and
what we have done.

Oh, when the Saviour shall
make up His jewels,
When the bright crowns of
rejoicing are won:
Then shall His weary and
faithful disciples;
All be remembered by what
they have done.
Amen.

A ó kojá lọ bí ìràwọ òwúrọ,
Ògo wa yóó wọ ní ọsán
gangan:
Kúrò nínú làálàá ayé yí;
A ó se'ràntí wa nípa
ohun t'á se.
A ó se'ràntí, a ó se'ràntí,
A ó se ràntí wa níp'ohun
t'á se;
T'á bá ré kojá inú làálàá
ayé yí;
A ó se'ràntí wa níp' ohun
t'á se.

Sé wọn yóó dárò wa nígbà
t'á bá lọ?
Sé a ó lè kórè ohun
tí a ti gbìn?
Dandan l'a gbọdọ fi làálàá
yíì sílẹ:
Títí láélaé ni wọn yóó
ràntí wa.

Àfi òtítọ́ tí a ti sọ l'áyé,
Pẹlú àwọn 'rúgbìn
tí a ti gbìn,
Wọnyí yóó máa j'ẹlẹrí 'gbé
ayé wa;
Irú èso tí ayé wa ti so.

Nígbà t'Olúwa yóó wá
k'áyànfẹ Rẹ,
Nígbà t'ádé ológo yóó
jẹ ti wọn:
'Gbà náà l'àwọn olóòtọ
ọm' ẹyin Rẹ;
L'a ó se 'rántí wọn níp'
ohun t'ọn ti se.

englishTitle: I'VE REACHED THE LAND OF CORN AND WINE
yorubaTitle: MO TI DÉ ILẸ RERE NÁÀ

sections.text:
I've reached the land of corn
and wine,
And all its riches freely mine,
Here shine undimmed one
blissful day,
For all my night has passed
away.
O Beulah land, sweet
Beulah land,
As on thy highest mount
I stand
I look away across the sea.
Where mansions are
prepared for me,
And view the shining glory
shore
My heaven, my home for
ever more!

My Saviour comes and walks with me,
And sweet communion here have we,
He gently leads me by His hands
For this is heaven's border-land.

A sweet perfume upon the breeze,
Is borne from ever vernal trees,
And flowers that never fading, grow.
Where streams of life forever flow.

The zephyrs seem to float to me,
Sweet sounds of heaven's melody,
As angels with the white-robed throng,
Join in the sweet redemption song.
Amen.

Olùgbàlà wá s'ọdọ mi,
Nínú ìdàpọ t'ó l'ádùn;
Ó fọwọ Rẹ jęję sìn mí,
Lọ sí ilé rere l'ọrun.

Afẹfẹ olóòórùn dídùn;
Fẹ jęję lát'orí igi,
Ìtànná tí kò lè kú láé
Ní'bi t' odò 'mi ìyè ń sàn.

Orin dídùn wá s'étí mi,
Ohùn orin t'ó dùn jùlọ,
Àwọn ángẹl'l'ásọ àlà;
Wọn ń kọ orin ìràpadà.
Ààmín.
